entries.name: Heavy Ammo Finder
entries.text: Grants a 1.33x|1.66x|2x multiplier to all Heavy Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Weft Cutter
entries.text: 20 Direct Hits on a target within 1 second of each other applies Sever for 10 seconds (15 seconds with Thread of Continuity) and grants you Woven Mail for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Chaotic Exchanger
entries.text:
Grants 20% Damage Resistance while overcharging a Void Grenade with Chaos Accelerant.
Overcharged Grenade Hits apply Weaken for 6 seconds and grant additional base grenade Regeneration Rate depending on the equipped grenade for 1.75 seconds.
• Axion: 5000% [4000%]
• Scatter: 3700% [2700%]
• Vortex: 3400% [2400%]
• Handheld Supernova: 2500% [2000%]
4 second cooldown between activations, which is removed on grenade usage. Grants between 50-60% Grenade energy per activation.
Vortex Grenades can proc twice if enemies get hit by the initial explosion and the last few ticks.

entries.name: Powerful Attraction
entries.text:
Class Ability usage collects certain pickups within 12.5|18.5 meters with 1|2+ Mods equipped.
Applicable pickups:
• Orbs of Power
• Motes of Light in Gambit
• Crests in Supremacy
• Data Motes in Episode: Echoes activities

entries.name: Iron Grip
entries.text: Passively increases Stability by 20 but decreases Reload Speed by 20.

entries.name: Adrenaline Junkie
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Adrenaline Junkie for 4.5 seconds. Grenade Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly even if the weapon is stowed.
Adrenaline Junkie benefits:
• 20 Handling
• 6.7%|13.3%|20%|26.6%|33.3% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks

entries.name: Kinetic Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Kinetic Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Nano-Munitions
entries.text:
While within 15 meters of an ally:
Grants a stack of Nano-Munitions every 3 seconds. Maximum of 7 stacks.
Emptying this weapon's magazine consumes a stack to refill 25% of your magazine (rounded up). Consuming a stack restarts the timer for gaining new stacks.
Emptying the magazine of any other weapon consumes all stacks, with each stack refilling 25% of your Magazine (rounded up). Holding a weapon with an empty magazine also consumes these stacks.
Heat weapons confuse the perk in unexpected and inconsistent ways, and all stacks may be consumed at random while using one.

entries.name: Box Breathing
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights for 🡅1.4 seconds without firing grants the following for a single shot:
• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 40% increased precision damage (35% for Scout Rifles, 30% for Heavy Ammo Sniper Rifles)
Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.
For glaives (Greasy Luck), the projectile must strike the target's critical hitbox in order to recieve the 40% [35%] damage bonus.
🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.

entries.name: Gift of the Traveler
entries.text: Gain 15 Handling, 15 Reload Speed, and 2 Aim Assist for each stack of Gathering Light.

entries.name: Quicksilver Storm Catalyst
entries.text:
Converts this weapon's element into Strand damage.
Kills with Grenade Chaser grenades spawn a Tangle.

entries.name: Special Ammo Scout
entries.text: Special Ammo bricks spawned from your ammo meter now appear for allies as well. These bricks contain 37%|67%|100% of the ammo a regular brick would have at 1|2|3 copies of the mod.

entries.name: Empowering Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

entries.name: Healing Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.

entries.name: Dual Loader
entries.text: Reloading loads 1 additional round into the magazine at a time.

entries.name: The Scientific Method
entries.text: Dealing damage grants 'Scientific Method' for 5 seconds, granting 35 Handling and maximized Movement Speed. Buff cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Sword Logic
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant Stacks of Sword Logic.
The number of Stacks and the buff duration are tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed since activation:
• Minors: 1 Stack for 5.5 seconds
• Elites, Players: 2 Stacks for 7.5 seconds
• Players in their Super and Minibosses: 3 Stacks for 10.5 seconds
• Bosses: 4 Stacks for 15.5 seconds
Damage increase at 1|2|3|4 Stacks:
15% | 25% [15%] | 35% | 50%
Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to the duration tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed.

entries.name: The Right Choice
entries.text:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.
Every 7th shot in the magazine deals 252.52% [5%] increased damage, has 50% increased Auto Aim cone size, and ricochets to the nearest target within an 8 [5] meter radius.

entries.name: Reaper
entries.text:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds of using your Class Ability spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)
10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Opening Shot
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits for your first shot (of the burst):
• 20 Aim Assist and 25 Range
• 5% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.
Firing the weapon prevents the perk from activating for 3 seconds.

entries.name: Shield Break Charge
entries.text: Breaking a Combatant Shield with the matching Elemental Damage Type grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

entries.name: CQC Optics: High
entries.text:
Passively increases Zoom by 1.
Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased Absolute Recoil
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

entries.name: Solar Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Solar Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Gravity Well
entries.text:
Finishing a reload picks up all Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
Also works on Motes and Crests.

entries.name: Permeability
entries.text:
Class Ability usage refills ?% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your Super Ability until stowed.
Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.
Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on Primary, 15% on Special).
🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.name: Explosive Payload
entries.text:
Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact.
The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more. On Hand Cannons, the Payload deals 7% decreased damage in PvP.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.
[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Supercharged Magazine
entries.text:
Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while Amplified.
Activating Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.
🡅 Passively grants 15 Magazine stat. (Equivalent of 50% of Backup Mag's Magazine stat benefit)

entries.name: Fleet Footed
entries.text:
Dealing damage grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds.
Scoring a Weapon Kill increases this to 30 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Weapon damage refreshes buff duration.

entries.name: Facet of Defiance
entries.text:
Finishers trigger an Elemental explosion that deals up to 135 Super-Matching Elemental Damage and applies a Super-Matching Elemental Debuff in a ? meter radius.
Elemental Debuffs applied:
• Arc: Jolt
• Solar: x40 Scorch
• Void: Volatile
• Stasis: x? Slow for ? seconds
• Strand: Sever for ? seconds

entries.name: Weighted Edge
entries.text:
When the magazine has at least 1 round loaded, Glaive Melee Attacks deal 50% increased damage and apply 40 Slow for 4 [1.5] seconds (8 [1.5] with Whisper of Durance).
Bosses only receive 20% increased damage.

entries.name: Final Warning Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 10% increased damage to marked targets. Minibosses and Bosses only receive 5% more damage.
Hits against marked Minors and Elites|Minibosses and Bosses have an 85%|25% chance to refund one ammo into the magazine.

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: One Thousand Voices Catalyst
entries.text:
I gain 30 Stability and 20 Ammo Generation.
Each of my detonations release a Taken Seeker which aggressively tracks and burrows into nearby targets, dealing 22 ticks of damage, one tick every 0.25 seconds, for 5.65 seconds.
My Taken Seekers can stun Overload Champions.
My foes can be afflicted by up to 5 seekers at once, and Blighted Enemies (directly impacted by Witherhoard) take 100% increased tick damage.
I do not interact with Malfeasance or Wish-Ender.
▛ Most of those who bargain with me do not win... ▟

entries.name: Hellion
entries.text:
Casting your Class Ability grants 'Hellion' for 20 seconds.
Hellion fires Scorching projectiles every 1.35 seconds up to a distance of 32 meters, and inflict 30 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius (40 Scorch with Ember of Ashes).
Hellion projectiles count as a Grenade Ability and are buffed by, and trigger, grenade-specific effects. However, Scorch and Ignitions sourced by Hellion itself do not scale.

entries.name: Touch of Flame
entries.text:
Enhances your Healing, Firebolt, Solar, and Fusion Grenade Abilities:
• Healing Grenades grant Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 4 seconds (6 with Ember of Solace)
• Firebolt Grenades gain 50% increased search radius (8🠚12 Meters) and targets 5 enemies (up from 4).
• Solar Grenades last 2 seconds longer and release 'Molten Lava Orbs' that deal additional damage.
• Fusion Grenades detonate a second time after 0.5 seconds, dealing additional damage in an 8 meter radius.

entries.name: Heat Rises
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness. Allows you to use your weapons and abilities while gliding.
Kills while Airborne grant Melee Energy based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 20%
• Elites: 25%
• Minibosses: 35%
• Bosses and Players: 50%
Hold [Grenade] to consume it, activating 'Heat Rises' for 15 seconds, and grant Healing to you and allies within a 9 meter radius based on what was consumed.
Consuming a Healing Grenade grants Cure x3. If Touch of Flame is equipped, this also grants Restoration x1 for 4 seconds.
Consuming a Song of Flame Wisp grants Cure x3 and Restoration x2 for 4 seconds.
Restoration effects are extended to 6 seconds with Ember of Solace. All other grenades grant Cure x2.
Heat Rises grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness and effectively infinite Glide flight time, along with improved base movement capabilities of your equipped Glide. Enemy combatants are less accurate while Heat Rises is active.
Scoring kills while Airborne extends Heat Rises, up to a maximum of 30 seconds based off Combatant Rank:
• Minors and Players: 5 seconds
• Elites and Minibosses: 10 seconds
• Bosses: 15 Seconds

entries.name: Icarus Dash
entries.text:
While Airborne, pressing [Air Move] performs a horizonal dash that propels you 8 meters towards the input direction before entering a 4 second cooldown.
While Heat Rises or Song of Flame is active, gain an additional charge of Icarus Dash before entering a 5 second cooldown (currently only works in Song of Flame while using Incinerator Snap). Both charges are refilled per cooldown period.
Icarus Dash can be used infinitely during Daybreak at the cost of 4.2% super energy per use.
While Airborne, Weapon or Super Kills within 5 seconds of each grants Cure x1. Activation Progress is based on Combatant Rank:
• Minor: 34%
• Elite: 67%
• Bosses: 100%
• Players: 67%

entries.name: Empowered Finish
entries.text: Finishers with no active Armor Charge Stacks grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon
entries.text:
Deals 50% increased damage to PvE Combatant Shields and 200% increased damage to Barrier Champion shields.
Melee Hits can discharge Bolt Charge stacks.
Tapping [Heavy Attack] throws your blade up to 50 meters away, seeking up to 3 enemies before returning. Blade deals 945 [174] damage to each target and 80% reduced damage while returning. Pressing [Light Attack] recalls the blade early.
Holding [Heavy Attack] throws your blade 20 meters forward in a straight unguided path and increases its damage by 100%.
With Gyro Core Equipped: Thrown Blade Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
•  Grants x1 Bolt Charge
•  35? Scorch (50? with Ember of Ashes). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
•  Weakens for 6 seconds
•  50 Slow for 4 seconds (8 with Whisper of Durance). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
•  Severs for 10 seconds (15 with Thread of Continuity)

entries.name: Hungering Quarrel
entries.text: Fires two Void Bolts that heal on hit for 11 HP each.

entries.name: Onslaught
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed

entries.name: Strand Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Strand Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Arc Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Arc Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Hatchling
entries.text:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a Threadling at the target's location.
🡅 Spawns an additional hatchling every ? activations.

entries.name: Void/Strand Dual Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Void or Strand Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Reaper's Tithe
entries.text:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)
'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 15 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.
Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 15-second duration.
Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.

entries.name: The Dance
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness to Primary Weapons.
Grants the following benefits while a Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 30 Mobility
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance
DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.
Primary Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 20%
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
At full Class Ability energy, scoring multiple Primary Weapon Kills within 6 seconds of each grants an additional Class Ability Charge. Maximum of 2 extra charges.
Activation progress granted by Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 100%

entries.name: Adept Accuracy
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Accuracy.

entries.name: Runneth Over
entries.text:
While within 15 meters of allies:
• Finishing a reload overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% of the Base Magazine Capacity (rounded up) for each ally
• Bows receive 7.5%|15%|17.5%|20%|25% decreased Draw Time for 1|2|3|4|5+? allies
• Swords receive increased Charge Rate

entries.name: Adhesive Ordnance
entries.text:
Picking up an Ammo Brick causes the next shot fired to attach a Sticky Bomb on impact.
Sticky Bomb detonates after 0.8 seconds, dealing up to 🡅410 [?] Kinetic Damage and Exhausting targets in 6 meter radius. Damage falls off to 50% at the edge of the radius.
Sticky Bombs inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.
🡅 Increases Sticky Bomb damage.

entries.name: Hierarchy of Needs Catalyst
entries.text:
Deploying a Guidance Ring or Guidance Seeker Hits grants the following benefits for 5 seconds:
• 40% reduced Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone
• 50% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.name: Headstone
entries.text:
Precision Kills create a Large Stasis Crystal at the target's location.
Tier 1-2 Minor and Tier 1 Elite Combatants only spawn a Medium Stasis Crystal.
Creating 5 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Facet of Blessing
entries.text:
Melee Kills start health regeneration.
While Transcendent, this also applies to allies within ? meters.

entries.name: Facet of Command
entries.text:
Freezing or Suppressing an enemy refills your readied weapon's magazine from reserves and grants 20? Stability, ? Aim Assist, and 40 Airborne Effectiveness for 11 seconds.
4 second cooldown between activations.
Killing Frozen or Suppressed Enemies spawns a Stasis Shard or Void Breach respectively.

entries.name: Facet of Purpose
entries.text:
Collecting Orbs of Power grants Elemental buffs based on your equipped Super's element:
• Arc: 1 Bolt Charge Stack
• Solar: Restoration x1 for 5 seconds
• Void: 22.5 HP Overshield for 5 seconds
• Stasis: 2 Frost Armor Stacks for 9 seconds
• Strand: Woven Mail for 5 seconds

entries.name: Facet of Ruin
entries.text:
Ignitions have a 25% increased blast radius.
Shattering enemies or destroying Crystals creates an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] meter radius.
Damage falls off to 17 [4] damage at the edge of the radius.

entries.name: Facet of Mending
entries.text:
Grenade Ability Kills grant you Cure x1.
Prismatic Grenade Kills grant you Cure x2.

entries.name: Facet of Honor
entries.text:
Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying a Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment:
• Ionic Traces, Firesprites, Void Breaches: 7.5% Light Transcendence Energy
• Stasis Shards: 5% Darkness Transcendence Energy
• Tangles: 10% Darkness Transcendence Energy

entries.name: Facet of Sacrifice
entries.text: Ability Kills with an active Arc, Solar, or Void Elemental buff grant an additional 1% [?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.

entries.name: Facet of Bravery
entries.text:
Grenade Kills grant Volatile Rounds to Void Weapons for 11 [7.5] seconds.
Powered Melee Kills (including Knockout) grant Unraveling Rounds to Strand Weapons for 11 [7.5] seconds.

entries.name: Facet of Dominance
entries.text:
Void Grenade Ability damage applies Weaken for 6 [?] seconds.
Arc Grenade Ability damage applies Jolt.

entries.name: Facet of Awakening
entries.text:
Scoring a Super Kill or Killing 3 enemies with Elemental Damage within 6 seconds of each spawns an Elemental Pickup.
The type of Elemental Pickup is determined by the Damage Type of the final Kill.
5 second cooldown between spawning the same Pickup again. Spawned Tangles share the 12 second global spawn cooldown with the Fragment.
Kills with the element of the spawned Pickup while the cooldown is active do not count towards spawning another Elemental Pickup.
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

entries.name: Dynamic Charge
entries.text:
Precision Hits and Kills grant one stack of 'Dynamic Charge'. Maximum of 15 stacks.
Holding [Reload] refills the magazine based on the number of stacks and converts them into 'Revolution' stacks. Switching modes again removes all stacks.
Revolution stacks remain ready until fired, after which point they last 10 seconds. Arc Seekers gain 30% [Varying] increased damage per stack of Revolution, up to 450% increased damage.
Arc Seekers also gain a non-linear increase to their splash radius, granting 33%|233% increased splash radius at x10|x20 Stacks (up to 4|7 meters in radius).
While Revolution's timer is active, Arc Seekers generate x2 Bolt Charge for each hit and gain the ability to discharge Bolt Charge stacks. At or above 10 stacks of Revolution, hits generate x3 Bolt Charge.
Bolt Charge generation is unaffected by Spark of Frequency.
Review this exotic's intrinsic perk to learn a special note about the Bolt Charge behavior from this gun.

entries.name: Soulburn
entries.text:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.
Landing two Frontal Blade hits within 2 seconds of each other, or scoring a Frontal Blade kill, heals you for 40 HP and grants one stack of 'Soulfire Charge'. Maximum of 6 stacks.
Firing this weapon consumes one stack of Soulfire Charge to apply Potent Corruption (poison) that increases in DOT over time.
Potent Corruption deals 65 [?] Kinetic damage once every 0.5 seconds for 10 seconds, ramping up in damage by 8.7% for each tick over 20 ticks, ending at 300 [?] damage on the final tick. In total, one application of Potent Corruption deals 2,985 [?] damage.
Frontal Blades deal 50% increased melee damage against corrupted (poisoned) enemies.

entries.name: Reversal of Fortune
entries.text: Missing twice within 6 seconds refills 1 round into the Magazine from thin air.

entries.name: Sleeper Simulant Catalyst
entries.text: Increases Reserves by 2 (14🠚16) and decreases Charge Time by 33% (1024🠚774) without reducing damage.

entries.name: Whirlwind Blade
entries.text:
Powered Sword Hits grant 3% increased damage for 🡅4 seconds. Stacks 10 times for a 30% Buff.
Stowing the weapon or Blocking removes all stacks. Wolfpack Round Hits also count as Powered Sword Hits.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Mulligan
entries.text:
Missing has a chance to refund 1 ammo into the magazine based on the ammo type:
• Primary Weapons: 🡅40%
• Special and Power Weapons: 🡅25%
🡅 Ammo Refund chance is increased by an additive 5%.

entries.name: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits within 6 seconds of each fires a Tracking Rocket that matches the weapon's element.
Rockets deal 22.4 [14] Impact and 24 [15] Explosive damage on Hit and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling. On non-primary weapons, the Rockets receive an additional damage increase.
% of magazine capacity as Hits required and the additional damage increase by weapon archetype:
• Hand Cannons, Pulse Rifles, Submachine Guns: 45% Magazine Capacity \\ 0% increased damage (Baseline)
• Sniper Rifles: 50%? \\ 100%
• Grenade Launchers: 30% \\ 25%
• Machine Guns: 25% \\ 50%
• Fusion Rifles, Shotguns: ?% \\ 150%
1 second cooldown after activation before further Hits provide activation progress again.

entries.name: Dragonfly
entries.text:
Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing up to 123.89 [95.3] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4.5-meter radius.
🡅 Increases detonation damage by 10%.

entries.name: For the Empire
entries.text: Deals 11% increased damage against Cabal enemies and pierces through Phalanx Shields and Cabal Shield Domes.

entries.name: Reaper's Tithe
entries.text:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)
'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 🡅17 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.
Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 🡅17-second duration.
Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.

entries.name: Under-Over
entries.text:
Increases damage against shielded targets:
• 🡅140% increase against PVE Combatant Overshields
• 🡅55% increase against PVE Combatant Elemental Shields and Barrier Champion Shields
• 🡅22% increase against Player Overshields and for bodyshots against Players with Woven Mail
Notable Combatant Overshields include Shadow Legion Tech Pack and Lucent Moth Overshields. They are indicated with a glowing outline around the targets as well as a small blue health bar under the normal one.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
🡅 Damage Buff is increased: 125%⁠🠚⁠140%, 50%⁠🠚⁠55%, 20%⁠🠚⁠22?⁠%.

entries.name: Volatile Battery
entries.text:
Sets the Magazine Size to 33, greatly exceeding that of any other fusion rifle.
▛ ...an energy cell pulling from multiple timelines, resulting in a charge surplus that can only be explained if the firing cycle began in... ▟

entries.name: Glacial Guard
entries.text:
Requires a Stasis Super Ability to be equipped. Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to a unique, faster, 70 second Base Cooldown class ability (~30 seconds at 100 Class Stat).
Scoring 2 Stasis Kills within 3 seconds of each grants a Stack of Frost Armor.
Restores 10 HP for each Stack of Frost Armor you gain from any source.
Replaces Barricade with Glacial Guard which has a cooldown matching Towering Barricade's. Does not work with Thruster.
On Glacial Guard Cast:
• Grants you maximum Frost Armor Stacks (restoring HP for each Stack gained)
• Applies 100 [40] Slow to enemies within ? meters

entries.name: Trapper's Ambush
entries.text:
While Airborne with full Class Ability Energy, activate [Air Move] to consume your Class Ability and quickly slam to the ground, dealing damage to all enemies within a 6? meter radius. Deals 50% increased damage in a 33?% bigger radius if you have a Void Buff (Devour, Overshield, Invisibility) active.
Grants 5 seconds (7 with Echo of Persistence) of Void Invisibility if cast while already Invisible.
Hits heal for ?HP, and kills grant Devour for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence).
When paired Vanishing Step Aspect:
Trapper's Ambush adopts its former functionality and drops a Void Smoke Cloud upon landing. Enemies hit by the detonation of the Smoke Cloud are Weakened for 10 [5] seconds, while allies are granted Void Invisibility for 6.5 seconds.
Trapper's Ambush triggers the effects of your equipped dodge upon consumption. Damage scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.

entries.name: Vanishing Step
entries.text:
Replaces your Dodge Animation with a longer range, faster traveling side-step that grants Void Invisibility for 5 seconds (7 with Echo of Persistence).
This aspects grants additional functionality to Trapper's Ambush upon casting the air move (see Trapper's Ambush description).

entries.name: Stylish Executioner
entries.text:
Defeating a Void-Debuffed (Prismatic Only: Any Elementally Debuffed) target grants Void Invisibility for 8 seconds (11 with Echo of Persistence) and Truesight for 4 seconds.
Activating Stylish Executioner incurs a 2 [12] second cooldown.
While under the effect of Void Invisibility granted by Stylish Executioner, gain the following benefits for 0.? seconds after leaving Invisibility:
• 300% [20%] Increased Melee Damage
• Melee applies Weaken for 5 [2] seconds
• Melee Lunge Range is extended by ? meters
Powered Melee Abilities may benefit from this effect if they deal damage within the exit window.

entries.name: On the Prowl
entries.text:
Entering Void Invisibility, or going 12 seconds without having marked a combatant in PvE, marks a Non-Boss target within 45 [25] meters of you, prioritizing Minor combatants close to your reticle. Target remains marked indefinitely [15 seconds] until killed.
Defeating the marked target triggers a Void Smoke explosion at their death location and grants one stack of 'Successful Hunt' for 7  seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Successful Hunt instantly grants ?% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy upon being earned, and additionally provides ? Stability, ? Reload Speed, and ?% decreased Reload Animation Speed for its duration.
Void Smoke lasts for 7 seconds, deals damage over time, and can trigger melee-associated effects. Enemies within are Disoriented and Weakened, while allies that enter are granted Void Invisibility for 5 seconds (7 seconds with Echo of Persistence).

entries.name: Halberdier's Reach
entries.text:
Glaive Melee Kills load 1 Ammo into the Magazine from reserves. Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity.
While within 15 meters of 3 enemies:
Grants 50 Reload Speed and 200% increased Glaive Melee Damage.
Glaive Projectile Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 350 [101] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4? meter radius.

entries.name: Slideshot
entries.text:
Sliding refills 15% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants 🡅22 Range and Stability for your next shot (of the burst) within 2.5 seconds.
0.3 second cooldown after activation but can activate multiple times during a slide. Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 2?.

entries.name: Ambush
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits if you have not dealt or received damage in the last 5 seconds:
• 20 Range and 20 Handling
• 15% decreased Draw Time on Bows
• 10.78% increased damage against PvE Combatants. Linear Fusion Rifles only receive an 8.88% damage increase.
Deactivates 2 seconds after exchanging damage.

entries.name: Stasis Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Butterfly
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights for 1.5 seconds without firing causes your next kill to trigger an explosion matching the weapon's element within an 8 meter radius, experiencing a maximum of 30% damage falloff.
Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

entries.name: Lightning Rod
entries.text:
Precision Kills grant 'Lightning Rod'.
Lightning Rod arrows explode on impact and chain lightning in an 8 meter radius around their point of impact for 194 [50.3] damage each.

entries.name: Archer's Tempo
entries.text:
Precision Hits decrease Draw Time by 25% for 3 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Pulse Monitor
entries.text:
Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 30% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.
Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 30% Shield Health.
Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.

entries.name: Paracausal Shot
entries.text:
On kill or Precision Hit, gain one stack of Paracausal Charge. Maximum of 7 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or any full magazine refill.
Paracausal Charge grants increased damage against Combatants at 1|2|3|....|7| Stacks:
21%|36.5%|48%|55%|60%|63%|66%
Paracausal Charge turns into Paracausal Shot on the final round of the magazine. Buff is removed if stowed.
Paracausal Shot's damage bonus at 1|2|3|...|7| stacks:
PvE: 292%|300%|340%|425%|667%|1071%|1736%
PvP: 30%|33%|46%|80.5%|154%|288%|509%

entries.name: Snareweaver
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.
Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3
At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.
Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [5] damage and are Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.
5 second cooldown between Suspends on the same enemy.
Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.name: Häkke Precision Frame
entries.text: This weapon fires a small auto-tracking missile. Missiles lock onto targets when aimed.

entries.name: The Master
entries.text:
Rounds must be chambered after every shot. Animation can be sprint-cancelled as soon as the bolt is drawn in (at the 'clink'), allowing for an increased rate of fire.
Scoring a Precision Hit grants one stack of 'The Master' up to an infinite amount, with effective benefits ending after 20 stacks. Shots visually explode after 20 stacks with no added benefit.
Grants diminishing increases to Precision Damage across 1|2|3|....|20 stacks:
• Stacks 1-5: 16%|22%|27%|31%|35%
• Stacks 6-10: 38%|41%|44%|47%|49.5%
• Stacks 11-15: 52%|54%|56.5%|59%
• Stacks 16-20: 63%|64.5%|66%|68%|70%
Buff persists until death.

entries.name: Sundering
entries.text:
Grants the following for 7 seconds upon breaking an enemy's shield or destroying a Vehicle or Construct:
• 40 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.9x Draw Time Multiplier

entries.name: Detonator Beam
entries.text:
Scoring 🡅20 Hits within ? seconds of each triggers an explosion around the target, dealing up to 250 [?] weapon element-matching damage in an 8 meter radius.
🡅 Number of Hits required is decreased by 5.

entries.name: Overclocked Heatsink
entries.text:
Passively grants 2% increased damage and 10 decreased Cooling Efficiency stat.
🡅 Passively grants 2 Handling.

entries.name: Soaring Fang
entries.text:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
While grounded, hits grant 1.5% charge to your Anti-Grav Repulsors. Kills grant 10% charge.
Once you are above 3% charge, hits after being airborne for 0.5 seconds activate 'Hover Mode'. Hover Mode is disengaged by Holding [Reload], reaching 0% charge, or stowing the weapon.
Hover Mode removes all airborne accuracy penalties, reduces combatant accuracy (similar to Amplified's effects), and grants complete aerial movement at a speed of 5.5 meters per second.
Hover Mode starts at 3 seconds. Each hit restores 0.3 seconds to the timer. Timer cannot exceed 3 seconds.

entries.name: Adept Blast Radius
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Blast Radius.

entries.name: Osteo Striga Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 30 Reload and 20 Stability.
Poison Kills instantly refill the magazine and can overfill it up to 300% total capacity.
0.5 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Apollonic Tangent
entries.text:
While at 3 stacks, hip-firing a fully-drawn arrow spawns a Guidance Ring.
Guidance Ring lasts 20 seconds and will rotate in place to face you. Only one Guidance Ring per-guardian can exist at a time, but up to 3 Guidance Rings can exist across a fireteam. Each Guidance Ring can stack.
Firing any fully-drawn arrow through the Guidance Ring triggers several additional seeking projectiles, each dealing 192 [15] damage. Seekers gain 50% [15-20%] increased damage past 40 meters and have a maximum range of 80 meters. Precision hits with the fired arrow guide the seekers towards that enemy.
Each seeker applies 15 Scorch (20 with Ember of Ashes) and deals Weapon-Element Matching Explosive Damage in a 4 meter radius.
Guidance Rings grant their benefits to any Combat Bow, including Legendaries, Exotics, Heavy Crossbows, Shadowshot, and also Buried Bloodline.
Arrows fired by Hierarchy of Needs release three seekers, while most other bows release two. Casting Shadowshot: Deadfall releases six.

entries.name: Service of Luzaku Catalyst
entries.text:
Teeming Nests can be harvested into a collectible Tangle after spawning 6 Threadlings. This destroys the nest.
These tangles ignore the global Tangle cooldown.

entries.name: Peregrine Strike
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness.
Grants Peregrine Strike after sprinting for 2 seconds and being airborne for 0.5 seconds. Buff is removed upon touching the ground.
Peregrine Strike increases the impact damage of Shoulder Charge Melee Abilities by 250%.
Against Minibosses, the buff is increased to 550% and refunds your Melee Ability charge on hit.
Shoulder Charge abilities: Seismic Strike, Hammer Strike, and Shield Bash
Provides no benefits when hitting Frozen enemies.

entries.name: Vanishing Execution
entries.text:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant Invisibility and restore 67 HP.
Invisibility Duration is based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 7 seconds
• Elites, Enemy Players: 10 seconds
• Minibosses and Bosses: 13 seconds
The duration of Invisibility granted by Finishers is 3 seconds longer. Echo of Persistence increases Invisibility duration by 41.5%.

entries.name: Reflective Vents
entries.text:
Upon sliding after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds with your Class Ability fully charged:
Projects a 180° frontal shield that reflects all incoming projectiles for 0.45 seconds.
Reflected projectiles deal 50% increased damage.
After shield deactivation, 2% Class Ability energy is drained for every point of damage reflected.
Currently partially bugged and does not drain Class Ability Energy for projectiles reflected at the end of your slide.

entries.name: Attrition Orbs
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy.
Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.
Hit requirements for activation:
• Rocket Launchers: 2 hits
• Heavy Grenade Launchers: 3 Hits
• Wave-Frame Grenade Launchers: 4 hits
• Bows: 4 Hits
• Swords: 5 Hits
• Area-Denial Grenade Launchers: 26 Hits
• Others: 55% of Magazine Size rounded down + 1
Support Frame Auto Rifle healing round Hits on damaged allies count as 2 Hits.

entries.name: Rapid Hit
entries.text:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Radiolaria Transposer
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Weapon Kills within 8 seconds of each causes your last-killed target to explode and create a Radiolaria Pool at their location. Stowing the weapon resets the Kill Counter.
Explosion deals up to 67.5 [?] damage in a 3? meter radius.
Radiolaria Pool information:
• Deals 15 [?] Arc damage every 0.65 seconds
• Lasts for ? seconds (3? damage ticks)
• Inherits the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling and any weapon damage buffs
Activation Progress based on Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: ?%

entries.name: Reservoir Burst
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Magazine Size stat. (Identical to a Backup Mag mod)
While Magazine is at or above maximum capacity:
Grants 🡅33% increased damage and causes enemies to explode on death, dealing 162.5 damage in a ? meter radius.
Explosions inherit the weapon's element and Combatant Damage Scaling. Explosions triggered with Linear Fusion Rifle kills deal an additional 30% increased damage.
🡅 Damage buff is increased by 10% (30%🠚33%).

entries.name: Weavewalk
entries.text:
While Airborne with at least one full Melee Charge, pressing [Air Move] activates Weavewalk and consumes 20% Melee Ability Energy.
While Weavewalk is active, your Melee Energy drains at a rate of 25% per second, and you generate a Perched Threadling every 0.5 seconds.
Weavewalk grants 90% Damage Resistance against Combatants and Players, and functionally grants the effects of Void Invisibility, preventing enemy combatants from engaging you.
You are unable to interact with the world while Weavewalk is active. This includes reviving other Players, collecting ammo bricks, or picking up Orbs of Power. Threadlings, Arc Souls, and No Time To Explain's 'Time-Slip Portal' deal 50% decreased damage while Weavewalk is active.
Exiting Weavewalk grants Woven Mail based on the duration it was active, granting 2 to 20 seconds of Woven Mail.

entries.name: Weaver's Call
entries.text:
Dealing damage to enemies gradually generates 'Perched' Threadlings at a maxium rate of one Threadling every 2 seconds.
Scoring kills also generate progress towards creating a Perched Threadling based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors, Elites, and Minibosses: 33%
• Players: 67%
• Bosses: 100%
Casting your Class Ability creates three Threadlings and simultaneously deploys all Perched Threadlings.
Threadlings grant 10% Class Ability Energy per hit.

entries.name: Mindspun Invocation
entries.text:
Enhances your Strand Grenade abilities:
• Grapple Melees create 3 Threadlings on hit
• Threadling Grenade can be charged by holding [Grenade] to create a Threadling Nest on impact, which spawns 3 Threadlings instantly and then one additional Threadling every 5 seconds for 17.5 seconds.
• Shackle Grenade can be consumed by holding [Grenade], granting 'Weaver's Trance' for 25 seconds. Kills while Weaver's Trance is active trigger a ? meter radius explosion around the target that Suspends enemies for 6? seconds
• Slicewire Grenade can be charged by holding [Grenade] to drop 4 additional explosion submunitions, and ends with the creation of a Tangle (ignores global cooldowns)

entries.name: The Wanderer
entries.text:
Threadling Kills can now spawn a Tangle, and reduce Tangle cooldown by 1 second per kill.
Shooting a Tangle creates a delayed explosion that detonates after ? seconds, Suspending all enemies hit for 7 seconds.
Thrown Tangles are unaffected by gravity and aggressively seek targets, attaching to them and detonating after ? seconds. These detonations Suspend enemies in a ? meter radius for 7 seconds.

entries.name: Noble Deeds
entries.text:
Assisting Allies by Reviving, Healing, Empowering, or granting Subclass Buffs to them grants 10 Stacks of Noble Deeds. Maximum of 10 Stacks.
Can be triggered even while the weapon is stowed.
Kills consume 1 [2] Stacks of Noble Deeds.
Grants 🡅 35? Handling and 🡅 35? Reload Speed while you have active Stacks. Swords receive 🡅 25? Charge Rate instead.

entries.name: Firmly Planted
entries.text:
While Crouched:
• 30 Handling and 20 Stability
• -40% Accuracy Cone Size
• -17% Accuracy Cone Growth
• -80% horizontal Recoil
Effects are halved on Fusion Rifles (decimals are rounded up).

entries.name: White Nail
entries.text: Landing 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each refills the magazine. Pulls 2 shots from reserves and generates 1 ammo from thin air.

entries.name: Temporal Alignment Refit
entries.text:
Grants 20% increased damage for 16 seconds upon activating both Arc and Stasis Overcharge one after another.
No time limit between the two activations.

entries.name: Transcendent Zen Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Transcendent Moment trait:
Weapon Kills grant stat benefits based on the weapon's elemental alignment for ? seconds.
Light Alignment grants ? Stability and ? Handling.
Dark Alignment grants ? Range and ? Aim Assist.
Kills while Transcendent activate both bonuses.
Light Alignment: Arc, Solar, Void
Darkness Alignment: Stasis, Strand

entries.name: Subsistence Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Subsistence trait:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.
Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.

entries.name: Rapid Hit Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Rapid Hit trait:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Rampage
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Rampage. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Stacks expire one at a time every 🡅5 seconds.
Grants a 10%|21%|33.1% damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Revved Consumption
entries.text: Landing hits grants 7HP per damage instance.

entries.name: Unflinching Harmonic Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Weapons matching your Subclass Element:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Adept Range
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Range.

entries.name: Release the Wolves
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights, fires in 5 round bursts.
While Hip-Firing, Lord of Wolves becomes fully-automatic and grants the following benefits:
• 60% increased Rate of Fire
• 200% increased Accuracy Cone Size
• ? reduced Range
• 39% increased bodyshot damage and 20% increased precision damage. Bosses take 10% increased bodyshot damage and receive no increase to precision damage.

entries.name: Delicate Tuning
entries.text:
Grants linearly decreasing benefits as Weapon Heat increases from 0% to 50%:
• 20 to 10 Range
• ? to ? Handling
• ? to ? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

entries.name: Unflinching Arc Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Arc Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Pulse Monitor
entries.text:
Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 🡅35% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.
Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 🡅35% Shield Health.
Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.
🡅 Activates with 5?% more Shield Health remaining.

entries.name: Cosmology
entries.text:
Kills throw enemies ? meters back before triggering a Void Explosion. Void Explosions deal 470 [?] damage in a 7 meter radius and spawn two seeking orbs, each dealing 51 [20] damage. Explosion falls to 0% damage at the edge of its blast radius.
Void Explosion kills can trigger additional Void Explosions.

entries.name: Solar Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Solar Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Cascade Point
entries.text:
After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:
Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for 🡅2.75 seconds.
Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.
Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.25 seconds.

entries.name: Precision Instrument
entries.text:
Direct Weapon Hits grant a stack of Precision Instrument for 1.25 seconds (2.1 seconds on weapons with a Draw/Charge Time).
Maximum of 6 stacks. Reloading the weapon (except on Bows) or missing removes all stacks... usually.
Heavy Burst Frame weapons can only gain 1 stack per burst.
Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifles require 1.5? Hits for each stack (and missing sometimes does not remove your stacks on them).
Precision damage increase at 1|2|... stacks:
🡅5% | 10% | 15% | 20% | 25% | 30%
🡅 Precision Damage Buff is increased by 20%.

entries.name: Close the Gap
entries.text:
Hits against Suspended enemies inflicts 20 Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes).
Kills spawn a Firesprite.
After picking up a Firesprite, hold [Reload] to enable a Charged Laser. Charged Laser takes 0.5 seconds to charge, at which point it fires for 0.93 seconds at 1000 RPM and hits 15 times.

entries.name: Stasis Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Stasis Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Chill Clip
entries.text:
While at/above 🡅40% of the Base Magazine Capacity:
Direct Hits apply 60 Slow Stacks for 4 [1.5] seconds (8 [2] with Whisper of Durance) to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Micro-Missile Sidearms and Rapid-Fire Fusion Rifles only apply 40 Slow Stacks.
Only activates once per shot/burst.
🡅 Magazine capacity thershold is lowered by 10% (50%🠚40%).

entries.name: Assassin's Blade
entries.text:
Grants the following on Weapon Kills for 5 seconds:
• 15% increased damage
• Maximized Movement Speed
Remains active even if stowed.

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: Temporal Manipulation
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to refill 3 ammo and switch between firing modes:
• Arc Mode fires at 150 RPM
• Stasis Mode fires at 95 RPM and deals explosive splash damage in a 3 meter radius.
Scoring 3 Kills or Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants 'Arc|Stasis Overcharge' when in Stasis|Arc firing mode. Overcharge drains at a rate of 4.5% per second once earned.
Buff is removed if you swap off the mode matching its element.

entries.name: Ember of Torches
entries.text:
Elemental Melee Hits make you and allies within 8 meters Radiant for 8 seconds (12 with Ember of Solace).
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: Ember of Combustion
entries.text:
Targets killed by Solar Supers Ignite and spawn a Firesprite at their location.
Note: Well of Radiance makes all of the caster's Weapon Damage count as Super Ability Damage so Solar Weapons Kills will also count as Solar Super Kills.

entries.name: Ember of Tempering
entries.text:
Solar Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Ember of Tempering for 8 seconds to you and allies within 15 meters.
Ember of Tempering grants the following benefits:
• 20|40|60 Health stat at 1|2|3 Stacks
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• Solar Weapon Kills spawn a Firesprite

entries.name: Ember of Char
entries.text:
Ignitions apply 40 Scorch Stacks (60 with Ember of Ashes) to enemies damaged by the explosion.
Does not apply to the Ignited enemy.

entries.name: Ember of Benevolence
entries.text:
Applying certain buffs to allies grants 300% Additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 7 [3.5?] seconds.
Activation Triggers:
• Granting the Cure, Radiant, or Restoration Solar subclass buffs to allies
• Healing (from most sources), or reviving allies
Will NOT trigger Ember of Benevolence:
Empowering Rifts, Mods, Crest of Alpha Lupi's Healing Pulse, Mothkeeper's Wraps Overshield Moth, Non-Solar Support Frame Auto Rifles

entries.name: Ember of Singeing
entries.text:
Grants 400% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 3 seconds upon applying Scorch to enemies that are not currently Scorched.
Will not activate if the enemy dies from the hit that would have applied Scorch.

entries.name: Ember of Empyrean
entries.text:
Solar Kills extend the duration of Restoration and Radiant effects up to the maximum of 15 seconds.
Scoring a Solar Kill while Restoration's or Radiant's timer is above 15 seconds will lower it back down to 15 seconds.
Seconds added based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1.5s
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2.25s
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Enemy Players: 3s
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 6s

entries.name: Ember of Beams
entries.text:
Grants Solar Super projectiles stronger tracking.
Only affects Blade Barrage, Daybreak, and Song of Flame projectiles.

entries.name: Ember of Solace
entries.text:
Restoration and Radiant effects applied to you last 50% longer.
Specific increases from Ember of Solace for Restoration and Radiant sources can be found in their descriptions.

entries.name: Ember of Blistering
entries.text:
Ignition Kills grant Grenade Energy based on the Enemy Rank of the killed targets:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 8%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 12.25%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 16.5%
• Players: 20.75%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Third Iteration Catalyst
entries.text:
Precision Kills with Amalgamation Rounds trigger an explosion dealing 145 [?] damage in a 5 meter radius, while also applying Weaken to all enemies within an 8 meter radius for 6 seconds.
Explosive damage deals 20% damage at the edge of its radius.

entries.name: Target Lock
entries.text:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.
Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.
% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%
Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [10.46%] to 40% [25%] upon reaching maximum strength.
Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.

entries.name: Radar Tuner
entries.text: Radar immediately returns once no longer Aiming Down Sights. (Normally takes 1.5 seconds)

entries.name: Shock Blast
entries.text:
Fires 15 pellets in a wide blast with no damage falloff and unlimited overpenetration. Max range of 18 meters.
Hits against grounded enemies deal an additional instance of 135.2 [150] damage.
Reloads faster than its fire rate, effectively granting a bottomless magazine if fired after each reload.

entries.name: Enduring Snare Refit
entries.text: Increases Snareweaver Trap duration by 10 seconds (15🠚25).

entries.name: Multi-Threaded Snare Refit
entries.text: Increases the maximum number of Suspensions per linked trap wire up to 3.

entries.name: Vorpal Weapon Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Vorpal Weapon trait:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.
Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• Primary Weapons: 20% [60%]
• Special Weapons: 15% [20%]
• Power Weapons: 10% [20%]

entries.name: Hatchling Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Hatchling trait:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

entries.name: Impact Induction
entries.text:
Grants Grenade Ability Energy upon dealing Elemental Melee Damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.
Grenade Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: MIDA Multi-Tool
entries.text:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
Radar remains active while Aiming Down Sights with this weapon.
Grants 12.5% increased Movement Speed while held. This benefit is shared across all equipped MIDA-Synergy weapons.

entries.name: Adaptive Glaive
entries.text:
Hybrid melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield.
Generates energy on dealing ranged damage.
[Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield, depleting energy over time
[Melee]  : Kinetic melee combo

entries.name: Hawkmoon Catalyst
entries.text:
Increases Magazine Size by 1 (8🠚9).
Grants the following benefits at 1|2|3|...|7| stacks of Paracausal Charge:
• 8|14|22|26|28|29|30 Range
• 15|25|35|40|50|50|50 Reload Speed
• ? Handling
Clarity's Exotic Weapon Insights built by Hawkmoona Matata. Enjoy! ♥

entries.name: Healing Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.

entries.name: Empowering Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

entries.name: Bring the Heat
entries.text:
Fusion Grenades have Fastball intrinsically and detonate on impact, stunning Unstoppable Champions on hit.
Fusion Grenade Kills refund Grenade Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 25%
• Elites: 50%
• Players, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Burning Fists
entries.text:
Finisher and (Glaive) Melee Kills grant a Stack of Burning Fists. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
After not having scored further Finisher or (Glaive) Melee Kills for 2 seconds, your Stacks start decaying one at a time over 9.5|10|4|4|3 seconds for the 1st|...|5th Stacks.
Damage Buff at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• Additional Base Melee Damage: 80%|160%|240%|320%|400%
• Additional Base Glaive Melee Damage: 40%|80%|120%|160%|200%
• Weapon, PVE: 0%|20%|25%|30%|35%
• Weapon, PVP: 0%|0%|20%|25%|25%
Weapon damage increases are Empowering Buffs.

entries.name: Arc Traps
entries.text:
Grenades fired are Arc Traps that lay inactive for 30 seconds and connect to other bolts within 15 meters. Up to 6 Arc Traps can exist at a time.
Enemies within 2 meters of a trap activate all linked traps. Activated traps deal damage once every 0.5 seconds and detonate after 10 seconds.
Unlinked Arc Bolts deal damage in a 4 meter radius after detecting an enemy within 5 meters. Linked Arc Bolts only damage enemies touching the tripwire.
Traps that are linked together deal 100% bonus tick damage (compared to a single bolt).

entries.name: Scatter Charge
entries.text:
Grants an extra Scatter Grenade Ability Charge. Stacks with Chaos Accelerant's additional grenade charge.
Kills with Scatter Grenade spawn 3 additional scatter submunitions. Submunition kills cannot chain.
Scatter Grenades are faster and receive Chaos Accelerant's Tracking Bonus. This does not stack with Chaos Accelerant.

entries.name: Firing Line
entries.text:
Being within 15 meters of 2 allies grants 20% increased Precision Damage.
🡅 Grants 10 Handling while the perk is active.

entries.name: Restoration Ritual
entries.text:
Reviving an ally or performing a Finisher grants 'Restoration Ritual' and refills the Magazine from reserves.
'Restoration Ritual' refills the Magazine from reserves the next time it is emptied.

entries.name: Grave Robber
entries.text:
Powered Melee Hits and (Glaive) Melee Kills refill the magazine from reserves.
3 second cooldown between activations.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.name: Cold Steel
entries.text:
Powered Sword Hits apply Slow stacks for 4.25 [1.5] seconds.
Light Attacks apply 40 Slow stacks, Heavy Attacks apply 60.
Flash Counter's disorienting blast also applies 60 Slow stacks.
🡅 Passively grants 10 Ammo Capacity.

entries.name: Tracking Module
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights and targeting an Enemy:
Fired Rockets track the targeted enemy. Diminshed effectiveness in PVP.
Tracking persists for 1 second once no longer aiming at the enemy.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.

entries.name: Broadside
entries.text:
Each successive shot fired within 0.5 seconds of each other deals increasingly higher damage and has a wider pellet spread.
Broadside increases the damage of the 2|3|4|5th shot by 18%|39%|59%|81% damage in exchange for 25% increased pellet spread on the first shot and then 33% increased spread for all shots afterwards.

entries.name: Solar Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Solar Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: Dark Deliverance
entries.text:
Fire a large slow-traveling projectile. Release the trigger after firing to remotely detonate it into 7 submunitions.
Deals no self-damage.

entries.name: Fail-deadly
entries.text:
Dealing damage with this weapon grants one stack of 'Fail-Deadly'. Maximum stacks are equal to this weapon's base magazine capacity.
Each stack grants ? Range, ? Aim Assist, and +1 Base Magazine Capacity, up to 100% Capacity.
This increased Base Magazine Capacity will be considered the baseline for all other magazine-modifying traits, such as Overflow.
All stacks are removed upon scoring a weapon kill.

entries.name: Emergency Reinforcement
entries.text:
Grants 10% Damage Resist upon reaching Critical Health while at 3 or more Stacks Armor Charge and consumes all Armor Charges.
Buff lasts 6|9|12|15 seconds with 3|4|5|6 Stack of Armor Charge consumed.

entries.name: Envious Assassin
entries.text:
Upon readying the weapon after scoring Kills with your other Weapons:
Refills and/or overfills the Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills scored.
Maximum total overfill amount is 200% of the Magazine Capacity. Each activation can only load up to 100% of the Magazine Capacity into the magazine.
Loaded ammo per Kill by ammo type (rounds up):
• Primary Weapons: 🡅12.5% of Magazine Capacity
• Special and Power Weapons: 🡅22.5%
🡅 Loaded ammo per Kill is increased by 2.5% of the Magazine Capacity (e.g. 10%⁠🠚⁠12.5%).

entries.name: Delayed Gratification
entries.text:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
Fires bouncing grenades that can be remotely detonated after 0.3 seconds. Has a 4.5 meter blast radius, dealing 30% damage at the edge of the radius.
Deals 40% increased damage against Minor Combatants (Exotic Primary bonus is typically 30%).
Passively grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

entries.name: Marksman's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs an evasive maneuver in your movement input's direction that instantly reloads all equipped weapons and collects ammo bricks that are on the ground within a 15 meter radius of you.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

entries.name: Gambler's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Grants 1% [0.35%] Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] at 100 Melee Stat.
Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of 200% [70%] energy.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Lord of Wolves Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 20 Stability, 60 Reload Speed, and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration.
Hipfired shots apply 10 Scorch stacks (15 with Ember of Ashes) on hit with a 0.5 second cooldown.
Kills while ADS trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) to enemies within an 8 meter radius.

entries.name: The Chaperone Catalyst
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 1 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.name: Harmony
entries.text:
Upon readying the weapon within 3 seconds of getting a Kill with a different weapon:
Grants 20% increased damage and 15 Handling for 7 seconds.

entries.name: Arc Ammo Generation
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Arc Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: Blunt Execution Rounds
entries.text:
Upon dealing Melee damage while an Enemy is within 15 meters:
Grants 500% [100%] increased damage and 100 Handling for the next full burst within 10 seconds.
4 second cooldown after buff expires. Can be activated while stowed. Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
Any Powered Melee that requires sprinting, sliding, or performs a slam will not activate the perk.

entries.name: Acrius Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 40 Reload Speed, 50 Ammo Generation, and increases Magazine Size by 2 (4🠚6).
Grants the Trench Barrel trait:
Dealing Melee Damage grants the following for the next 3 shots within 5 seconds:
• 30 Reload Speed and 30 Handling
• 50% increased damage
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.name: Tractor Cannon Catalyst
entries.text: Increases Magazine Size by 3 (4🠚7) and grants 50 Ammo Generation.

entries.name: Cormorant Reversal
entries.text:
Blocking grants 100% [?] damage resistance against attacks that are within a ? degree cone in front of you.
Guarding while taking any damage fires a 255 [50] Kinetic damage Blaster Bolt towards your reticle.
With Refraction Core Equipped: Blaster Bolt Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
•  Grants x1 Bolt Charge
•  10? Scorch (17? with Ember of Ashes)
•  Weakens for 6 seconds
•  20 Slow for 1? second (2? with Whisper of Durance)
•  Severs for 10 seconds (15 with Thread of Continuity)

entries.name: Harmonic Laser
entries.text:
Holding down the trigger cycles between the three power levels: Low, Medium, and High.
Cycle resets upon trigger release, and follows the order:
Medium for 0.5 seconds 🠚 Low 1s 🠚 High 1s 🠚 Medium 1.5s 🠚 Low 1.5s 🠚 Medium 2s 🠚 High 1.25s 🠚 Low 1.25s 🠚 Repeats
Cycle determines damage output, with Low|Med|High granting the following damage increases:
• PvE: Base|32.2%|68.7%
• PvP: Base|3%|6.25%

entries.name: Headseeker
entries.text:
Dealing non-Precision Direct damage grants the following benefits for 0.55 seconds:
• 20% increased Precision Bonus (complicated, see specific damage increases below)
• 3% increased Aim Assist Cone size
Precision damage increases by weapon type/frame:
• Pulse Rifles: Adaptive: 7.1%, Aggressive Burst: 10%, Heavy Burst: 9.5%, High-Impact: 8.74%, Lightweight: 6.3%, Rapid-Fire: 10.3%
• Sidearms: Adaptive Burst: 8.46%, Heavy Burst: 7.36%
• Scout Rifles: Precision: 8.66%
[Bug] Heavy Burst Hand Cannons: 7% increased Weakspot damage.
The distinction between Weakspots and Critspots is complicated and we might write an explainer blog post about it eventually. For the purposes of PvP, the two are equivalent.

entries.name: Stormbringer
entries.text:
3 kills within 3? seconds of each spawns a Lightning Strike centered on the last target defeated, followed by a Lightning Storm.
Lightning Strike deals 382 [?] damage in a 7 meter radius after 1.1 seconds, which falls to 0% damage at the edge of its radius.
Lighting Storm occurs 0.5 seconds after the Lightning Strike and releases 4 bolts spread in an X-Pattern over the target, dealing 426 [?] damage in a 5 meter radius. Damage falls to 25% at the edge of the radius.

entries.name: Reconstruction
entries.text:
Every 🡅5.5 seconds while not firing the weapon:
Loads 25% of the Magazine Capacity (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.
Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity. Works even while stowed.
🡅 Loading delay is decreased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Smoothbore
entries.text: Increases Shotgun Pellet Spread by 7.5%

entries.name: Le Monarque Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 20 Reload Speed and 30 Stability.
Grants the Unrelenting trait:
Starts Health Regeneration and restores 65 HP upon reaching 100% Activation Progress with Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each.
Activation Progress by Enemy Rank:
• Minor Combatants: 34%
• Players: 67%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%

entries.name: Void Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Void Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Recombination
entries.text:
Elemental Kills grant 1 Stack of Recombination even while the weapon is stowed. Maximum of 10 stacks.
Each Stack additively increases the damage of the next shot by 10% [5%], up to 100% [50%] at 10 stacks.

entries.name: Harvester Spike
entries.text:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
Deals 40% increased damage against Minor Combatants (Exotic Primary bonus is typically 30%).
Fires a micro-missile-like projectile that explodes in a 5 meter radius. Kills create a Vestige that travels up to 40 meters towards you.
Shots fired into Champions, Minibosses, or Bosses impale them, damaging them once every 0.8 seconds for 4 seconds and creating a Vestige on each tick (6 Vestiges total).
Impaled Spikes can be stacked.

entries.name: Shrapnel Launcher
entries.text:
Reloads its entire magazine at once.
Fires bursts of solar pellets depending on aiming mode.
Scorch and Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 53% increased damage. This is reduced to 24% against Bosses.

entries.name: Wish-Dragon Teeth
entries.text:
Intrinsically grants Fastball to all grenades.
Enhances Tripmine Grenades:
• 14% increased Explosion damage
• Explosion Length and Width are increased to 14 meters
• Explosions don't have any damage falloff
• Explosion no longer deals self-damage
• Last 20 seconds longer (10s🠚30s)
• Grants Tripmine Grenades 70 HP
Solar Ability Hits grant 30% [8%] Tripmine Grenade Energy. Crackshot's Golden Gun shots grant 10% [?] per hit (30% per full salvo). The first Scorch tick from your abilities will also trigger the energy gains.
0.3 second cooldown between energy gains.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Spring-Loaded Mounting
entries.text:
Passively grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness, 100 Handling and 100 Reload Speed to Sidearms.
Upon readying a Sidearm while at Critical Health:
• Refills the Magazine of the Sidearm from reserves
• Grants 100% [10%] increased damage until your shield are fully recharged, after which it has a 5 second duration
Sidearm Kills extend the buff duration by 3 seconds (capped at 5 seconds) and refill your Magazine from reserves.

entries.name: Riskrunner Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 30 Range.
Weapon Kills trigger an elemental explosion, dealing up to 114 [?] damage in a 3 meter radius.
This explosion can deal self-damage and trigger Arc Conductor.

entries.name: Towering Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation.
Creates a tall, slightly curved, see-through Barricade in front of you that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Grants 60% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while standing behind the Barricade.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Standing extremely close to the barricade consistently prevents enemy melee attacks from hitting you through it.

entries.name: Rally Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation and keeps you crouched after.
Creates a short, curved, see-through Barricade that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies while standing behind it:
• 10% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 50% Flinch Resistance
• 30 Stability
• 100 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 80% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants

entries.name: Thruster
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a quick, first-person, 8 meter dash in your current input direction. Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles (needs confirmation) and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Not inputting a movement direction results in a 4 meter backwards dash.

entries.name: Threat Detector
entries.text:
Grants 1|2 Stacks while within 15 meters of 1|2+ enemies.
Bonuses at 1|2 Stacks:
• 🡅19|🡅44 Stability
• 🡅19|🡅63 Reload Speed
• 🡅28|100 Handling
• 0.9x|0.81x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier
🡅 Grants 4? more stability when active as well as 1|3 more Reload Speed at 1|2 Stacks.

entries.name: Elemental Honing
entries.text:
Dealing Elemental Damage grants a stack of Elemental Honing for 🡅23 seconds for each unique Element used. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Gaining a stack refreshes the buff duration. Duration cannot be refreshed once at 5 stacks.
Buff can be activated while stowed. Kinetic Damage does not trigger the buff.
Weapon damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks by weapon damage type:
• Kinetic: 10%|20%|30%|35%|40%
• Elemental (PVE): 2.5%|10%|20%|30%|35%
• Elemental (PVP): 1.25%|5%|20%|30%|35%
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 3 seconds.

entries.name: Dark-Forged Trigger
entries.text:
While not Aiming Down Sights:
• Increases RPM to 130
• 50% Reduced Accuracy Cone Size
• 50% Reduced Accuracy Cone Growth
• 27% [15%] increased damage at x5 Cranial Spike
Aim Assist Cone will favor precision hits in the case of overlapping regions.

entries.name: Ionic Return
entries.text:
Breaking an elemental shield matching the currently selected element refills the magazine from reserves and grants 5 shots of 'Ionic Return'.
Ionic Return grants each shot the following benefits:
• 15% increased bodyshot damage
• 37% increases critical damage

entries.name: Modified Heatsink
entries.text:
Passively refills 1 round every 5 seconds. Firing resets this timer.
Reloading greatly increases this rate and scales with your reload speed, similar to venting Heat Weapons.

entries.name: Accomplice
entries.text: Kills refill the magazine of Energy-Slot weapons.

entries.name: Steady Hands
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 100 Handling and a 0.825x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier to all weapons for 8.5 seconds.
Additional kills while the perk is active refresh the duration to 6.5 seconds.

entries.name: Rangefinder
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights grants the following benefits:
• 10 Range
• 10% increased Effective Zoom
• 5% increased Projectile Speed
The Effective Zoom increase pushes out Aim Assist Falloff by 10%, reduces (Absolute) Recoil by 10% and narrows the Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones by the same amount. (This is the normal behavior of Zoom and isn't unique to Rangefinder)
🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.name: Trickle Charge
entries.text:
Receiving Bolt Charge refills 10% of the magazine. Does not currently dissipate Heat for Heat Weapons.
Discharging Bolt Charge refills 20% of the magazine. Dissipates 100% Heat on Heat Weapons.
Works while stowed.
🡅 Increases the magazine refill amount.

entries.name: Photoinhibition
entries.text:
Passively increases damage against shielded enemies:
• 34.3% increase against PVE Combatant Elemental Shields and Barrier Champion Shields
• 21.6% increase against PVE Combatant Overshields
• 15.6% increase against Player Overshields
Breaking a PVE Combatant's Shield Disorients them for ? seconds. Other enemies within ? meters are also Disoriented if the weapon matches the Shield's element.

entries.name: Gun and Run
entries.text:
Kills grant one stack of 'Gun And Run' for 10 (🡅 11) seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks. If the buff expires, the next kill will grant however many stacks were previously held.
