After sprinting for 0.75 seconds without a full magazine, consume one stack and refill 25% magazine capacity every 0.85 seconds.
For bows, this trait instead grants a 15% Faster Draw Time for ? seconds.
Provides no benefit to Swords.

entries.name: Sprint Grip
entries.text:
Sprinting for 1.5 seconds while holding the weapon grants 35 ADS and Ready Handling.
Buff is removed when you stop sprinting.

entries.name: Thermodynamic Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Solar or Stasis Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Desperation
entries.text:
Kills with a Cursed Thrall Explosion, or finishing a reload within 5.2? seconds of a Precision Kill, grants the following benefits for 7 seconds:
• 20% increased Rate of Fire
• 6 Stability
• 10-15 Aim Assist

entries.name: Izanagi's Burden Catalyst
entries.text:
Increases the damage bonus of Honed Edge x4 by 20%, granting the following values:
• 155% [218%] increased bodyshot damage
• 370% [487%] increased critical damage

entries.name: Lucent Blades
entries.text:
Swords are granted 30|50|60 Charge Rate with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Glaive Projectile Hits grant 20%|30%|35% Increased Weapon Energy. (Stacks additively with Immovable Object)

entries.name: Solar Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Solar Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Arc Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Arc Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Pugilist
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 🡅11% Melee Ability Energy.
Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant 🡅22%.
Dealing Melee Damage grants 35 Handling for 3 seconds.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
🡅 Melee Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%. (e.g. 10%🠚11%)

entries.name: Compression Chamber
entries.text:
Reloads its entire magazine at once.
Passive 5% increased damage falloff distance compared to similar shotguns.
While Hip-Firing, this gun fires a spread of 12 pellets in the pattern of a Precision Frame shotgun, each pellet dealing 104 [?] damage.
While Aiming Down Sights, this gun fires a single slug round, dealing 1891 [?] precision damage.

entries.name: Whisper of Chains
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Kills with Frost Armor active spawns a Stasis Shard.
Activation progress on Kills by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 34%
• Elites: 67%
• Minibosses and Bosses: 100%
• Players: ?%

entries.name: Whisper of Torment
entries.text:
Receiving damage from an enemy grants 7% Grenade Energy. This is increased to 12% while Frost Armor is active.
1 second cooldown between activations.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Whisper of Fractures
entries.text: Shattering a Frozen Enemy with a melee attack grants you a Stack of Frost Armor.

entries.name: Whisper of Impetus
entries.text:
Powered Melee Hits grant 40 Handling for 5 seconds and refill all weapons from reserves.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Alloy Magazine
entries.text:
Linearly grants a Reload Duration Multiplier as your magazine drops from 50% capacity to empty.
Reload Duration Multiplier scales from 0.9x at 50% capacity to 0.8x with an empty magazine.

entries.name: Beyond The Veil
entries.text:
Grants an extra Smoke Bomb Melee Ability Charge.
Invisibility now grants 50% [10%] Damage Resistance (Resist x4).
Cloaking allies starts their health regeneration, grants them the same Damage Resist benefits, and refunds 50% Melee Ability Energy per ally made invisible.
Damage Resistance does not apply while in Super.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Heavy Ammo Finder
entries.text: Grants a 1.33x|1.66x|2x multiplier to all Heavy Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Precision Instrument
entries.text:
Direct Weapon Hits grant a stack of Precision Instrument for 1.25 seconds (2.1 seconds on weapons with a Draw/Charge Time).
Maximum of 6 stacks. Reloading the weapon (except on Bows) or missing removes all stacks... usually.
Heavy Burst Frame weapons can only gain 1 stack per burst.
Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifles require 1.5? Hits for each stack (and missing sometimes does not remove your stacks on them).
Precision damage increase at 1|2|... stacks:
4.17% | 8.33% | 12.5% | 16.67% | 20.83% | 25%

entries.name: Killing Tally
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Killing Tally. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Stowing or reloading the weapon removes all Stacks.
Damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks:
• PVE: 10% | 20% | 30%
• PVP: 5% | 10% | 15%

entries.name: Loose Change
entries.text:
Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 🡅10 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Buff can be activated while stowed.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Reverberation
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 100 Blast Radius for 5.5 seconds.
Blast Radius does not affect the lingering pools created by Area Denial Frame Grenade Launchers.

entries.name: Rasputin's Arsenal
entries.text: Refills 50% of the Magazine (rounded up) from reserves upon breaking Elemental, Barrier Champion, or Player Shields.

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: Force Multiplier
entries.text:
Passively grants ? Reload Speed and 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Shotguns.
Scoring Shotgun or Melee Kills begins Health Regeneration after reaching 100% Progress. Minor Combatants grant 34% progress, while Elites and Guardians grant 50%.
While Void Overshield, Amplified, Restoration, Frost Armor, or Woven Mail is active:
• Shotguns deal 35% [10%] increased damage (Empowering Buff)
• Melees are granted 30% [?%] increased damage
• Shotgun or Melee kills extend the duration of any the above effects by 5 seconds, up to their respective maximum.
• If a Void Overshield is active, it also recieves 15 HP.
The following Super 'Melee' Abilities are also granted the damage bonus if the above conditions are met:
• Fist of Havoc's Light Attack
• Hammer of Sol's Shrapnel
• Sentinel Shield's Light Attack
• Glacial Quake's Light Attacks
• Glacial Quake's Howl of The Storm
The ability damage bonus stacks additively with the Shieldcrush Artifact Mod.

entries.name: Prismatic Inferno
entries.text:
Scorch and Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 15% increased damage.
Holding down the trigger for 0.45 seconds creates a focused 'Solar Field' that continuously expands from the point of impact.
The radius grows up to 4? meters wide over the course of 4 seconds, dealing 19 [6] damage every 0.1 seconds to all enemies within it.
Scoring 20 hits within 1.5 seconds of each with this weapon's beam or Solar Field applies 20 Scorch stacks (30 with Ember of Ashes).

entries.name: Violent Reanimation
entries.text:
While Devour is not active, scoring multiple kills grants Devour.
Activation Progress by Combatant Classification:
• Minors: 25%
• Elites and Above: 100%
• Players: 25%
Activation has no timer and persists through stow.

entries.name: Triple Tap
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 🡅3 seconds of each refills 1 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.
🡅 Allowed time between Precision Hits is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Edge
entries.text: Passively grants 6 Charge Rate and 6 Guard Resistance.

entries.name: Praxic Lift
entries.text:
Scoring Weapon and Arc-Powered Melee Kills build up 'Jetpack Fuel'. Weapon kills grant 20% energy, and Arc-Melee kills grant 50% energy. Jetpack Fuel additionally builds at a passive rate of 3.5% per second.
Once Jetpack Fuel is fully charged, pressing [Air Move] input while airborne thrusts you forward in a jet-propelled flight for 30 meters for 1.5 seconds. Holding down the input results in a 100% longer flight duration, traveling 50 meters over 3 seconds.
Jetpack Activation deals 168 [69] Arc Damage in a 6 meter radius and applies Exhaust.
Colliding with an enemy while flying triggers a Melee Strike for 1509 [?] Arc Damage, Blinds targets in a ? meter radius for 10 seconds, and grants 40 Melee stat for 7 seconds.

entries.name: Kinetic Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Kinetic Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Winterbite Catalyst
entries.text: Killing Frozen Enemies or Shattering a Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants a Stack of Frost Armor.

entries.name: Moving Target
entries.text:
Grants the following while Aiming Down Sights (ADS):
• 10 Aim Assist
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

entries.name: Iron Reach
entries.text: Passively increases Range by 20 but decreases Stability by 20.

entries.name: Wraithmetal Mail
entries.text:
Passively grants 10 Stability and ?% decreased Ready Animation Duration.
Casting your Class Ability grants 'Wraithmetal Mail' for 15 seconds, collects all ammo bricks within 15 meters, and reloads your currently equipped weapon. Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.
Wraithmetal Mail grants the following benefits:
• 35 Stability
• ? Handling
• 12.5% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance
• ? Decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Does not grant any benefit to the Class stat, despite what the game says.

entries.name: Synapse Junctions
entries.text:
Arc Staff hits now apply Jolt.
Hits with Arc Staff grant a Stack of 'Synapse Junctions' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Damage increases | Passive Super Drain decreases:
• Synapse Junctions x1: 27% | 20%
• Synapse Junctions x2: 61% | 40%
• Synapse Junctions x3: 105% | 60%
Arc Staff's Heavy Palm Blast (Light->Light->Heavy) recieves a higher damage bonus, dealing 40%|96%|174% increased damage at 1|2|3 stacks of Synapse Junctions.

entries.name: Probability Matrix
entries.text:
Arcbolt Grenades Jolt and Disrupt targets on hit and can chain an additional time (4🠚5).
Applying Jolt or triggering a Jolt chain grant 15% and 7.5% Arcbolt Grenade energy, respectively. (Due to the nature of Jolt, these events can often happen simultaneously)
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Compulsive Reloader
entries.text:
While above 50% Magazine Capacity:
🡅55 Reload Speed with a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.
🡅 Reload Speed bonus is increased by 5.

entries.name: Cross Counter
entries.text:
While you have an Arc Melee Ability equipped:
Receiving Melee damage or scoring an Arc Elemental Melee Hit grants the 'Cross Counter' buff for your next Melee Attack within 3 seconds.
Cross Counter grants 400% additional base Melee damage and restores 40 HP on Melee Hits. Cross Counter's Melee deals Arc Damage.

entries.name: Chain Reaction
entries.text:
Weapon Kills trigger an elemental explosion matching the weapon's element.
Damage and radius of the explosions varies based on the weapon's ammo type:
• Special Weapons: Up to 🡅73.92 [49.28] damage in a 2.4 meter radius
• Power Weapons: Up to 🡅120.12 [80.08] damage in a 3 meter radius
🡅 Explosion damage is increased by 10%.
Swords receive 20 Guard Endurance.

entries.name: Graviton Lance Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 20 Range.
Grants the Turnabout trait:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 10 seconds.
Also grants the Vorpal Weapon trait:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.
Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• Primary Weapons: 20% [60%]
• Special Weapons: 15% [20%]
• Power Weapons: 10% [20%]

entries.name: Vigilance Wing Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants the Ensemble trait:
Grants 30 Handling and 40 Reload Speed while within 15 meters of an ally.
Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once you're no longer near allies.

entries.name: Successful Warm-Up
entries.text:
Weapon Kills decrease Charge/Draw Time by 37.5% for 6 seconds.
Kills while the perk is active add 🡅5 seconds to the duration up to a maximum of 20 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Additional kills add 1 more second to the duration.

entries.name: Fanatical Lance
entries.text:
Scoring kills in either mode triggers a 7.5 meter radius Void explosion, dealing 239 [?] damage and spawning a Radiolaria Pool at the target's location. Pool deals 123 [?] Arc damage in a 3 meter radius once per second for 5 seconds.
Kills needed to spawn a Radiolaria Pool based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 3
• Elites and Higher: 1
• Players: ?
While not Aiming Down Sights:
Firing this gun consumes 5 ammo and launches a slow-traveling projectile, splitting into a plus (+) shaped volley of five projectiles after 7.5 meters. Projectiles deal splash damage in a ? meter radius, despawn after 100 meters, and cannot deal precision damage.
Hitting an enemy with the projectile before it splits deals 947 [233] damage in a 3 meter radius.
Split projectiles individually deal 187 [49] damage each, totalling for 985 [245] damage in a 3 meter radius.

entries.name: Warlord's End
entries.text:
Does not work with Grapple melee or Song of Flame melees.
Powered Melee damage Weakens targets for 6 seconds (15% debuff).
Powered Melee and Finisher Kills disorient and apply a stronger (30%) Weaken debuff to enemies in a given radius around the target.
The debuff Duration and application radius are dependent on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 15 meter radius, 10 second duration
• Elites, Players: 20m radius, 15s duration
• Minibosses, Bosses: 25m radius, 20s duration
Finishers increase the debuff duration by 5 seconds and the application radius by 5 meters. Both duration and radius are capped at the values provided by killing (Mini)Bosses.
Additional PvP effects of on-kill debuffs: screen is blackened for 7.5 seconds before gradually fading away over the following 7.5 seconds. (HUD remains unobstructed)
Applying Weaken to the target extends the debuff's duration.

entries.name: Flight
entries.text: Passively grants 6 Velocity and 6 Persistance.

entries.name: Desperado
entries.text:
Finishing a reload 5.2 seconds after a Precision Kill or 3 kills within ? seconds of each reduces Firing Delay by 30% for 🡅7 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Ruinscribe's Forge
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to switch to Ruinscribe Turret Mode and make your next shot launch an autonomous floating turret. Costs 3 ammo.
Deploying a turret refills the magazine.
Turret lasts for 25 seconds and targets enemies in a 70 meter radius, firing a 359 [131] damage missile at the closest target every 2 seconds.

entries.name: Ride the Bull
entries.text:
Holding down the trigger grants a stack of 'Ride The Bull' every 0.833 seconds. Maximum of 2 stacks. Stacks are removed on trigger release.
Ride The Bull grants 10%|20% increased rate of fire and ?%|?% increased recoil at 1|2 stacks.
Kills instantly refill the magazine.

entries.name: Melee Font
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Melee stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Solar Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Solar Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Adept Reload
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Stasis Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Stasis Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Sword Logic
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant Stacks of Sword Logic.
The number of Stacks and the buff duration are tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed since activation:
• Minors: 1 Stack for 🡅6.5 seconds
• Elites, Players: 2 Stacks for 🡅8.5 seconds
• Players in their Super and Minibosses: 3 Stacks for 🡅11.5 seconds
• Bosses: 4 Stacks for 🡅16.5 seconds
Damage increase at 1|2|3|4 Stacks:
15% | 25% [15%] | 35% | 50%
Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to the duration tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Quantum Nova
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to consume up to  9 Ammo from reserves and refill the magazine, activating 'Quantum Nova'.
The duration of Quantum Nova depends on the amount of ammo consumed. Buff lasts for 4|8|14|20 seconds upon consuming 1|3|6|9 reserve ammo.
While active, this gun applies a Strong Weaken (30%) that lasts for 5 seconds on hit.
Timer is paused while stowed.

entries.name: Cormorant Combo
entries.text:
Press [Heavy Attack] immediately after landing 3 Light Attacks to perform an overhead strike, dealing 689 [?] damage followed by 3 additional ticks of 417 [?] damage each.
With Impact Core Equipped: Blade Melee Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
•  Grants x1 Bolt Charge
•  25? Scorch (35? with Ember of Ashes)
•  Weakens for 6 seconds
•  40 Slow for 1? second (2? with Whisper of Durance)
•  Severs for 10 seconds (15 with Thread of Continuity)

entries.name: Elliptical Orbit
entries.text:
Passively grants 'Inner Orbit'. Sprinting for 1.5 seconds replaces this buff with 'Outer Orbit', which lasts for 3 seconds after exiting sprint. Sprinting again will refresh the buff to its full duration.
Benefits granted by 'Inner Orbit':
• ? Stability
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% Flinch Resistance
Benefits granted by 'Outer Orbit':
• 🡅 45 Ammo Generation Stat

entries.name: Memento Mori
entries.text:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.
Grants Radar while Aiming Down Sights.
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill grants 6 'Memento Mori' shots, each dealing 68% [29%] increased damage.
Ace of Spades has 15% Decreased Damage Falloff Distance while Memento Mori is active.
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.name: Power Surge
entries.text:
Scoring 2 hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next shot fired within 3 seconds to have an Explosive Payload. Explosive Payload deals 122 [?] additional damage over 4 meters, which deals 50% reduced damage at the edge of its radius.
Hits with this Payload grant 8%? additional progress to Latent Power.

entries.name: Gear Shift
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill, or becoming Amplified, grants 1 stack of 'Gear Shift' for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Grants 15%|20%|25%|30%|35% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks.
Buff can be triggered while stowed and refreshed with each new application of Amplified.

entries.name: Conserve Momentum
entries.text:
Kills grant 34% decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.
Each projectile hit grants one stack of 'Conserve Momentum'. Maximum of 15 stacks.
Conserve Momentum non-linearly decreases Charge Time and damage for each stack earned:
• 7% decreased Charge Time and 0.84% decreased damage at the first stack
• 80% decreased Charge Time and 11.93% decreased damage at maximum stacks

entries.name: Meganeura
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one stack of Meganeura for 3.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing 123.89 [95.3] | 173.6 [?] | 207.57 [?] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 7.5-meter radius at 1|2|3| stacks.
Explosion has up to 50% damage falloff at the furthest point.

entries.name: Sniper Damage Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Damage from PVE Combatants more than 29 meters away by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Skyburner Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 20 Reload Speed.
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.
Direct Hits against Scorched Enemies apply 10 [4] additional Scorch per Direct Hit (15 [9?] with Ember of Ashes) on a 0.5 second cooldown.
Scoring 11 Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.
Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.

entries.name: Iceflare Bolts
entries.text:
Shattering a Frozen enemy creates a Stasis Seeker that targets the closest enemy within a 12 meter radius.
Seekers detonate in a 3 [1.75] meter radius upon reaching their target, Freezing all enemies hit.
Iceflare Bolts incur an 8 second cooldown upon creating 7 [1] Seekers within ? seconds of each other.

entries.name: Frostpulse
entries.text:
Freezing enemies grants 11% Class Ability Energy per enemy frozen.
Casting your Class Ability instantly Freezes enemies within an 8.5 [5] meter radius and increases Melee Lunge Distance by 2.5 meters for 1.2 seconds. Enemy Players within 5 to 8 meters receive x50 Slow stacks for 3? seconds.
Successfully freezing a target with this ability grants x5 Frost Armor.

entries.name: Compulsive Reloader
entries.text:
While above 50% Magazine Capacity:
50 Reload Speed with a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

entries.name: Forerunner Catalyst
entries.text:
Holding [Reload] within 4 seconds of a kill consumes 4 ammo, refills the magazine, and grants 'The Rock'.
The Rock replaces your grenade ability with a tossed Kinetic grenade that explodes for 2072 [181] damage in a 9 meter radius, dealing 20% damage at the edge of its radius. Detonates 0.6 seconds after it slows down enough.
The Rock counts as a grenade ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-associated effects.

entries.name: Circle of Life
entries.text:
Triggering 'Support Frame Boost' by healing allies with the weapon grants 25% [12.5%] increased damage for 🡅11 seconds.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Transcendent Moment
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant stat benefits based on the weapon's elemental alignment for ? seconds.
Light Alignment grants ? Stability and ? Handling.
Dark Alignment grants ? Range and ? Aim Assist.
Kills while Transcendent activate both bonuses.
Light Alignment: Arc, Solar, Void
Darkness Alignment: Stasis, Strand
🡅 Buff duration is increased.

entries.name: Eddy Current
entries.text:
Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier
Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.
Being Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.

entries.name: Health Font
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Health stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Solar Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Solar Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Accelerated Coils
entries.text: Decreases charge time by 40ms and damage by 2%.

entries.name: Pugilist
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 10% Melee Ability Energy.
Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant 20%.
Dealing Melee Damage grants 35 Handling for 3 seconds.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Light Shift
entries.text:
Replaces Dodge with Shift if you have a Stasis or Arc Super equipped (does not work with Acrobat's Dodge), and overrides base cooldown to that of Marksman's Dodge.
Shift effectively acts as a fast horizontal teleport with a travel distance of 10 meters. Shift renders you completely invisible (except for a trail) and invulnerable for the duration of the animation.
Casting Shift grants one stack of 'Light Shift' for 11 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Light Shift grants 10%|21%|33% increased Arc, Stasis, and Lord of Wolves Weapon Damage at 1|2|3 Stacks.
Light Shift additionally grants 10% increased Weapon Damage against Stasis-debuffed enemies.
Light Shift's buff stacks with all other buff sources.
Passive Class Ability regeneration is disabled for the duration of Light Shift. Instead, Weapon Kills grant 60% Class Ability Energy while Light Shift is active.

entries.name: Reciprocity
entries.text: Hitting allies with healing projectiles from the weapon restores 3 HP to you for each projectile.

entries.name: Soulforge
entries.text:
Enemies that are afflicted by this weapon's Potent Corruption create a 'Soulfire Crystal' upon death.
Soulfire Crystals have 400 HP and linger in the world for 15 seconds upon creation. Upon destruction, the crystals explode for 1,065 [?] damage in an 8 meter radius, experiencing up to 25% damage falloff at the edge of the blast radius.

entries.name: Offensive Grip
entries.text:
Scoring 3 damage instances grants 1 ammo.
Passively grants:
• 5 Impact (~3% increased damage)
• 20 Charge Rate
• 10 Guard Resistance
• 10 Guard Endurance

entries.name: Eye of the Storm
entries.text:
Grants a scaling buff to Handling and Accuracy as your Shield Health drops below 40 and reaches maximum strength at 0 Shield HP.
Buff at maximum strength grants:
• 30 Handling
• 40% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 17% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
The buff linearly scales from 0% at 80 Shield HP to 100% at 0 Shield HP (Critical Health).
It initially triggers as you drop to 40 Shield HP — giving you 50% of the maximum buff. However, as you regenerate your Shield Health, the buff will still remain until you reach 80 Shield HP where the benefits scale down to zero.

entries.name: Vengeance
entries.text:
Receiving damage highlights the enemy that dealt it for 8 seconds. Highlighting cannot be transfered to a different target before it expires.
Killing the highlighted enemy grants the Vengeance buff for 6 seconds, providing a 95 HP Overshield.
Highlighting is disabled while Vengeance is active.

entries.name: Stasis Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Stasis Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Quickdraw
entries.text:
Switching to the Weapon grants 100 Ready/Stow Handling and a 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier for 1 second.
Buff is removed as soon as ADS input is pressed.

entries.name: Sniper Damage Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Damage from PVE Combatants more than 29 meters away by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Elemental Capacitor
entries.text:
Grants Passive Bonuses based on the element of your selected Super's element:
• Solar: 🡅55 Reload Speed
• Arc: 🡅55 Handling
• Void: 🡅25 Stability
• Strand: 🡅25 Airborne Effectiveness
• Stasis: 🡅25 Recoil Direction & 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
🡅 Stat Bonuses are increased by 5.

entries.name: Perfect Float
entries.text:
After being in Combat for 6 seconds:
Grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness and 35% Flinch Resistance for 🡅12 seconds.
Can activate while stowed. Dealing and receiving damage refreshes the buff duration.
For Pefect Float, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 🡅3.5 seconds.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds. Allowed time between damage exchanges is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Jolting Feedback
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits with the weapon within 3 seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to apply Jolt.
Being Amplified decreases the number of Hits required.
Hits needed to activate normally | while Amplified:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 🡅17 | 13
• Machine Guns: 🡅14 | 11
• Auto Rifles: 🡅14 | 11
• Pulse Rifles: 🡅13 | 9
• Sidearms: 🡅9 | 7
• Rocket Pulse Rifle: 🡅7 | 5
• Scout Rifles, Hand Cannons: 🡅5 | 🡅3
• Swords: 🡅4 | 🡅3
• Glaives, Linear Fusion Rifles: 🡅3 | 3
• Rocket Sidearm, Sniper Rifle?: 🡅3 | 2
• Bows, Grenade Launchers: 🡅2 | 2
• Shotguns, Aggressive Frame Fusion Rifle: 🡅2|1
🡅 Number of Hits required while not Amplified is decreased by 1.

entries.name: Stasis Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Stasis Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Dearly Departed
entries.text:
Grants 25% [5%] Damage Resistance (Resist x2) to you and allies inside Rifts you create. (Well of Radiance does not count but you can cast a Rift inside it for the benefits)
Reaching Critical Health grants the Dearly Departed buff, granting 50% [25%] Class Ability Energy.
Buff lasts until you are no longer at Critical Health, essentially serving as a cooldown.
Dying spawns a Healing Rift at your location.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Truth Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)
'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 15 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.
Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 15-second duration.
Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.

entries.name: Freehand Grip
entries.text: Passively decreases Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone Size by 30% and grants a 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier.

entries.name: Blessing of the Sky
entries.text:
Hip-Firing consumes one stack of 'Noble Rounds' and fires a healing orb that seeks the closest ally within a ? meter radius.
Healing orbs restore 90HP to all allies within a ? meter radius of impact, and grant both you and them 'Blessing Of The Sky'.
Blessing of The Sky is an Empowering Buff that grants 35% [15%] increased Weapon Damage and 100 Class Stat for 11 seconds.

entries.name: Vanguard's Vindication
entries.text: Weapon Kills restore 10 HP.

entries.name: Well-Rounded
entries.text:
Grenade Ability usage and Elemental Melee hits grant 1 Stack of Well-Rounded for 15 seconds. Super Ability usage grants 2 Stacks. Maximum of 2 Stacks.
Each Stack grants 10 Range, 10 Stability, and 10 Handling.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: No Backpack
entries.text:
This gun has no reserve ammo and fires at 49 RPM. Deals ~47% increased damage against PvE Combatants compared to an Aggressive-Frame Sniper Rifle.
Shots fired deal 2761 [497] precision damage.
Kills or assists with abilities and other guns generate ammo based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 1 Ammo (per 2 kills)
• Elites: 2 Ammo
• Miniboss and Bosses: 3 Ammo
• Guardians: 1? Ammo

entries.name: Adept Charge Time
entries.text: Passively decreases Charge Time by 40ms without affecting damage.

entries.name: Disorienting Grenades
entries.text:
Passively grants -200 Blast Radius, 25% decreased damage, and 15% decreased detonation radius.
Enemies within 6 meters of the explosion are disoriented for 4.5 seconds. Disorient radius cannot be increased using other perks.
Champions and Bosses are unaffected by Disorient.
(Disorient is effectively the equivalent of Arc Blind without any of the elemental synergies and anti-champion benefits)
Players near the explosion briefly lose their HUD and have their screen distorted for up to ? seconds. Duration varies depending on the distance from the blast.

entries.name: Break the Bank
entries.text:
Direct Hits apply 'Blighted' to the target, dealing twice as much tick damage as Blighted Pools at half the rate for 9.5 seconds. Killing Blighted enemies causes them to drop a Blighted Pool.
Targets can only take damage from a single instance of Blighted at a time.
Enemies that are Blighted can take simultaneous damage from a Blighted Pool, and also take 25% increased damage from Malfeasance and Wish-Ender.
Blighted targets are STILL NOT CONSIDERED "TAKEN COMBATANTS".

entries.name: Aggressive Burst
entries.text: Hard-hitting two-burst fire.

entries.name: Aggressive Frame
entries.text: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after kill.

entries.name: Bray Inheritance
entries.text:
Weapon Hits grant Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy. Does not require Direct Hits.
Ability Energy gains on Hits by weapon:
• Trustee: 0.35%
• Posterity: 0.45%
• Commemoration: 0.4%
• Heritage: 0.85%
• Succession: 1.5%
• Bequest: 2% (Grenade and Class Ability only)
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Colony Catalyst
entries.text: Increases Magazine Size by 1 (7🠚8) and grants 30 Ammo Generation.

entries.name: Repulsor Brace
entries.text: Kills against Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistence).

entries.name: No Distractions
entries.text:
Grants 35% Flinch Resistance after 1 second of Aiming Down Sights (ADS) without firing. Remains active until you're no longer ADS.
Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.

entries.name: Enlightened Action
entries.text:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.
Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed
Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack

entries.name: Field Prep
entries.text:
Grants the following while Crouched:
• 50 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier
Passively grants 20 Ammo Generation stat. (50% more than 1 Ammo Generation armor mod)

entries.name: Play with Your Prey
entries.text:
Void Rocket applies Suppression for 10 seconds.
Solar Rocket applies 60 Scorch (90 with Ember of Ashes).

entries.name: Osmosis
entries.text:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.
Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.
Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on Primary, 15% on Special).
Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.name: Surrounded
entries.text:
Being within 15 meters of 3 Enemies grants 🡅47% increased damage. Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once the condition is no longer met.
Exceptions:
• Swords only receive a 🡅41.75% damage increase.
• Grenade and Rocket Launchers receive a 🡅41.75% Explosive Damage increase and a 🡅47% Impact Damage increase.
• Wolfpack Rounds receive a 🡅41.75% Explosive Damage increase.
🡅 Damage is increased by a further 5%. (40%🠚47%, 35%🠚41.75%)

entries.name: One-Two Punch
entries.text:
Hitting a target with 🡅10 of the 12 Pellets in the spread increases the damage of your next Melee attack within 3 seconds.
Melee Damage increase by weapon type:
• Shotgun: 150% additional base melee damage
• Hand Cannon: 75% [100?%] additional base melee damage
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
The buff does not stack with the passive Melee Damage increase against Frozen non-Boss targets. The higher buff of the two takes precedence.
🡅 Requires 2 fewer Pellets to activate.

entries.name: Unflinching Arc Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Arc Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Evolution
entries.text:
Transmutation Spheres act like Relics and grant three actions. Spheres last 30 seconds once on the ground, start with 30 ammo on pickup, and drain at a rate of 1 ammo per second. Dropping a Sphere despawns it.
• Light Attacks deal 270 [150] damage, disorient combatants, and cost 1 ammo. You can attack twice per second. Airborne attacks deal 25% reduced damage.
• Heavy Attacks consume the sphere, slamming it on the ground for 1350 [300] damage with no falloff, and Suppress enemies in a 5 meter radius.
• Guarding projects a draining field in a 5 meter radius around you. The field disorients enemies, deals 28 [12] damage every 0.3 seconds to lifesteal 5 HP, and grants 80% [50%] damage resistance along with knockback immunity.
Guarding drains 1 ammo every 0.25 seconds, slowing at 3 ammo and halting on the final round. Guarding at 1 ammo deals increasingly lethal self-damage every 0.7 seconds until you stop or die.

entries.name: Void Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Void Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Temporal Unlimiter
entries.text:
Kills in Auto Rifle mode grant 'Overcharge' stacks. Maximum of 6 Stacks.
Tier 1 and 2 Minors, as well as Tier 1 Elites grant 1 stack. All other enemy tiers and players grant 2 stacks.
At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to change this Fusion Rifle into a Linear Fusion Rifle. Grants three Hobgoblin-like shots that deal 1475 [537] precision damage and 200% increased damage against Champions. Stowing after activation removes all charged shots.
Precision Kills while in this mode trigger a Solar Ignition that deals 5% more damage than base.
Exiting Linear Mode refills the magazine.

entries.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
entries.text: Full Auto. Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.

entries.name: Heretical Behavior
entries.text:
Landing 4 Weapon Hits within 3 seconds of each other grants 'Heretical Behavior' for 8 (🡅 ?) seconds. Each hit only counts once every 0.4 seconds. Glaive Melees require 8 hits. Area-Denial Grenade Launchers require ? hits.
Heretical Behavior grants the following benefits while active:
• 8% Increased Damage
• 50? Handling
• 50? Reload Speed
• 20% Faster Reload Animation Speed
Buff can be refreshed.

entries.name: Finality's Auger Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants the Bait and Switch trait:
Dealing damage with a weapon starts a 7 second timer. Dealing additional weapon damage resets the timer to 7 seconds.
Dealing damage with all 3 of your weapons without letting the timer run out grants you 'Bait and Switch' for 10 seconds, granting 30% increased damage.
Timer is disabled while Bait and Switch is active, requiring a full activation sequence once the buff expires.

entries.name: Shattering Blade
entries.text: Grants 67% increased damage for Grounded Heavy Attacks that consume all remaining ammo.

entries.name: Red Death Reformed Catalyst
entries.text:
Scoring 2 [1] kills grants 'Red Death Charged'.
Your next kill with Red Death Reformed consumes this buff and triggers a burst of healing, granting 120 HP (Cure x2) to allies within a 7.5 meter radius of you.
This kill also spawns a Restoration Orb at your feet, granting you and allies Restoration x2 for 4 seconds (6 with Ember of Solace) on pickup.

entries.name: Proximity Power
entries.text:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of an enemy grant a stack of Proximity Power 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Each stack grants 🡅18 Melee stat.
🡅 Grants 3 more Melee stat per stack.

entries.name: Seriously, Watch Out
entries.text:
Grants one stack of Bolt Charge every 1.5 seconds while Juggernaut's Shield is active.
While Speed Booster is active, allies in a ""certain"" area behind you receive Speed Booster.
...We have no idea what they were cooking with this rework, but it's here to stay I guess.

entries.name: Backup Plan
entries.text:
Grants the following for 🡅2.5 seconds upon readying:
• 30% decreased Charge Time
• 20% decreased damage
• 100 Handling
Weapon must be stowed for 3 seconds before readying for the perk to activate.
Linear Fusion Rifles only: firing the weapon refreshes the buff duration (but only at higher framerates).
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Phase Magazine
entries.text:
Sets the Submachine Gun's damage and magazine profile to that of a Precision Frame.
Does not grant Precision Frame intrinsic benefits.

entries.name: Lucent Blades
entries.text:
Swords are granted 30|50|60 Charge Rate with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Glaive Projectile Hits grant 20%|30%|35% Increased Weapon Energy. (Stacks additively with Immovable Object)

entries.name: Hatchling
entries.text: Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

entries.name: Kickstart
entries.text:
Upon sliding after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon held:
Grants 15% increased damage and 20% decreased Charge Time for ? seconds.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased.

entries.name: Stasis Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Stasis Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Vex Mythoclast Catalyst
entries.text:
Landing 15 hits within 3 seconds of each, or scoring a kill, grants 20% increased damage, 20 Stability, and 20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size for 5 seconds.
Buff applies to Auto Rifle mode only.

entries.name: Encore
entries.text:
On Weapon Kill, for 🡅7.5 seconds:
Grants 1 Stack on Bodyshot Kills and 2 Stacks on Precision Kills. Maximum of 4 Stacks.
Each stack grants 5 Range, 8 Stability, and -1.25% Accuracy Cone Size.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Steady Hands
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 100 Handling and a 0.825x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier to all weapons for 🡅9.5 seconds.
Additional kills while the perk is active refresh the duration to 6.5 seconds.
🡅 Initial Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Carrion Munitions
entries.text:
Killing an Elite or higher-ranked Combatant spawns a seeking insectoid robot that chases enemies within 25 meters. The insectoid deals weapon-element matching damage (varying by archetype) in a 5 meter radius.
0.5 second cooldown between insectoid spawns. Insectoid kills count as weapon kills and can trigger perks, but cannot spawn more insectoids.
🡅 Insectoid robot damage is increased by ?%

entries.name: Lightning Seeker
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a seeking Arc Wave.
Lightning Seeker Properties:
• Aggresively tracks the closest enemy within a 32 meter radius, dealing 1634 [Death] damage and applying Jolt
• Additionally chains to 4 additional targets within a 10 meter radius on hit, dealing 65 damage

entries.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
entries.text:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 🡅3 seconds of each refills 2 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.
🡅 Allowed time between Precision Hits is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Unrelenting
entries.text:
Starts Health Regeneration and restores 🡅70 HP upon reaching 100% Activation Progress with Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each.
Activation Progress by Enemy Rank:
• Minor Combatants: 34%
• Players: 67%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
🡅 Restores an additional 5 HP.

entries.name: Ashes to Assets
entries.text:
Increases Super Energy Gains from Grenade Kills based on Enemy Rank with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1%|?|?
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: ?|?|?
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?|?|?
• T4 Minors, T3-T4 Elites, and higher: 5%|?|?
• Players: ?|?|?
Bonus Super Energy gains from Grapple Melee Kills are reduced by 50%. Kill can only trigger either Ashes to Assets or Hands On but not both.

entries.name: Tight Fit
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Direct Weapon Hits within 3? seconds of each grants ~20% Class Ability Energy. There is no cooldown on hits or activation procs (Hint: Use DoT Weapons).
Activation progress granted by weapon type:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords, Shotguns: 20%
• Fusion Rifles, Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Sniper Rifles: 34%
Casting Dodge reloads all equipped weapons, collects all nearby ammo bricks within 15 meters, and grants you 1 Stack of 'Tight Fit' for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.
Allies within 15 meters receive the same number of stacks as you have after the Dodge.
Stat Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 40|40|45|50|55 Reload Speed
• 0%|7.5%|8.5%|9%|11% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 40?|40?|45?|50?|55? Handling

entries.name: One for All
entries.text:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 🡅11 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Vermin
entries.text: Finishing a reload within 3 seconds of a kill grants Void Invisibility for 5.8 seconds.

entries.name: Jötunn Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants the Cornered trait:
Grants 15% decreased Charge/Draw Time while within 15 meters of 2 enemies.
Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.
Also grants the Incandescent trait:
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

entries.name: Shot in the Dark
entries.text:
Entering Void Invisibility grants 'Shot in The Dark' until you leave Invisibility. Lasts for 2.5 seconds upon exit.
While Shot In The Dark is active:
• 25% increased damage
• Hits apply Weaken for 6 [3] seconds
• Kills grant Invisiblity again

entries.name: Paracausal Imbuement
entries.text:
Kills grant bonus Super Energy based on Combatant Rank.
Refills the magazine on Super cast.
Grants 20% increased damage for 20 seconds once Super energy reaches 0%.

entries.name: Harmonic Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Weapons matching your Super Element and the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Willing Vessel
entries.text:
Dealing damage or scoring kills increments continuously scales up stat bonuses. Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up continuously.
Maximum effect is displayed as x5 Willing Vessel. Stat bonuses constantly decrease by 2.2?% of the maximum bonus per second?.
Stat bonuses when the visual stack display reaches 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• ?|?|?|?|20? Stability
• ?|?|?|?|30? Handling
• 2?|5|10|25|30 Reload Speed
• ?|?|?|?|15% decreased Draw/Charge Time
• 20|40|50|70|80 Charge Rate (Swords)

entries.name: Strategist
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 10% Class Ability Energy.
Kills with Fusion Rifles, Glaives, Shotguns, and Sniper Rifles grant 20%.
Class Ability usage grants ? Stability for ? seconds.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: And Another Thing
entries.text:
Grants an extra Grenade Ability Charge and a passive copy of Firepower.
Weapon Kills grant 10% Grenade Ability Energy, and using a Grenade Ability refills your weapon's magazine.

entries.name: Bolt Scavenger
entries.text:
Picking up a Crossbow Bolt grants ? Handling and ? Reload Speed for 4 seconds.
Picking up additional Bolts adds 3? seconds to the buff duration up to the maximum of 15 seconds.
🡅 Buff duration is increased.

entries.name: Hunter's Trace IV
entries.text:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.
Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.
Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [474] precision damage.
Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.

entries.name: Hunter's Trace II
entries.text:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.
Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.
Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [474] precision damage.
Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.

entries.name: Hunter's Trace III
entries.text:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.
Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.
Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [474] precision damage.
Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.

entries.name: Rapid Cooldown
entries.text:
Class Ability usage grants 6.25% increased Sprint Speed for 10 seconds. Duration is not refreshable.
Sprinting grants the following benefits:
• 1 stack of Frost Armor every 3 [6] seconds
• 100% [200%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Doubled [100% Additional] Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate
For as long as Frost Armor is active, you are granted x3 [x1] Stasis Weapon Surge.
Multiplicative Ability Regeneration Rate increase in PVE is applied after all additive Ability Regeneration Rate modifiers.

entries.name: Kinetic Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Kinetic Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Blessing of Order
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Lumina and Noble Seekers grant Noble Rounds to it.
Standing in a Rift or Well of Radiance creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies within 40 meters and apply buffs to them:
• Healing Rift Seeker: restores 70 Health, 60 Shields, and starts Health Regeneration
• Empowering Rift Seeker: grants 100 Class Stat and 35% [15%] increased damage for 5 seconds (Empowering Buff)
Noble seekers spawn at a constant rate based on your Fireteam size.
Buffing allies with Noble Seekers grants ?|25%|?|?|? Class Ability energy based when your fireteam has 2|3|4|5|6 members.
Seekers prioritize allies who have not been healed in the last 8 seconds followed by nearby allies. Seekers will not target an ally more than once every 4 seconds.

entries.name: Discord
entries.text:
Grants the following for 🡅8 seconds upon readying the weapon within 5? seconds of scoring a Kill with a different weapon:
• 25% decreased ADS Animation Duration
• 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness
Weapon Kills while Discord is active fully refill the Magazine of Primary Weapons, and refund 1 Ammo for Special and Power Weapons. (Scoring multiple kills with a single shot/burst still only refunds 1 ammo.)
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.

entries.name: Sneak Bow
entries.text:
Crouching grants the following benefits:
• Prevents Radar Ping when shooting
• ? Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 25% increased Hold Time

entries.name: Puppeteer's Control
entries.text:
Improves Drengr's Lash and grants Woven Mail for 10 seconds upon Suspending enemies.
When used with a Barricade:
Drengr's Lash creates 2 additional Lashes. Lashes gain stronger seeking capabilities, travel 16.7% (5 meters) farther, and Suspend for 3 seconds longer (2 seconds for Minibosses).
When used with Thruster:
Created Strand Knot is launched towards nearby enemies with some tracking. Detonates and Suspends nearby targets on contact.

entries.name: Telesto Catalyst
entries.text:
Increases the Magazine Size by 3 (4🠚7) and grants 40 Ammo Generation.
Triggering Harbinger's Pulse three times will cause Telesto to start smoking and short circuiting, granting access to 'Harbinger's Seethe'.
Hold [Reload] to slap your malfunctioning Telesto. On its next direct hit, it will spawn a Wormhole from the Telesto Dimmension, wildly spraying 22 Telesto Bolts over 2.25 seconds.

entries.name: Fervid Coldsnap
entries.text:
Grants Coldsnap Grenades an extra Ability Charge, better tracking, and travel 17.5% farther and faster.
Damaging an enemy with Coldsnap Grenades grants Grenade Ability Energy.
Grenade Energy gains based on Enemy Rank:
• Enemy Players: 7%
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 34%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 50%
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Slice
entries.text:
Using your Class Ability (even while the weapon is stowed) grants you 'Slice' for 8 seconds.
While 'Slice' is active, damaging non-Severed targets Severs them, grants a stack of Slice, and refreshes the buff duration. (Hitting immune targets also triggers this.)
Reaching 5 stacks immediately removes the buff.
If the Severing hit kills the target, the perk will not trigger and you will not gain a stack.

entries.name: Fighting Lion Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.
Firing this gun grants equipped Kinetic and Heavy ammo weapons the following benefits for 3 seconds:
• 100 Handling
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size

entries.name: Prospector Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 40 Blast Radius and 50 Reload Speed.
Increases Blast Radius by ?% and decreases Self-Damage by 40% while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.
Effect lingers for 3.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.

entries.name: Tome of Dawn
entries.text:
While a Solar Super Ability is equipped:
• Grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness while airborne
• Aiming Down Sights while airborne grants 'Tome of Dawn'
Tome of Dawn lasts 2.8 seconds and holds you in place midair. Weapon Hits add ? seconds to its duration.
Tome of Dawn grants the following benefits:
• 15% Damage Resistance
• 25% Flinch Resistance
• Enemies are less accurate when targeting you
• Weapon Kills grant Restoration x1 and refill the magazines of stowed weapons from reserves

entries.name: Fusion Harness
entries.text:
Grants the following with Fusion Grenades equipped:
• An extra Grenade Charge
• 100% Class Ability Energy on Fusion Grenade Kills
• Passive 20% Additional Base Grenade Ability Recharge Rate
While Radiant, in an Empowering Rift, or in a Well of Radiance:
• Weapon Kills grant 15% Fusion Grenade energy
• Weapon Hits grant 5% Fusion Grenade energy (0.4 second cooldown between activations)
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Resolute
entries.text:
Scoring 2 to 3 Arc Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 1 Stack of Arc Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks. Arc Kills while at 4 Stacks refresh the buff's duration.
Grants a 75 HP Overshield upon casting the Fists of Havoc Super that negates Precision Damage. As long as it does not get fully destroyed, the overshield regenerates over 7 seconds after not receiving damage for 5 seconds.
Scoring Kills with Fists of Havoc refunds ?% Super Energy.
Once Fists of Havoc ends, it grants 4 Stacks of Arc Weapon Surge for 30 [6] seconds.

entries.name: Cayde's Retribution
entries.text:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.
Precision Hits and collecting Orbs of Power charge up a Golden Gun. Precision Hits grant 16.67% progress, and Orbs of Power grant 8.34% progress. Progress persists through death, and Rally Flags fully charge this perk.
Hold [Reload] at full charge to cast 'Cayde's Retribution' for 3 shots. Cayde's Retribution lasts 16 seconds and deals 100% increased precision damage to Bosses.
Each Precision Hit with Cayde's Retribution grants 45%|90% increased damage for the 2nd|3rd shot.
Wearing Celestial Nighthawk transforms Cayde's Retribution into a single high-powered shot that deals ~43% more damage than 3 successive precision shots and causes enemies to explode if defeated.
Does not count as a super for related effects or buffs.

entries.name: Advanced Reflexes
entries.text:
Upon Aiming Down Sights or Guarding within 1 second of receiving damage:
• 5% Increased Damage
• 30 Mobility
• 40 Handling
• 35 Charge Rate (Swords) for 7.5 seconds.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Concussive Dampener
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming AoE Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Contending Cascade
entries.text:
Scoring kills within 4 seconds of another kill each grant a stack of Contending Cascade. Maximum of ? stacks. Kills from any source count.
Each stack of Contending Cascade grants increased Handling and Reload Speed.
Starting at 15 stacks, kills trigger an explosion matching this weapon's element.

entries.name: Horizon Ironsights
entries.text: Iron Sights. Allows for peripheral vision while scoped in.

entries.name: Personal Assistant
entries.text:
Hits apply Jolt.
Aiming at a target for 0.5 seconds highlights them and reports their Health and Shield percentages, Distance, and Power Level into the scope.
Maximum Highlight Range of 150 Meters.

entries.name: Target Acquired
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits while Personal Assistant is active:
• 18.35% increased damage
• 31.34% increased precision damage
• ? Aim Assist
• 50% decreased Flinch, Recoil, and Accuracy Cone Size
Buff lasts for 1 second after being off-target.

entries.name: Icarus Grip
entries.text: Passively grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness.

entries.name: SUROS Legacy
entries.text:
Kills have a 25% chance to grant 20 HP and begin Health Regeneration.
Linearly grants 5% to 10% increased damage as the magazine decreases from 50% capacity.

entries.name: Impulse Amplifier
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Reload Speed and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration (20% for Rocket Launchers).
Passively increases Projectile Velocity based on Weapon Archetype:
• Rocket Launchers: 10%
• Support-Frame Auto Rifles: 15%
• Micro-Missile Frame Weapons: 25%

entries.name: Arc Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Arc Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Onslaught
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 🡅5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5? seconds.

entries.name: Snapshot Sights
entries.text:
Passively decreases the ADS Animation Duration:
• 50% decrease on Primary Weapons
• 20% decrease on Special Weapons

entries.name: Danger Zone
entries.text:
Increases Blast Radius by ?% and decreased Self-Damage while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.
Effect lingers for 3.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.
Grenade Launchers: 40% decreased Self-Damage
Rocket Launchers: 99.99% decreased Self-Damage and allows for rocket jumping

entries.name: Tear
entries.text:
Precision Kills Sever enemies within ? meters of the target for ? seconds.
? second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Ignition Trigger
entries.text:
Accuracy Cone Size and Accuracy Cone Growth are massively decreased while hip-firing. Hip-Firing grants 50% reduced recoil, which is carried into ADS if the trigger stays held down after initially hip-firing.
Firing 20 rounds within 0.125 seconds of each begins 'Ignition Trigger'. Ignition Trigger grants 100% [50%] increased damage and 3% reduced Accuracy Cone Growth size while active. In exchange, it drains 15 HP every 0.4 seconds until you reach Critical Health.
While Ignition Trigger is active, firing builds its meter at a rate of 20% per second. Meter drains at a rate of 25% per second when not firing.
This meter serves as a timed period in which Ignition Trigger can be resumed without warmup and provides no other benefits. Meter progress persists through reload.

entries.name: Wicked Implement Catalyst
entries.text:
Stasis Shards grant 7 ammo on pickup that can overfill the magazine, up to 100% capacity.
Due Tithing Harvest refilling the entire magazine on Stasis Shard pickup, the overfill effect only activates if your current magazine is above 13 shots remaining.
Grants the Headstone trait:
Precision Kills create a Large Stasis Crystal at the target's location.
Tier 1-2 Minor and Tier 1 Elite Combatants only spawn a Medium Stasis Crystal.
Creating 5 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Firepower
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Grenade Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)
10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Arc Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Arc Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Envious Assassin
entries.text:
Upon readying the weapon after scoring Kills with your other Weapons:
Refills and/or overfills the Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills scored.
Maximum total overfill amount is 200% of the Magazine Capacity. Each activation can only load up to 100% of the Magazine Capacity into the magazine.
Loaded ammo per Kill by ammo type (rounds up):
• Primary Weapons: 10% of Magazine Capacity
• Special and Power Weapons: 20%

entries.name: Ager's Scepter Catalyst
entries.text:
While at full Super Energy, Hold [Reload] to activate Will Given Form.
Will Given Form immediately takes away 20% Super Energy, then drains at a rate of 4% Super Energy per second to grant the following benefits:
• Overfills the magazine from reserves to 192
• 80% increased damage
• 20 [0] slow stacks per hit
Effect lasts until deactivated by holding [Reload] again, or until the magazine is emptied, super energy is drained, or the weapon is stowed.
Does not count as a super for related effects or buffs.

entries.name: Pulse Monitor
entries.text:
Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 30% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.
Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 30% Shield Health.
Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.

entries.name: Gathering Light
entries.text:
Kills grant one stack of Gathering Light. Maximum of 10 stacks.
Hold [Reload] to consume all stacks, granting 10% Melee, Grenade, and Class Ability energy per stack.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Binary Orbit
entries.text:
Scoring opposing Elemental Alignment Kills grants 25% increased damage for 🡅10.5 seconds.
Buff can be activated while stowed.
Elemental Alignment details:
• Arc, Solar, Void Kills buff Kinetic, Stasis, and Strand Weapons
• Kinetic, Stasis, and Strand Kills buff Arc, Solar, and Void Weapons
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.

entries.name: Attrition Orbs
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 🡅1.1% Super Energy.
Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.
Hit requirements for activation:
• Rocket Launchers: 2 hits
• Heavy Grenade Launchers: 3 Hits
• Wave-Frame Grenade Launchers: 4 hits
• Bows: 4 Hits
• Swords: 5 Hits
• Area-Denial Grenade Launchers: 26 Hits
• Others: 55% of Magazine Size rounded down + 1
Support Frame Auto Rifle healing round Hits on damaged allies count as 2 Hits.
🡅 Spawned Orbs grant 37.5?% more Super Energy (0.8%⁠🠚⁠1.1?⁠%).

entries.name: LN2 Burst
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] any time after scoring a kill to load a Freezing Shot. Animation is tied to reload speed.
Freezing Shot must charge for 533ms before firing.
Buff is removed on stow once the freezing shot is loaded.

entries.name: Tunnel Vision
entries.text:
Grants the following for 5 seconds upon finishing a Reload within 3.6 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
• 20 Aim Assist
• ? ADS Handling
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
🡅 Buff Duration is increased.

entries.name: Drengr's Lash
entries.text:
Defeating any Elementally-Debuffed target grants %? Class Ability energy.
Casting your Barricade sends out a 'Suspending Wave' over 30 meters.
This wave will track enemies and Suspend any target hit for 6? seconds, and scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.

entries.name: Into the Fray
entries.text:
Casting your Super Ability grants allies within ? meters of you Woven Mail for 10 seconds.
Destroying a Tangle releases three 10 meter radius pulses from where it was destroyed; one pulse every 2 seconds. Allies within this radius are healed for 15 HP and receive Woven Mail for 10 seconds.
While Woven Mail is active, gain 300% [200%] Increased Base Melee Regeneration Speed.

entries.name: Banner of War
entries.text:
Scoring a kill with your Melee, Sword, Glaive, Super Light Attack, or Finisher begins 'Banner of War' for 15 seconds. Banner of War has a radius of 10 meters and stacks up to 4 times.
Allies within the radius are granted the following benefits:
• 100% Increased Base Melee Damage
• 40% Increased Bladefury Damage
• 10% Increased Sword Damage (20% for the user)
• 20 HP Healing Pulses every 2.5 seconds
Gain an additional stack when 7 [2] kills occur through any of three methods:
• You kill an enemy
• An enemy within a 20 meter radius of you dies
• An ally within a 20 meter radius of you kills an enemy
Each kill extends the buff timer up to 30 seconds, with the extension dependent on the number stacks you currently have. Higher stacks reduce the delay between each healing pulse.
Extension amount and Healing Pulse delay per stack:
• x1: 6 seconds | 2.5 Seconds
• x2: 5 seconds | 2 Seconds
• x3: 4 seconds | 1.5 Seconds
• x4: 3 seconds | 1 Second

entries.name: Flechette Storm
entries.text:
Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding launches you into the air, deals damage and knocks enemies away, and consumes 50% melee energy.
While Airborne after this attack, continued [Melee] input fires four Unraveling Strand Projectiles at a cost of 50% melee energy per salvo. Attacks can be chained until Melee Energy is drained.
Grants 25% Damage Resistance against non-melee combatant attacks during this animation.

entries.name: Loss
entries.text:
Reaching critical health or having an ally die within ? meters of you grants one stack of 'Loss'. Maximum of 10 stacks.
Loss grants the following benefits for each stack:
• ? Stability
• ? Handling
• ? Aim Assistance
Stacks remain active until you die.

entries.name: The Perfect Fifth
entries.text:
Precision Hits refill 1 ammo.
Scoring 4 Precision Hits loads a delayed Solar Explosive. Solar Explosive is removed after 6 seconds.
Solar Explosive detonates after a 0.5? second delay, dealing 215 [78] damage and applying 40 Scorch stacks (60 with Ember of Ashes) in a 4 meter radius. Damage falls to 0% at the edge of the radius.

entries.name: Disaster Plan
entries.text: Firing/Swinging the weapon after collecting an Ammo Brick grants 15 Range and 15% Flinch Resistance for 1.5 seconds. Swords receive 100 Charge Rate instead.

entries.name: Cornered
entries.text:
Grants 15% decreased Charge/Draw Time while within 15 meters of 2 enemies.
Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.
🡅 Grants 10 Stability while the perk is active.

entries.name: Stopping Power
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits against low (under 🡅33%) Health targets. Ignores Shield HP:
• Increased Stagger Force
• 7% to 15% increased damage, scaling with remaining Health
• ? Increased Target Acquisition
🡅 Benefits activate at a higher remaining health percentage.

entries.name: Sharpshooter
entries.text:
Possesses inherently increased weapon stats, which are boosted further during Cayde's Retribution.
Increased benefits while Cayde's Retribution is active:
• 18% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 60% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• ? Aim Assist, ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration, ?% Flinch Resistance

entries.name: Kill Clip
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill grants 25% increased damage for 5 seconds.
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.name: Blast Distributor
entries.text:
Dealing Explosive Weapon damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
'Blast Distributor' grants 10 Grenade Stat per stack.

entries.name: Void Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Void Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Latent Power
entries.text:
Direct Hits, Precision Hits, and Kills with this weapon charge 'Latent Power'. The amount of charge granted varies by source:
• Hits: 4%
• Precision Hits: 8%
• Kills: 25%
Upon reaching 100% Progress towards Latent Power, hold [Reload] to enter 'Unleashed Power' and gain the following benefits for 13 seconds:
• Instantly refill the magazine
• Increase RPM to 225
• Significantly improved Hip-Fire Accuracy
• ? Stability and ? Aim Assist
• Shots fired are immediately returned to the magazine, effectively granting infinite ammo
Every shot fired in this mode also Weakens targets for 6 seconds on hit and gain Explosive Payloads that deal an additional 87 [?] damage on hit.
After 3 seconds, Unleashed Power changes into Overwhelming Power, which drains 13 HP every second for the remaining 10 seconds of the buff.
Special Note: While Empowerment is active and this weapon is readied, Rocket Launchers and Micro-Missile damage is increased by 30%. Hazardous Propulsion Rockets deal 200% increased damage.

entries.name: High-Impact Frame
entries.text: Slow-firing and high-damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary and aiming down sights.

entries.name: Unflinching Solar Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Solar Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Cryosthesia 77K Catalyst
entries.text: Shattering a Frozen enemy instantly refills the magazine.

entries.name: Emergency Reinforcement
entries.text:
Grants 10% Damage Resist upon reaching Critical Health while at 3 or more Stacks Armor Charge and consumes all Armor Charges.
Buff lasts 6|9|12|15 seconds with 3|4|5|6 Stack of Armor Charge consumed.

entries.name: Banned Weapon
entries.text:
Fires a 3-round burs-...
[This tooltip has been redacted in accordance with Official Vanguard Policy]

entries.name: Cold Fusion
entries.text:
Linearly grants up to 80% increased damage as the beam is charged to 100% power.
Beam Energy is generated in two ways:
• Dealing damage grants 40% energy over 1 second. Initially has a 0.267 second delay before this starts granting energy.
• Collecting an Ionic Trace grants 50% energy over 0.5 seconds
Not generating energy for 1.05 seconds rapidly cools the weapon down to 0% over 0.2 seconds.
Reaching maximum energy grants 100 Stability and 100 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Hands-On
entries.text:
Melee Kills grant additional Super energy based on Enemy Rank with 1|2|3 mods:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: ?% | ?% | ?%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 1.33?% | ?% | ?%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?% | ?% | ?%
• T4 Minors, T3-T4 Elites, and higher: 5?% | ?% | ?%
• Players: ?% | ?% | ?%
Kill can only trigger either Hands On or Ashes to Assets but not both.

entries.name: Orbs of Restoration
entries.text:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability on Orb of Power pickups.
Abilities with multiple charges do not receive any energy if they already have a full charge.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Heirloom Catalyst
entries.text:
Scorch and Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 5% increased damage.
Direct Hits with Charged Shots apply 20|40|60 Scorch Stacks at Charge Level 1|2|3. Scorch application is unaffected by Ember of Ashes.
Grants 10% increased damage to Scorched enemies.
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

entries.name: Utility Kickstart
entries.text:
When a Class Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Class Ability Energy.
Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Class Ability Energy refunds.
Class Ability Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

entries.name: Full Choke
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights:
• Decreases Shotgun Pellet Spread by 5%
• Reduces Precision Multiplier by 7.6% (1.1078x🠚1.0294x)

entries.name: Adaptive Munitions
entries.text:
Hits against Barrier Champion or non-matching Elemental Shields deal increasingly higher damage.
Buff is removed upon hitting a matching shield or an unshielded enemy.
Damage increase by Weapon Archetype:
• Fusion Rifles: untested
• Machine Guns, Auto/Pulse/Trace Rifles: 10% per hit, up to 50%
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 22% per hit, up to 44%
• Bows, Glaives, Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 25% per hit, up to 50%

entries.name: Wild Card
entries.text:
Kills release a varying number of Submunitions on top of where the enemy died. 6? second cooldown between activations.
The number of Submunitions spawned is tied to Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 1 Submunition
• Elites and Players: 3 Submunitions
• Minibosses and Bosses: 7 Submunitions
Submunitions:
• Identical to Telesto Bolts in behavior, exploding on proximity or contact and last up to 10.5 seconds after attaching to a surface.
• Deal up to 39.5? [?] damage and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

entries.name: Ember of Eruption
entries.text: Ignitions have a 25% increased blast radius (8﻿🠚﻿10 meters).

entries.name: Ember of Ashes
entries.text:
Increases the number of Scorch Stacks you apply to targets by 50% in MOST cases.
Always rounds up: 3 🠚 4.5 🠚 5
Specific increases from Ember of Ashes for Scorch sources can be found in their descriptions.

entries.name: Ember of Wonder
entries.text:
Killing 2 enemies within ? seconds of each with Ignitions creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Ember of Searing
entries.text:
Killing Scorched enemies spawns a Firesprite and grants Melee Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 8%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 15%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 17.5%
• Players: 20%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: MIDA Synergy
entries.text: Superb handling. Move faster with this lightweight weapon equipped. This weapon grants additional speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.

entries.name: Pyrogenesis
