entries.text: Charged Laser applies 20 Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes) for every hit and triggers an Ignition on every kill.

entries.name: The Queenbreaker Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants the Rewind Rounds trait:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 60% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.
Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.
Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).
Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 14% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)

entries.name: Cranial Spike III
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.name: Cranial Spike II
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.name: Cranial Spike IV
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.name: Honed Edge
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to consume up to 4 ammo. Gain one stack of 'Honed Edge' per ammo consumed to create a single shot with increased damage.
Damage increase based on stacks of Honed Edge:
Honed Edge x2:
• 12% [20%] bodyshot damage
• 79% [91%] critical damage
Honed Edge x3:
• 25% [45%] bodyshot damage
• 131% [167%] critical damage
Honed Edge x4:
• 112% [165%] bodyshot damage
• 291% [389%] critical damage

entries.name: Danger Zone
entries.text:
Increases Blast Radius by ?% and decreased Self-Damage while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.
Effect lingers for 3.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.
Grenade Launchers: 40% decreased Self-Damage
Rocket Launchers: 99.99% decreased Self-Damage and allows for rocket jumping
🡅 Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.

entries.name: Solar Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Solar Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Solar Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Solar Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Elemental Honing
entries.text:
Dealing Elemental Damage grants a stack of Elemental Honing for 20 seconds for each unique Element used. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Gaining a stack refreshes the buff duration. Duration cannot be refreshed once at 5 stacks.
Buff can be activated while stowed. Kinetic Damage does not trigger the buff.
Weapon damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks by weapon damage type:
• Kinetic: 10%|20%|30%|35%|40%
• Elemental (PVE): 2.5%|10%|20%|30%|35%
• Elemental (PVP): 1.25%|5%|20%|30%|35%

entries.name: Overclocked Heatsink
entries.text: Passively grants 2% increased damage and 10 decreased Cooling Efficiency stat.

entries.name: Embers of Light
entries.text:
Requires a Solar Super to be equipped to function.
Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 18%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 26%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 40%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 60%
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 80%
• Bosses: 100%
• Players: 30%
Weapon Kills while standing in a Healing Rift grant 7 seconds (10 with Ember of Solace) of Radiant to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.
Weapon Kills while standing in an Empowering Rift grant Cure x1 to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.
Daybreak Kills grant Cure x2 and 10 seconds (15 with Ember of Solace) of Radiant to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Kinetic Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Kinetic Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Exhumation
entries.text:
While grounded, Charged Heavy Attacks grant Void Invisibility for 6.3 seconds and release four tracking orbs 8? meters ahead of you. Each orb deals 507 [363] damage in a ? meter radius with no falloff.
Void Orbs deal 30% increased damage to Minor combatants.

entries.name: Harmonic Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Weapons matching your Super Element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: Paracausal Pellets
entries.text: Landing 10 out of 12 pellets instantly Freezes or Ignites the target, matching on the element of the shot.

entries.name: Trickle Charge
entries.text:
Receiving Bolt Charge refills 10% of the magazine. Does not currently dissipate Heat for Heat Weapons.
Discharging Bolt Charge refills 20% of the magazine. Dissipates 100% Heat on Heat Weapons.
Works while stowed.

entries.name: Unflinching Stasis Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Stasis Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Loose Change
entries.text:
Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 9 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Arc Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Arc Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Utility Finisher
entries.text:
Finisher consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant Class Ability Energy.
Energy Gains with 3|4|5|6 Stacks Consumed:
70% | 80% | 90% | 100%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Threat Remover
entries.text: Hitting a target with 11 of the 12 Pellets in the spread grants ? Stability, ? Handling, and 60 Reload Speed for 7 seconds.

entries.name: Unyielding Handle
entries.text: Grants 15% Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring 2 Light Attacks within 3 seconds of each. Buff can be refreshed.

entries.name: Super Font
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Super stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Enhanced Athletics
entries.text:
Passively increases non-sprinting Movement Speed and non-ability Jump Height.
Grants 30|50|60 Mobility Stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Mobility as a stat is capped at 130. Warlocks and Titans inherently have 30 mobility, while Hunters have 100 [70].
Forward (including left and right diagonally) Walk Speed with 0|1|2|3 Mods equipped by class:
• Warlocks and Titans: 5.6|6.2|6.6|6.8 m/s
• Hunters (PvP): 6.4|7|7.6|7.6 m/s
• Hunters (PvE): 7|7.6|7.6|7.6 m/s
Strafing (side-to-side and backwards movement) decreases these speeds by 15%. Strafe speed is capped at 6 m/s.
ADS decreases these speeds by 25% and cannot exceed 6 m/s. Sidearms uniquely only suffer a 15% penalty.
Crouching decreases these speeds by 45%. Crouch speed is capped at 4 m/s.
Holding a Machine Gun, Rocket Launcher, Guarding with a Sword, and certain Exotic Heavy Weapons have an additional 15% movement speed penalty.
Sprint speed is set to 8 m/s by default and is capped at 9 m/s. This cap applies to regular Forward Walk Speed as well.

entries.name: Withering Gaze
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights (ADS) for 1.5 seconds without firing and staying ADS causes your next shot to apply Weaken on a Direct Hit.
Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.

entries.name: Edge of Action Catalyst
entries.text: Kills against Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistence).

entries.name: Beacon Rounds
entries.text:
Kills with the weapon grant a Stack of Beacon Rounds for 🡅7 seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks.
Scoring futher Hits with the weapon can extend the buff duration up to the maximum of 4 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.
Each Stack grants increased projectile tracking. Projectile Tracking is only in effect while the Targeted Reticle is active.
Grants the following while you have active Stacks:
• 15 Reload Speed
• 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 45% increased Projectile Tracking Cone size
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.

entries.name: Melee Kickstart
entries.text:
When a Melee Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Melee Ability Energy.
Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Melee Energy refunds.
Melee Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%
Bug: Doesn't work if you have more recharged Melee Ability Energy than a single ability charge.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Seraph Rounds
entries.text: Combines the overpenetration from Armor-Piercing Rounds, the guaranteed ricochets from Ricochet Rounds, and the flinch increase from High-Caliber Rounds.

entries.name: Planetary Torrent
entries.text:
Increases Class Ability Regeneration Rate while 3 enemies are within 15 meters:
250%|666%|1085%|1500% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate with 3|4|5|6+ enemies
1 second after casting a Rift:
The Rift releases an Arc Shockwave that deals 400 [100] damage and knocks back enemies in a 7.5 meter radius. Additional Arc Shockwaves are released every 5 seconds.
Enemies killed by Shockwaves explode, dealing up to 200 [100?] Arc damage.
While you have an Arc Super equipped, Shockwaves and explosions Blind nearby targets.

entries.name: Counterattack
entries.text:
Upon receiving damage within 0.5 seconds of starting to Guard:
Grants 50% increased damage for 🡅3 seconds.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Cobra Totemic
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Airborne Effectiveness, 35 Reload Speed, and 35 Handling to all weapons.

entries.name: Stylostixis
entries.text:
Grants Arcane Needles Shield-Piercing properties.
Scoring an Arcane Needle hit on an enemy marks them with a vertical mark for 10 seconds. Marked Enemies explode on death, releasing a Suspending Blast that Suspends and damages targets in a 10 meter radius.
Suspending Blast damage by Enemy Rank:
Players: 40, Minors: 80, Elites: 120, Minibosses: 160, Bosses: 200
Landing 2 Arcane Needle hits on a Marked Enemy triggers Suspending Blast that deals 2x damage.
Landing 5 Needlestorm Hits on a single enemy triggers a Suspending Blast that deals 11x damage and inherits Super damage buffs.
Arcane Needle Kills and Killing Suspended targets grant Melee Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 15%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22.2%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Enemy Players: 33%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 100%
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Merciless Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 40 Range and 40 Stability.
Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants Cure x2 to you and Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.

entries.name: Impact Induction
entries.text:
Grants Grenade Ability Energy upon dealing Elemental Melee Damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.
Grenade Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: Biotic Enhancements
entries.text:
Being within 15 meters of 3+ enemies grants the 'Biotic Enhancements' buff for 5 seconds.
Biotic Enhancements benefits:
• 35 Handling and 35 Reload Speed
• 50% increased Super damage
• 165% [100%] increased Melee damage
• 100% increased Glaive Melee damage

entries.name: Fury Conductors
entries.text:
Melee Hits grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge. (Each damage instance is counted separately)
Having active Armor Charges grants Melee Damage Resistance against Combatants. Receiving a Melee Attack consumes all Armor Charges and emits a Jolting Arc Burst in a ? meter radius.
Benefits with 1|2|…|6 Armor Charges:
• Arc Burst Damage: 90|130|170|200|225|245
• Melee Damage Resistance against Combatants: 23.3% | 46.7% | 70% | 73.3% | 76.7% | 80%

entries.name: Horns of Doom
entries.text:
Scoring 2 to 3 Void Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 1 Stack of Void Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks. Void Kills while at 4 Stacks refresh the buff's duration.
Elemental Void Melee Kills grant the following:
• 20% [10%] Super Energy once per ability usage
• All 4 Stacks of Void Weapon Surge
Sentinel Shield's Shield Throw Hits grant 10% Super Energy, extending the Super's Duration. Sentinel Shield Light Attacks grant 100% Shield Throw energy.

entries.name: Cursed Thrall
entries.text:
After a Melee Kill, for 7.5 seconds:
Weapon Kills cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 123.5 [?] damage over a 4.5? meter radius.
Explosions inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling and match the element of the Weapon.

entries.name: Swashbuckler
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Swashbuckler' for 🡅6.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
(Glaive) Melee Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly.
Damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
6.7% | 13.3% | 20% | 26.6% | 33.3%
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 2 seconds.

entries.name: Cauterizing Flame
entries.text:
Only works with a Solar Super Ability equipped.
Reaching Critical Health consumes your Class Ability to spawn a Sunspot under you.
Manually casting your Class Ability also spawns a Sunspot under you.
The spawned Sunspot grants the Sol Invictus buff even without having the Aspect equipped. (The Aspect is still required to extend the sunspot's duration)

entries.name: Imperial Allegiance
entries.text:
Grants one stack of Imperial Allegiance for each ally within 15 meters.
Benefits at 1|2|3 stacks:
• ? Charge Rate
• 3.5%|7%|10.5% increased Cooling Efficiency
• 3.5%|7%|10.5% increased damage while above 50% Weapon Heat

entries.name: Deconstruct
entries.text:
Upon scoring multiple hits within 6 seconds of each:
• Refills 10% of the Magazine (rounded up) from reserves. Can be reactivated without a cooldown. Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
• Grants 40% increased damage against Constructs and Vehicles for 5 seconds. Additional hits refresh the buff duration.
Number of Hits Required:
• If Magazine Size is 1: 3 Hits
• Otherwise: 2 + 50% (25% on Primary Weapons) of Base Magazine Capacity rounded down
Hits against Constructs and Vehicles provide 1.5x activation progress for Primary weapons and 2x progress for Special weapons.
Wave Frame Grenade Launchers:
• Direct Impacts count as 2 Hits
• Doesn't receive bonus activation progress against Constructs and Vehicles

entries.name: Nano-Assault
entries.text:
Every Nanite that attaches to you grants 4.5% progress to 'Nano-Assault'. Requires 21 Nanites to reach full charge.
Hold [Reload] at full Nano-Assault charge to enter 'Assault Mode'. Assault Mode immediately grants 14 ammo, 25% increased damage, and 30% Sword Energy per second for the duration of the buff. Stowing the blade during Assault Mode ends it and refunds 50% charge.
While Nano-Assault is active, Fully-Charged Heavy Attacks launch a solar wave that travels 13 meters and creates a 'Swarm-Nado' on impact. This detonates in a 7? meter radius with no damage falloff. Swarm-Nado deals ? damage in a 5 meter radius every 0.3 seconds for 3 seconds, and constantly generates ? nanites that return back to you.

entries.name: Lasting Impression
entries.text:
Passively grants 🡅55 Blast Radius.
Rockets attach on impact and detonate after 3 seconds, dealing 35% increased Explosive Damage.
Due to the split of impact and explosive damage on Rocket Launchers, this perk only provides an overall increase of 26-27% damage for the sake of boss DPS.
Does not buff the damage of Wolfpack Rounds.
🡅 Grants 5 more Blast Radius passively.

entries.name: Outlaw
entries.text:
Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Restorative Finisher
entries.text:
Finishers consume 2 Stacks of Armor Charge and grant 50% Ability Energy to your least-charged Ability.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Feeding Frenzy
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Feeding Frenzy for 3.5 seconds, increasing the Reload Speed of the weapon. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 🡅13|🡅55|🡅65|🡅85|100 Reload Speed
• 2.5%|10%|13%|16%|20% decreased Reload Animation Duration
🡅 Increases Reload Speed stat bonus by 5 at 1-3 Stacks and by 10 at 4 Stacks.

entries.name: Headstone
entries.text:
Precision Kills create a Large Stasis Crystal at the target's location.
Creating 5 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.
🡅 Low-tier enemy kills also spawn a Large Stasis Crystal instead of a Medium one.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries.text:
Scoring any Kill while the weapon is stowed grants a "trigger stack". Maximum of 3 stacks.
Readying the weapon with active "trigger stacks" converts them to Stacks of 'Sleight of Hand' with a 🡅8.5 second duration.
Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of 'Sleight of Hand':
10|20|30 Handling, Reload Speed, and Stability
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Thresh
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant an additional 🡅1.33% Super Energy.
Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant an additional 🡅2% instead.
🡅 Bonus Super Gains are increased by 33.3%. (e.g. 1.5%⁠🠚⁠2%)

entries.name: Worm's Hunger
entries.text:
Kills scored by abilities and other guns grant stacks of 'Worm's Hunger'. Maximum of 20 stacks.
Stacks earned based on Combatant Rank:
• Tier 1 and 2: 1 stack
• Tier 3 and 4: 4 stacks
• Minibosses, Bosses, and Players: 5 stacks
Worm's Hunger grants 10% increased damage and ?% increased Blast Radius for each stack, up to a maximum of 200% increased damage and ?% larger Blast Radius.

entries.name: Anarchy Catalyst
entries.text:
Scoring 3 hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next damage instance to apply Jolt.
Being Amplified decreases the number of hits required to 2.

entries.name: Mechanized Autoloader
entries.text: Picking up a Heavy Ammo brick refills the magazine.

entries.name: Spindle
entries.text:
Dealing damage with any Threadling grants one stack of 'Spindle'. Maximum of 25 stacks.
Spindle linearly grants the following benefits per stack:
• 2% Increased Damage (up to 50%)
• ? Handling
• ? Reload Speed
Weapon hits refresh this buff.

entries.name: Firefly
entries.text:
On Precision Kills:
• Target explodes, dealing 104 [80] Solar damage in a 4 meter radius
• Grants 🡅55 Reload Speed for 6 seconds
🡅 Reload Speed bonus is increased by 5.

entries.name: Armor of the Colossus
entries.text:
While fully spun up and at full HP, gain an 80HP Arc Shield over 1 second. Arc Shield recharges after 2 seconds of not taking damage.
Arc Shield Properties in PvP:
• Provides immunity to precision damage
• 50% Damage Resist against Kinetic Damage
• 15% Damage Resistance against Non-Arc Elemental Damage
• If destroyed by Arc Damage, it damages you and nearby allies for 130 damage in a ? meter radius

entries.name: Penance
entries.text: Maintaining the Vex Cage for 3.75 seconds creates a burst of 1060 [520] damage to targets within it. Timer increases to 3 seconds after the first burst of damage.

entries.name: Saint's Fists
entries.text:
Hitting a target with 18 pellets in a burst grants your next Melee attack within 3 seconds 300% Additional Base Melee Damage.
Dealing Melee Damage grants 'Saint's Fury' for 8.5 seconds, providing the folllowing:
• 35% increased weapon damage
• 15% decreased Charge Time
• ? Increased Reload Speed
Saint's Fury can be refreshed by melee damage and is removed on stow.

entries.name: Class Font
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Class stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Closing Time
entries.text:
Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% capacity to empty:
• 10 to 20 Range
• 30? to 50? Handling
• 10-20% decreased Handling Animation Duration
• 5?% to 10?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.

entries.name: Encore
entries.text:
On Weapon Kill, for 7 seconds:
Grants 1 Stack on Bodyshot Kills and 2 Stacks on Precision Kills. Maximum of 4 Stacks.
Each stack grants 5 Range, 8 Stability, and -1.25% Accuracy Cone Size.

entries.name: Heavy Ammo Finder Enhancement
entries.text: Weapon Kills provide 10% more activation progress to Heavy Ammo Finder mods.

entries.name: Ancillary Ordinance
entries.text:
Killing Elemental-Debuffed targets or scoring 3 Elemental Kills within 4 seconds of each grants this weapon one stack of Ancillary Ordinance. Maximum of 4 stacks.
Stacks can be earned while stowed.
Kills consume a stack of Ancillary Ordinance to release a seeking Micro-Missile from the enemy's point of death, traveling up to 30 meters before dealing 330 [100] damage in a small radius.
Killing Elemental-Debuffed Targets with this weapon instantly spawns a missile.

entries.name: Ruinous Effigy Catalyst
entries.text: Kills, or damaging Champions, Minibosses, or Bosses, with your Transmutation Sphere (inconsistently) grants 30% [15%] increased weapon damage for 7 seconds.

entries.name: Big Frigid Glaive
entries.text:
Intrinsically Anti-Overload.
Fires a large Freezing Orb that travels for 6 seconds and moves at a rate of 9.5 meters per second. The orb fires Freezing projectiles every 0.5 seconds at any non-frozen target within a 10 meter radius of it. Projectiles deal 60 [11] damage and have a 3 meter freezing radius.
Freezing Orb deals 1282 [250] damage on impact and detonates in a 10 meter radius, applying 60 Slow for 4 seconds (8 with Whisper of Durance).
Grants 25% Glaive Energy on each hit with either the orb or its projectiles.

entries.name: Tempest Cascade
entries.text:
Collecting an Ionic Trace increases the next shot's damage by 100% [7%] and applies Jolt.
Buff can be triggered while stowed.

entries.name: Empowered Finish
entries.text: Finishers with no active Armor Charge Stacks grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

entries.name: Void Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with with a Void Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Repulsor Force
entries.text:
Fires a powerful Void Blast that knocks back enemies. Minibosses and Bosses are unaffected by knockback.
Hits apply Suppression as well as a higher tier Weaken that increases all damage dealt to the target by 30% for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Ascending Amplitude
entries.text:
Requires Stormtrance to be equipped to function.
Casting your Super grants Amplified.
While Amplified, Arc Ability Hits grant x1 Bolt Charge. 0.6 second cooldown between activations.
Hits and Kills during Stormtrance grant a Stack of 'Ascending Amplitude' for 8 seconds. Maximum of 30 Stacks.
Ascending Amplitude:
• Decreases the Super Energy cost of Stormtrance's Ionic Blink by 50% (6.25%🠚3.125%).
• Increases Stormtrance's damage by 6.7% per Stack, up to 200% bonus damage at maximum stacks.
Refunds up to 30% of Super Energy based on the number of enemies killed with your Super.

entries.name: The Lament Catalyst
entries.text:
Direct Hits against Scorched Enemies apply 20 additional Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes) on a 0.5 second cooldown
Scoring 3 Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to Scorch the target. This allows The Lament to Scorch through a singular revved attack.
Hit counter persists through stow.
Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage, and thus, triggers Revved Consumption's healing, granting 7HP per tick.

entries.name: Rega's Refrain
entries.text: Stasis kills refills 10 ammo into the magazine from reserves.

entries.name: Adept Mag
entries.text:
Passively grants 40 Magazine Stat (identical to Backup Mag combined with Tactical Mag).
On Swords, it grants 40 Ammo Capacity Stat (5 more than having 2 Reserves Mods or Enduring Blade) and the Handling penalty has no effect.

entries.name: All-Star
entries.text:
Picking up a Special ammo brick refills the magazine and grants 100 Reload and 35% [15%] increased damage for 6 seconds. Heavy ammo bricks grants the buff for 9 seconds.
Timer only decreases while the weapon is readied, and remains paused while stowed.

entries.name: Malfeasance Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 20 Range.
Grants the Vorpal Weapon trait:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.
Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• Primary Weapons: 20% [60%]
• Special Weapons: 15% [20%]
• Power Weapons: 10% [20%]

entries.name: Together Forever
entries.text: This weapon has a well-rounded adaptive grip, reliable and sturdy. Kills with this weapon reload Sturm and overflow a bonus damage round into it.

entries.name: Sweet Business Catalyst
entries.text: Grants 25% increased Flinch Resistance while at maximum Rate of Fire.

entries.name: Coldheart Catalyst
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Stability and 20 Reload Speed.
(Yes, these are the same stats that are set to 100 when at 100% Fusion Energy)
Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while Amplified.
Activating Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.

entries.name: Extrovert
entries.text:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of 3 enemies or a Nightmare restore 60 HP after a 0.25 second delay.
Glaive Melee Kills also count.
3 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Font of Focus
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Grenade stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Bolt Thrower
entries.text:
Adopts the profile of a Balanced 'Perfect Vent' Heat Weapon.
Aiming down sights charges explosive bolts that deal high damage in a 4 meter radius. Detonation damage falls off to 50% at the edge of the radius.

entries.name: Temporal Anomaly
entries.text:
While in Arc Mode with Arc Overcharge active:
Precision Hits and Kills call down a lightning strike, consuming 34% Overcharge energy and dealing 502 [?] Arc Damage in a ? meter radius
While in Stasis Mode with Stasis Overcharge active:
Precision Hits and Kills trigger a Stasis Explosion, consuming 34% Overcharge energy and dealing 126 [?] damage in a ? meter radius. The explosion creates two Medium Stasis Crystals that spawn 4 meters away on either side of the target at a 45 degree angle.

entries.name: Hot Swap
entries.text:
Readying the gun within ? seconds of receiving damage grants 30 Handling for 4 seconds.
Swords receive 100 Guard Resistance, 100? Guard Endurance, and 100 Charge Rate.
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.name: Unflinching Kinetic Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Kinetic Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Celerity
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Handling and 20 Reload Speed.
While Last Guardian Standing:
• 100 Handling, 100 Reload Speed, ? Aim Assist
• Greatly increased Flinch Resistance
• Increased Accuracy
• Stronger Sight Highlight
• Enables Radar while ADS
Does not activate when playing solo.

entries.name: Pressurized Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Under Pressure trait:
Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty:
• 12.5% to 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 0 to 30? Stability

entries.name: Frenzy Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Feeding Frenzy trait:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Feeding Frenzy for 3.5 seconds, increasing the Reload Speed of the weapon. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 8|50|60|75|100 Reload Speed
• 2.5%|10%|13%|16%|20% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.name: 4-Timer Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Fourth Time's The Charm trait:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 2 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.name: Outlaw Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Outlaw trait:
Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Creeping Attrition
entries.text:
Landing 4 Precision Hits within 4.5 seconds of each other grants 'Creeping Attrition' for 4.5 seconds. Further Precision Hits refresh the timer. Buff is removed on stow.
While Creeping Attrition is active, Precision Hits apply 40 [20] Slow for 4 seconds (8 [6] seconds with Whisper of Durance).

entries.name: Be the Danger
entries.text:
Kills with Unrepentant's Burst refresh the buff and reload the magazine, granting a second burst.
Counts as a true reload, not refill, for on-reload perks.

entries.name: Heavy Ammo Scout
entries.text: Heavy Ammo bricks spawned from your ammo meter now appear for allies as well. These bricks contain 37%|67%|100% of the ammo a regular brick would have at 1|2|3 copies of the mod.

entries.name: Cluster Bomb
entries.text:
Rocket detonations release 8 Cluster Bombs.
Each Cluster Bomb deals up to 150 [11] damage in a 4 meter radius.

entries.name: Stunning Recovery
entries.text: Stunning a Champion refills the magazine from reserves, restores 60 HP, and grants 40 Recovery for 3 seconds.

entries.name: Adaptive Ordnance
entries.text:
Scoring 4 kills in a single volley grants 'Adaptive Ordnance' and generates one ammo out of thin air into your reserves.
Adaptive Ordnance grants 50% increased damage to your next volley.

entries.name: Gambler's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Grants 1% [0.35%] Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] at 100 Melee Stat.
Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of 200% [70%] energy.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Marksman's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs an evasive maneuver in your movement input's direction that instantly reloads all equipped weapons and collects ammo bricks that are on the ground within a 15 meter radius of you.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

entries.name: Together Forever
entries.text: This weapon has a well-rounded adaptive grip, reliable and sturdy. Kills with this weapon reload Sturm and overflow a bonus damage round into it.

entries.name: Spread Shot Package
entries.text: Aiming down sights decreases pellet spread by 25%.

entries.name: Ionic Sentry
entries.text:
Arc and Kinetic Kills charge an Ionic Sentry. Weapon kills grant 1 [2] charge, while ability kills grant 2 [?] charges.
At 6 charges, replaces your Grenade Ability with a throwable Ionic Sentry. Ionic Sentry Blinds on impact within a 5 meter radius for 10 [5] seconds. Incurs a 6 second cooldown upon being thrown.
Ionic Sentry lasts for 15 seconds and shoots chain lightning at targets within a 16 meter radius once every second. Enemies hit by this attack chain the lightning to one additional target within a 6 meter radius.
Grants x1 Bolt Charge per enemy hit.
Ionic Sentry counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.

entries.name: Electrostatic Mind
entries.text:
Kills with Arc Abilities and against Arc Debuffed Targets create an Ionic Trace.
Collecting an Ionic Trace grants Amplified.
1 second cooldown between generating Ionic Traces.

entries.name: Lightning Surge
entries.text:
Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding teleports you 10 meters forward, calling down 5 lightning bolts around your exit point in a 7 meter radius.
Grants Amplified upon use and x1 Bolt Charge for each enemy hit.
Grants ? damage resistance against Combatants for ? seconds upon use.
Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.

entries.name: Arc Soul
entries.text:
Grants 40% [20%] | 80% [40%] | 120% [60%] Increased Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate while within 15 meters of 1|2|3 allies.
Casting your rift grants an 'Arc Soul' to allies inside it for 15 seconds. Arc Souls fire homing projectiles in a 3-round burst at 100 RPM towards enemies within 24 meters.
While Amplified, Arc Soul fires a 5-round burst at 225 RPM.
Arc Souls count as grenade abilities and are buffed by, and trigger, grenade-specific effects.

entries.name: Harmonic Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming PVE Combatant Damage matching your Subclass Element by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Subjugation
entries.text:
Perk behavior changes depending on the enemy rank of the target you're shooting.
Against Minor and Elite Combatants:
Shots explode on hit, dealing up to 6.5 (32.5 on Shotgun) additional damage in a 3? meter radius. Explosions inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.
Trace Rifle-specific: only every 4th Hit explodes.
Against Minibosses and Bosses:
Exhausts for 5 seconds on hit.
Against Players:
Grants ?% Flinch Resistance for ? seconds.

entries.name: Deathbringer Catalyst
entries.text: The initial Orb Damage is increased by 63%, allowing maximum damage to be reached 1 second sooner.

entries.name: Together Forever
entries.text: This weapon has a well-rounded adaptive grip, reliable and sturdy. Kills with this weapon reload Sturm and overflow a bonus damage round into it.

entries.name: Harmonic Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Weapons matching your Super Element and the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Dead Man's Tale Catalyst
entries.text:
While not Aiming Down Sights:
• Increases RPM to 130
• 50% Reduced Accuracy Cone Size
• 50% Reduced Accuracy Cone Growth
• 27% [15%] increased damage at x5 Cranial Spike
Aim Assist Cone will favor precision hits in the case of overlapping regions.

entries.name: Pick Your Poison
entries.text:
Charged Burst behavior changes based on aiming method.
While Aiming Down Sights, it fires hitscan bullets which deal 100% increased critical damage to marked targets.
When Hip-Firing, it fires aggressively tracking projectiles which deal 20% increased bodyshot damage to marked targets.

entries.name: Resurgence Directive
entries.text:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.
Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.
Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.
Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.

entries.name: Harmonic Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Weapons matching your Super Element 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Strand Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Strand Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Air-Cooled Core
entries.text:
Grants ? Handling and ?% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty while your magazine is fully loaded or weapon Heat is below 10%.
Sprinting for 0.5 seconds grants ? Reload Speed for 6 seconds.

entries.name: Cryocannon
entries.text:
Deals 25% increased damage to Frozen Enemies and always destroys Stasis Crystals on hit.
Charging this weapon makes your next shot create a triangular pattern of Stasis Crystals on impact with the top pointed towards you.
Stasis Crystals spread outwards as one Small Crystal at the front, two Medium Crystals in the middle, then three Large Crystals in the back.

entries.name: Adaptive Glaive
entries.text:
Hybrid melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield.
Generates energy on dealing ranged damage.
[Aim Down Sights]: Raise shield, depleting energy over time
[Melee]: Kinetic melee combo

entries.name: Cranial Spike
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.name: Precision Frame
entries.text: Recoil pattern on this weapon is more predictably vertical. Fires quickly with high accuracy.

entries.name: Bad Juju Catalyst
entries.text: String of Curses's maximum duration is increased by 2 seconds (5.5🠚7.5).

entries.name: Heir Apparent Catalyst
entries.text:
Arc Shield gains 75% [25%] Damage Resistance.
Refills 50% of the magazine upon Arc Shield being depleted.

entries.name: Unplanned Reprieve
entries.text:
Powered Heavy Attacks spawn clusters of 'Telesto Bolts', each dealing 68 or 117 [83] damage.
Telesto Bolt clusters vary by Sword Frame:
• Aggressive: 8 bolts in a clustered spread ahead of you
• Caster: 6 bolts on projectile point of impact
• Lightweight: 7 bolts in a forward arc ahead of you
• Vortex: 10 bolts spread around you
• Wave: 8 bolts at the end of the wave

entries.name: Starless Night
entries.text:
Weapons of Light from Ward of Dawn can now persist outside the bubble for 15 seconds.
While Weapons of Light is active:
Gain stacks of 'The Saint' by dealing damage or scoring kills against enemies. Maximum of 14 stacks. Stack duration is equal to the remaining duration of your currently active Ward of Dawn.
Stacks granted by kill are based off Enemy Rank, with Minor|Elite|Miniboss Tier enemies granting 1|2|3 stacks. Stacks granted by hit are granted after dealing an average of ~500-700 damage, with higher damage instances requiring at minimum 2 hits. Hit requirement stays the same across all difficulties (ignores power-deltas).
Gaining a stack of 'The Saint' through Kinetic or Void damage triggers a Suppressing Blast in a 6? meter radius around the target, applying Suppression for 6 [?] seconds.
Picking up your Ward of Dawn consumes all stacks of The Saint and extends its active timer by ? seconds per stack consumed. Maximum of two extensions per super.

entries.name: Quick Access Sling
entries.text: Passively decreases Ready/Stow Animation Duration by 10%.

entries.name: Adaptive Glaive
entries.text:
Hybrid melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield.
Generates energy on dealing ranged damage.
[Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield, depleting energy over time
[Melee]  : Kinetic melee combo

entries.name: Devouring Rift
entries.text:
Casting your Empowering Rift with a Void Super equipped grants Devour for 11 seconds (17 seconds with Echo of Persistence), and kills with Devour active grant you 10% Class Ability energy.
Empowering Rifts cast by you have additional behaviors:
• Standing in the Rift grants you Devour for 11 seconds (17 seconds with Echo of Persistence)
• Exiting and re-entering the Rift refreshes the duration of Devour without needing a kill.
Legacy (Non-Functional) Perk:
Empowering Rifts you cast grant Overload Shot to you and allies. Previously, this allowed non-intrinsic weapons to gain Disruption, with the exception that it could not overwrite pre-existing intrinsics.
However, now that all weapons have an intrinsic Breaker-type, Secants can no longer overwrite any of them. This breaks the UI in your weapons tray and leaves this portion of the exotic non-functional.

entries.name: Delicate Tuning
entries.text:
Grants linearly decreasing benefits as Weapon Heat increases from 0% to 50%:
• 🡅22 to 🡅11 Range
• ? to ? Handling
• ? to ? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
🡅 Stat Benefits are increased by 10%.

entries.name: Adept Shield Duration
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Shield Duration.

entries.name: Outlaw
entries.text:
Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for 🡅7 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
entries.text:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 2 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.name: Wish-Dragon's Talons
entries.text:
Grants an additional Frenzied Blade Ability Charge.
Frenzied Blade or Flechette Storm Hits grant a Stack of 'Wish-Dragon's Talons' for 2.75 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Can only grant 1 Stack per ability usage.
'Wish-Dragon's Talons' grants 25%|60%|120% increased Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm damage at 1|2|3 stacks.
Banner of War's Pulses grant 5% Frenzied Blade Ability Energy and an additional 5% for each ally within 10 meters.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
entries.text:
Each shot while holding down the trigger grants the following benefits:
• 1 Stability
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Reaches maximum strength after 10 shots, granting 10 Stability, ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size, and 100% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth.

entries.name: Gutshot Straight
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights:
• Increased Body Shot damage
• 15% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size (No effect on Magnetism AKA reticle stickiness)
Body Shot damage increases:
• Auto/Scout/Sniper Rifles, Bows, Hand Cannons: 20%
• Pulse/Trace Rifles, Sidearms, SMGs, LMGs: 10%

entries.name: Opening Shot
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits for your first shot (of the burst):
• 🡅25 Aim Assist and 🡅30 Range
• 5% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.
Firing the weapon prevents the perk from activating for 3 seconds.
🡅 Grants 5 more Aim Assist and Range.

entries.name: Ionic Conductor
entries.text:
Ionic Traces move 66% faster and grant increased Ability Energy.
Total ability energy gained per Ionic Trace:
Grenade: 25% | Melee: 25% | Class Ability: 30%
Ionic Trace pickups grant 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy to allies within 15 meters.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Spinning Up
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to switch to this mode.
While holding down the trigger, RPM increases by 17%|33% after 12|24 bullets.
Kills generate ?% increased Special Ammo Progress.

entries.name: Dream Work
entries.text:
Once per reload, ally kills on targets previously hit by the Weapon or Kills on targets damaged by allies grant the following benefits:
• Loads 66% of the Magazine Capacity (rounded up) into the weapon from reserves (this can overfill the Magazine)
• Grants ? Reload Speed
Bows receive ?% decreased Draw Time instead of the above benefits.

entries.name: Cerberus+1 Catalyst
entries.text:
Holding [Reload] within 7 seconds of scoring a kill grants the following benefits for 7 seconds:
• 50% [10%] increased damage
• 30% decreased Pellet Spread
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.name: Overcharge Capacitor
entries.text:
Sprinting, sliding, or firing increases the Overcharge Capacitor based on the action performed:
• Sliding grants 10% progress
• Sprinting for 0.25 seconds grants 20% progress per second
• Shooting for 0.267 seconds grants 20% progress per second
Overcharge Capacitor linearly? grants the following benefits based on progress:
• ? Range
• ? Reload Speed
At above 40% charge, kills cause enemies to explode for 95 [76] damage and apply Blind for 10 seconds in a 7 meter radius. At 100% charge, the explosions deal 189 [?] damage and Blind for 10 seconds in an 8 meter radius.
Overcharge Capacitor decays at a rate of 33% per second after 1.1 seconds of not being built. Performing a manual reload resets your charge to 0%.

entries.name: Liquid Cooling
entries.text: Freezing Shot instantly Freezes targets on direct hit, and applies Freeze [Slow x50] in a 6 meter radius around the point of impact.

entries.name: Kinetic Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Kinetic Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Precision Slug
entries.text:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
Uniquely deals 10% more damage than Precision Frame slug shotguns and has 5% increased damage falloff distance.

entries.name: Combat Sights
entries.text:
Left-side scope. While this scope is active, gain:
• 10 Handling
• 40 Aim Assist
• Charge Time is set to 533ms
Fires a 3-round burst of Arc Bolts. Scoring 6 hits within ? seconds of each grants 'Charge Accelerant' for 5.5 seconds and decreases Charge Time by 40%.
Charge Accelerant does not decrease damage dealt.
This scope also displays the charge status of your grenade, melee, and super.

entries.name: Marksman Sights
entries.text:
Right-side scope. While this scope is active, gain:
• 15 Range
• 10 Zoom
• Charge Time is set to 633ms
Fires a single Bolt that chains up to 5 enemies within a 10 meter radius of the original target. Applies Arc Blind to all enemies hit for 9 seconds. The chaining bolts deal 27% reduced damage.
This scope also displays charge status and remaining magazine ammo.

entries.name: Omega Strike
entries.text:
Dealing damage grants one stack of 'Missiles Loaded'. Maximum of 20 stacks.
Hold [Reload] to convert these stacks into an equal number of Arc Missiles that fire on next trigger pull, dealing 1138 [237] damage each.
Missiles can be fired in groups of five or all at once.

entries.name: Stats for All
entries.text:
Upon damaging 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each, for 🡅11 seconds:
• 35 Handling and Reload Speed
• 10 Stability and Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Cloudstrike Catalyst
entries.text:
Passively grants 25 Handling.
Grants the Triple Tap trait:
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 1 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.name: Lightning Rounds
entries.text:
While holding down the trigger:
• Increases Rate of Fire by 25%|40% after 13|26 shots.
• Summons a Lightning Strike after 10 hits and grants x1 Bolt Charge.
This weapon's reticle experiences less shake from continuous fire, and inherents benefits similiar to that of Dynamic Sway Reduction:
Each shot while holding down the trigger grants the following benefits:
• 1 Stability
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Reaches maximum strength after 10 shots, granting 10 Stability, ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size, and 100% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth.

entries.name: Blood Magic
entries.text:
While standing in a Rift or a Well of Radiance:
• Grants 4 Stacks of Super-Matching Weapon Surge
• Damaging enemies marks them for 5 seconds, increasing your damage against them by 10% (stacks with everything, does not buff teammates' damage)
• Kills grant 'Blood Magic' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 15 seconds.
Blood Magic pauses the duration of Rifts for as long as it is active. Doesn't apply to Well of Radiance.
Swapping to Sanguine Alchemy in combat disables its effects for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Air Trigger
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Ammo Generation Stat. (Equivalent of 1 Ammo Generation Armor Mod)
Being Airborne grants the following benefits:
• 30 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 15?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 20?% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size

entries.name: Reservoir Burst
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Magazine Size stat. (Identical to a Backup Mag mod)
While Magazine is at or above maximum capacity:
Grants 30% increased damage and causes enemies to explode on death, dealing 162.5 damage in a ? meter radius.
Explosions inherit the weapon's element and Combatant Damage Scaling. Explosions triggered with Linear Fusion Rifle kills deal an additional 30% increased damage.

entries.name: Perpetual Motion
entries.text:
While moving at a minimum of 2 meters per second:
Grants a Stack of 'Perpetual Motion' after 2 seconds and a second Stack after 10 seconds.
Each Stack provides 10 Stability, 10 Handling, and 10 Reload Speed. All Stacks are removed if movement speed is below 2 m/s for 0.5 seconds.
Works and can activate while stowed.

entries.name: Alloy Magazine
entries.text:
Linearly grants a Reload Duration Multiplier as your magazine drops from 50% capacity to empty.
Reload Duration Multiplier scales from 0.9x at 50% capacity to 0.8x with an empty magazine.

entries.name: Myrmidon's Reach
entries.text:
Grants an additional Shield Throw Melee Ability Charge.
Shield Throw gains Shield-Piercing properties and Weakens targets for 10 seconds on hit.
Stunning a Barrier Champion with Shield Throw grants a Melee Ability Charge.
Kills with Shield Throw spawns a Void Breach. This ignores the global Void Breach spawning cooldown.
Collecting a Void Breach grants 20%? Shield Throw Ability Energy.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Bipod
entries.text:
Increases Magazine Capacity by 1 and Total Reserve Size by 5. Decreases Firing Delay by 25%.
Decreases Blast Radius by 30, Reload Speed by 20, and damage by 25% (also applies to Wolfpack Rounds and Cluster Bombs).

entries.name: Phoenix Dive
entries.text:
Only usable while airborne.
Performs a dive to the ground in the direction of your movement input. Not inputting a movement direction results in a vertical downward dive.
Applies Cure x2 to you and allies within 9 meters upon landing.

entries.name: Healing Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.

entries.name: Empowering Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

entries.name: Adaptive Glaive
entries.text:
Hybrid melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield.
Generates energy on dealing ranged damage.
[Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield, depleting energy over time
[Melee]  : Kinetic melee combo

entries.name: Adamantine Brace
entries.text:
Passively grants 40 Airborne Effectiveness and 10 Draw Time Stat (equivalent of a Draw Time Masterwork) to Bows.
Full Draws grant 'Adamantine Brace':
• Allows Perfect Draws to be held indefinitely
• Grants 37.5% increased damage against PVE Combatants for every 0.5 seconds you hold a perfect draw, up to a 200% increase
PVE damage buff only affects the initial Impact damage (e.g. Wish Ender's overpenetration is unaffected) and expires after 4 seconds of Adamantine Brace being active.
Leviathan's Breath does not receive the damage increase.

entries.name: Sharp Edges
entries.text:
Throwing Knife Kills grant 2.5-5% Super Energy depending on Enemy Rank.
Passively increases Blade Barrage impact and explosive damage by 25%.
Landing 5 Blade Barrage knives triggers a Solar Detonation, up to a maximum of 2 Solar Detonations per cast.
Each Solar Detonation deals significant damage across a 10 meter radius with no falloff and releases 4 Scorching Shrapnel, which apply 20 Scorch each (unaffected? by Ember of Ashes). Detonation and shrapnel deal ~35% reduced damage to Boss-Tier combatants and are not buffed by the Super Stat.
Blade Barrage Hits and Kills refund Super Energy depending on Enemy Rank, up to a maximum of 50%.
Overall increase to Blade Barrage damage (against Boss Combatants) is roughly ~140%.

entries.name: Barrel Constrictor
entries.text:
Kills with the weapon reduce Pellet/Projectile Spread by 20% for 7.5 seconds.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Depths of Duskfield
entries.text:
Increases Duskfield Grenade radius by 25% and spawns a Medium Stasis Crystal in its center.
Enemies inside a Duskfield Grenade's Slowing Field deal 50% [20%] decreased damage.
You and allies immediately receive 1 Stack of Frost Armor upon entering the Slowing Field and receive additional Stacks for every 0.5 seconds they stay in the field.
When combined with the Touch of Winter aspect:
• Increases Crystal size from Medium to Large
• Radius increase stacks additively for a total of 75%

entries.name: Demoralize
entries.text:
Precision Kills apply Weaken to enemies within 7 meters of the target for ? seconds.
1.5? second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Vexadecimal
entries.text:
Holding down the trigger for 16 rounds (is supposed to) make the 16th round Weaken for 6 Seconds.
Due to an unresolved bug, this gun actually only Weakens after 32 uninterrupted rounds.
Releasing the trigger after firing a Vexadecemial round (16 shots) refills 12 ammo from reserves on trigger release, as long as the current magazine isn't empty.

entries.name: Queen's Wrath
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights while fully drawn grants Truesight. Truesight reaches 64 meters.
Buff disappears after 3 seconds or leaving ADS. Bow must be fully redrawn to reactivate Truesight.

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: Monte Carlo Method
entries.text:
Dealing damage grants 2% Melee Ability Energy per hit.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
Kills have a 25% chance to grant 100% Melee Ability Energy.

entries.name: Explosive Pact
entries.text:
Grenade Ability usage or scoring a Grenade Kill grants 1 stack of Explosive Pact for 7.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Healing Grenade orb pickups (by anyone) and Grenade Kills grant 1 stack each.
Running over a Speaker's Sight Healing Turret does not grant any stacks.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks of Explosive Pact:
• ? Stability
• 8|16|20|24|44 Reload Speed
• 0.98x|0.98x|0.975x|0.96x|0.945x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Jade Rabbit Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 30 Stability.
Hold [Reload] to consume all Fate of All Fools stacks and load a Micro-Missile. Missile has a blast radius of 8 meters with a maximum damage falloff of 45%, and deals increased damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
Deals 293 damage (122 impact/171 explosive) [?] at base, becoming heavily weighted towards explosive damage as the stacks increase.
Damage is increased by 107%|157%|193%|223%|315%|345% at 2|3|4|5|10|15 Stacks, with a fully charged missile dealing 1304 (281 impact/1023 explosive) [?] damage.
Micro-Missile deals no self damage and can be used for rocket jumping.

entries.name: Ergo Sum Catalyst
entries.text: Generates 3 [1] ammo from thin air upon dealing damage with your Prismatic grenade.

entries.name: Strand Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Strand Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Supercharged Magazine
entries.text:
Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while Amplified.
Activating Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.

entries.name: One with the Void
entries.text:
Void Souls last 5 seconds longer and can be retrieved by interacting with them. Retrieving them grants 'Void Soul Ready' for 25 seconds, allowing it to be redeployed while keeping its Kill Bonuses.
Void Soul Kills permanently increase their damage and Damage Resistance, maxing out after 4 Kills:
• 25%|50%|75%|100% increased Void Soul damage
• 12.5%|25%|37.5%|50% increased Void Soul Damage Resistance
While tethered to targets, Void Souls' damage ramps up to a 30% increase over 10 seconds. This damage bonus resets once no targets are tethered.
If multiple Void Souls tether the same enemy, they will each deal the damage of the first Soul to do so.

entries.name: Stopping Power
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits against low (under 30%) Health targets. Ignores Shield HP:
• Increased Stagger Force
• 7% to 15% increased damage, scaling with remaining Health
• ? Increased Target Acquisition

entries.name: Divinity Catalyst
entries.text:
Scoring 18 hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next hit to apply Jolt. Being Amplified decreases the number of hits required to 13.
Scoring 68 Precision Hits grants 25% increased damage for 11 seconds. Stowing or Reloading the weapon resets the Precision Hit counter.
Buff remains active while stowed.

entries.name: The Perfect Fifth
entries.text:
Scorch and Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 41% increased damage. While Transcendent, this increases to 78.5%.
Landing 5 Sword Hits causes a Solar Explosion dealing 237 [64] damage and applying 40 Scorch (60 Scorch with Ember of Ashes) in a 5 meter radius.

entries.name: Tap the Trigger
entries.text:
Firing grants 'Tap The Trigger' for 🡅0.76 seconds, providing the following benefits:
• 40 Stability
• 50% decreased Recoil
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
Fusion Rifles only receive 25% of the benefits.
Buff cannot be refreshed until Automatic Weapons stop firing, or until the next burst.
[Controller-Only] Weapon fires the instant trigger pressure is applied.
🡅 Stronger Effect. Duration is increased by 0.16 seconds.

entries.name: Reconstruction
entries.text:
Every 6 seconds while not firing the weapon:
Loads 25% of the Magazine Capacity (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.
Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity. Works even while stowed.

entries.name: Taken Ambition
entries.text:
Scoring 12 hits on a single target within ? seconds of each other generates 22% Blight.
Blighted Seekers detonate on impact, each dealing 587 [30?] damage in a 0.25 meter radius.

entries.name: Adept Counterbalance
entries.text: Passively grants 35 Recoil Direction.

entries.name: Outlaw
entries.text:
Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Superconductor
entries.text:
While Arc Conductor is active:
Gain 10% increased damage, 100 Handling, and each shot fired has a 33% chance to fully refill the magazine.
Scoring 2 to 3 hits within 0.2 seconds of each other causes the target to chain 'weak' lightning to the closest enemy within an 8 meter radius for 22 [?] damage.
Enemies hit by this 'weak' lightning release multiple stronger chains of lightning around them, striking up to 4 targets in an 8 meter radius for 28 [?] damage.
The stronger chains of lightning only target enemies that haven't been hit by them for 0.33 seconds.

entries.name: Wire Rifle
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to switch between Combat Sights and Marksman's Sights.
Review this weapon's scopes to learn their behavior.

entries.name: Land Tank
entries.text:
Kills with the weapon grant a stack of Land Tank. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Land Tank grants 10|20|30 Health stat and 5%|10%|15% Damage Resist against PvE Combatants for 5 seconds at 1|2|3 stacks.

entries.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Reload Speed.
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a Weapon Kill refills stowed weapons from reserves.
🡅 Allowed time before reloading is increased.

entries.name: Redirection
entries.text:
Hits against Minor Combatants grant 2 Stacks of Redirection. Maximum of 30 Stacks.
Stacks remain active while stowed.
Hits against Elite or higher-ranked Combatants consume up to 🡅2 Stacks to grant 🡅50% increased damage per Stack consumed.
🡅 Maximum number of Stacks consumed per shot is decreased by 1. Damage increase granted by each Stack is increased to 50% (from 33%).

entries.name: Binary Orbit
entries.text:
Scoring opposing Elemental Alignment Kills grants 25% increased damage for 8.5 seconds.
Buff can be activated while stowed.
Elemental Alignment details:
• Arc, Solar, Void Kills buff Kinetic, Stasis, and Strand Weapons
• Kinetic, Stasis, and Strand Kills buff Arc, Solar, and Void Weapons

entries.name: Vorpal Weapon
entries.text:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.
Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• Primary Weapons: 20% [60%]
• Special Weapons: 15% [20%]
• Power Weapons: 10% [20%]

entries.name: Centrifuse Catalyst
entries.text: While you are Amplified, Overcharge Capacitor will continuously build at a rate of 7% charge per second and no longer passively decay.

entries.name: Shatter Shot
entries.text:
Uncharged shots destroy all Stasis Crystals in a ? meter radius on hit.
Shattering three Stasis Crystals within ? seconds of each instantly refills the magazine.

entries.name: Kinetic Tremors
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits against a target within 3 seconds of each emits 3 damaging shockwaves from its location at the time of activation. Hit counter persists through stow.
Shockwaves appear 0.25 seconds after scoring enough Hits and have a 1 second delay between each pulse. With Bows, the initial delay is decreased to 0.167 seconds.
Each shockwave deals up to 90 [20] damage in a 6 meter radius. Shockwaves deal 33.33% more damage when activated on Miniboss or higher tier PvE Combatants.
Shockwaves inherit Weapon Damage Buffs, the weapon's passive Kinetic Damage Bonus in PVE (10% on Primary, 15% on Special), and its Combatant Damage Scaling. They also count as non-direct Hits with the weapon for other interactions.
The perk cannot be retriggered by anyone on a target until 2? seconds after the last shockwave.
Hits required for Activation:
• Submachine Guns: 🡅13
• Auto Rifles: 🡅11
• Pulse Rifles: 🡅10
• Sidearms: 🡅7
• Hand Cannons or Scout Rifles (Rapid-Fire and Precision-Frame): 🡅5
• All other Hand Cannons and Scout Rifles: 🡅4
• Rocket Sidearms: 🡅3
• Bows, Sniper Rifles: 🡅2
🡅 Hit Requirements are decreased by 1.

entries.name: Thunderlord Catalyst
entries.text: Triggering a Lightning Strike refills 5 ammo from reserves.

entries.name: Explosive Head
entries.text:
Splits off 50% of the Bow's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates in a 3 meter radius on impact.
The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.
Payload detonation time after hitting a target or surface depends on the distance.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. On crits, the overall increase is 10.33% for Precision Bows and 9.69% for Lightweight Bows.
[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Accuracy.

entries.name: Unflinching Solar Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Solar Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Taken Resolution
entries.text:
Damaging 3 enemies within ? seconds of each generates 50% Blight.
Blighted Seekers deal 173 [6.85] damage in a 3 meter radius each and chain two additional times to enemies within a 10 meter radius.
Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.

entries.name: Lead from Gold
entries.text:
Heavy Ammo Pickups grants 25% of your maximum Special Ammo Reserves even while the weapon is stowed.
Equipping two Special Weapons halves the amount of ammo granted.

entries.name: Touch of Malice Catalyst
entries.text:
Direct Weapon Hits grant a stack of Precision Instrument for 1.25 seconds. Maximum of 6 stacks. Reloading the weapon or missing removes all stacks...usually.
Precision damage increase at 1|2|3... stacks:
4.17% | 8.33% | 12.5% | 16.67% | 20.83% | 25%

entries.name: High-Caliber Rounds
entries.text:
Hits inflict increased Flinch on Enemies.
PVE: Tier 1-2 Minors can be repeatedly staggered. Higher Tier Combatants stagger quicker.
PVP: Flinch against Players varies based on damage and Weapon Archetype. Flinch increase ranges between 5-10%.

entries.name: Kinetic Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Kinetic Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Firefly
entries.text:
On Precision Kill:
• Target explodes, dealing 436 [80] Solar damage in a 7.5 meter radius. Falloff begins at 3.75m.
• Grants 50 Reload Speed for 6 seconds
(Ace of Spade's Firefly is 272% stronger than the Legendary trait in PvE)

entries.name: Timed Payload
entries.text:
Splits off 55% of the Weapon's Bodyshot damage into a Explosive Payload that detonates after a 0.6 second delay. The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~16.5% of the weapon's Bodyshot damage. On Crits, the overall increase is 10.9% for Adaptive/Precision Hand Cannons and 10.17% for Aggressive Hand Cannons.
[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability.

entries.name: Rewind Rounds
entries.text:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 🡅70% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.
Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.
Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).
Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 🡅16.33% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)
🡅 Refill amount is increased by 16.66% (60%⁠🠚⁠70%).

entries.name: Howl of the Storm
entries.text:
Grants an Additional Melee Charge.
Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding performs a Stasis Uppercut, dealing damage and freezing [slowing] targets within ? meters of the attack.
Howl of The Storm instantly spawns two lines of Stasis Crystals in a (V) Formation in front of you. Each line is comprised of one small, two medium, then one large Stasis Crystal.
Spawned Crystals are considered Powered Melees and inherent damage boosts, melee effects, and Exotic benefits.
This attack can also be used during Glacial Quake at the cost of 15% Super Energy per Uppercut.
Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.

entries.name: Heating Up
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Heating Up for 5.5 seconds. Maximum of 2 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2 Stacks of Heating Up:
• 15|30 Stability
• 20|40 Recoil Direction
• 15%|25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 15%|25% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Buff remains active while stowed.

entries.name: Lead From Light
entries.text:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 1 Stack of Lead from Light. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Weapon Kills consume one stack to grant 25% increased Special Ammo generation progress for that kill.

entries.name: Split Electron
entries.text:
Fires a even split spread of three arrows while hip-firing.
Aiming Down Sights and fully drawing the bow both greatly reduce this spread.

entries.name: Bullseye Bolster
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant the following benefits for 3 seconds. Buff is removed on miss or if a bodyshot occurs.
• 5% increased Rate of Fire
• 40 Reload Speed
• ? Stability
• ? Handling

entries.name: Stats for All
entries.text:
Upon damaging 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each, for 10 seconds:
• 35 Handling and Reload Speed
• 10 Stability and Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Winterized Gear
entries.text:
Passively grants 'Winterized Gear Ready'.
Taking or dealing damage grants 'Winterized Gear x3', with each stack being removed after 5 seconds.
Benefits at Winterized Gear x3|2|1:
• ?|?|? Stability
• ?|?|? Handling
• ?|?|? Reload Speed
Incurs a 12 second cooldown before Winterized Gear is ready again.

entries.name: Counterbalance Stock
entries.text: Passively grants 15 Recoil Direction.

entries.name: Void Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Void Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Replenishing Aegis
entries.text:
Refills 1 round into the Magazine from reserves upon blocking damage.
1 second cooldown after activation. Does not work while the magazine is overfilled (assumed).
🡅 Refill cooldown is decreased.

entries.name: Tactical
entries.text: Passively grants 6 Reload Speed and 6 Handling.

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: Backup Plan
entries.text:
Grants the following for 2 seconds upon readying:
• 30% decreased Charge Time
• 20% decreased damage
• 100 Handling
Weapon must be stowed for 3 seconds before readying for the perk to activate.
Linear Fusion Rifles only: firing the weapon refreshes the buff duration (but only at higher framerates).

entries.name: Paracausal Fluid
entries.text:
Scoring Hits with the weapon grants 2 Paracausal Fluid x2 for 3 seconds.
Buff drops to Paracausal Fluid x1 when stowed.
Paracausal Fluid x2 grants ? Handling, 50 Mobility, and 50 Charge Rate (Swords).
Note: test if it actually gives Mobility still.

entries.name: Controlled Demolition
entries.text:
Dealing damage with a Void Ability or Volatile Detonation applies Volatile to the target for 10 [6] seconds.
Triggering a Volatile Detonation heals you and allies within a 40 meter radius for 90 HP.
Healing pulse incurs a 1? second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Bastion
entries.text:
Casting your Super Ability grants a 45 HP Void Overshield to allies within a 15 meter radius.
Casting your Barricade grants a 45 HP Void Overshield to both you and allies within 15 meters, and allows the Barricade to constantly grant Void Overshield at a rate of 11 HP per second.
In PvP Only:
Bastion Barricades take 20% increased damage from other players, and equipping this aspect overrides your Base Class Ability Cooldown to 100 seconds for Towering Barricade and 80 seconds for Rally Barricade.

entries.name: Offensive Bulwark
entries.text:
Grants an additional Shield Throw during your Sentinel Shield Super.
While Void Overshield is active or inside Ward of Dawn:
• Kills grant ?% Melee Ability Energy and ?% Grenade Ability Energy
• 160% [20%] Increased Melee Damage
• Increases Melee Lunge Range to 5.5 Meters
• Melee Kills grant 10HP of Void Overshield
• Unpowered Melees count as Void-Powered Melee Abilities (does not trigger Doomfang Pauldrons)

entries.name: Unbreakable
entries.text:
Base Grenade Cooldown is set to 152 seconds while equipped.
Holding [Grenade] summons a frontal Void Shield that grants 95% [75%?] Damage Resistance against blocked shots. Combatants in front of you are taunted, and enemies that contact the shield become Disoriented.
Void Shield drains 50% your Grenade Energy over 1 second, then 25% per second after that, in exchange for continuously granting you ? HP Void Overshield every second. Void Overshield lasts for 5 seconds (7.5 with Echo of Persistence).
Blocking damage reduces your movement speed by 50% for 0.5 seconds and grants ?% Grenade Energy per hit absorbed. Energy granted is reduced over time. If you have Sentinel Shield equipped, blocking damage also spawns an Orb of Power for your allies every 4.5 seconds.
Releasing [Grenade] unleashes a blast of Void Energy 11? meters in front of you, consuming your Grenade Charge and dealing damage proportional to the amount of damage you blocked.
Kill with this blast grant Devour for ? seconds (? with Echo of Persistence).

entries.name: Dynamo
entries.text:
Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Super Ability Energy.
Super Energy Gains with 1|2+ Mods:
2.5% [1.25%] | 4% [2.4%]
Energy Multipliers based on Class:
Hunters: 1x | Titans: 1.2x | Warlocks: 2x

entries.name: Hakke Breach Armaments
entries.text:
Passively increases damage dealt to...
• Vehicles and Automatons by 15%
• Turrets, Sentries, and Emplacements by 30%
• Stasis Crystals by 45%

entries.name: Fragile Focus
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Range but deactivates if you drop to 0 Shield HP (Critical Health).
Buff reactivates 0.5 seconds after your Shields HP fully regenerates.
🡅 Reactivation delay is decreased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Eager Edge
entries.text:
Readying the Sword grants 🡅100% increased Grounded and 🡅80% increased Airborne Lunge Distance for 3 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow. 3 second cooldown after the buff is removed.
🡅 Lunge Distance bonus is increased by 25% (e.g. 80%⁠🠚⁠100%).

entries.name: Stacks on Stacks
entries.text: All Armor Charge sources grant an additional Stack.

entries.name: Phase Converter
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights, this gun becomes a Rapid-Fire Pulse Rifle and deals 30% increased damage to Arc-Debuffed targets.
Defeating Arc-Debuffed targets while ADS causes a explosion that deals 100 [?] damage in an 8? meter radius and Blinds for 10 seconds. Damage falls to 0% at the edge of the radius.

entries.name: Percussive Flames
entries.text:
Modifies Burning Maul into a single-use slam that deals 650% increased damage and releases 3 tracking Waves. Waves create Cyclones on impact which also track enemies.
Waves apply 20 (60 with Ember of Ashes equipped) Scorch on Impact. The released Cyclones last 7.5 seconds and track enemies, dealing 19 [16] damage every 0.2 seconds, while applying 3 (5 with Ember of Ashes) Scorch every 0.56 seconds.
