Consecration's center wave creates a weaker Cyclone that deals 7 [3] damage and does not have tracking; though, it still retains the Scorching capability.
Damage from multiple Cyclones can overlap.
Burning Maul no longer receives faster active super generation as a roaming-class super.

entries.name: Grave Robber
entries.text:
Powered Melee Hits and (Glaive) Melee Kills refill the magazine from reserves.
3 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Lancer's Vigil
entries.text:
Diamond Lance creates a Stasis Crystal on impact. Hitting an Elite or higher tier Combatant creates 3 additional Stasis Crystals.
With a Stasis Super Ability equipped, spawn a Diamond Lance next to you by performing one of three actions:
• Stand behind a Rally Barricade and score a Kill or 3 Precision Hits within ? seconds of each
OR
• Reach 100% progress by landing hits with Stasis Weapons. Bodyshots grant 5% progress, and precision damage grants 12% progress
OR
• Score two Stasis Weapon kills
Diamond Lance damage is increased by 144%|253%|333%|389%|428%|455%|475% at 1|2|3... stacks of Frost Armor.
Slamming the Diamond Lance gives Frost Armor first, therefore always benefitting from the damage buff.
This exotic shares the cooldown of the Diamond Lance Aspect, but using the Aspect is not required.

entries.name: Under Pressure
entries.text:
Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty:
• 12.5% to 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 0 to 30? Stability

entries.name: Duelist's Trance
entries.text:
Sword Kills grant 🡅65 Guard Resistance, Guard Endurance, and (Guard) Charge Rate.
Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Grants 5 points of each Stat.

entries.name: Long March
entries.text: While held and loaded with at least 1 round, your outer Radar detection range is increased to 80 meters.

entries.name: Touch of Thunder
entries.text:
Enhances your Flashbang, Lightning, Pulse, and Storm Grenade Abilities:
• Flashbang Grenade releases a full damage Blinding pulse in a 5 meter radius of its first impact with a surface
• Lightning Grenade grants an additional Grenade Ability charge. Each pulse Jolts targets and grants x5 Bolt Charge
• Pulse Grenade creates an Ionic Trace on hit (1 second cooldown), and deals 2%|9%|18.5%|24%|25% increased damage on the 1|2|3|4|5th pulse. Deals 25% increased damage on all pulses after the 5th
• Storm Grenade turns into a roaming 'Storm Cloud' that lasts 4.5 seconds and fires 11 lightning bolts over its lifetime (6 seconds and 15 bolts with Spark of Amplitude). Storm Cloud moves at a starting rate of 2.7 [1.5] meters per second, then doubles its speed over 1.6? seconds

entries.name: Juggernaut
entries.text:
Sprinting for ? seconds with full Class Ability Energy grants a 50 HP frontal overshield. Shield grants x1  Bolt Charge per hit absorbed.
While Amplified, the shield gains an additional 33% damage resistance, effectively increasing to 67 HP.
This overshield grants 60% [10%] Splash Damage Resistance, and an additional 10% Damage Resistance against combatants.
Upon being destroyed, Overshield consumes your Class Ability Energy. Overshield will fully absorb any overkill damage on the last hit.
Juggernaut Overshield stacks with other Overshields.

entries.name: Knockout
entries.text:
Melee kills grant Amplified, begin Health Regneration, and restore a fixed amount of HP based on Combatant Rank:
• Minor: 50 HP
• Elite: 75 HP
• Miniboss and Bosses: 100 HP
• Players: 30 HP
Breaking a combatant or player shield, or dealing damage to a target below 30% HP, grants 'Knockout' for 6 seconds.
Knockout makes all Unpowered Melees count as Arc-Powered Melees and grants the following benefits:
• 160% [30%] Increased Uncharged Melee Damage
• 160% [20%] Increased Charged Melee Damage
• Increases Melee Lunge distance against Combatants to 6 meters
In PvP Only:
Spark of Feedback's damage increase is reduced to 15% while Knockout is active.

entries.name: Storm's Keep
entries.text:
Casting Thruster grants x6 Bolt Charge. Casting your Barricade grants x4 Bolt Charge to you and nearby allies.
While within your Barricade's area of effect, you and allies gain x1 stack of Bolt Charge every 0.6 seconds, and can discharge Bolt Charge through weapon damage.
Spark of Frequency does not increase the rate at which the barricade grants Bolt Charge.
Multiple Storm's Keep Barricades do not stack.

entries.name: Charge Shot
entries.text:
Fires a single tracking projectile that detonates on impact and creates a burning pool of fire.
Projectile deals 1184 [?] impact damage and 269 [?] explosive damage over 7 meters. This is reduced to 0% damage at the edge of the radius.
Lingering pool deals 46 [8] damage every 0.25 seconds for 1.75 seconds.

entries.name: Ahamkara's Eye
entries.text:
Scorch granted by me and Ignitions that started from me deal 31.6% increased damage.
▛ I see you, O Seeker of Knowledge Mine. Reading this somewhere [Real]. My Eye is a Chorus of coalesced Will and Desire...were my [Voices] not enough to [satiate] your ravenous tastes? ▟

entries.name: Transmutation
entries.text:
Intrinsically deals 40% more PvE damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.
Kills with this weapon's beam turn the target into a Transmutation Sphere. Incurs a 5 second cooldown before another sphere can be created.
Transmutation Spheres are considered a generic 'Void Weapon'. They benefit from Empowering and Void-Verb Buffs, but are unaffected by nor trigger Ability, Trace Rifle, or Weapon Surge effects.

entries.name: The Roadborn
entries.text:
Precision Kills or two Precision Hits grants 'Roadborn' for 10 seconds. Additional Precision Hits add 3 seconds.
While 'Roadborn' is active, gain the following benefits:
• 22% increased Precision Damage
• 42% faster Rate of Fire
• 10% increased Damage Falloff distance (stacks with Intrinsic benefit, granting a total increase of 15%)
• 20 Stability
• 40 Reload Speed
• 25% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 44% decreased Handling Animation Duration

entries.name: Genesis
entries.text:
Energy Weapons are refunded 1 Ammo upon hitting matching PVE Combatant Elemental Shields.
Refills magazine from reserves upon breaking a PVE Combatant, Barrier Champion, or Player Shield.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.name: Lead From Light
entries.text:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 1 Stack of Lead from Light. Maximum of 🡅6 Stacks.
Weapon Kills consume one stack to grant 25% increased Special Ammo generation progress for that kill.
🡅 Maximum number of Stacks is increased by 1.

entries.name: Sneak Bow
entries.text:
Crouching grants the following benefits:
• Prevents Radar Ping when shooting
• ? Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 25% increased Hold Time
🡅 Grants an additional ? Stability and Reload Speed while crouched.

entries.name: Sunfire Furnace
entries.text:
While a Solar Super is equipped and fully charged, ability kills (including Unpowered Melees) grant Cure x2 and stacks of 'Sunfire Furnace' based on Enemy Rank. Minor Tier enemies grant 1 stack, while Elite and Higher tier enemies grant 2. Stacks last for 20 seconds. Maximum of 10 stacks.
While Sunfire Furnace is active, kills with Shieldburst or ANY Grenade triggers an Ignition (even Forerunner's 'The Rock').
Sunfire Furnace also grants Increased Super Damage and Additional Base Grenade and Class Ability Regneration rate at 1|2|3... stacks.
• 6.5%|13.6%|22%|32%|43%|57%|73%|93%|118%|150%| Increased Super Damage
• ?|?|?|?|?|?|?|?|?|250% Base Grenade and Class Ability Regeneration
Casting your Super locks all stacks. Refund 8%|20%|26%|33%|45% Super Energy at 1|2|3|4|5+ stacks of Sunfire Furnace after your super ends.

entries.name: Survival Well
entries.text:
Class Ability usage heals you and allies within 12 meters as long as they have line of sight to you.
Casting a Barricade restores 70 Health and 110 Shield HP. Using Thruster restores 60 Health.
Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3 seconds of each while behind a Barricade triggers an additional healing pulse that restores 30 HP in a 12 meter radius.
Activation progress granted by weapon type:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords: 20%
• Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles: 34%
Additional hits provide no activation progress for 2 seconds after a Healing Pulse is triggered. 5 second cooldown between healing pulse activations. (why are these separate)
Super Abilities generate an extra Orb of Power that grants 7.14% Super Energy (regular Super Orb).
Specific Interactions:
• Roaming Supers generate an Orb with the first Kill instead of needing at least 2 Kills
• Ward of Dawn generates 4 Orbs with each granting 3.57% Super Energy (up from 3 Orbs granting 2.3% each for a ~2x increase)

entries.name: Auto-Loading Link
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Auto Rifles and Machine Guns.
Refills 10% of readied Auto Rifles' and Machine Guns' magazines (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds.
Scoring Auto Rifle or Machine Gun kills grants stacks of Auto-Loading Link. Maximum of 10 stacks. Stacks expire one at a time.
Auto-Loading Link grants 1.5% increased damage, ? Stability, and 5 Ammo Generation per stack.
The 1st stack lasts 7 seconds, with each subsequent stack having a 0.5 second shorter duration. The 10th stack lasts 2.5 seconds.

entries.name: Void Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Void Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: Font of Restoration
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Class stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Roar of Battle
entries.text:
Exchanging damage at most every 0.65 seconds for at least 2 seconds grants 'Roar of Battle' for 6 seconds.
'Roar of Battle' grants 10? Stability and 10? Handling.

entries.name: Harmonic Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Weapons matching your Super Element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Worm Byproduct
entries.text:
Taking self-damage from the explosion grants 'Worm Byproduct', increasing other weapon's damage by 15%.
This damage buff stacks with all other Empowering buffs.

entries.name: Disruption Break
entries.text:
On Elemental, Barrier or Guardian Shield Break:
Applies Kinetic Damage Vulnerability to the enemy, increasing Kinetic damage taken by 50% for 5.5 [5] seconds.
Stacks with all other Buffs and Debuffs (including itself).

entries.name: Prometheus Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 20 Stability and 20 Handling.
Grants the Incandescent trait:
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

entries.name: Pulse Monitor
entries.text:
Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 🡅35% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.
Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 🡅35% Shield Health.
Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.
🡅 Activates with 5?% more Shield Health remaining.

entries.name: En Garde
entries.text:
Readying the Sword grants 30% increased damage for 1.5 seconds.
2? second cooldown after the buff expires.

entries.name: Death at First Glance
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights, deal 32.5% increased damage for as long as you land Precision Hits or damage a Combatant Shield.
Buff reactivates after 3 seconds of not firing.

entries.name: Liquid Coils
entries.text: Increases charge time by 40ms and damage by 2%.

entries.name: EM Anomaly
entries.text:
Precision Kills with this gun trigger a Void Implosion that pulls enemies within a 9 [?] meter radius and explodes for 341 [?] damage.
For some 'large weight' enemies, they are pushed back instead.

entries.name: Illegally Modded Holster
entries.text:
Passively grants the following benefits while a Hand Cannon is readied:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance
Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).
'Illegally Modded Holster' grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• PVE ONLY: Direct Hits grant a Stack of 'Illegally Modded Holster'. Maximum of 10 Stacks.
'Illegally Modded Holster' grants 45% increased Direct Impact damage per Stack, maxing out at 450%. Boss-Tier Enemies take 33% decreased damage from Lucky Pants shots.
• Uncivil Discourse only recieves 30% increased damage per stack.
• Sturm's Overcharged Rounds only receive 11% increased damage per Stack (110%).
• Hawkmoon's Paracausal Shot receives 5% increased damage per stack upon being fired (50%).
• Malfeasance's Explosive Shadow is unaffected by the buff.
While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping to a non-Hand Cannon weapon or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Uncanny Arrows
entries.text:
Deadfall returns Ability Energy per Enemy Tethered:
• X% Super Energy up to the maximum of 50%
• 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy
Moebius Quiver can fire an additional volley per Super Activation and lasts 4 additional seconds (16🠚20 Seconds)
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website. (Super Energy is unaffected)

entries.name: Hydraulic Boosters
entries.text:
Passively grants 30% Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while Airborne.
Increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%. Greatly increases the initial momentum of all Jump Abilities.

entries.name: Big-Game Hunter
entries.text: Bolts fire with significantly increased Stagger Force.

entries.name: Harmonic Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Weapons matching your Super Element ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Classy Contender
entries.text:
Kills grant 5% Class Ability Energy.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Heavy Handed
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Elemental Melee Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)
10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: Adept Targeting
entries.text: Passively grants 7 Aim Assist.

entries.name: Delicate Tomb Catalyst
entries.text: Picking up Ionic Traces refill 4 ammo from reserves.

entries.name: Voltshot
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 5.3 seconds of a Weapon Kill grants Voltshot for 🡅8 seconds.
While Voltshot is active, your next Weapon Hit consumes the buff and applies Jolt to the target.
Applied Jolt's damage (generally) does not count as Weapon Damage.
🡅 Buff can be held 1 second longer.

entries.name: Spark of Focus
entries.text:
After 1.25 seconds of sprinting and while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5 meters per second:
Grants 150% [75%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
Deactivates once you have at least one Class Ability charge.

entries.name: Spark of Frequency
entries.text:
Scoring a Melee Hit grants 15 Stability, 50 Reload Speed, and a 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier for 5.25 seconds.
While Amplified:
• (Almost) all sources of Bolt Charge now grant an additional stack
• Grants no additional benefit to reload speed (bug?)

entries.name: Spark of Discharge
entries.text:
Collecting Ionic Traces grants a Stack of Bolt Charge.
Scoring multiple Arc Weapon Kills spawns an Ionic Trace at the killed target's location.
Activation progress granted by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 34%
• Elites, Players: 67%
• Minibosses and Bosses: 100%

entries.name: Spark of Ions
entries.text:
Killing a Jolted enemy or scoring a kill with a Bolt Charge lightning bolt creates an Ionic Trace.
10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Spark of Shock
entries.text: Arc Grenades apply Jolt on Hit.

entries.name: Spark of Momentum
entries.text: Collecting Ammo Bricks by sliding over them refills your held weapon's magazine from reserves and grants 3 stacks of Bolt Charge.

entries.name: Spark of Resistance
entries.text:
Grants 25% [10%] Damage Resistance while within 15 meters of 3+ enemies.
Remains active for 2 seconds once the activation condition is no longer met.

entries.name: Spark of Beacons
entries.text: Arc Special or Power Weapon Kills while Amplified create an explosion, Blinding enemies within 7.5 meters of the target.

entries.name: Spark of Magnitude
entries.text:
Lightning Grenades release an additional lightning bolt. (4🠚5)
Pulse Grenades release an additional 2 pulses. (6🠚8)
Storm Grenades release a third volley, dealing the same damage as the second volley.
When combined with the Touch of Thunder titan aspect, Storm Grenade's Roaming Storm lasts 1.5 seconds longer. (4🠚5.5s)

entries.name: Spark of Recharge
entries.text: Dropping to Critical Health grants 400% [200%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate until your Shields are fully recharged.

entries.name: Edge of Concurrence Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier
Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.
Being Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.

entries.name: Clenched Fist
entries.text:
Passively grants 100 Guard Resistance and Guard Endurance to Swords.
While Guarding:
• Grants 50% [10%] Damage Resistance (Stacks multiplicatively with the Damage Resistance provided by Sword Guard against blocked attacks)
• Blocking a hit grants 2 Stacks of Perfect Guard. Maximum of 100 Stacks. (Cannot gain stacks while you have the Restoration buff)
• Heavy Ammo Sword Energy does not decay from holding guard
All Stacks are removed if no hits have been blocked in the last 10 seconds.
Dealing Sword Damage with active Perfect Guard Stacks grants Restoration x2:
4 [3] second duration at 1 Stack, scaling up to 16 [6] seconds at 100 Stacks. (Ember of Solace increases this by 50%, up to 24 [9] seconds)

entries.name: SUROS Regime Catalyst
entries.text: Grants 50 Recoil Direction and doubles the healing chance (25%🠚50%).

entries.name: Tilting at Windmills
entries.text:
Blocking damage with this weapon increases movement speed while Blocking by 25?% for 🡅5 seconds.
Buff is removed when you stop blocking or if Glaive/Sword Energy runs out.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1? second.

entries.name: Zen Moment
entries.text:
Weapon Hits grant 1 Stack of the perk for 1 second up to the maximum of 5? Stacks.
Benefits granted per Stack:
• Grants ?% Flinch Resistance
• Reduces Visual Weapon Shake by 15%
• Reduces Reticle Bounce by 15%
Stacks gained per Weapon Hit by weapon type:
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 2?
• Pulse Rifles, Sidearms: 1.5
• Other Weapons: 1
🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability.

entries.name: Relentless Strikes
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Powered Hits within 2? seconds of each refunds 1 ammo.
Wolfpack Round Hits do not count.

entries.name: Innervation
entries.text:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Grenade Ability Energy on Orb of Power Pickups with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Golden Munitions
entries.text:
Generates 3 Ammo upon casting Cayde's Retribution. Wearing Celestial Nighthawk generates 1 ammo.
Ammo is added into reserves if the magazine is full.

entries.name: Kickstart
entries.text:
Upon sliding after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon held:
Grants 15% increased damage and 20% decreased Charge Time for ? seconds.

entries.name: Time Dilation
entries.text:
Extends Armor Charge decay time to 15|18|20 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Armor Charge decays at the rate of 1 Stack every 10 seconds by default with Passive Mods equipped.

entries.name: Rat King Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 20 Aim Assist and 20 Recoil Direction.
Finishing a reload within 6 seconds of a kill begins Health Regeneration.

entries.name: Melee Damage Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Damage from PVE Combatants less than 4 meters away by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Melee Kickstart
entries.text:
When a Melee Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Melee Ability Energy.
Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Melee Energy refunds.
Melee Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%
Bug: Doesn't work if you have more recharged Melee Ability Energy than a single ability charge.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Dimensional Shift
entries.text:
Collecting a Void Breach grants 'Dimensional Breach' until your next Weapon Kill.
Scoring a Weapon Kill while Dimensional Breach is active grants a 🡅25 HP Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistence) and begins a 5 second timer.
Additional weapon kills extend the timer back to 5 seconds.
🡅 More Void Overshield is granted per kill.

entries.name: Firing Line
entries.text: Being within 15 meters of 2 allies grants 20% increased Precision Damage.

entries.name: Enlightened Action
entries.text:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.
Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed
Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack
🡅 Maximum Stat Bonus is increased by 5. (50🠚55, breakdown by Stacks currently unknown)

entries.name: Osmosis
entries.text:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.
Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.
Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on Primary, 15% on Special).
Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.

entries.name: Grenade Font
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Grenade stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Close to Melee
entries.text:
Glaive Projectile Kills grant 60% [30%] increased Glaive Melee damage for 10 seconds.
Dealing Projectile or Melee damage extends the buff duration by 5 seconds, up to 10 seconds.

entries.name: Crimson Catalyst
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Range.
Every 30 points of damage taken with the weapon readied grants a Stack of 'To the Pain'. Maximum of 10 Stacks. Stowing the weapon removes all Stacks.
Each Stack grants ? Handling and 2 Aim Assist, maxing out at ? Handling and 20 Aim Assist.
Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.

entries.name: Time Dilation
entries.text:
Extends Armor Charge decay time to 15|18|20 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Armor Charge decays at the rate of 1 Stack every 10 seconds by default with Passive Mods equipped.

entries.name: Explosive Shadow
entries.text:
Intrinsically Anti-Unstoppable, but only Slug explosions stun Unstoppable champions.
Hits embed Explosive Slugs into the target. Target death or embedding a fifth slug causes all slugs to explode, each dealing 203 [45] damage in a 1? meter radius.

entries.name: Judgment
entries.text:
Deals 50% less damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.
Dealing 10 [5] hits within 0.15 seconds of each creates a 'Vex Cage' around the target for 1.25 seconds. At maximum rate of fire, this cage forms in 0.67 seconds.
Maintaining the cage does not require continuous fire.
Targets within a Vex Cage receive 15% increased damage from all sources (30% for Divinity). For sources that can deal precision damage, any damage dealt to a Vex Cage is treated as a Precision Hit.

entries.name: Cornered
entries.text:
Grants 15% decreased Charge/Draw Time while within 15 meters of 2 enemies.
Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.

entries.name: Stasis Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Stasis Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits within 6 seconds of each fires a Tracking Rocket that matches the weapon's element.
Rockets deal 22.4 [14] Impact and 24 [15] Explosive damage on Hit and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling. On non-primary weapons, the Rockets receive an additional damage increase.
% of magazine capacity as Hits required and the additional damage increase by weapon archetype:
• Hand Cannons, Pulse Rifles, Submachine Guns: 45% Magazine Capacity \\ 0% increased damage (Baseline)
• Sniper Rifles: 50%? \\ 100%
• Grenade Launchers: 30% \\ 25%
• Machine Guns: 25% \\ 50%
• Fusion Rifles, Shotguns: ?% \\ 150%
🡅 0.? second cooldown after activation before further Hits provide activation progress again.

entries.name: Aggressive Burst
entries.text: Hard-hitting two-burst fire.

entries.name: Chaos Reshaped
entries.text:
Being in Combat for 🡅11.5 seconds grants a Stack of 'Chaos Reshaped' for 7 seconds. Maintaining the first Stack for 🡅11.5 seconds grants a second Stack. Buff can be activated while stowed.
For Chaos Reshaped, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds.
Benefits at Chaos Reshaped x1 and x2:
• x1: grants 20% increased damage
• x2: grants 35% increased damage and grants a periodic burst of healing
🡅 Each Stack is gained 0.5 seconds sooner.
Healing effect is bugged!
While Chaos Reshaped x2 is active:
Stowing the weapon or keeping it readied for 7 seconds grants a continous healing effect of 5 HP per second.
Stowing this weapon grants the effect for 1 to 7 seconds (cycling, it's complicated), while keeping it readied after activation makes the healing effectively constant.
While this healing effect is active, NO OTHER SOURCE OF HEALING CAN RESTORE THE FINAL [~35 to 5] HP OF YOUR HEALTH BAR!
This unrecoverable HP segment can only be healed by Chaos Reshaped's 5/HPs effect.
For more details, visit the perk description in the Destiny Data Compendium.

entries.name: Dichotomous Thinking
entries.text:
Deals 30% more damage than other High Impact Machine Guns.
Scoring hits with the gun grants 10% Healing Charge. (Unlike Support-Frame Auto Rifles, this is the only way to gain charge.)
Hip-fire to shoot Healing Rounds at 600 RPM that seek allies within the reticle. Healing Rounds restore 30 HP per hit and do not consume ammo, instead costing 2% Healing Charge each. Firing a healing round refills 2 rounds into the magazine from reserves.
Landing 6 healing rounds within 1 second of each spawns a Threadling at the ally's location, and grants both you and them 'Support Frame Boost'. Support Frame Boost increases weapon damage by 10% for 6 seconds and stacks with everything.
Healing a Teeming Nest also grants you the Support Frame Boost.

entries.name: Subsistence
entries.text:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.
Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.

entries.name: Slickdraw
entries.text:
Passively grants:
• 100 Handling
• 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 20% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size (No effect on Magnetism AKA Reticle Stickiness)

entries.name: Noble Deeds
entries.text:
Assisting Allies by Reviving, Healing, Empowering, or granting Subclass Buffs to them grants 10 Stacks of Noble Deeds. Maximum of 10 Stacks.
Can be triggered even while the weapon is stowed.
Kills consume 1 [2] Stacks of Noble Deeds.
Grants 30 Handling and 30 Reload Speed while you have active Stacks. Swords receive 20 Charge Rate instead.

entries.name: Sturm Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 40 Handling and 20 Range.
Kills with Overcharged Rounds grants 2 stacks of 'Helping Hands'. Maximum of 6 stacks.
Helping Hands grants 50% decreased Stow/Ready Animation Speed while active. Readying Sturm or a Together Forevever weapon consumes one stack.

entries.name: Sunshot Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 30 Range and 20 Stability.
Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 9 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Ex Diris Catalyst
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant Amplified for 15 seconds.
While Amplified, Direct Hits charge Enrage twice as fast (25%🠚50% per hit).

entries.name: Assault Barricade
entries.text:
Replaces Towering Barricade with an Assault Barricade that allows the caster and their allies to shoot through it.
Assault Barricades take 60% increased damage from Enemy Players, effectively decreasing its HP from 500 to 312.5 in PvP.

entries.name: Inverse Relationship
entries.text:
Hits grant ? Handling, ?% Flinch Resistance, and ?% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds. This effect stacks up to 6 times, and additional hits refresh the duration.
Gain increased damage as your Shield is depleted past 114|60|0 remaining HP.
• PvE: 10%|20%|40%
• PvP: 2%|4%|6%

entries.name: Arc Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Arc Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Parting Gift
entries.text:
Class Ability usage drops a Parting Gift that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 440 [121] damage over a 7.5 meter radius.
Parting Gift applies an additional effect based on the element of your equipped Super Ability:
• Arc: Blind for 10 [3] seconds
• Solar: 40 Scorch (60 with Ember of Ashes)
• Stasis: 40 [20] Slow Stacks for 4 [1.5] seconds (8 [2] seconds with Whisper of Durance)
• Void: Suppression for 10 seconds [Does not apply to Guardians in their Super]
• Strand: Sever for 10 [5] seconds (15 [7] with Thread of Continuity)
Detonates instantly on contact with a surface or an enemy (for instant detonations, try the 4pc Dark Age Set Bonus from Warlord's Ruin).

entries.name: Marksman Optics: High
entries.text:
Passively increases Zoom by 2.
Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased Absolute Recoil
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

entries.name: Accelerated Assault
entries.text:
For single-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 1.2 seconds or at most 4 seconds between each other grants ? Reload Speed and 🡅6% [?] increased damage for 8 seconds.
Additional hits while the buff duration is below 4 seconds refresh the timer to 4 seconds.
For multi-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 0.8 seconds or at most 1.2 seconds between each other refills 10% of the magazine and grants 🡅6% [?] increased damage for 4 seconds.
🡅 Damage bonus is increased by 20% (5%🠚6%).

entries.name: Invigoration
entries.text:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Melee Ability Energy on Orb of Power Pickups with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Business Time
entries.text:
Holding down the trigger progressively grants up to 60% increased Rate of Fire and ? Range after 1.38 seconds.
As long as the trigger continues to be held, an explosive projectile is added every 18 shots, dealing 56 [21] damage with no damage falloff.
Achieving maximum fire rate increases the frequency of these projectiles to once every 8 shots.

entries.name: Blastwave Striders
entries.text:
Passively grants 75% Damage Resistance against explosive self-damage.
The following actions charge up Blastwave Striders:
• Minor PVE Combatant Kills: 10%
• Elite or higher tier PVE Combatant Kills: 25%
• Enemy Guardians: 20%
• Collecting Alethonym's Vestiges: 10%
While at 100% charge, deal damage with Shiver Strike, Howl of The Storm, or explosive self-damage to propel yourself backwards in an explosive jump, releasing 8 Stasis Shrapnel Projectiles and granting 5 Frost Armor Stacks. Each Projectile deals 623 [?] damage and spawns a Stasis Crystal on impact.
This explosive jump also releases an expanding ? meter radius Stasis Wave that Freezes enemies on contact [Slows for ? seconds].
Shrapnel Kills do not charge Blastwave Striders.

entries.name: Mark of the Devourer
entries.text:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.
Shots fired overpenetrate unlimited targets.
Direct hits with this weapon apply Corruption (DoT Poison), dealing 30 [0.4] damage every 0.5 seconds for 2 seconds. Multiple instances of Corruption can be stacked on the same target.
Kills create a Remnant which tracks towards you when within a 15 meter radius. Remnants last for 8 seconds in the world before despawning.

entries.name: Hard Light Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 25 Stability.
While Amplified, Radiant, or Devour is active:
• ? Handling
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration

entries.name: Hip-Fire Grip
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits while hipfiring:
• 25 Stability and 15 Aim Assist
• 2.7° larger Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 20% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 20% increased Damage Falloff Distance
The Damage Falloff increase does not apply to The Last Word, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles, and Fusion Rifles.
PvP-specific note: the Precision Aim Cone Angle increase essentially just allows you to hit Crits while aimed above or slightly to the side of the head. (This is already the default behavior of Submachine Guns, Sidearms, Bows, Machine Guns, and Linear Fusion Rifles so it does not affect them)

entries.name: Under-Over
entries.text:
Increases damage against shielded targets:
• 125% increase against PVE Combatant Overshields
• 50% increase against PVE Combatant Elemental Shields and Barrier Champion Shields
• 20% increase against Player Overshields and for bodyshots against Players with Woven Mail
Notable Combatant Overshields include Shadow Legion Tech Pack and Lucent Moth Overshields. They are indicated with a glowing outline around the targets as well as a small blue health bar under the normal one.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.name: Bleak Domain
entries.text:
Enhances Bleak Watcher:
• Targeting Range is increased to 50 meters
• Creates 4 outward-tilted Medium Stasis Crystals around where it spawns (these respawn after 15 seconds)
• Releases a Stasis Storm in a 3 meter radius
Standing in the Stasis Storm grants a Stack of 'Icicle' every second. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Shooting consumes a Stack of Icicle, releasing a Stasis Projectile that deals 50 [?] damage and applies 50 [20] Slow Stacks for ? seconds.
Icicle can fire every 0.2 seconds. Icicle Stacks expire if you leave the Stasis Storm for more than 2 seconds.

entries.name: Collective Purpose
entries.text:
Grants a stack of 'Collective Purpose' for each ally within 15 meters. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Collective Purpose grants the following benefits while at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 5?|10?|15?|20?|25? Range
• 5?|10?|15?|20?|25? Handling
• 0.975x?|0.95x?|0.925x?|0.9x?|0.875x? Draw Time Multiplier
• 5|10|15|20?|25? Charge Time Stat (For reference, 10 Charge Time stat is the benefit of a Charge Time Masterwork)

entries.name: Arbalest Catalyst
entries.text:
Passively grants:
• 20 Handling
• Increases Magazine Size by one (5🠚6)
Refills magazine from reserves upon breaking a PVE Combatant, Barrier Champion, or Player Shield.

entries.name: Tension
entries.text: Passively grants 6 Draw Time Stat and 6 Accuracy.

entries.name: Adept Draw Time
entries.text: Passively decreases Draw Time by 40.

entries.name: Collective Pugilism
entries.text:
Collecting an Elemental Pickup enables Weapon Damage to generate Melee Ability energy per hit for 8 seconds.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Shot Tangles extend the timer by 4 seconds. Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Thrown Tangles extend the timer by 8 seconds.
Timer can be extended to a maximum of 16 seconds.
Melee energy granted by weapon type:
Spreadshot HC: 0.5%
Burst Sidearm: 0.78%
Fusion Rifle: 1.15%
Rocket Pulse: 1.95%
Sidearm: 2.34%
Scout: 3.34%
Rocket Launcher: 12.9%
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

entries.name: Tap the Trigger
entries.text:
Firing grants 'Tap The Trigger' for 0.6 seconds, providing the following benefits:
• 40 Stability
• 50% decreased Recoil
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
Fusion Rifles only receive 25% of the benefits.
Buff cannot be refreshed until Automatic Weapons stop firing, or until the next burst.
[Controller-Only] Weapon fires the instant trigger pressure is applied.

entries.name: Harmonic Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Weapons matching your Super Element 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: MIDA Synergy
entries.text: Superb handling. Move faster with this lightweight weapon equipped. This weapon grants additional speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.

entries.name: Suspending Blast
entries.text:
Manually detonating at least 6 rounds that are embedded into a target Suspends them for 6 seconds (8 with Thread of Continuity).
Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.name: Edge of Action
entries.text:
Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a small protective Void Dome.
Weapon Kills apply Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant Volatile Rounds for 3 seconds.
1.5 second cooldown between activations.
Only applies to Glaive Projectiles.

entries.name: Font of Agility
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Weapons stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: All at Once
entries.text:
Shots dissipate after 50 meters.
Holding down the trigger for 0.5 seconds begins loading a burst of 10 shots and marks enemies within 24 meters of you. Shots load over the course of 0.9 seconds.
Grants 30 Stability during the burst. Fully charged bursts apply Unravel to marked targets.

entries.name: To Excess
entries.text: Weapon kills while your Super Ability is charged grant 20 Grenade stat and 20 Melee stat for 12 seconds.

entries.name: Full Court
entries.text:
Starts linearly increasing Detonation and Burn (DoT) damage 0.2 seconds after the grenade projectile is fired.
Reaches maximum strength after 1.1 seconds at a 35% damage increase.
The damage increase is finalized at the point of detonation and any lingering effects left will not increase it further.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.

entries.name: Exhaustive Research
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights at an enemy within 60 meters loads up a Micro-Rocket over 0.6 seconds.
Micro-Rocket replaces a regular bullet, firing a tracking missile that matched the weapon's element and deals up to ? Explosive Damage in a ? meter radius.
5.5 second cooldown before a new rocket can be loaded.

entries.name: Demolitionist
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 🡅11% Grenade Ability Energy.
Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant 🡅22%.
Using your Grenade Ability refills the Magazine with a 3 second cooldown.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
🡅 Grenade Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%. (e.g. 10%⁠🠚⁠11%)

entries.name: Thermal Atomization
entries.text:
While above 50% Heat:
• Grants 8.25% [3.5] to 14% [?] increased weapon damage as Heat increases from 50% to 100%
• Enemies explode on direct damage kills, dealing up ? damage matching the weapon's element in a 7.5 meter radius.
Detonation damage by weapon type:
• Hand Cannons: 74 (lol) [77?]
• Submachine Guns: 289 [?]
• Sniper Rifles: 552 [?]
Detonation damage falls off to 0% damage at the edge of the radius.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.name: Built to Blast
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits while Void Overshield, Frost Armor, or Woven Mail is active:
• 30 Stability
• ? Aim Assist
• ?% Flinch Resistance

entries.name: Overflowing Light
entries.text:
Grenade or Class Ability usage and dealing Elemental Melee damage grants the 'Empowered Abilities' buff to the other two abilities for 5 seconds (e.g.: Barricade usage 🠚 Empowered Grenade and Melee Abilities). Casting your super removes all stacks.
Buff display on the HUD is nonsensical and does not accurately represent the buff's behavior when chaining multiple abilities together.
Empowered Melee x1|x2 benefits:
• 10% | 50% increased Melee damage
• 400% [100%] | 800% [200%] Additional Base Melee Regeneration Rate
Empowered Grenade x1|x2 benefits:
• 20% [10%] | 35% [20%] increased Grenade damage
• 400% [100%] | 800% [200%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate
Empowered Class Ability x1|x2 benefits:
• 25%|50% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Does not grant any measurable benefit to Barricade HP despite stating it does

entries.name: Grim Harvest
entries.text:
Stasis Shards now grant Frost Armor upon pickup:
• Small Stasis Shards grant x1 Frost Armor, 10% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 10 HP.
• Large Stasis Shards grant x3 Frost Armor, 50% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 20 HP.
While Frost Armor is active:
• Kinetic and Stasis Weapon Kills have an escalating chance to trigger a Stasis Shatter based on the number of Frost Armor stacks.
• Taking damage grants ?% Class Ability energy (once per second).
Intrinsic to All Stasis Subclasses:
Stasis Shards are generated by:
• Shattering a Frozen target or Stasis Crystal
• Defeating a Stasis-Debuffed (Slowed or Frozen) target
Minor combatants generate a small Stasis Crystal, while Elites, Minibosses, and Guardians generate a Large Stasis Crystal.
In PvP Only:
Stasis Shards go on a 10 second cooldown upon creating 6 shards within ? seconds of the first.

entries.name: Grenade Kickstart
entries.text:
When a Grenade Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Grenade Ability Energy.
Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Grenade Energy refunds.
Grenade Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Destabilizing Rounds
entries.text:
Weapon Kills apply Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant Volatile Rounds for 🡅4.5 seconds.
1.5 second cooldown between activations.
🡅 Volatile Rounds duration is increased by 1.5 seconds.

entries.name: Unplanned Reprieve
entries.text:
Fires seven bolts that deal impact damage and then explode after 5 seconds or when within 3 meters of an enemy.
Due to repeated bugs and exploits, these bolts are immune to all forms of premature destruction.
Upon detonation, each bolt deals 236 [47] damage in a 4 meter radius, down to a minimum of 12.5% damage at the edge of the radius.

entries.name: Necrochasm Catalyst
entries.text:
Damaging 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each other grants the following benefits for 10 seconds:
• 35% increased damage
• ? Handling
• ? Range
• ? Aim Assist
Buff can be refreshed.

entries.name: Subsistence Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Subsistence trait:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.
Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.

entries.name: Destabilizing Rounds Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Destablizing Rounds trait:
Weapon Kills apply Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant Volatile Rounds for 3 seconds.
1.5 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Onslaught Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Onslaught trait:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed

entries.name: Close Enough
entries.text:
Collecting Ionic Traces grants 4% Chaos Reach Super Energy.
While at 5 Stacks of Bolt Charge or higher, after having sprinted for at least 1.5 seconds, maintaining sprint grants you a Stack of Bolt Charge every 0.33 seconds.
Chaos Reach refunds 10% Super Energy on hit.
0.75 second cooldown between refunds. This can increase Chaos Reach duration by up to ~120%.

entries.name: Slickdraw
entries.text:
Passively grants:
• 100 Handling
• 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 🡅15% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size (No effect on Magnetism AKA Reticle Stickiness)
🡅 Auto Aim Penalty is decreased by 25?% (20%⁠🠚⁠15%).

entries.name: Timed Payload
entries.text:
Splits off 55% of the Weapon's Bodyshot damage into a Explosive Payload that detonates after a 0.6 second delay. The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~16.5% of the weapon's Bodyshot damage. On Crits, the overall increase is 10.9% for Adaptive/Precision Hand Cannons and 10.17% for Aggressive Hand Cannons.
[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

entries.name: Rimestealer
entries.text: Killing Frozen Enemies or Shattering a Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants a Stack of Frost Armor.

entries.name: Balanced Grip
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Melee Attack kills within 5 seconds of each grants 1 ammo.
Passively grants:
• 2 Impact (~1.2% increased damage)
• 10 Charge Rate
• 40 Guard Resistance
• 40 Guard Endurance

entries.name: Wolfpack Rounds
entries.text:
Light attacks spawn 1 Wolfpack Round.
Grounded Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Pack Hunter' to you and allies in a ? meter radius for 10 seconds.
Pack Hunter buffs all Ergo Sum and Non-Exotic Swords. Pack Hunter causes sword swings to release 3 tracking submunitions that deal 90 [33] damage each.
Wolfpack Rounds count as sword hits, and can benefit from both sword perks and Empowering buffs.

entries.name: Quickdraw
entries.text:
Switching to the Weapon grants 100 Ready/Stow Handling and a 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier for 1 second.
Buff is removed as soon as ADS input is pressed.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Panic Response IV
entries.text:
Magazine is refilled every 0.2 seconds based on currently remaining ammo while not firing the weapon.
Refill amount by currently remaining ammo:
• 1-2 Ammo: 4 shots
• 3-8 Ammo: 3 shots
• 9-16 Ammo: 2 shots
• 17 Ammo: 1 shot
Generates 2% Blight per hit. Not firing for 1.3 seconds drains 3.33% Blight every 1.2 seconds.
Performing a manual reload creates Blighted Seekers for 7 seconds, granting 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight converted. Maximum of 6 Seekers. Blight always rounds up to the next full Seeker.
Grants ? Reload Speed based on the amount of Blighted Seekers prepared.
Blighted Seekers are fired at 720 RPM while aiming down sights or 450 RPM if fired from the hip.

entries.name: Panic Response V
entries.text:

• 3-8 Ammo: 3 shots

entries.name: Heavy Metal
entries.text: Holding down the trigger for 4 rounds makes the 4th round apply Volatile for 10 Seconds.

entries.name: Replenishing Aegis
entries.text:
Refills 1 round into the Magazine from reserves upon blocking damage.
1 second cooldown after activation. Does not work while the magazine is overfilled (assumed).

entries.name: Command Frame II
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights consumes one ammo to fire a single hit-scan projectile that can deal precision damage.
Projectile deals 243 [40.25] bodyshot damage and 435 [72] precision damage.

entries.name: Command Frame III
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights consumes one ammo to fire a single hit-scan projectile that can deal precision damage.
Projectile deals 243 [40.25] bodyshot damage and 435 [72] precision damage.

entries.name: Command Frame IV
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights consumes one ammo to fire a single hit-scan projectile that can deal precision damage.
Projectile deals 243 [40.25] bodyshot damage and 435 [72] precision damage.

entries.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
entries.text:
Grants 5% increased damage against Elemental and Barrier Champion Shields.
Allows bullets to overpenetrate enemies once.

entries.name: Hammer of the Gods
entries.text:
Casting Thunderclap refunds Melee Ability Energy after use. Refund amount is FPS-based, granting 10|18|32|41|77% Melee Ability Energy at 30|60|120|144|300 frames.
Kills with Thunderclap and this exotic's Lightning Strikes refund additional melee energy per kill, up to a maximum of 50%.
Upon activating and upon discharging Thunderclap, summon Jolting Lightning strikes in a 15 meter radius around you, dealing 181 [50] damage. Lightning Strikes instantly trigger their Jolt chains during both events, and their damage is doubled while Amplified.
Lightning Damage can be further increased by up to 200% by fully charging Thunderclap, which stacks multiplicatively with the damage bonus from being Amplified.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Harmonic Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Weapons matching your Super Element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: The Fourth Magic
entries.text:
Kills with Weapons matching your Grenade Element grant a Stack of Death Throes. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Stacks decay one at a time over 8|7|6|5|4 seconds for the 1st|...|5th Stacks.
Death Throes benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 0.5%|1%|1.5%|2%|2.5% Grenade Energy per second
• PVE: 40%|55%|70%|85%|100% increased Grenade damage
• PVP: 20%|40%|60%|80%|100% increased Grenade damage
Grapple Grenade is uniquely tuned and receives an additive buff instead (170% at maximum stacks).
On Grenade Ability usage with active Death Throes Stacks, for 5 seconds:
Allies receive 'Feel The Flames' while within 20 meters of you.
'Feel the Flames' grants 10x Grenade Recharge Rate.
(Grenade Regeneration Rate Multiplier is applied after all additive Grenade Recharge Rate modifiers.)

entries.name: Blades of Unmaking
entries.text:
Replaces your melee ability with a 2-hit combo blade attack. Each stab deals 543 [84] damage and has an extended lunge range of 7 meters.
Scales with the Melee Stat and Melee-Damage Buffs. Despite its behavior, this is not considered a "Glaive Melee".

entries.name: Dealer's Choice
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant additional Super Ability Energy. Equipping multiple Pale Heart Weapons increases the amount granted.
Extra Super Energy gains with 1|2|3 equipped Pale Heart Weapons: 0.3%|1.6%|3%
Pale Heart Weapons include:
• Weapons with the Dealer's Choice Origin Trait
• Ace of Spades, Khvostov 7G-0X, and Still Hunt

entries.name: Anti-Taken Fletching
entries.text:
Grants 10% increased damage to Taken Combatants.
Also grants 25% increased damage to Combatants blighted by Witherhoard.

entries.name: Loyal Moths
entries.text:
Kills or 2 Direct Hits within ? seconds of each other spawn a seeking Hive Moth.
Hive Moths deal 525 [31] damage with a blast radius of 7 meters and Blind for 10 seconds.
Wearing Mothkeeper's Wraps spawns an additional Hive Moth that grants 22.5 HP Void Overshield to the nearest ally.
3 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Malevolent Grasp
entries.text:
Only works while a Strand Super is equipped.
Casting a Rift Suspends all combatants within 6 meters. Killing Suspended Enemies restores 15 HP.
Targets you Suspend take ticks of damage every 0.467 [0.3] seconds. Each damage tick restores 5 HP.
Damage over time starts at 23 [9] damage, increasing by ~5.5% [?%] per tick.
Enemies breaking free from Suspension take an additional 64 [34?] damage.
Targets Suspended with a Rift cast take ~112.5% increased damage from the the above sources.

entries.name: Turnabout
entries.text:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 🡅11.4 seconds.
🡅 Increases the Overshield duration by 1.4 seconds.

entries.name: Hail Storm
entries.text:
Stasis arrows create Large Stasis Crystals on impact, and Freeze on direct hits.
In PvP, direct hits apply [50 Slow] for 1 second (2 seconds with Whisper of Durance).
This weapon deals 50% increased damage to Frozen enemies and Stasis Crystals (damage increase stacks with Whisper of Rending).

entries.name: High-Impact Reserves
entries.text:
Increases damage by 12.1% [3%] to 25.6% [6%] as the Magazine drops from 🡅55% of its base capacity to empty.
The buff in PVE ranges between 10.3% and 22.9% instead on Fusion Rifles and Aggressive Frame Linear Fusion Rifles.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
🡅 Activates with 5% more of the Magazine Capacity remaining.

entries.name: Thin the Herd
entries.text:
Deal 24.5% increased impact damage to Combatant Shields.
Dealing damage grants 70 Reload Speed for 7 seconds. Direct Hits apply Volatile to the target and enemies in a 7.5 meter radius.
For 6 seconds after either scoring a kill with another weapon or dealing Fighting Lion damage, performing the other action refills Fighting Lion's magazine.

entries.name: Nucleosynthetic Magazine
entries.text:
Fires Hive-Knight Arc Projectiles that deal 372 [21] impact damage and 355 [119] explosive damage in a 4.5 meter radius.
Damage is decreased by 70% at the edge of the radius.

entries.name: Ambitious Assassin
entries.text:
Reloading after scoring Kills with the weapon overfills the magazine from reserves based on the number of Kills scored.
Overfill amount maxes out at 150% of the Magazine Capacity. Always rounds up. Kill counter persists through stow.
Overfill amount per Kill scored:
• Primary Weapons: 20%
• Special and Power Weapons: 10%

entries.name: Perpetual Motion Enhanced
entries.text:
While moving at a minimum of 2 meters per second:
Grants a Stack of 'Perpetual Motion' after 2 seconds and a second Stack after 🡅9 seconds.
Each Stack provides 10 Stability, 10 Handling, and 10 Reload Speed. All Stacks are removed if movement speed is below 2 m/s for 0.5 seconds.
Works and can activate while stowed.
🡅 Second Stack is gained 1 second sooner.

entries.name: Lodestar Catalyst
entries.text:
While Amplified:
• 10 Aim Assist
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

entries.name: Serve the Colony
entries.text:
Grants the Auto-Loading Holster trait:
Refills stowed weapon from reserves after 3.5 seconds of it being stowed.

entries.name: Property: Irreducible
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to consume your grenade charge over a 2.3 second animation that refills the magazine and prepares an explosive [projectile | shape | language]. Can consume both Transcendence Grenades and Song of Flame Wisps.
The explosive's damage type always matches your equipped grenade, and deals 3,311 [223] damage in a 6 meter radius on impact. Kills trigger a second explosion for 67.2? [44.8?] damage in a 2.4? meter radius.
The [projectile | shape | language]'s damage is increased by 19% if you are Transcendent.

entries.name: Energy Transfer
entries.text:
Every point of damage taken while Guarding grants Class Ability Energy:
• 1.5% when Melee Damage is Blocked
• 1% when non-Melee Damage is Blocked
• 0.5% when damage isn't Blocked (getting hit from behind)
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Momentum Transfer
entries.text:
Grants Melee Ability Energy upon dealing Grenade Ability damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.
Melee Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Attaching to targets with a Grapple triggers the mod but Grapple Melees do not.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Tectonic Harvest

• Small Stasis Shards grant x1 Frost Armor, 10% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 10 HP.
• Large Stasis Shards grant x3 Frost Armor, 50% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 20 HP.

• Kinetic and Stasis Weapon Kills have an escalating chance to trigger a Stasis Shatter based on the number of Frost Armor stacks.

• Shattering a Frozen target or Stasis Crystal
• Defeating a Stasis-Debuffed (Slowed or Frozen) target
Minor combatants generate a small Stasis Crystal, while Elites, Minibosses, and Guardians generate a Large Stasis Crystal.
In PvP Only:
Stasis Shards go on a 10 second cooldown upon creating 6 shards within ? seconds of the first.

entries.name: Cryoclasm
entries.text:
Passively grants an 'Enhanced Slide' that travels 50% further and sends a Stasis Wave that travels 20? meters along the ground. This stasis wave instantly Shattering any Crystals or Frozen Targets on contact in a ? meter radius. Incurs a 2 second cooldown between uses.
Sliding into Stasis Crystals or Frozen Enemies instantly Shatters them and other targets within a ? meter radius.

entries.name: Controlled Burst
entries.text:
Scoring a Kill or hitting every shot in a burst grants 20% increased damage and 10% decreased Charge Time for 🡅2.5 seconds.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Edge of Intent Catalyst
entries.text: Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants Cure x2 to you and Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.

entries.name: Slideways
entries.text:
Sliding refills 15% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves and grants 15? Stability and 30 Handling for 3 seconds.
0.5 second cooldown between activations. Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Cooling Baubles
entries.text:
Collecting an Orb of Power or Elemental Pickup dissipates 🡅35% Weapon Heat.
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.
🡅 Dissipates 2% additional Heat per activation.

entries.name: Dark Ether Reaper
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Kills with the weapon spawns a Dark Ether Charge at the target's location. ? second cooldown between Charge spawns.
Charge spawning progress on Kill by Enemy Rank:
Minors and Players: 25% | Elites: ?% | Minibosses and higher: 100%
Dark Ether Charges last 5? seconds and can be detonated by shooting or coming into contact with them.
Detonations deal up to 386 [50] elemental damage in a 3? meter radius and match the weapon's element. Detonations inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.
Damage is always attributed to the Charge's creator regardless of who destroys them.
Detonating Charges refills and overfills the magazines of all equipped Dark Eather Reaper weapons from reserves up to 140% capacity (rounded up).

entries.name: Destabilizing Rounds
entries.text:
Weapon Kills apply Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant Volatile Rounds for 3 seconds.
1.5 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Unsated Hunger
entries.text:
Grants 20 Stability, 60 Handling, and 60 Reload Speed while Grenade, Melee, and Class Abilities are all uncharged.
Swords receive 50 Charge Rate and 40 Guard Endurance instead.

entries.name: Lucky Shot
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Precision Kill grants 'Lucky Shot Ready'.
Scoring a Precision Hit while you have Lucky Shot Ready refills the magazine by 1 from reserves and begins a 7 second timer. Additional precision hits during this timer continue to refill the magazine from reserves.

entries.name: Meaning-Making
entries.text:
Kills with this weapon create a 'Teeming Nest'. Killing an enemy within 30 meters of a Teeming Nest will instead spawn a Threadling at the enemy's location.
Teeming Nests spawn Threadlings every 5 seconds and last for 17.5 seconds at base. Nests lose 6.7% of their health per second after being at full health for 1.5 seconds.
Nests can be targeted by Service of Luzaku's healing shots, which heal them for 11.5% HP each shot. Landing 6 healing shots on a Teeming Nest fully restores its health.
Threadlings spawned from Teeming Nests interact with Strand Fragments, count as weapon damage, can trigger Armor Mods, and benefit from Empowering Buffs.

entries.name: Arc Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Arc Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Lone Wolf
entries.text:
Passively grants 🡅6 Aim Assist, 🡅16 Airborne Effectiveness, and a 🡅15% decreased ADS Animation Duration.
While no allies are within 15 meters:
Bonuses are increased to 🡅11 Aim Assist, 🡅32 Airborne Effectiveness, and a 🡅25% decreased ADS Animation Duration.
🡅 Aim Assist bonus is increased by 1, Airborne Effectiveness bonus is increased by 1 (2 with no nearby allies), and the ADS Animation Duration is decreased by a further 5 percentage points.

entries.name: Kinetic Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Kinetic Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Eager Edge
entries.text:
Readying the Sword grants 80% increased Grounded and 64% increased Airborne Lunge Distance for 3 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow. 3 second cooldown after the buff is removed.

entries.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 'Crystalline Corpsebloom' for 4 seconds.
Kills while Crystalline Corpsebloom is active spawn a Stasis Crystal 3 meters away from the enemy death location in a random direction.
🡅 Stasis Crystal is bigger.

entries.name: D.A.R.C.I. Catalyst
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Stability.
Hits on Highlighted targets grants one stack of 'Networked Targeting' to you and allies within a 15 meter radius for 10.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Networked Targeting buffs D.A.R.C.I and Non-Exotic Sniper Rifles.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2.8%|6.1%|9.1%|12.5%|15.9% increased damage
• ? Stability, Handling, Aim Assist, Flinch Resistance
Granting the 5th stack to an ally increases D.A.R.C.I's damage by an additional 15%.

entries.name: Borealis Catalyst
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Reload Speed.
On Matching Elemental Shield Break:
Explosion disorients enemies within 7 meters for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Rally Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation and keeps you crouched after.
Creates a short, curved, see-through Barricade that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies while standing behind it:
• 10% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 50% Flinch Resistance
• 30 Stability
• 100 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 80% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants

entries.name: Towering Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation.
Creates a tall, slightly curved, see-through Barricade in front of you that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Grants 60% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while standing behind the Barricade.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Standing extremely close to the barricade consistently prevents enemy melee attacks from hitting you through it.

entries.name: Cluster Bomb
entries.text:
Rocket detonations release 8 Cluster Bombs.
Each Cluster Bomb deals up to 🡅165 🡅[12.1] damage in a 4 meter radius.
🡅 Cluster Bomb damage is increased by 10%.

entries.name: Grand Overture Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 20 Handling and 20 Stability.
Arc Missiles apply Blind for 2 seconds. Kills trigger an explosion dealing ? damage in a ? meter radius.

entries.name: Charged with Blight
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Charged With Blight'. Each stack grants ? Stability and ? Reload Speed, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
At 10 stacks, hold [Reload] to load a 'Taken Blight'. Animation speed is scaled by reload stat. Entering this mode immediately triggers the 105 HP heal and health regeneration.
Taken Blight deals 220 [113] Arc Damage on direct impact with a poisoning field around it that inflicts Corruption and applies Blind in a ? meter radius. Corruption deals 27 [0.375] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for 3.5 [2] seconds.
Any target hit by the Blight takes 50% increased damage from all Weapons of Sorrow for 5 seconds.
Blight can benefit from the final round damage bonus.

entries.name: Desperate Measures
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 'Desperate Measures x1' (DMx1), increasing damage by 10% for 7 seconds.
Grenade or Melee Kills grant 20% increased damage for 7 seconds (DMx2). Scoring another Grenade or Melee Kill with DMx2 active increases this to 30% (DMx3).
Can be activated while stowed. Weapon, Grenade, and Melee Kills refresh the buff duration.

entries.name: Xenophage Catalyst
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Rampage. Maximum of 3 Stacks. Stacks expire one at a time every 🡅4.5 seconds.
Grants a 10%|21%|33.1% damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks.
Weapon Kills trigger a solar elemental explosion, dealing up to 109 [72.8] damage in a 3 meter radius.

entries.name: Full Auto Trigger System
entries.text:
Weapon fires Full Auto. (Identical to the setting)
Decreases Firing Delay by 10% on Shotguns.

entries.name: Vanishing Shadow
entries.text:
Void Invisibility lasts 2 seconds longer.
Entering Void Invisibility grants one stack of “Vanishing Shadow” for 7 seconds. Vanishing Shadow's timer does not decrease while Invisibile. Vanishing Shadow stacks up to 3 times. Additional stacks can only be gained after exiting Invisibility.
Each stack of Vanishing Shadow grants improved base ability regeneration rate at 1|2|3 stacks.
• Class Ability: 67%|133%|200%
• Grenade: 166%|333%|500%
• Melee: 166%|333%|500%
Reaching Vanishing Shadow x3 or gaining Void Invisibility while at Vanishing Shadow x3 grants you a 15HP Void Overshield for 7 seconds (10 seconds with Echo of Persistence).

entries.name: Field-Tested
entries.text:
Hits and Kills with your Weapon grant you 'Points'. Hitting Point thresholds grants Stacks of Field Test.
Maximum of 5 Stacks. Buff is only removed on death.
Stat Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 3 | 6 | 9 | 12 | 20 Range
• 5 | 10 | 20 | 35 | 50 Reload Speed
• ? | ? | ? | ? | 30? Stability
• ? | ? | ? | ? | ? Handling
• 5 | 10 | 20 | 35 | 55 Charge Rate (Swords)
• 5 | 10 | 20 | 30 | 40 Guard Resistance (Swords)
Points required for 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• Primary Weapons: 51|151|351|651|1001
• Special Weapons: 26|76|176|326|501
• Power Weapons: 11|31|71|131|201
Each Hit grants 1 Point regardless of Weapon Archetype and Enemy Rank. Does not require Direct Hits.
Points granted by Kills are based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1-2 Minors: 1 Point
• Tier 3-4 Minors, Tier 2+ Elites, and higher: 4 Points
• Tier 1 Elites: 5 Points
• Enemy Players: 10 Points
Kill Point Multipliers by Weapon Archetype:
• Primary Weapons and Shotguns: 5x
• Sniper Rifles: 2.5x
• Breech-Loaded Grenade Launchers: 2x

entries.name: Rat Pack
entries.text:
Gain 1 stack of 'Rat Pack' for each ally within 20 meters that is currently holding Rat King. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Rat Pack benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 0|13%|20%|30%|40% increased Rate of Fire
• 0|2|4|6|9 increased Magazine Size

entries.name: Taken Predator
entries.text: Deals 25% increased damage against Taken combatants, Invaders in Gambit, and targets blighted by Witherhoard.

entries.name: Light Touch
entries.text:
While Amplified, Radiant, or Devour is active:
• ? Handling
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration
🡅 Stat Benefits are increased.

entries.name: Eyes Up, Guardian
entries.text:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 7 stacks of 'Eyes Up, Guardian'.
Firing a ricochet round consumes one stack, increasing the number of richochets to 7 and the seeking radius to a 12 meters. Enemies can only be damaged by the same ricochet twice.

entries.name: Ashes to Assets
entries.text:
Increases Super Energy Gains from Grenade Kills based on Enemy Rank with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1%|?|?
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: ?|?|?
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?|?|?
• T4 Minors, T3-T4 Elites, and higher: 5%|?|?
• Players: ?|?|?
Bonus Super Energy gains from Grapple Melee Kills are reduced by 50%. Kill can only trigger either Ashes to Assets or Hands On but not both.

entries.name: Ancillary Ordinance
entries.text:
Killing Elemental-Debuffed targets or scoring 3 Elemental Kills within 4 seconds of each grants this weapon one stack of Ancillary Ordinance. Maximum of 🡅5 stacks.
Stacks can be earned while stowed.
Kills consume a stack of Ancillary Ordinance to release a seeking Micro-Missile from the enemy's point of death, traveling up to 30 meters before dealing 330 [100] damage in a small radius.
Killing Elemental-Debuffed Targets with this weapon instantly spawns a missile.
🡅 Increases maximum number of stacks.

entries.name: Well-Rounded
entries.text:
Grenade Ability usage and Elemental Melee hits grant 1 Stack of Well-Rounded for 15 seconds. Super Ability usage grants 2 Stacks. Maximum of 2 Stacks.
Each Stack grants 🡅12 Range, 🡅12 Stability, and 🡅12 Handling.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.
🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 2?.

entries.name: High Ground
entries.text:
Scoring a Kill grants 1 [2] Stacks of 'High Ground' for 7 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Weapon damage increases at 1|2|3 Stacks:
10% [5%] | 17.5% [10%] | 25% [15%]
While you are not airborne:
Damaging targets that are 2 meters [5 for Primary weapons] lower in elevation than the ground you stand on immediately grants all 3 Stacks [Primary weapons only grant 1 Stack] of the buff. The damage increase is applied to the shot triggering the perk as well.
The reference point of enemies' elevation is generally their lowest point.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Noble Rounds
entries.text:
Kills create a Remnant which tracks towards you when within a 15 meter radius. Remnants last for 8 seconds in the world before despawning.
Remnants refill 4 rounds into the magazine and grant one stack of 'Noble Rounds'. Maximum of 6 stacks.
Receiving a 'Noble Seeker' from a rift empowered by Boots Of The Assembler also grants one Noble Round.

entries.name: Tri-Planar Mass Driver
entries.text:
Fires a spread of four Void projectiles per shot.
Aiming Down Sights tightens the spread into a compressed high-damage shot.

entries.name: No Time to Explain Catalyst
entries.text: Delay between Time-Slip Portal bursts is 47% shorter (1.25/s🠚0.85/s).

entries.name: Reverberation
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 100 Blast Radius for 🡅6 seconds.
Blast Radius does not affect the lingering pools created by Area Denial Frame Grenade Launchers.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Aggressive Burst
entries.text: Hard-hitting two-burst fire.

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: Perpetual Loophole
entries.text:
While Void Overshield is active, Glaive Melee attacks deal 20% increased damage.
Glaive Melee kills grant 100% Glaive Energy, fully refill Void Overshield Health, and extend Overshield duration to 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistance).

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries.text:
Scoring any Kill while the weapon is stowed grants a "trigger stack". Maximum of 3 stacks.
Readying the weapon with active "trigger stacks" converts them to Stacks of 'Sleight of Hand' with a 7.5 second duration.
Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of 'Sleight of Hand':
10|20|30 Handling, Reload Speed, and Stability
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.name: Voltshot
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 5.3 seconds of a Weapon Kill grants Voltshot for 7 seconds.
While Voltshot is active, your next Weapon Hit consumes the buff and applies Jolt to the target.
Applied Jolt's damage (generally) does not count as Weapon Damage.

entries.name: Arc Alignment
entries.text:
Dealing Arc Damage charges 'Arc Alignment'.
Energy is granted by the following on a per-hit basis:
• Pulse Rifle Mode: 3%
• Trace Rifle Mode: 1%
• All other Arc-damage sources: 1%
At full energy, hold [Reload] to enter Arc Alignment. Doing so instantly refills the magazine and grants 75% reduced recoil.
Arc Alignment energy drains at a rate of 14% per second, and causes hip-fired shots to apply Jolt. Aiming Down Sights reduces energy drain by 67%, down to 4.62% per second.

entries.name: Powerful Friends
entries.text: Allies within 18 meters receive 1 Armor Charge on Orb of Power Pickup.

entries.name: Roast 'Em
entries.text:
Grants 625% Additional Base Melee Recharge Rate while Proximity Knife remains unexploded.
Proximity Explosive Knife applies 60 Scorch on detonation. (Unaffected by Ember of Ashes). Proximity Explosive Knife kills trigger an Ignition.
Ignition kills (on any subclass) grant a full Melee Ability Charge. This can overflow into one additional Solar Knife charge (any knife) or one additional Withering Blade charge beyond capacity.
On Prismatic, this can overflow into two additional Knife Tricks or Withering Blades beyond capacity.
Scorch grants 7% Melee Ability Energy per tick. (Due to chunk ability scaling, this grants ~5% energy to Proximity Knife).

entries.name: Banshee's Wail
entries.text:
Holding [Block] grants one stack of 'Banshee's Wail' and charges the blade. Maximum of 9 stacks. Depleting your Sword Energy or ending your combo removes all stacks.
'Charged' Light Attacks consume 20% Sword Energy, dealing 539 [389] damage followed by two hits of 135 [95] damage. Continued attacks increase the damage of the main hit by 33% and grant one stack of 'Banshee's Wail' per damage instance (3 stacks per landed swing).
Performing a Heavy Attack while Banshee's Wail is active consumes all stacks and performs an overhead strike, dealing 1054 [811] damage followed by two hits of 198 [152].
Heavy Attack Damage is increased based off the number of Banshee's Wail stacks:
• 1-3 Stacks: 0% increased damage
• 4-6 Stacks: 54% increased damage
• 7-9 Stacks: 109% increased damage

entries.name: Poison Arrows
entries.text:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
Only the Poision Burst is intrinsically Anti-Overload. Regular arrows do not stun Champions.
Arrows released within the Perfect Draw window apply poison on hit. Poison deals 70 [2.5] damage every 0.25 seconds for 1.35 seconds, totalling 420 [15] damage.
Precision Hits within the Perfect Draw window trigger a burst of poison in a 5 meter radius around the target.

entries.name: Roving Assassin
entries.text:
Leaving Void Invisibility while within 15 meters of an enemy releases a cloud of smoke that lasts 7 seconds and Weakens enemies. 5 second cooldown between uses.
While in Spectral Blades:
Refunds Super Energy on Heavy Attack based on the number of Spectral Blade Hits and Kills scored before doing so.

entries.name: Double Dodge
entries.text:
Grants an extra Class Ability Charge.
Acts as a copy of the Reaper armor mod.

entries.name: Better Already
entries.text:
Orb of Power Pickups immediately start Health Regeneration.
Equipping multiple copies provides no benefit.

entries.name: Radiant Light
entries.text:
Grants 1 Armor Charges to Allies within 21 meters on Super Cast. Allies on a different Subclass Element are granted 2 Charges.
Caster receives 1 Armor Charge if already charged.

entries.name: Buried Bloodline Catalyst
entries.text:
While Devour is active, grants the following benefits:
• Hits apply Weaken for 6 seconds
• ? Reload Speed
• ? Decreased Reload Animation Duration
