entries.name: Eyes on All
entries.text:
Tracks up to six targets, releasing a volley of rockets divided among the tracked targets.
Each rocket deals damage in a 9 meter radius.

entries.name: Crystalline Transistor
entries.text:
Kinetic Weapon Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 252 [100] elemental damage matching your equipped Super in a 4 meter radius. Precision Kills increase the radius to 8 meters.
Elemental Kills grant one stack of 'Crystalline Transitor' for 11 seconds. Maximum of 2 stacks. Stacks expire one at a time.
Crystalline Transitor increases the radius of the explosion to 6|8 Meters, at 1|2 stacks.
Enemies hit by the explosion receive an elemental debuff corresponding to your equipped Super:
• Arc: Blinds for ? [1] seconds
• Solar: Applies 15 Scorch (20 with Ember of Ashes)
• Stasis: Applies 30 Slow Stacks for 7 seconds (8 with Whisper of Durance)
• Strand: Severs for 6 seconds (8 with Thread of Continuity)
• Void: Weakens for 4 seconds

entries.name: Battle-Hearth
entries.text:
Grants additional Super Energy on Kills (by either you or allies) while inside your Well of Radiance and below 50% Super Energy.
Amount of Super Energy gained is decreased by 1.5% for each successive Kill, down to a minimum of 4% Super Energy per Kill:
10% 🠚 8.5% 🠚 7% 🠚 5.5% 🠚 4% 🠚 4% ...

entries.name: Häkke Heavy Burst Fire
entries.text: Becomes a Heavy-Burst Frame Pulse Rifle.

entries.name: Empowering Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

entries.name: Healing Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.

entries.name: Turnabout
entries.text:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 10 seconds.

entries.name: High-Impact Reserves
entries.text:
Increases damage by 12.1% [3%] to 25.6% [6%] as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty.
The buff in PVE ranges between 10.3% and 22.9% instead on Fusion Rifles and Aggressive Frame Linear Fusion Rifles.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.name: MIDA Synergy
entries.text: Superb handling. Move faster with this lightweight weapon equipped. This weapon grants additional speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.

entries.name: Kinetic Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Kinetic Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Disruption Break
entries.text:
On Elemental, Barrier or Guardian Shield Break:
Applies Kinetic Damage Vulnerability to the enemy, increasing Kinetic damage taken by 50% for 5.5 [5] seconds.
Stacks with all other Buffs and Debuffs (including itself).
🡅 Debuff duration is increased in PVE.

entries.name: Butterfly
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights for 🡅1.4 seconds without firing causes your next kill to trigger an explosion matching the weapon's element within an 8 meter radius, experiencing a maximum of 30% damage falloff.
Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.
🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.

entries.name: Shot Swap
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 2 Stacks of Shot Swap. Maximum of 6 Stacks.
Grants 100? Ready/Stow Handling and 🡅35% decreased Ready/Stow Animation duration while you have active stacks.
Stowing the weapon consumes 1 stack.
🡅 Stronger effect.

entries.name: Ruinscribe's Beacon
entries.text:
While a turret is deployed, Ruinscribe Turret Mode is replaced with a laser designator that marks enemies for 30 seconds.
Firing at a target marks them; firing at a surface marks all enemies within a 6 meter radius. Turret prioritizes marked targets, firing three 274 [?] damage missiles every 1.65 seconds.

entries.name: Thunderer
entries.text:
Fires at 300 RPM.
Kills refill the magazine based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 1 ammo
• Elites: 0 ammo (???)
• Minibosses and Bosses: Full Magazine

entries.name: Unstoppable Force
entries.text:
Blocking damage with the Glaive Shield grants 20% increased projectile damage for 4 seconds.
Buff is removed if you stop blocking.

entries.name: Guidance Ring
entries.text:
Direct Hits grant one Stack of 'Guidance Ring'. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Guidance Ring Seeker Hits do not grant Stacks.

entries.name: Kinetic Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Kinetic Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Storm and Stress
entries.text:
Kills with Sturm overfill the magazine of Together Forever weapons by 1 round. Maximum of 100% increased Magazine Size.
Kills with Together Forever weapons progressively grant Overcharge Rounds. Maximum of 25 rounds.
Chaining together Forever Weapon kills within 3 seconds of each grants additional stacks per kill. The second kill grants 2 rounds, and further kills in the chain grant 3 rounds.
Sturm's Overcharge Rounds deal increased damage based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors and Elites: 300%
• Minibosses and Champions: 280%
• Bosses: 260%
• Players: 75%

entries.name: Close to Melee
entries.text:
Glaive Projectile Kills grant 60% [30%] increased Glaive Melee damage for 🡅11 seconds.
Dealing Projectile or Melee damage extends the buff duration by 5 seconds, up to 🡅11 seconds.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Flash Counter
entries.text:
Taking damage while Guarding emits a blast in a wide, 8? meter long wide cone in front of you.
The blast disorients enemies hit by it for 5 seconds and deals weapon-matching elemental damage.
The damage scales up from 75 [14] damage at point-blank range to the maximum of 110 [45] damage after ? meters.
The strength of the disorientation against Players similarly also scales up with distance.
2.5 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Proximity Ward
entries.text: Grants a 200 HP Overshield for the duration of your Finisher Animation.

entries.name: Arc Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Arc Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Search Party
entries.text:
Grants the following if no allies are within 15 meters:
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
• 15% decreased ADS Animation Duration

entries.name: Aerodynamics
entries.text: Passively grants 6 Blast Radius and Velocity.

entries.name: Strand Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Strand Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Mega Kill Clip
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill grants 40% increased damage for a duration based on the number of kills achieved before reloading. Maximum of 20 seconds.
Base duration is 3 + 2 additional seconds for each kill scored before reloading (One kill is 5 seconds, two kills is 7 seconds...)
Additional kill-reloads will additively stack on top of the currently active timer, extending its duration up to the maximum.
🡅 Buff duration is increased.

entries.name: Pyrotoxin Rounds
entries.text:
Fires high-caliber explosive rounds with a splash radius of 3 meters. Damage is split into two portions (18% Impact and 82% Explosive), with the explosion damage having no falloff.
Super Good Advice: Tap-Firing reduces Xenophage's Rate of Fire. Holding down the trigger is recommended.

entries.name: Stasis Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Lumina Catalyst
entries.text: Kills create an additional Remnant (1🠚2).

entries.name: Perfect Float
entries.text:
After being in Combat for 6 seconds:
Grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness and 35% Flinch Resistance for 10 seconds.
Can activate while stowed. Dealing and receiving damage refreshes the buff duration.
For Pefect Float, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 3 seconds.

entries.name: Echo of Dilation
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits while Crouching:
• Doubles Radar Resolution (6🠚12 Sectors)
• Prevents Crouch Speed from being decreased below 4 meters per second

entries.name: Echo of Domineering
entries.text:
Upon Suppressing an enemy:
• Refills readied weapon from reserves
• Grants 30 Weapons stat for 10 seconds
• Increases Forward Movement Speed by 4% for 10s
10 second cooldown between activations.
Killing Suppressed enemies spawns a Void Breach.

entries.name: Echo of Provision
entries.text:
Grenade Ability Damage grants Melee Energy once per Damage Instance.
'Damage Over Time' grenades only provide Melee Energy once per damage tick regardless of the number of enemies damaged. Other grenades only grant Melee Energy once per submunition.
Melee Energy granted per Damage Instance:
• 3%: Void Spike, Void Wall, Scatter Grenade, and Vortex Grenade
• 8%: Axion Bolt, Suppressor Grenade, and Magnetic Grenade (including when used with the Chaos Accelerant aspect)
Does not work with Unbreakable.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Echo of Expulsion
entries.text: Void Ability Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 160 [130] damage in a 7 meter radius.

entries.name: Echo of Remnants
entries.text:
Improves lingering Void Grenade Abilities:
• Axion Bolt: tracks enemies for ?% longer
• Void Spike: lasts 40% longer and starts dealing damage 0.1 seconds earlier
• Void Wall: lasts 60% longer
• Vortex Grenade: lasts 25% longer (55% longer when overcharged by Chaos Accelerant) and starts dealing damage 0.13 seconds earlier

entries.name: Echo of Exchange
entries.text:
Melee Kills grant Grenade Energy based on the Enemy Rank of the killed target:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 7.5%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 11%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, and Players: 16.25%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Echo of Undermining
entries.text: Void Grenades apply Weaken on hit for 6 [2.5] seconds.

entries.name: Echo of Reprisal
entries.text:
Kills grant an additional Super Energy while surrounded by at least 3 enemies within 8 meters.
Gain 0.3%|0.65%|1%|1.6%|2.3% additional Super Energy per kill when surrounded by 3|4|5|6|7+ enemies.
1 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Echo of Leeching
entries.text: Melee Kills start Health Regeneration for you and allies within ? meters.

entries.name: Echo of Persistence
entries.text:
Void Buffs applied to you last longer.
Devour and Void Overshield: 50% increased duration
Invisibility: 40% increased duration
Specific increases from Echo of Persistence for Void Buff sources can be found in their descriptions.

entries.name: Explosive Light
entries.text:
Orb of Power pickups (even while the weapon is stowed) grant 1 Stack of Explosive Light. Maximum of 🡅7 Stacks.
Firing the weapon comsumes 1 Stack per Shot, granting increased damage and 100 Blast Radius.
Grenade Launchers: 60% increased Explosive damage.
Rocket Launchers: 25% increased Impact and Explosive damage. (Does not affect Wolfpack Rounds)
🡅 Maximum number of Stacks is increased by 1.

entries.name: Bipod
entries.text:
Increases Magazine Capacity by 1 and Total Reserve Size by 5. Decreases Firing Delay by 25%.
Decreases Blast Radius by 🡅25, Reload Speed by 🡅15, and damage by 25% (also applies to Wolfpack Rounds and Cluster Bombs).
🡅 Stat penalties are reduced by 5.

entries.name: Solar Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Solar Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Clown Cartridge
entries.text:
Reloading randomly overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% to 50% of the base Magazine Capacity (rounded up).
Works out to a 30% overfill on average.

entries.name: Broadhead
entries.text:
This arrow deals 3 instances of damage.
The arrow itself deals 276 [129] damage, which is further increased by dealing Precision Damage. Broadhead deals two [one] addition hits, each dealing 444 [28.75] damage, and is unaffected by Precision Damage.
A single arrow can deal up to 1164 [159] damage.

entries.name: Bewildering Burst
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a kill grants 'Bewildering Burst' for 6 seconds.
While Bewildering Burst is active, your next Direct Hit spawns a Kinetic explosive above the target that detonates after a 0.85 second delay. The detonation deals 10 [4] damage and Disorients enemies within a 10 meter radius for 3.5 [1] seconds.

entries.name: Microcosm Catalyst
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant an additional 1% Super Energy.
Grants the following benefits against low (under 30%) Health targets. Ignores Shield HP:
• Increased Stagger Force
• 7% to 15% increased damage, scaling with remaining Health
• ? Increased Target Acquisition

entries.name: Circle of Life
entries.text: Triggering 'Support Frame Boost' by healing allies with the weapon grants 25% [12.5%] increased damage for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Adept Projectile Speed
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Velocity.

entries.name: Strand Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Strand Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).
Currently bugged and does not work with Swords.

entries.name: Mega Kill Clip
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill grants 40% increased damage for a duration based on the number of kills achieved before reloading. Maximum of 20 seconds.
Base duration is 3 + 2 additional seconds for each kill scored before reloading (One kill is 5 seconds, two kills is 7 seconds...)
Additional kill-reloads will additively stack on top of the currently active timer, extending its duration up to the maximum.

entries.name: Kinetic Reserves
entries.text: Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Kinetic Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Supercharged Battery
entries.text:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 'Supercharged Battery' for 10 seconds and refills the magazine. Additional orbs grant 10 seconds each, extending the duration up to 20 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.
Supercharged Battery sets the power level to High for the duration of the buff, and dealing sustained damage for 2 seconds applies Suppression for 7 seconds.

entries.name: Harsh Truths
entries.text:
5-Round Burst Pulse Rifle.
This weapon has deterministic recoil.
If an ally dies within a 24 meter radius of you, your Health Regeneration is triggered and you gain the following benefits for 6 seconds:
• 20 Mobility
• 33% increased Slide Distance
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed

entries.name: Field Prep
entries.text:
Grants the following while Crouched:
• 🡅55 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier
Passively grants 🡅30 Ammo Generation stat. (Equivalent of 2 Ammo Generation armor mods)
🡅 Grants 5 more Reload Speed and 10 more Ammo Generation stat.

entries.name: High Priority
entries.text:
Refills 4% of the magazine of Trace Rifles (rounded up) from reserves every 0.7 seconds. Works even while stowed.
Rapidly scoring 5 Trace Rifle hits on a Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Vehicle marks them for you and allies for 10 seconds.
Additional hits refresh the mark duration. Does not require Direct Hits. Multiple people cannot mark the same enemy.
Only one target can be marked at a time and the mark cannot be transferred to a different target before the duration runs out or the enemy is defeated.
Ally kills on Marked Enemies spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick for allies and a Special Ammo Brick for you.
Spawned Ammo Bricks grant 10.33% of your total reserves (rounded up).

entries.name: Kinetic Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Kinetic Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: High Ground
entries.text:
Scoring a Kill grants 1 [2] Stacks of 'High Ground' for 7 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Weapon damage increases at 1|2|3 Stacks:
10% [5%] | 17.5% [10%] | 25% [15%]
While you are not airborne:
Damaging targets that are 2 meters [5 for Primary weapons] lower in elevation than the ground you stand on immediately grants all 3 Stacks [Primary weapons only grant 1 Stack] of the buff. The damage increase is applied to the shot triggering the perk as well.
The reference point of enemies' elevation is generally their lowest point.

entries.name: Solar Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Solar Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Feed the Void
entries.text:
Ability kills grant Devour for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence). (Prismatic Only: Kills with Shatter, Volatile Explosions, and Tangles also grant Devour).
Your Devour is enhanced, granting twice as much HP (70HP🠚140 HP) and Grenade Ability Energy.
Kills while Devour is active add 5 seconds to the timer (8 with Echo of Persistence).
Enhanced Devour Grenade Energy granted is based on Combatant Tier:
• Tier 1: 15%
• Tier 2: 23.2%
• Tier 3: 27.5%
• Tier 4 or Players: 40%

entries.name: Chaos Accelerant
entries.text:
Grants an additional Grenade Charge.
Holding [Grenade] charges your grenade ability over the span of ? seconds and enhances it once thrown.
Enhanced Behaviors:
• Axion Bolt gains 2 additional seekers, travels ?% further, deals 25% increased damage, and retriggers again 1 second after landing
• Scatter Grenade gains 4 additional submunitions, aggressively seeks targets within 5 meters, and deals 25% increased damage against Combatants
• Vortex Grenade gains 70% increased radius, 7.5% increased duration, pulls targets in and begins its damage 0.2 seconds sooner, and continously retriggers its pull every ? seconds
• Magnetic, Spike, Suppressor, and Voidwall Grenade become a 'Handheld Supernova' and release a short-range blast of 9 high damage projectiles. Projectiles travel up to 12.5 meters away and apply Volatile on hit. Passively grants 15% increased Grenade Regeneration Speed

entries.name: Soul Siphon
entries.text:
Dealing damage with Pocket Singularity grants 'Soul Siphon Ready' for 20 seconds, replacing your melee ability with Soul Siphon.
[Melee Input] while Soul Siphon is readied to tether up to four enemies within 20 meters in front of you, granting 15 HP of Void Overshield for 15 seconds (23 seconds with Echo of Persistence) per tick of damage.
Soul Siphon deals 8 ticks of increasingly higher melee damage over 3.2 seconds and restores ?% Class Ability energy per tick.
At the end of the drain, Soul Siphon triggers a final burst of damage that staggers any surviving combatants.

entries.name: Child of the Old Gods
entries.text:
Casting your Rift grants a 'Void Soul' for 25 seconds.
Weapon Hits send the Void Soul towards the target's location, projecting a 10 meter radius Weakening field upon arrival that lasts for 9.25 seconds. Void Soul continously deals damage and applies Weaken every 0.7 seconds. The  Weaken lasts for 4 [2.5] seconds after its last application. For the first 4 [?] seconds of being tethered, targets are Suppressed as well.
If you have Healing Rift equipped, the Void Soul grants 4% Grenade and Melee Energy every other tick. If you have Empowering Rift equipped, the Void Soul grants 25 HP every other tick.
Defeating targets within Void Soul's radius grant Class Ability Energy based on Combatant Tier:
• Tier 1: 10%
• Tier 2: 15%
• Tier 3: 20%
• Tier 4 or 5: 50%
• Players: 33.3%
Void Soul counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.

entries.name: Unflinching Kinetic Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Kinetic Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Forge's Kin
entries.text:
Kills with Black Armory Weapons, or readying a Black Armory weapon within 7 seconds of any weapon kill, grants 'Forge's Kin'. Maximum of 3 stacks. Timer begins upon readying the weapon and cannot be refreshed.
Equipping and performing the above conditions with additional Black Armory weapons increases the potency and duration of the buff.
Forge's Kin provides the following benefits with 1|2|3 Black Armory Weapons equipped:
• 5|7|9 Second Buff Duration
• 15|?|? Reload Speed
• ?|?|? Ammo Generation
• 0%|5% (🡅 7%)|10% (🡅 13%) Increased Damage Against Combatants
The exotic weapons Izanagi's Burden, Jötunn, and Le Monarque count as Black Armory weapons for the purposes of the origin trait, but do not recieve its benefits.

entries.name: Impetus
entries.text:
Finishing a reload 6 seconds after a kill grants 50% increased damage for 4.5 seconds.
Buff can be refreshed.

entries.name: Kismet
entries.text:
While at Full HP, scoring a Weapon Kill or not taking damage for 4.5 [15] seconds continuously generates 6.6 [1.1] Void Overshield HP per second until you take damage again.
Grants the following while any Overshield is active:
• 15% increased weapon damage against Combatants (20% for Heat-Based weapons)
• 25 Stability
• 25 Handling
• 5% Decreased Accuracy Cone Size
Damage bonus stacks with other Empowering weapon buffs.
While any Overshield is active, scoring a kill enables 'Hasty Escape'. Hasty Escape activates upon the depletion of your Overshield, granting 30 Mobility for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Solar Rampart
entries.text:
Solar Kills grant 15% Class Ability Energy. 1? second cooldown between activations.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
Upon casting a Barricade Class Ability with a Solar Super equipped:
Unleashes 3 Solar Waves from the front of the barricade that travel 18.5 meters and have tracking capabilities.
The Waves deal 480 [100] damage and apply 60 [30] Scorch Stacks (90 [45] with Ember of Ashes).
Enemies Hit [Killed] by the Waves leave behind a Sunspot at their location.
Solar Wave does not trigger nor is affected by Roaring Flames.

entries.name: Salvation's Grip Catalyst
entries.text: Killing Frozen Enemies or Shattering a Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants a Stack of Frost Armor.

entries.name: Impromptu Ammunition
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 15% improved Special ammo generation and 10% improved Heavy ammo generation from all sources for 5 seconds. Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration up to 7 seconds.
Buff is additive to Ammo Finder Helmet mods.

entries.name: Trench Barrel
entries.text:
Dealing Melee Damage grants the following for the next 3 shots within 5 seconds:
• 30 Reload Speed and 30 Handling
• 50% increased damage
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.name: Leviathan's Breath Catalyst
entries.text:
Increases Reserves by 5 (9🠚14) and Ammo Generation by 80.
Precision Hits grant 43.7% decreased Draw Animation Speed for 3 seconds.

entries.name: Whisper of Reversal
entries.text:
Dealing or receiving Physical (non-projectile) Melee Damage while you have Frost Armor active applies 10? Slow Stacks to your enemy for ? seconds.
Glaive Melees also benefit from this.

entries.name: Whisper of Chill
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Stasis Weapon Kills spawns a Small Stasis Shard.
Activation progress on Kills by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 34?%
• Elites and Enemy Players: 67%
• Minibosses and higher: 100%
Further Kills do not provide activation progress for 5? seconds after activation.

entries.name: Remote Shield
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a small Void Dome.
Void Dome Properties:
• Lasts 20 seconds with 2400 HP
• 15% added Damage Resistance against Bosses and 85% Damage Resistance against all other Combatants
• Grants a 45 HP Void Overshield for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence) upon entry, with a 1 second cooldown before it can be granted again.
• Grants 'Stat Boost' for 10 seconds, granting ? Reload Speed, ? Handling, and 5% Increased Weapon Damage (which stacks with all other Empowering Sources)
• Benefits from Helm of Saint-14's defensive buffs.

entries.name: Cruel Remedy
entries.text:
Kills restore 32 HP and triggers Health Regeneration.
Precision Kills instantly refill the magazine.

entries.name: Zen Moment
entries.text:
Weapon Hits grant 1 Stack of the perk for 1 second up to the maximum of 5? Stacks.
Benefits granted per Stack:
• Grants ?% Flinch Resistance
• Reduces Visual Weapon Shake by 15%
• Reduces Reticle Bounce by 15%
Stacks gained per Weapon Hit by weapon type:
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 2?
• Pulse Rifles, Sidearms: 1.5
• Other Weapons: 1

entries.name: Umbral Sustenance
entries.text: Receiving or refreshing any Void Buff (Devour, Overshield, Invisibility) instantly refills the magazine.

entries.name: Slideways
entries.text:
Sliding refills 15% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves and grants 🡅17? Stability and 🡅33 Handling for 3 seconds.
0.5 second cooldown between activations. Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 10?%.

entries.name: Chain Reaction
entries.text:
Weapon Kills trigger an elemental explosion matching the weapon's element.
Damage and radius of the explosions varies based on the weapon's ammo type:
• Special Weapons: Up to 67.2 [44.8] damage in a 2.4 meter radius
• Power Weapons: Up to 109.2 [72.8] damage in a 3 meter radius

entries.name: Leviathan's Sigh
entries.text: Fully drawn shots apply Volatile to the target and knock back enemies in a ? meter radius from the point of impact.

entries.name: Tactical
entries.text: Passively grants 6 Handling and 6 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Focused Fury
entries.text:
Scoring 35% of the Base Magazine Capacity as Precision Hits grants 25% increased damage for 🡅12 seconds.
Stowing or Reloading the weapon resets the Precision Hit counter. The buff remains active while stowed.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Vestigial Alchemy
entries.text:
Vestiges collected by Harvester Spikes charge up 'Vestigial Alchemy'.
After collecting 7 Vestiges (50% charge):
Enables a Hold [Reload] interaction that makes your next shot fired spawn a Special Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies, granting 10% of your Total Special Ammo Reserves
After collecting 17 Vestiges (100% charge):
Allows you to cycle Hold [Reload] a second time, making your next shot fired spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies on impact, granting 10% of your Total Heavy Ammo Reserves
Creating ammo bricks consumes the energy it cost to reach that level on the meter. Ammo-Spawning spikes cannot impale targets.

entries.name: Kinetic Reserves
entries.text: Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Kinetic Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Wardcliff Coil Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants some tracking to the rockets I guess?
(Good luck on figuring that one out!)

entries.name: Void Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Void Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: Dynamo
entries.text:
Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Super Ability Energy.
Super Energy Gains with 1|2+ Mods:
2.5% [1.25%] | 4% [2.4%]
Energy Multipliers based on Class:
Hunters: 1x | Titans: 1.2x | Warlocks: 2x

entries.name: Offhand Strike
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant the following benefits to hip-firing for 7 seconds:
• 30 Stability
• 45% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• ~3° larger Precision Aim Angle
• 95%? decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 95%? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Special Ammo Finder Enhancement
entries.text: Weapon Kills provide 10% more activation progress to Special Ammo Finder mods.

entries.name: Adrenaline Junkie
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Adrenaline Junkie for 🡅5 seconds. Grenade Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly even if the weapon is stowed.
Adrenaline Junkie benefits:
• 20 Handling
• 6.7%|13.3%|20%|26.6%|33.3% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Permeability
entries.text:
Class Ability usage refills ?% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your Super Ability until stowed.
Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.
Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on Primary, 15% on Special).

entries.name: Arc Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Arc Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Tex Balanced Stock
entries.text:
Scoring 4 Hip-Fire Hits within 4? seconds of each grants the following benefits for 4 seconds:
• 20 Range, Handling, and Reload Speed
• 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 1.5° larger Precision Aim Cone
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Scoring additional Hip-Fire Hits refreshes the buff duration.

entries.name: Composite Propellant
entries.text:
Rockets embed into targets, spewing three Napalm Pools every 0.75 seconds until detonation. Napalm Pools rapidly apply 40 Scorch (60 with Ember of Ashes) every ? seconds for 5 seconds.
Gain one stack of 'Composite Propellant' every 6 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Firing this weapon triggers a 3 second cooldown on passive stack generation.
Composite Propellant benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 1.5|2.25|3|3.75|4.5 second delay before detonation
• 3|6|9|12|15 released incendiary pools
• 0%|7%|14%|21%|29% increased detonation damage
At 5 stacks of Composite Propellant, rockets leave a trail of Napalm behind them, applying 50 Scorch (70 with Ember of Ashes) every ? seconds for 2 seconds.

entries.name: Barri-nade
entries.text:
Passively grants 45% faster Base Class Ability Regeneration (does not function with Thruster).
Replaces Grenade Ability with Barri-Nade on Class Ability usage. Barri-Nade is lost if Class Ability fully recharges.
Barri-Nade spawns your selected Barricade type on the impact location and inherits the benefits of Aspects such as Bastion and Drengr's Lash. Non-barricade class abilities default to Towering Barricade and match its cooldown.
Enemies within 5? meters of the Barri-Nade's impact location are disoriented. Spawned Barricade deals no Contact damage within 2 seconds of its creation.
Collecting three Orbs of Power grants 'Enhanced Barri-Nade', causing the next Barri-Nade to spawn three Barricades in a circular formation on impact.
Aspect effects of barricades stack outside of the Storm's Keep's Bolt Charge generation.
Barri-Nade has no collision with enemies.

entries.name: Heavy Handed
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Elemental Melee Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)
10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: Killing Wind
entries.text:
On Weapon Kill, for 5 seconds:
• 50 Mobility
• 40 Handling and 20 Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
Additional Kills extend the duration by 5 seconds, up to 8 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Fragile Focus
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Range but deactivates if you drop to 0 Shield HP (Critical Health).
Buff reactivates 1 second after your Shields HP fully regenerates.

entries.name: Amalgamation Rounds
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights charges an 'Amalgamation Round' over the course of 1 second. When charged, fire an extremely dense shot that deals 290% [18%] increased damage and marks the target for all allies for 5 seconds.
This gun deals 95% [6.7%] increased Spread Shot damage and 30% [6.7%] increased Amalgamation Round damage to marked targets
Defeating a marked target with this gun or scoring a precision kill with an Amalgamation Round grants Void Invisibility for 7 seconds (10.5 with Echo of Persistence) and Truesight for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Void Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Void Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Multikill Clip
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of scoring 1|2|3 Weapon Kills within 3.5 seconds of each grants 17%|33%|50% increased damage for 5 seconds.
Buff is overwritten every time it is triggered and is removed on stow.

entries.name: Light Touch
entries.text:
While Amplified, Radiant, or Devour is active:
• ? Handling
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration

entries.name: Trench Barrel
entries.text:
Dealing Melee Damage grants the following for the next 3 shots within 5 seconds:
• 🡅35 Reload Speed and 🡅35 Handling
• 50% increased damage
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 5?.

entries.name: Kinetic Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Kinetic Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: MIDA Synergy
entries.text: Superb handling. Move faster with this lightweight weapon equipped. This weapon grants additional speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.

entries.name: Glacial Fortification
entries.text:
While a Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Class Abilities are replaced by a Stasis Crystal formation.
When used with Rally or Towering Barricade:
• Spawns a Stasis Crystal Wall made of a Small Crystal in the middle and 2 Medium Crystals on either side of it
• Grants Rally Barricade benefits to players standing behind the middle Crystal for 14 seconds, even if destroyed.
• Overrides Class Ability cooldown with Towering Barricade's
When used with Thruster:
• Spawns 2 Medium Crystals diagonally forward to either side of you

entries.name: Mad Scientist
entries.text:
Deals 80% decreased damage to Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.
Shoots a wildly imprecise volley of 8 rockets.
Every 2 rockets fired grant x1 Bolt Charge to you and nearby allies within a ? meter radius.

entries.name: Threat Remover
entries.text:
Hitting a target with 🡅10 of the 12 Pellets in the spread grants ? Stability, ? Handling, and 60 Reload Speed for 7 seconds.
🡅 Requires hitting with 1? fewer Pellet to activate.

entries.name: Harmonic Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Weapons matching your Super Element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Longest Winter
entries.text:
At 100% Beam Energy, hits spawn an Ionic Trace.
2 second cooldown between spawns.

entries.name: Whisper of Rending
entries.text:
Primary Ammo Weapons deal 100% Increased Damage against Stasis Crystals and 50% Increased Damage against Frozen Enemies.
Also applies to Fighting Lion, Revision Zero, Vex Mythoclast, and their alternate fire modes.
Frozen enemies normally receive 5% [50%] decreased damage from Primary Weapons. Using the fragment results in a 42.5% overall Damage Increase in PVE and a 25% overall Decrease in PVP.

entries.name: Whisper of Conduction
entries.text: Stasis Shards within 15 meters are pulled toward you after a 1 second delay.

entries.name: Whisper of Rime
entries.text: Increases the maximum number of Frost Armor Stacks to 7 and its maximum duration to 6 seconds.

entries.name: Whisper of Hunger
entries.text:
Stasis Shards grant increased Melee Energy:
• Small Shards: 10% 🠚 17.5%
• Large Shards: 50% 🠚 75%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Firepower
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Grenade Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)
10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Indomitability
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant ability energy based on your Super's elemental alignment:
• Light Super: 5% Grenade Ability Energy
• Dark Super: 5% Melee Ability Energy
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Prototype Trueseeker
entries.text:
This rocket's tracking capabilities are stronger than other traditional tracking rocket launchers, and have a blast radius of 11 meters.
Dealing damage with 3 rockets without reloading generates 1 Ammo. Finishing a reload after having dealt damage with all three rockets grants 'Prototype Trueseeker'.
Prototype Trueseeker grants the following benefits:
• 80% Faster Rate of Fire
• ? Stability
• Significantly improved tracking capabilities
• Rockets now explode into 8 cluster munitions upon detonation, each cluster having a blast radius of 3 meters.

entries.name: Resurgence Directive III
entries.text:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.
Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.
Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.
Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.

entries.name: Resurgence Directive II
entries.text:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.
Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.
Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.
Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.

entries.name: Resurgence Directive IV
entries.text:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.
Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.
Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.
Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.

entries.name: Ensemble
entries.text:
Grants 🡅35 Handling and 🡅45 Reload Speed while within 15 meters of an ally.
Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once you're no longer near allies.
🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 5.

entries.name: Towering Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation.
Creates a tall, slightly curved, see-through Barricade in front of you that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Grants 60% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while standing behind the Barricade.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Standing extremely close to the barricade consistently prevents enemy melee attacks from hitting you through it.

entries.name: Rally Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation and keeps you crouched after.
Creates a short, curved, see-through Barricade that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies while standing behind it:
• 10% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 50% Flinch Resistance
• 30 Stability
• 100 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 80% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants

entries.name: Bullwhacker
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights generates 3% Heat per second, building up to Charge Level x1|x2|x3 after 0.5|1.2|1.8 seconds.
Each Charge Level generates 20%|30%|34% heat upon firing and increases impact damage, explosion damage, and detonation radius.
Benefits at Charge Level x1|x2|x3:
• 36.5%|91%|145% increased Impact damage
• 17%|27%|91% increased Explosion damage
• 5|6|9.5 meter Detonation Radius

entries.name: Firewalker
entries.text:
Increases Solar Weapon and Ignition damage while Roaring Flames currently active.
Benefits at Roaring Flames x1|x2|x3:
• 6%|9.2%|12.4% increased Weapon Damage
• 15%|20%|24.9% increased Ignition Damage
The number Slow stacks and their duration, as well as the duration of Suspend applied to you are halved. Damage from Stasis Breakout is removed.
Stasis or Suspend Breakout creates a burst of Solar Energy, dealing up to 105 damage in a 9 meter radius.

entries.name: Nadir Focus
entries.text:
Firing or swinging the weapon grants a stack of Nadir Focus for 2 seconds. Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
Maximum number of Stacks by Weapon Type:
• Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns?: 11 stacks
• Sidearms, Swords: 5 stacks
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 stacks
• Grenade Launchers: ? stacks
Benefits scale linearly? with each stack, equalizing between Weapon Types at max stacks. (E.g.: you would gain 1/4 of the maximum benefit per stack with Hand Cannons)
Benefits at max Stacks:
• 10 Range
• 7.5%? decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 100%? increased Lunge Distance (Swords)
• ?% increased Projectile Velocity (Grenade Launchers)

entries.name: Arc Conductor
entries.text:
Recieving Arc Damage activates 'Arc Conductor' for 6 seconds. Direct Weapon Kills extend the buff by 3 seconds, up to 6 seconds.
While Arc Conductor is active, gain 50% [15%] Arc Damage Resistance.
Arc Conductor can be activated and grants its benefits even while stowed.

entries.name: Solar Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Solar Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: Gjallarhorn Catalyst
entries.text:
Increases Magazine Size by 1 (1🠚2).
Kills with Wolfpack Rounds spawn an upgraded Wolfpack Round that seeks targets ?% faster and deals 126.5% increased damage.

entries.name: Stasis Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Stasis Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Blunt Execution Rounds
entries.text:
Upon dealing Melee damage while an Enemy is within 15 meters:
Grants 500% [100%] increased damage and 100 Handling for the next full burst within 🡅11 seconds.
4 second cooldown after buff expires. Can be activated while stowed. Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
Any Powered Melee that requires sprinting, sliding, or performs a slam will not activate the perk.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Tessellation Catalyst
entries.text:
Your explosive [projectile | shape | language] inherents subclass debuffs based on its element.
Deals an additional instance of 165 [10] damage in a 10 meter radius and applies a debuff matching its element:
•70 Scorch Stacks (80 with Ember of Ashes)
•Weaken for 6 [2.5] seconds
•Blind for 9 seconds
•80 Slow Stacks
•Sever for 5 seconds (7.5 with Thread of Continuity)
Effects are applied after the explosion.

entries.name: Ravenous Beast
entries.text:
Dealing damage with Tarrabah grants Raveneous Beast 2% [5%] charge for each hit. Dealing damage to Scorched enemies grants 3%[6.7%] charge per hit.
Taking damage grants it 1% charge per instance taken, and kills grant 10% charge.
Stowing Tarrabah subtracts 50% charge (E.g. 70%🠚20%).
At full power, hold [Reload] to 'Unleash The Beast' and refill the magazine, granting the following benefits for 8 seconds:
• 187% [120%] increased Bodyshot Damage
• 99% [52.7%] increased Precision Damage
• 50% [15%] Solar Damage Resistance
• 20% increased Rate of Fire
• 100 Handling
• 100 Mobility
• 100 Reload Speed
• 20% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 33% increased Slide Distance

entries.name: Repulsor Brace
entries.text:
Kills against Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP Void Overshield for 🡅10 seconds (🡅15 with Echo of Persistence).
🡅 Overshield Duration is increased by 2 seconds.

entries.name: Box Breathing
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights for 1.5 seconds without firing grants the following for a single shot:
• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 40% increased precision damage (35% for Scout Rifles, 30% for Heavy Ammo Sniper Rifles)
Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.
For glaives (Greasy Luck), the projectile must strike the target's critical hitbox in order to recieve the 40% [35%] damage bonus.

entries.name: Melee Damage Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Damage from PVE Combatants less than 4 meters away by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Collective Action
entries.text:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 🡅33% [🡅11%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. Firesprites and Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.
Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.
Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, or Void Breaches
Does not trigger with Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.
🡅 Damage is increased by 10%. (30%⁠🠚⁠33%)

entries.name: Compounding Force
entries.text: Instantly destroys PvE Combatant Elemental and Champion Shields on hit.

entries.name: Head Rush
entries.text:
Upon sliding, or upon standing up after having crouched for 2 seconds:
Grants 30 Handling, 30 Reload Speed, and 15% Increased Damage to Hive Combatants for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Nightsworn Sight
entries.text:
Kills or collecting a Void Breach grants 'Nightsworn Sight' for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.
Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters of you also receive the Nightsworn Sight when you score a kill with the gun.
Nightsworn Sight grants ? Reload speed and the following benefits:
• 15% increased Precision Damage
• 10% increased damage against Fallen and Scorn
• Automatically load 2 rounds from reserves every 4 seconds
• Submunitions apply Weaken for 4 seconds
• Submunitions deal 18% decreased damage and bounce 1 additional time.
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Multikill Clip
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of scoring 1|2|3 Weapon Kills within 3.5 seconds of each grants 17%|33%|50% increased damage for 🡅5.5 seconds.
Buff is overwritten every time it is triggered and is removed on stow.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Atomizing Rounds
entries.text:
Fires a 3-round burst of delayed Micro-Missile projectiles that detonate after 6 seconds of being embedded into a target.
Hold [Reload] to instantly detonate all fired rounds.

entries.name: Null Factor
entries.text:
Withering Blade hits and bounces grant 7.5% Melee Ability Energy. Additionally, the 1st and 3rd bounces spawn a Small Stasis Crystal.
Shattering a Stasis Crystal or Frozen Enemy with Withering Blade releases a spread of 3 Withering Blades.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Charged Up
entries.text: Increases the Maximum Number of Armor Charge Stacks you can hold from 3 to 4|5|6 with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Rewind Rounds
entries.text:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 60% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.
Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.
Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).
Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 14% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)
Nanite Hits count as Hits with the weapon.

entries.name: Headseeker
entries.text:
Dealing non-Precision Direct damage grants the following benefits for 0.55 seconds:
• 20% increased Precision Bonus (complicated, see specific damage increases below)
• 3% increased Aim Assist Cone size
Precision damage increases by weapon type/frame:
• Pulse Rifles: Adaptive: 7.1%, Aggressive Burst: 10%, Heavy Burst: 9.5%, High-Impact: 8.74%, Lightweight: 6.3%, Rapid-Fire: 10.3%
• Sidearms: Adaptive Burst: 8.46%, Heavy Burst: 7.36%
• Scout Rifles: Precision: 8.66%
[Bug] Heavy Burst Hand Cannons: 7% increased Weakspot damage.
The distinction between Weakspots and Critspots is complicated and we might write an explainer blog post about it eventually. For the purposes of PvP, the two are equivalent.

entries.name: Rapid Hit
entries.text:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Lone Wolf
entries.text:
Passively grants 5 Aim Assist, 15 Airborne Effectiveness, and a 10% decreased ADS Animation Duration.
While no allies are within 15 meters:
Bonuses are increased to 10 Aim Assist, 30 Airborne Effectiveness, and a 20% decreased ADS Animation Duration.

entries.name: Sharp Harvest
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Powered Sword Hits within 🡅2 seconds of each grants 5% of Special Ammo reserves.
Equipping two Special Weapons halves the amount of ammo granted to 2.5% for each one.
🡅 Time allowed between hits is increased by 0.5? seconds.

entries.name: Traitor's Vessel
entries.text:
Fires a wide 16-bolt volley. Aiming Down Sights tightens the spread, overlapping into 8 bolts (with 2 in each group).
Hip-Fired Bolts deal 20% increased damage.
Kills spawn Ionic Traces based off Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 10%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
• Players: 100%

entries.name: Kinetic Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Kinetic Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Shot Swap
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 2 Stacks of Shot Swap. Maximum of 6 Stacks.
Grants 100? Ready/Stow Handling and 30% decreased Ready/Stow Animation duration while you have active stacks.
Stowing the weapon consumes 1 stack.

entries.name: Timelost Magazine
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant an additional 1?% Super Energy.
Upon your Super ending:
• Refills magazine from reserves
• Grants 100% increased Base Magazine Capacity for 20 seconds
• Causes Found Verdict to reload two shells at a time for 20 seconds
Buff can be activated while stowed.
The increased Base Magazine Capacity will be considered the baseline for other perks such as Overflow.

entries.name: Tireless Blade
entries.text: Your first Powered Sword Kill after (re)spawning refunds 1 Ammo. Afterward, every other Powered Sword Kill also refunds 1 Ammo.

entries.name: Controlled Burst
entries.text: Scoring a Kill or hitting every shot in a burst grants 20% increased damage and 10% decreased Charge Time for 2 seconds.

entries.name: Special Ammo Finder
entries.text:
Grants a 1.25x|1.4x|1.5x multiplier to all Special Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
This works in the Crucible as well.

entries.name: Frame of Reference
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a stack of 'Frame of Reference' for 8 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
'Frame of Reference' timer is paused while stowed. Remaining duration is rounded up to a whole number of seconds.
'Frame of Reference' benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 1.45%|2.8%|4.2%|5.6%|7% increased weapon damage
• ?|?|?|?|? Range
• ?|?|?|?|? Reload Speed

entries.name: Heart Piercer
entries.text:
Slug rounds shatter on impact into 7 semi-tracking submunitions that deal 99 [5] damage each. Direct Slug Hits will deal damage with every submunition.
Submunitions are unaffected by damage falloff and ricochet 3 times. They deal 18% reduced damage on the first bounce, then 42.5% reduced damage on subsequent bounces.
Submunitions will attempt to steer towards enemies within 5 meters of their ricochet.

entries.name: Heavy Slug Thrower
entries.text: Can only be fired when Aiming Down Sights and fully spun up. Aiming begins a spin-up time of 1.5 seconds.

entries.name: Golden Tricorn
entries.text:
While the perk's buff isn't active, Weapon Kills grant 'Golden Tricorn x1' for 7 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 15%. Additional Kills refresh the buff duration.
While Golden Tricorn x1 or x2 is active:
Grenade or Elemental Melee Kills matching the element of the Weapon grant Golden Tricorn x2 for 10 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 50%.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: Collective Demolition
entries.text:
Collecting an Elemental Pickup enables Weapon Damage to generate Grenade Ability energy per hit for 8 seconds.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Shot Tangles extend the timer by 4 seconds. Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Thrown Tangles extend the timer by 8 seconds.
Timer can be extended to a maximum of 16 seconds.
Grenade energy granted by weapon type:
Spreadshot HC: 🡅0.55%
Burst Sidearm: 🡅0.86%
Fusion Rifle: 🡅1.27%
Rocket Pulse: 🡅2.15%
Sidearm: 🡅2.57%
Scout: 🡅3.67%
Rocket Launcher: 🡅14.19%
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.
🡅 Melee Energy generated is increased by 10%.

entries.name: Rimestealer
entries.text:
Killing Frozen Enemies or Shattering a Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants 🡅2 Stacks of Frost Armor.
🡅 Grants an additional stack of Frost Armor.

entries.name: Absorption Cells
entries.text:
Kills or scoring 5 hits with Weapons matching your Super Element grant Super Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1.5%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 2.5%
• Players: 2.5?%
While your Super is charged:
Kills with Weapons matching your Super's Element grant 4 Stacks of Subclass-Matching Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds.
After casting your Super Ability, gain x4 Arc, Solar, Void, Stasis, and Strand Weapon Surge for 10 seconds, and 'Harmonic Munitions' for 15 seconds.
Harmonic Munitions causes weapons that are the same element as your super to trigger an element-matching explosion on hit. Explosions deal 180 [?] damage in a 6 meter radius and can trigger once per second.

entries.name: The Fundamentals
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to cycle this weapon's element between Arc, Solar, and Void. Selected element persists through stow and death.
Grants 30% [10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon receiving or applying an elemental buff or debuff that matches the currently selected element.
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Ensemble
entries.text:
Grants 30 Handling and 40 Reload Speed while within 15 meters of an ally.
Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once you're no longer near allies.

entries.name: Facet of Balance
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Kills within 3? seconds of each with Light-aligned damage grants 10% Melee energy.
Scoring 3 Kills within 3? seconds of each with Dark-aligned damage grants 10% Grenade energy.
Light Alignment: Arc, Solar, Void
Darkness Alignment: Stasis, Strand

entries.name: Facet of Justice
entries.text: Ability Kills while Transcendent trigger an explosion that deals up to 130 [?] Ability-Matching Elemental damage in a ? meter radius.

entries.name: Facet of Protection
entries.text:
Grants 15% [?%] Damage Resistance while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.
The Damage Resistance is NOT increased while Transcendent, it simply stacks with Transcendence's 20% Damage Resistance for a total of 32%.

entries.name: Facet of Grace
entries.text:
Kinetic Weapon Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Light and Darkness Transcendence energy.
Super Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Light and Darkness Transcendence Energy to you and allies within ? metres.

entries.name: Facet of Hope
entries.text:
Having an active elemental buff grants an additional 40% Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
Having 2+ active elemental buffs grants an additional 60% instead.

entries.name: Facet of Solitude
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each causes your next damage instance within 3 seconds (from any source) to trigger a Severing Burst.
Severing Burst applies Sever to enemies in a 3 meter radius. Radius is increased to 6 meters while Transcendent.
Further Precision Hits within 4 seconds of an activation provide no activation progress.
Precision Hits required to prepare the Severing Burst:
• 20% of magazine size rounded down + 1
• Bows require 2 hits

entries.name: Facet of Courage
entries.text:
Light abilities deal 10% increased damage to enemies affected by Stasis or Strand elemental debuffs.
Light Melee Abilities in PVE instead deal an additional 50% of their base damage.

entries.name: Facet of Devotion
entries.text:
Killing enemies affected by Stasis or Strand Elemental debuffs grants additional Light Transcendence Energy:
• Minors: 1%
• Elites: 3%
• Minibosses and higher: 5%
• Players: ?%

entries.name: Facet of Dawn
entries.text:
Elemental Melee Hits grant you Radiant for 5 seconds.
Elemental Melee Kills grant you and allies within ? meters Radiant for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Facet of Generosity
entries.text:
Kills while Transcendent spawn up to 4 Orbs of Power for allies that grant 7.15?% Super Energy.
Orbs spawn upon passing specific point thresholds: 30, 50, 70, and 100 points for each orb.
Points gained per Kill by Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10 points
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 15 points
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20 points
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 34 points
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 40 points
• Bosses: 50 points
• Players: ? points

entries.name: Rolling Storm
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Bolt Charge.
While Amplified, this is increased to 2 Stacks.
🡅 Weapon Kills with no active Bolt Charge Stacks grant an additional Stack.

entries.name: Void Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Void Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Hail Barrage
entries.text:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
Kills grant one stack of 'Hail Barrage'. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Hip-firing consumes all stacks to fire Stasis arrows in an evenly spread volley.

entries.name: The Whispers
entries.text:
Grants an extra Melee Ability Charge.
Acts as a copy of the Heavy Handed armor mod.

entries.name: Unrepentant
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 3.6? seconds of a kill grants 'Unrepentant' for 10 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.
Unrepentant fires an extended 6-round burst that deals 200% [0%] increased damage.

entries.name: Bleak Watcher
entries.text:
Base Grenade Cooldown is set to 121 seconds while equipped.
Holding [Grenade] charges your grenade and converts it into a throwable 'Stasis Turret' that targets enemies within a 35 meter radius.
Stasis Turret fires a burst of 5 seeking projectiles over 0.7 seconds every 2 seconds. Each projectile applies x20 [x10] Slow for 4.5 [2] seconds on hit (9 [3.75] seconds with Whisper of Durance).
Turret lasts for 25 seconds (30 seconds with Whisper of Durance) and has 67% Damage Resistance until it has fired.
Stasis Turret counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.

entries.name: Marksman Optics: Low
entries.text:
Passively decreases Zoom by 2.
Decreasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Decreased Magnification
• Decreased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Increased Absolute Recoil
• Widened Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

entries.name: Fastball
entries.text: Increases velocity of thrown grenade abilities by ~25%.

entries.name: Glacial Harvest
entries.text:
Stasis Shards now grant Frost Armor upon pickup:
• Small Stasis Shards grant x1 Frost Armor, 10% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 10 HP.
• Large Stasis Shards grant x3 Frost Armor, 50% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 20 HP.
While Frost Armor is active:
• Kinetic and Stasis Weapon Kills have an escalating chance to trigger a Stasis Shatter based on the number of Frost Armor stacks.
• Taking damage grants ?% Grenade Ability energy (once per second).
Intrinsic to All Stasis Subclasses:
Stasis Shards are generated by:
• Shattering a Frozen target or Stasis Crystal
• Defeating a Stasis-Debuffed (Slowed or Frozen) target
Minor combatants generate a small Stasis Crystal, while Elites, Minibosses, and Guardians generate a Large Stasis Crystal.
In PvP Only:
Stasis Shards go on a 10 second cooldown upon creating 6 shards within ? seconds of the first.

entries.name: Successful Warm-Up
entries.text:
Weapon Kills decrease Charge/Draw Time by 37.5% for 6 seconds.
Kills while the perk is active add 4 seconds to the duration up to a maximum of 20 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Snareweaver IV
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.
Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3
At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.
Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [5] damage and are Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.
5 second cooldown between Suspends on the same enemy.
Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.name: Snareweaver II
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.
Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3
At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.
Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [5] damage and are Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.
5 second cooldown between Suspends on the same enemy.
Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.name: Snareweaver III
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.
Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3
At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.
Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [5] damage and are Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.
5 second cooldown between Suspends on the same enemy.
Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.name: Swooping Talons
entries.text:
While airborne, hits increase damage by 10% [2%] per hit, up to a maximum of 100% [20%]. Cooldown of 0.6 seconds between damage increases.
Buff is reset upon touching the ground.

entries.name: Harmonic Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Weapons matching your Super Element ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Surplus
entries.text:
Grants Stat Bonuses depending on the number of Charged Abilities.
Stat Bonuses with 1|2|3+ Charged Abilities:
• 5|15|25 Stability
• 5|25|60 Handling
• 10|25|60 Reload Speed
🡅 Stronger Effect.

entries.name: Echo of Instability
entries.text:
Grenade Kills grant you Volatile Rounds for 11 seconds, making Void Weapons apply Volatile on Hit. Does not require Void Grenade Kills.
(Volatile explosions do not count as damage originating from your weapon)

entries.name: Echo of Harvest
entries.text:
Killing Weakened enemies spawns a Void Breach and an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Echo of Obscurity
entries.text: Finishers grant Void Invisibility for 5 seconds (7 with Echo of Peristence).

entries.name: Echo of Starvation
entries.text: Picking up an Orb of Power or Void Breach grants Devour for 5 seconds (7.5 with Echo of Persistence).

entries.name: Archer's Gambit
entries.text:
Hip-fire Precision Hits grant the following benefits for 🡅5 seconds:
• 60% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ? Reload Duration Multiplier
Hip-fire Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 4 seconds up to the maximum of 8 seconds.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.

entries.name: Aggressive Frame
entries.text: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after kill.

entries.name: Relentless Tracker
entries.text:
Dealing ability damage to unhighlighted Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player targets highlights them for 10 seconds and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for 16 [11] seconds.
Highlight duration is not refreshable.
Killing highlighted targets with weapons matching the element of the highlighting ability spawns an Elemental Pickup corresponding to the element in question.
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

entries.name: Hawkeye Hack
entries.text:
Modifies Golden Gun to only fire a single shot that deals 650% increased damage and triggers an immediate Ignition.
The triggered Ignition overrides base Scorch sources and solely benefits from damage increases to the Golden Gun.
(A Celestial Nighthawk Precision Hit is ~85% more damage compared to 3 Precision Hits with Marksman Golden Gun. Also, please only use it with Marksman Golden Gun in PvE)
Scoring a Golden Gun Kill refunds 33% Super Energy and causes the enemy to explode, dealing up to 400 [?] damage in a ? meter radius.
Precision Kills grant 1.5-4.5% Super Energy depending on Enemy Rank.
Golden Gun no longer receives faster active super generation as a roaming-class super.

entries.name: Upgraded Sensor Pack
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness and Radar remains active while Aiming Down Sights.
Crouching grants Enhanced Radar (6⁠🠚⁠12 sectors).
Damaging a PVE Combatant or breaking a Player's Shields marks them for 3 seconds. Marks are visible through walls.
If an Enemy is below 30% Health:
Increases all outgoing damage against them by 1% for every percentage point below 30%.
(10% Health left 🠚 20% increased damage)
PVE Combatant and Player Shields do not count as Health.

entries.name: MIDA Synergy
entries.text: Superb handling. Move faster with this lightweight weapon equipped. This weapon grants additional speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.

entries.name: Accelerated Assault
entries.text:
For single-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 1.2 seconds or at most 4 seconds between each other grants ? Reload Speed and 🡅6% [?] increased damage for 8 seconds.
Additional hits while the buff duration is below 4 seconds refresh the timer to 4 seconds.
For multi-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 0.8 seconds or at most 1.2 seconds between each other refills 10% of the magazine and grants 🡅6% [?] increased damage for 4 seconds.
🡅 Damage bonus is increased by 20% (5%🠚6%).

entries.name: Worldline Catalyst
entries.text: Temporal Sprint is granted 50% faster (1s🠚0.5s).

entries.name: Incandescent
entries.text:
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (🡅45 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 🡅15 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.
🡅 Having Ember of Ashes equipped or Killing higher-tier targets each increase the amount of Scorch applied by 5 Stacks.

entries.name: Wellspring
entries.text:
On Weapon Kill:
Grants 🡅9% Ability Energy split equally amongst all uncharged abilities.
Abilities with multiple charges only receive one third of the ability energy normally split to them once they have a full ability charge ready.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
🡅 Ability Energy Gain is increased by 12.5%. (8%🠚9%)

entries.name: One-Two Punch
entries.text:
Hitting a target with all 12 Pellets in the spread increases the damage of your next Melee attack within 3 seconds.
Melee Damage increase by weapon type:
• Shotgun: 150% additional base melee damage
• Hand Cannon: 75% [100?%] additional base melee damage
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
The buff does not stack with the passive Melee Damage increase against Frozen non-Boss targets. The higher buff of the two takes precedence.

entries.name: Overflow
entries.text:
Upon picking up Special or Heavy Ammo:
Refills and Overfills the Magazine from reserves.
Overfill amount maxes out at 🡅120% of the Magazine Capacity. Activates even while stowed.
🡅 Maximum overfill amount is increased by 20% (rounds up).

entries.name: Verglas Curve Catalyst
entries.text: Applying Freeze or Slow to a target decreases Draw Time by 35% (567ms🠚368ms) for ? seconds.

entries.name: Adaptive Glaive
entries.text:
Hybrid melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield.
Generates energy on dealing ranged damage.
[Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield, depleting energy over time
[Melee]  : Kinetic melee combo

entries.name: Accelerated Assault
entries.text:
For single-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 1.2 seconds or at most 4 seconds between each other grants ? Reload Speed and 5% [?] increased damage for 8 seconds.
Additional hits while the buff duration is below 4 seconds refresh the timer to 4 seconds.
For multi-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 0.8 seconds or at most 1.2 seconds between each other refills 10% of the magazine and grants 5% [?] increased damage for 4 seconds.

entries.name: The Lost Voice
entries.text:
Replaces Healing Grenades' Restoration Orb with a Healing Turret. Consuming a Healing Grenade will spawn a Healing Turret in front of you.
Passively highlights low-health allies with a soft, flashing, red glow.
Healing Turret information:
• Lasts 9 seconds and has 100? Construct HP
• Releases Healing Seekers every 3 seconds towards the user and allies within 30 meters
• Healing Seekers apply Cure x1 and Restoration x1 for 4 [3] seconds in a 7.5 meter radius (strength of both buffs is increased to x2, for the wearer only, while Touch of Flame equipped).
Restoring health to damaged allies [6 times] spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy at their position.
10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Gambler's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Grants 1% [0.35%] Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] at 100 Melee Stat.
Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of 200% [70%] energy.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Marksman's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs an evasive maneuver in your movement input's direction that instantly reloads all equipped weapons and collects ammo bricks that are on the ground within a 15 meter radius of you.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

entries.name: Acrobat's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a front flip in your movement input's direction and slams down the ground with a Solar Knife.
Upon landing after using Acrobat's Dodge:
• Grants you and allies within ? meters Radiant for 10 seconds (15 with Ember of Solace)
• Deals up to 40 [20] damage to targets in a ? meter radius

entries.name: Moving Target
entries.text:
Grants the following while Aiming Down Sights (ADS):
• 10 Aim Assist
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
🡅 Aim Assist bonus is slightly increased.

entries.name: Solar Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Solar Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Magnificent Howl
entries.text:
Scoring a Precision Kill grants 1 Stack of 'Precision Final Blows' up to the maximum of 10 Stacks.
Reloading converts 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks into 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks. Having active 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks prevents you from gaining 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks.
Each shot consumes 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl, granting 50% increased damage and ?% increased Damage Falloff Distance.
Precision Kills with buffed shots refund a Stack of Magnificent Howl.

entries.name: Towering Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation.
Creates a tall, slightly curved, see-through Barricade in front of you that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Grants 60% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while standing behind the Barricade.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Standing extremely close to the barricade consistently prevents enemy melee attacks from hitting you through it.

entries.name: Rally Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation and keeps you crouched after.
Creates a short, curved, see-through Barricade that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
