Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies while standing behind it:
• 10% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 50% Flinch Resistance
• 30 Stability
• 100 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 80% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants

entries.name: Arc Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with an Arc Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Touch of Malice
entries.text:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.
The last round of this gun's magazine deals 132% [30%] increased damage, drains 7 HP, and is always refunded when shot. Health drain is not lethal.
Scoring kills or activating 'Charged With Blight' restores 105 HP and begins Health Regeneration.
Healing Activation from kills is based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 33.4%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
• Players: 66.7%

entries.name: Thresh
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant an additional 1% Super Energy.
Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant an additional 1.5% instead.

entries.name: High Octane
entries.text:
Ignitions that occur within a 70 meter radius of you grant 2 stacks of Composite Propellant.
Reaching 5 stacks of Composite Propellant refills the magazine from reserves.

entries.name: Warlord's Sigil
entries.text:
Melee/Glaive Melee Kills grant a stack of 'Warlord's Sigil'. Maximum of 10 stacks. Finishers grant 3 stacks (as soon as their animation starts).
Warlord's Sigil stacks decay one at a time every 4.75 seconds.
Warlord's Sigil grants the following Melee Damage increases at 1|2|3|...|10 stacks:
67.5% | 122% | 166% | 202% | 228% | 249% | 265% | 278% | 289% | 300% Additional Base Melee Damage.
Reaching or refreshing the duration of the 10th stack grants 1 Melee Ability Charge and 'Warlord's Fury Ready' for 8 seconds. The 10th stack's duration cannot be refreshed by Finishers.
Using any Melee while Warlord's Fury Ready is active will grant 'Warlord's Fury' for 10 seconds, granting the following benefits:
• 400% Additional Base Melee Damage
• 0.8x Melee animation duration
• 38.4x Melee ability regeneration speed
Warlord's Sigil's stack count is reset to 0 once Warlord's Fury ends. While Warlord's Fury is active, gaining stacks of Warlord's Sigil is not possible.
Not triggering Warlord's Fury will return the buff to Warlord's Sigil x10.

entries.name: Vampire's Caress
entries.text:
Melee Kills grant Cure x3 and Restoration x1.
Finishers grant Cure x3 and Restoration x2.
Restoration lasts 8 seconds (12 with Ember of Solace) in both cases.

entries.name: Helium Spirals
entries.text:
Only works with the Solar Element Grenades named Solar Grenade equipped.
Solar Grenades have Fastball intrinsically and last 2 seconds longer (4🠚6s normally, 6🠚8s with Touch of Flame equipped).
Powered Melee Kills grant 5 seconds of Sunbracers Ready. Using your Grenade Ability while Sunbracers Ready is active grants the Sunbracers buff.
'Sunbracers' grants 20,000% Additional Base 'Solar Grenade' Regeneration Rate for 4 seconds. (Effectively recharges ~132% of a 'Solar Grenade' charge per second)

entries.name: Devil's Ruin Catalyst
entries.text:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 30% [10%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. Firesprites and Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.
Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.
Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, or Void Breaches
Does not trigger with Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.

entries.name: Aggressive Burst
entries.text: Hard-hitting two-burst fire.

entries.name: Whisper Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.
Aiming Down Sights for 1.2 seconds without shooting grants 'Whispered Breathing' until you leave ADS.
Whispered Breathing grants 35% increased precision damage, and an additional 10.77% increased damage against combatants.

entries.name: Trinary Vision
entries.text:
Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that can [cannot] deal overlapping damage.
Each projectile deals 581 [?] damage and travels 12 meters across the ground.

entries.name: Stasis Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Stasis Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Slug Rifle
entries.text:
Hip-fired shots become slow traveling projectiles that deal up to 55 [?] splash damage in a 3.5 meter radius, down to 0% at the edge of the radius, and apply 5 Scorch stacks (10 with Ember of Ashes).
Aiming Down Sights shoots hitscan projectiles that deal splash damage in a 3 meter radius.

entries.name: Heating Up
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Heating Up for 🡅6.5 seconds. Maximum of 2 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2 Stacks of Heating Up:
• 15|30 Stability
• 20|40 Recoil Direction
• 15%|25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 15%|25% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Buff remains active while stowed.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Harmony
entries.text:
Upon readying the weapon within 3 seconds of getting a Kill with a different weapon:
Grants 20% increased damage and 15 Handling for 🡅8 seconds.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: M1R Distribution Matrix
entries.text:
Fires a spread of 5 bolts that alternate [+] and [x] pattern, similar to that of a Vex Wyvern.
Each bolt hit grants 8% Glaive Energy and deals 25% increased damage to Vex Combatants. Glaive Melee Hits on Vex Combatants disorient them.
While blocking with Glaive Energy, grants a Void Overshield at a rate of 14 HP/s to both you and allies within a 15 meter radius. Overshield lasts for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistance).
In PvP, glaive shield uniquely provides 50% Damage Resistance against Primary and Melee Damage from other players (compared to the standard 30%).

entries.name: Paracausal Beam
entries.text:
Deals 400% increased damage to Combatant Shields and Subjugator Bosses.
For the purposes of Microcosm, Tormentors and Subjugators are always considered shielded

entries.name: Property: Undecidable
entries.text:
The element of this [weapon | instrument | topology] will change to match your equipped grenade.
Kills grant 20% grenade energy and 2.5% additional Light and Dark Transcendence energy.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Fan Fire
entries.text:
Hip-Fired Precision Hits deal 88% [?] increased damage.
Hip-Fired hits grant a stack of 'Fan Fire' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 4 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or Aiming Down Sights.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4 stacks:
• 5|10|15|20 Reload Speed
• 5%|10%|15%|20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size

entries.name: Font of Vigor
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Melee stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Void Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with with a Void Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Feeding Frenzy
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Feeding Frenzy for 3.5 seconds, increasing the Reload Speed of the weapon. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 8|50|60|75|100 Reload Speed
• 2.5%|10%|13%|16%|20% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.name: Killing Tally
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Killing Tally. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Stowing or reloading the weapon removes all Stacks.
Damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks:
• PVE: 10% | 20% | 30%
• PVP: 5% | 10% | 15%

entries.name: Eddy Current
entries.text:
Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier
Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.
Being Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.
🡅 Buff duration is increased. Even stronger effect while Amplified.

entries.name: Void Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Void Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Absolution
entries.text:
On Orb of Power Pickups:
Grants 5%|7.5%|10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Stasis Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Stasis Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Arc Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Arc Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Pace Yourself
entries.text:
Firing semi-automatically grants the following benefits:
• 33% decreased recoil
• ? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
• ? decreased Accuracy Cone Size

entries.name: The Manticore Catalyst
entries.text:
While airborne, any kill or 5 hits against an Elite, Miniboss, or Boss refills 12 ammo and grants a 15HP Void Overshield for 6 seconds (9 seconds with Echo of Persistance).
1 second cooldown when activated by hits.
No cooldown when activated by kills.

entries.name: Desperate Measures
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 'Desperate Measures x1' (DMx1), increasing damage by 10% for 🡅7.5 seconds.
Grenade or Melee Kills grant 20% increased damage for 🡅7.5 seconds (DMx2). Scoring another Grenade or Melee Kill with DMx2 active increases this to 30% (DMx3).
Can be activated while stowed. Weapon, Grenade, and Melee Kills refresh the buff duration.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Rites of Ember
entries.text:
Daybreak Projectiles trigger a Solar Ignition on hit. Ignitions from any source deal 100% increased damage.
Each enemy damaged by an Ignition grants 40% Melee Ability Energy. Scorched enemies grant 5% Melee Ability Energy per tick.
Solar Fulmination from the Hunter's Journal Artifact doubles the Melee Ability Energy gained, and has its own damage doubled as well.
Does not increase Scorch tick damage.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Silkbound Slayer
entries.text:
Deal 50% [20%] increased precision damage against Suspended targets. Bodyshots are granted 125% [44%?] increased damage (although reported with yellow numbers, they are not precision hits).
Suspending an enemy from any source, or damaging a Suspended enemy with this weapon, grants 100 Reload Speed and 30% decreased Draw Time for 6? seconds.

entries.name: Swarmers
entries.text:
Spawns 2 Threadlings upon destroying a Tangle.
Threadlings apply Unravel for ? [5] seconds on hit (? [7.5] seconds with Thread of Continuity).

entries.name: Stasis Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Stasis Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Regenerative Motion
entries.text: Refills 5 ammo every 0.34 seconds while sprinting.

entries.name: Nightmare Fuel
entries.text:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant Nightmare Fuel for 7 seconds.
Gaining Nightmare Fuel grants 35% [20%] increased weapon damage (Empowering Buff), ? Handling, 50 Airborne Effectiveness, and refills the magazine of all stowed weapons from reserves.
Readying a different weapon after gaining Nightmare Fuel refreshes its duration. Swapping weapons again removes the buff.
Scoring a kill with a weapon currently benefitting from Nightmare Fuel grants you a fresh instance of the buff (as if you scored another Powered Melee Kill), allowing you to switch weapons again.

entries.name: Strand Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Strand Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Arc/Strand Siphon Combo
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with an Arc or Strand Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Demoralize
entries.text:
Precision Kills apply Weaken to enemies within 7 meters of the target for ? seconds.
🡅1? second cooldown between activations.
🡅 Cooldown is decreased by 0.5? seconds.

entries.name: Markov Chain
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a stack of 'Markov Chain' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Stacks are removed on stow.
Melee Kills instantly refills the magazine. Melee kills while Monte Carlo is being held grant all 5 stacks of Markov Chain.
Damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• PvE: 13%|26%|39%|52%|65%
• PvP: 6.6%|13.2%|19.8%|26.4%|33%

entries.name: Void Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Void Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Monte Carlo Catalyst
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] while at maximum Markov Chain stacks to lock the bayonet.
While Monte Carlo is held, it replaces your Melee Ability with a powerful glaive-like stab that deals 2,772 [140] melee damage. Stab can reach up to 7 meters away and grants 50% Melee Ability Energy on hit.

entries.name: Marksman's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs an evasive maneuver in your movement input's direction that instantly reloads all equipped weapons and collects ammo bricks that are on the ground within a 15 meter radius of you.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

entries.name: Gambler's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Grants 1% [0.35%] Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] at 100 Melee Stat.
Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of 200% [70%] energy.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Envious Arsenal
entries.text:
Dealing any damage with both of your other weapons refills the magazine from reserves upon readying the weapon.
🡅 Passively grants 10 Ammo Generation stat (equivalent of an Ammo Generation armor mod).

entries.name: Melee Momentum
entries.text:
Glaive Melee Kills grant Weapon Energy and ?% increased movement speed while Blocking for 10 seconds.
Weapon Energy granted by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 16.7%
• Elites, Players: ?%
• Minibosses: 50%
🡅 Weapon Energy granted is increased.

entries.name: Dynamic Duo
entries.text:
Holding [Grenade] consumes your Arc Grenade to make you Amplified and summon a 'Sentient Arc Soul' for 20 seconds.
Sentient Arc Soul information:
• Counts as Arc Grenade Ability damage
• Grants 5% Grenade Energy once per burst if it damages an enemy (this does not work if you have Devour active)
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: The Fourth Horseman Catalyst
entries.text: Grants 40 Reload Speed and Increases Magazine Size by 1 (4🠚5)

entries.name: Together Forever
entries.text: This weapon has a well-rounded adaptive grip, reliable and sturdy. Kills with this weapon reload Sturm and overflow a bonus damage round into it.

entries.name: Consul's Pitch
entries.text:
Hellion projectiles deal up to 20% increased damage after traveling 17 meters.
Hellion projectiles that have been in flight for 1 second release 4 pieces of Shrapnel with tracking capabilities.
Shrapnel projectiles deal 18 [?] Solar Damage and apply 5? stacks of Scorch each.

entries.name: Solar/Strand Dual Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Solar or Strand Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Eyes of Tomorrow Catalyst
entries.text:
Dealing damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds, increasing your Grenade Stat by 10 per stack. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Kills grant 10% Grenade Ability Energy.
Using your Grenade Ability refills the Magazine with a 3 second cooldown.

entries.name: Cast No Shadows
entries.text: Dealing Melee Damage refills 20% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants ? Handling for ? seconds.

entries.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
entries.text:
The upper 50% of the Magazine has up to 20 Stability and 30 Reload Speed.
The benefits decrease linearly as the Magazine approaches 50% capacity.

entries.name: Shoot to Loot
entries.text:
Weapon Hits against Orbs of Power collect them.
If collecting ammo is possible:
Weapon Hits against Ammo Bricks pick them up, trigger Ammo Pickup Effects, and refill all Weapons from reserves.
Does not require direct hits.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Range.

entries.name: Rangefinder
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights grants the following benefits:
• 10 Range
• 10% increased Effective Zoom
• 5% increased Projectile Speed
The Effective Zoom increase pushes out Aim Assist Falloff by 10%, reduces (Absolute) Recoil by 10% and narrows the Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones by the same amount. (This is the normal behavior of Zoom and isn't unique to Rangefinder)

entries.name: Ice Breaker
entries.text:
Bodyshot Kills or Shattering a Stasis Crystal triggers a Solar Explosion, dealing 480 [40] damage in a ? meter radius.
Precision Kills or Shattering a Frozen target triggers a Solar Ignition.

entries.name: Dragonfly
entries.text: Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing up to 123.89 [95.3] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4.5-meter radius.

entries.name: Energy Transfer
entries.text:
Every point of damage taken while Guarding grants Class Ability Energy:
• 🡅1.56% when Melee Damage is Blocked
• 🡅1.5% when non-Melee Damage is Blocked
• 🡅0.63% when damage isn't Blocked (getting hit from behind)
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
🡅 Increases Class Ability Energy gains by an additive 0.055%, 0.5%, and 0.125% in that order.

entries.name: Beacon Rounds
entries.text:
Kills with the weapon grant a Stack of Beacon Rounds for 6 seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks.
Scoring futher Hits with the weapon can extend the buff duration up to the maximum of 4 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.
Each Stack grants increased projectile tracking. Projectile Tracking is only in effect while the Targeted Reticle is active.
Grants the following while you have active Stacks:
• 15 Reload Speed
• 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 45% increased Projectile Tracking Cone size

entries.name: Flash Counter
entries.text:
Taking damage while Guarding emits a blast in a wide, 8? meter long wide cone in front of you.
The blast disorients enemies hit by it for 🡅6 seconds and deals weapon-matching elemental damage.
The damage scales up from 75 [14] damage at point-blank range to the maximum of 110 [45] damage after ? meters.
The strength of the disorientation against Players similarly also scales up with distance.
2.5 second cooldown between activations.
🡅 Disorient duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: New Land Beyond Catalyst
entries.text: While above 20 stacks of The Master, Bullseye Bolster duration is increased by ? seconds and the magazine is refilled on each shot.

entries.name: No Distractions
entries.text:
Grants 35% Flinch Resistance after 1 second of Aiming Down Sights (ADS) without firing. Remains active until you're no longer ADS.
Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.

entries.name: Rally Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation and keeps you crouched after.
Creates a short, curved, see-through Barricade that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies while standing behind it:
• 10% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 50% Flinch Resistance
• 30 Stability
• 100 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 80% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants

entries.name: Towering Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation.
Creates a tall, slightly curved, see-through Barricade in front of you that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Grants 60% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while standing behind the Barricade.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Standing extremely close to the barricade consistently prevents enemy melee attacks from hitting you through it.

entries.name: Thruster
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a quick, first-person, 8 meter dash in your current input direction. Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles (needs confirmation) and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Not inputting a movement direction results in a 4 meter backwards dash.

entries.name: Field Prep
entries.text:
Grants the following while Crouched:
• 50 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier
Passively grants 20 Ammo Generation stat. (50% more than 1 Ammo Generation armor mod)

entries.name: Lagrangian Sight
entries.text:
This weapon passively searches for Minor, Elite, or Player targets within 50 meters and marks them through walls [highlights them] for 45 seconds. Requires a minimum of three viable targets and prioritizes the farthest target away. Mark disappears past 80 meters. Cooldown of 7 seconds between marks.
Killing marked targets in any way spawns a 'Telemetry Pattern' at their location for 60 seconds, which can be physically collected to generate 1 ammo.
Telemetry Patterns are lost on death.
Collecting 3 Telemetry Patterns generates 6 ammo and 'Langrangian Sight' for 30 seconds, granting:
• 50% [87.5%] increased damage
• 30 Handling
• 35 Reload Speed
Buff can be activated while stowed.
Collecting Telemetry Patterns during Langrangian Sight's timer fully refreshes the buff.

entries.name: Stats for All Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Stats For All trait:
Upon damaging 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each, for 10 seconds:
• 35 Handling and Reload Speed
• 10 Stability and Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Cascade Point Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Cascade Point trait:
After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:
Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for 2.5 seconds.
Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.
Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits

entries.name: Repulsor Brace Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Repulsor Brace trait:
Kills against Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistence).

entries.name: Loose Change Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Loose Change trait:
Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 9 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Void Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Void Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Witherhoard Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 40 Handling.
This weapon is automatically loaded from reserves after 2 seconds of being stowed.

entries.name: Full Court
entries.text:
Starts linearly increasing Detonation and Burn (DoT) damage 0.2 seconds after the grenade projectile is fired.
Reaches maximum strength after 1.1 seconds at a 35% damage increase.
The damage increase is finalized at the point of detonation and any lingering effects left will not increase it further.

entries.name: Adagio
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant the following for 🡅8 seconds:
• 10 Range
• 30% increased damage
• 20% longer Firing Delay/Charge Time/Draw Time
Hand Cannons only recieve a 27% damage increase. Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Burning Ambition
entries.text:
Direct Hits against Scorched Enemies apply additional Scorch on a 0.5 second cooldown:
• Primary Weapons apply 10 [4] additional Scorch per Direct Hit (15 [9?] with Ember of Ashes)
• Special and Power Weapons apply 20 additional Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes)
Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.
Number of Direct Hits required by weapon type:
• Bows: 2
• Swords: 3
• Other Weapons: 55% of the base magazine size
Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.
Ember of Ashes increases the amount of Scorch applied by 50%.

entries.name: Hearts of Ice
entries.text:
Enemies frozen by Winter's Wrath receive 150% increased Shatter damage.
Upon performing Winter's Wrath's heavy attack:
• Allies within 30 meters receive the maximum Frost Armor Stacks and 4 Stacks of Stasis Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds
• Refunds ?% Super Energy per ally buffed. (Only works once per ally?)
Grants maximum Frost Armor Stacks to you once Winter's Wrath ends.
On Rift Cast with the Frostpulse Aspect equipped:
• You and allies within ? meters receive 2 Stacks of Stasis Weapon Surge for 11 [6] seconds alongside maximum Frost Armor Stacks
• Grants 2% Winter's Wrath Super Energy for each ally that received the above benefits

entries.name: Trespasser Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants the Tunnel Vision trait:
Grants the following for 5 seconds upon finishing a Reload within 3.6 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
• 20 Aim Assist
• ? ADS Handling
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Be The Danger's automatic reload activates this perk.

entries.name: Focused Fury
entries.text:
Scoring 35% of the Base Magazine Capacity as Precision Hits grants 25% increased damage for 11 seconds.
Stowing or Reloading the weapon resets the Precision Hit counter. The buff remains active while stowed.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.name: Killing Tally
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Killing Tally. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Stowing or reloading the weapon removes all Stacks.
Damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks:
• PVE: 10% | 20% | 30%
• PVP: 5% | 10% | 15%
🡅 Passively grants 10 Magazine Stat. (Identical to Tactical Mag)

entries.name: Veteran's Wisdom
entries.text:
Precision kills or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each triggers a Kinetic shockwave at the enemy's point of death.
Kinetic Shockwave deals very low damage in an 8 (🡅 9) meter radius and applies Exhaust for 10 seconds, reducing enemy damage output.

entries.name: Air Assault
entries.text:
Passively grants 🡅12 Airborne Effectiveness.
Grants 🡅32 Airborne Effectiveness per stack for 5 seconds. Maximum of 2 Stacks.
Grounded Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack while airborne kills grant 2 Stacks. Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Grants 2 more Airborne Effectiveness passively and per Stack.

entries.name: M1R Distribution Matrix IV
entries.text:
Fires a spread of 5 bolts that alternate [+] and [x] pattern, similar to that of a Vex Wyvern.
Each bolt hit grants 8% Glaive Energy and deals 25% increased damage to Vex Combatants. Glaive Melee Hits on Vex Combatants disorient them.
While blocking with Glaive Energy, grants a Void Overshield at a rate of 14 HP/s to both you and allies within a 15 meter radius. Overshield lasts for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistance).
In PvP, glaive shield uniquely provides 50% Damage Resistance against Primary and Melee Damage from other players (compared to the standard 30%).

entries.name: M1R Distribution Matrix III
entries.text:
Fires a spread of 5 bolts that alternate [+] and [x] pattern, similar to that of a Vex Wyvern.
Each bolt hit grants 8% Glaive Energy and deals 25% increased damage to Vex Combatants. Glaive Melee Hits on Vex Combatants disorient them.
While blocking with Glaive Energy, grants a Void Overshield at a rate of 14 HP/s to both you and allies within a 15 meter radius. Overshield lasts for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistance).
In PvP, glaive shield uniquely provides 50% Damage Resistance against Primary and Melee Damage from other players (compared to the standard 30%).

entries.name: M1R Distribution Matrix II
entries.text:
Fires a spread of 5 bolts that alternate [+] and [x] pattern, similar to that of a Vex Wyvern.
Each bolt hit grants 8% Glaive Energy and deals 25% increased damage to Vex Combatants. Glaive Melee Hits on Vex Combatants disorient them.
While blocking with Glaive Energy, grants a Void Overshield at a rate of 14 HP/s to both you and allies within a 15 meter radius. Overshield lasts for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistance).
In PvP, glaive shield uniquely provides 50% Damage Resistance against Primary and Melee Damage from other players (compared to the standard 30%).

entries.name: In-Flight Compensator
entries.text: Passively grants all weapons 15|25|30 Airborne Effectiveness with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Withering Gaze
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights (ADS) for 🡅1.4 seconds without firing and staying ADS causes your next shot to apply Weaken on a Direct Hit.
Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.
🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.

entries.name: Mortal Polarity
entries.text:
Precision Kills summon a lightning strike that deals 973 [300] damage in a 7 meter radius and grants x5 Bolt Charge.
Lightning strike has damage falloff and deals 0% damage at the edge of its radius.

entries.name: Grenades and Horseshoes
entries.text:
Rockets gain proximity detonation, automatically exploding within a 2 meter radius of targets.
These rockets deal increased detonation damage to account for the inability to deal impact damage.

entries.name: Nightsworn Sight III
entries.text:
Kills or collecting a Void Breach grants 'Nightsworn Sight' for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.
Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters of you also receive the Nightsworn Sight when you score a kill with the gun.
Nightsworn Sight grants ? Reload speed and the following benefits:
• 15% increased Precision Damage
• 10% increased damage against Fallen and Scorn
• Automatically load 2 rounds from reserves every 4 seconds
• Submunitions apply Weaken for 4 seconds
• Submunitions deal 18% decreased damage and bounce 1 additional time.
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Nightsworn Sight II
entries.text:
Kills or collecting a Void Breach grants 'Nightsworn Sight' for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.
Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters of you also receive the Nightsworn Sight when you score a kill with the gun.
Nightsworn Sight grants ? Reload speed and the following benefits:
• 15% increased Precision Damage
• 10% increased damage against Fallen and Scorn
• Automatically load 2 rounds from reserves every 4 seconds
• Submunitions apply Weaken for 4 seconds
• Submunitions deal 18% decreased damage and bounce 1 additional time.
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Nightsworn Sight IV
entries.text:
Kills or collecting a Void Breach grants 'Nightsworn Sight' for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.
Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters of you also receive the Nightsworn Sight when you score a kill with the gun.
Nightsworn Sight grants ? Reload speed and the following benefits:
• 15% increased Precision Damage
• 10% increased damage against Fallen and Scorn
• Automatically load 2 rounds from reserves every 4 seconds
• Submunitions apply Weaken for 4 seconds
• Submunitions deal 18% decreased damage and bounce 1 additional time.
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Soul Devourer
entries.text:
Collecting a Remnant grants 'Soul Devourer' for 7 seconds and refills 4 ammo.
Collecting additional Remnants can overflow both the timer and magazine, extending the duration up to 11 seconds and the magazine up to 350% capacity (40 rounds).
Soul Devourer increases poison damage by 200% [1750%?] while active.

entries.name: Stasis Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Stasis Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 'Crystalline Corpsebloom' for 4 seconds.
Kills while Crystalline Corpsebloom is active spawn a Stasis Crystal 3 meters away from the enemy death location in a random direction.

entries.name: Kill Clip
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill grants 25% increased damage for 🡅5.5 seconds.
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Dragon's Breath Catalyst
entries.text:
Doubles the rate of passive Composite Propellant generation (6🠚3 Seconds per stack).
Kills generate Firesprites. These kills ignore the global Firesprite spawning cooldown.

entries.name: Shatterdive
entries.text:
Casting [Air Move] causes you to rapidly descend to the ground, instantly Shattering any Frozen targets or Stasis Crystals in a 8.5 meter radius.
Shatterdive deals a small amount of damage on impact, then deals an additional higher damage instance against Frozen enemies.
Shattering a Stasis Crystal or Frozen Target with Shatterdive grants x5 Stacks of Frost Armor in PvE (x7 with Whisper of Rime), and x2 stacks in PvP.
Grants Fall Damage Immunity and ?% Damage Resistance against Crystal Shatter Damage while diving.

entries.name: Winter's Shroud
entries.text:
Applying Slow to a target grants 300% [150%] Increased Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 3 seconds.
Dodging applies 60x [40x] Slow to enemies in a 9 [8] meter radius for 8 [1.5] seconds (12 [2] seconds with Whisper of Durance).
Grants 50% Damage Resistance against Combatants for 4 seconds after the dodge.

entries.name: Rapid Hit
entries.text:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier
🡅 Stronger Effect.

entries.name: Target Lock
entries.text:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.
Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.
% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%
Damage Buff ramps up from 🡅18.82% [12.55%] to 🡅45% [30%] upon reaching maximum strength.
Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 🡅28.13% [19.02%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.
🡅 Damage Buff is increased by 12.5% [20%].

entries.name: Wrath of the Colossus
entries.text: Requires a one-second charge time before entering full-auto at the listed RPM.

entries.name: Tunnel Vision
entries.text:
Grants the following for 5 seconds upon finishing a Reload within 3.6 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
• 20 Aim Assist
• ? ADS Handling
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

entries.name: Beacons of Empowerment
entries.text:
The Sol Invictus buff you receive from Sunspots lasts twice as long (5⁠🠚⁠10 seconds).
Sunspots you create gain new visuals and now benefit allies, granting them the Sol Invictus buff for 10 seconds.
Sunspots can be extended by up to 2? seconds by dealing sustained Solar Weapon Damage (seems to not work without the Aspect, and only extends by 2 seconds).
Granting Solar Buffs to allies 3-5 times spawns a Sunspot under the user.

entries.name: Unflinching Stasis Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Stasis Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Strand Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Strand Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Wolfpack Rounds
entries.text: Rocket is forged with inherent tracking capabilities and releases 8 tracking cluster missiles on detonation.

entries.name: Master of Arms
entries.text:
Scoring a Kill with any weapon grants Master of Arms x1, granting 15% increased damage for 🡅8 seconds.
Scoring a Kill with any weapon with Master of Arms active grants Master of Arms x2, granting 25% increased damage for 🡅5 seconds.
Master of Arms x2 expiring reverts the buff back to Master of Arms x1.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Transcendent Duelist
entries.text:
Kills grant an additional 2.5% energy to both Light and Dark Transcendence bars.
While Transcendent, gain the following benefits:
• 44% increased sword damage (Exotic Perk effects are instead granted 20% increased damage)
• Dealing sword damage increases Transcendence Grenade Regeneration by 35% for 2 seconds
• Kills extend your Transcendence duration by an additional ? seconds

entries.name: Screaming Swarm
entries.text:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.
Deals 10% more damage than other Precision Frame SMGs.
Fires slow seeking projectiles that track targets within the reticle from up to ? meters away.

entries.name: Command Frame
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights consumes one ammo to fire a single hit-scan projectile that can deal precision damage.
Projectile deals 243 [40.25] bodyshot damage and 435 [72] precision damage.

entries.name: Excavation
entries.text:
Grenades fired explode into 3 additional cluster bombs, each dealing 158 [50] damage in a 4 meter radius.
Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing 109.2 [72.8] damage in a 3 meter radius.

entries.name: Chill Clip
entries.text:
While at/above 50% of the Base Magazine Capacity:
Direct Hits apply 60 Slow Stacks for 4 [1.5] seconds (8 [2] with Whisper of Durance) to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Micro-Missile Sidearms and Rapid-Fire Fusion Rifles only apply 40 Slow Stacks.
Only activates once per shot/burst.

entries.name: Phoenix Dive
entries.text:
Only usable while airborne.
Performs a dive to the ground in the direction of your movement input. Not inputting a movement direction results in a vertical downward dive.
Applies Cure x2 to you and allies within 9 meters upon landing.
Grants additional benefits if Heat Rises is active:
• Grants you Restoration x2 for 3 seconds (4.5 with Ember of Solace) instantly upon activation.
• Deals 100 Damage and applies 40 Scorch Stacks (60 with Ember of Ashes) to enemies within 5 meters upon landing.

entries.name: Empowering Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

entries.name: Healing Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.

entries.name: Kintsugi
entries.text:
Kills with a Weapon matching the element of your Super Ability grant Restoration x1 to you and allies within 15 meters for 3 seconds  (4.5 with Ember of Solace). 3 second cooldown between activations.
Reviving allies or being revived projects a 15-meter field around the wearer for 10 seconds that grants the wearer and allies inside it the Shielded buff.
Shielded grants a 100 HP Overshield that regenerates in 1 second as long as it remains active after not receiving damage for 2 seconds.
Shielded is removed if the Overshield is destroyed and you cannot regain it by leaving and reentering the field. If the wearer's Overshield is destroyed, the field granting it to allies is removed as well.

entries.name: Physic
entries.text:
Triggering 'Support Frame Boost' by healing allies with the weapon grants its element-matching effect to the user as well as the targeted ally.
Effect granted based on Weapon Element:
Solar: Restoration x1 for 4 seconds (6 with Ember of Solace)
Arc: Amplified for 5 seconds
Stasis: x2 Frost Armor for 5 seconds
Strand: Releases 4 Unraveling Threads
Void: Grants a ?HP Void Overshield for ? Seconds

entries.name: Fafnir Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 35% Flinch Resistance after 1 second of Aiming Down Sights (ADS) without firing. Remains active until you're no longer ADS.
Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.

entries.name: Power Preservation
entries.text:
Super Kills spawn an Orb of Power for allies.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.75%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
1.5? second cooldown between Orb spawns.

entries.name: Eriana's Vow Catalyst
entries.text:
Increases the magazine size by 3 (6🠚9).
Refills stowed weapon from reserves after 3.5 seconds of it being stowed.

entries.name: Roaring Flames
entries.text:
Solar Ability and Ignition Kills grant one stack of 'Roaring Flames' for 20 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Roaring Flames grants increased Solar Ability damage at 1|2|3 stacks:
• 20% [13%] | 44% [28%] | 73% [44%] Increased Grenade and Super Damage
• 67%|133%|200% Increased Base Melee Damage
While Roaring Flames is active, Unpowered Melee Hits apply 30 Scorch (40 with Ember of Ashes) and count as Powered Melee Hits.

entries.name: Sol Invictus
entries.text:
Hammer of Sol impacts, as well as kills with Solar Abilities or killing Scorched targets, create a Sunspot at their location for 5 seconds.
Sunspots deal damage and inflict 5 Scorch (8 with Ember of Ashes) every 0.167 seconds to enemies within them.
Entering a Sunspot grants Restoration x1 for 5 seconds (7.5 with Ember of Solace) and 'Sol Invictus'. Standing in the Sunspot continuously extends its lifetime up to a maximum 12 seconds.
Buff remains active until you leave the Sunspot, at which point it lasts for 5 seconds.
Sol Invictus grants 100% Increased Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate, and 40% Decreased Passive Super Drain.

entries.name: Consecration
entries.text:
Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding launches a Solar Wave that travels 20 meters and applies 40 Scorch (60 Scorch with Ember of Ashes) to all enemies hit. Consumes 50% Melee Energy on use, and grants 25% damage resistance against non-Melee Combatant damage during the animation.
After launching the Solar Wave, active your Melee Ability again to consume the remaining 50% and slam down, sending a second wave that travels the same distance, deals damage, and shatters Stasis Crystals. If this wave hits any Scorched enemies, they instantly Ignite.
Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.

entries.name: Shieldburst
entries.text:
After casting your barricade, pressing [Class Ability] again will remotely detonate it. Shieldburst Barricades apply 50 Scorch (75 with Ember of Ashes), deal damage, and blast Solar Shrapnel up to 40 meters in front of them.
Shieldburst Barricades passively grow in strength over time and after dealing damage. At maximum strength, the detonation deals 50% increased damage and releases three 15-meter Solar Waves across the ground.
Towering Barricade:
Your barricade slides 20 meters forward upon cast. Enemies that come into contact with your barricade take a burst of damage and recieve 20 Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes). Contact Damage can only trigger once every 2 seconds on the same enemy, and your barricade loses the ability to disorient. Shieldburst passively charges in strength at a rate of 34% per second.
Rally Barricade:
Your barricade grants Scorch Rounds to your Solar and Kinetic weapons. Scorch applied and rate of application varies between weapon archetypes. Shieldburst passively charges in strenth at a rate of 10% per second.
Barricade detonation scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.
Shieldburst counts as 'casting your class ability' both on cast and on remote detonation for the purposes of exotic armor.

entries.name: Full Stop
entries.text:
Deals 181% increased Precision Damage to PvE Combatants.
Aim well.

entries.name: Alacrity
entries.text:
While 1 teammate is currently dead:
Grants 10 Range, 10 Stability, 25 Reload Speed, and 5 Aim Assist.
While Solo or 2+ teammates are currently dead:
Grants 20 Range, 20 Stability, 50 Reload Speed, and 10 Aim Assist.
Only activates when the weapon has been readied for 1 second.
Does not work in the Rumble Crucible Game Mode.

entries.name: Still Hunt Catalyst
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Precision Kill grants 'Lucky Shot Ready'.
Scoring a Precision Hit while you have Lucky Shot Ready refills the magazine by 1 from reserves and begins a 7 second timer. Additional precision hits during this timer continue to refill the magazine from reserves.

entries.name: Elemental Charge
entries.text:
Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying Tangles grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Activation Progress.
Activation Progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• Firesprites, Void Breaches, Tangles: 50%|50%|100%
• Ionic Traces: 34%|50%|50%
• Stasis Shards: 25%|34%|50%

entries.name: Osmosis
entries.text:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.
Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.
Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on Primary, 15% on Special).
Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.

entries.name: Strand Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Strand Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.text:
After being in Combat for 12 seconds:
Grants 15% increased damage, 100 Handling, and 100 Reload Speed for 7.2 seconds.
Works and can activate while stowed. Dealing and receiving damage refreshes the buff duration.
For Frenzy, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 🡅5.5 seconds.
Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.
🡅 Allowed time between damage exchanges extended by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Strand Targeting
entries.text:
Grants the following to Strand Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Counterattack
entries.text:
Upon receiving damage within 0.5 seconds of starting to Guard:
Grants 50% increased damage for 2 seconds.

entries.name: Heal Clip
entries.text: Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants Cure x2 to you and Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.

entries.name: Invisible Hand
entries.text:
Consecutively missing multiple times within 2.5 seconds of each grants 25? Stability for 2.5 seconds.
Buff is removed 1? second after scoring a Hit. Missing again refreshes the buff duration.
Misses in a row required:
• Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns: 10
• Pulse Rifles: 9
• Hand Cannons: 4
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 2

entries.name: Carrion Munitions
entries.text:
Killing an Elite or higher-ranked Combatant spawns a seeking insectoid robot that chases enemies within 25 meters. The insectoid deals weapon-element matching damage (varying by archetype) in a 5 meter radius.
0.5 second cooldown between insectoid spawns. Insectoid kills count as weapon kills and can trigger perks, but cannot spawn more insectoids.

entries.name: Webcatcher
entries.text:
Threaded Spike can now target and bounce to Tangles, detonating them on impact and immediately returning to the user.
Catching the Threaded Spike after it detonates a Tangle equips you with a second throwable Tangle. Alternatively, failing to catch the Threaded Spike triggers a 9 meter Strand Detonation around you, dealing 727 [?] damage with no falloff.
This detonation counts as Powered Melee damage, scaling with the Melee stat and triggering melee-effects.
Catching a Threaded Spike that didn't detonate a Tangle refunds an additional fixed 25% Melee Ability Energy.

entries.name: Stunloader
entries.text: Stunning a Champion refills 50% of the Magazine from reserves.

entries.name: Edge of Intent
entries.text:
Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a sentient Healing Turret.
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.
Only applies to Glaive Projectiles.

entries.name: Disorienting Grenades
entries.text:
Passively grants -200 Blast Radius, 25% decreased damage, and 15% decreased detonation radius.
Enemies within 6 meters of the explosion are disoriented for 4.5 seconds. Disorient radius cannot be increased using other perks.
Champions and Bosses are unaffected by Disorient.
(Disorient is effectively the equivalent of Arc Blind without any of the elemental synergies and anti-champion benefits)
Players near the explosion briefly lose their HUD and have their screen distorted for up to ? seconds. Duration varies depending on the distance from the blast.

entries.name: Sacred Flame
entries.text:
Heavy Attacks apply 'Sacred Flame' to your target.
Light Attacks on Sacred-Flame marked targets, or on target death, trigger an explosion dealing 136 [?] damage in a 5 meter radius.
Sacred Flame does not recieve the Ergo Sum Transcendence damage buff.

entries.name: Explosive Payload
entries.text:
Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact.
The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more. On Hand Cannons, the Payload deals 7% decreased damage in PvP.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.
[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

entries.name: Magnificent Howl
entries.text:
Scoring a Precision Kill grants 1 Stack of 'Precision Final Blows' up to the maximum of 10 Stacks.
Reloading converts 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks into 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks. Having active 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks prevents you from gaining 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks.
Each shot consumes 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl, granting 🡅55% increased damage and ?% increased Damage Falloff Distance.
Precision Kills with buffed shots refund a Stack of Magnificent Howl.
🡅 Buff is increased by 10% (50%🠚55%).

entries.name: Arc Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Arc Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Shield Break Charge
entries.text: Breaking a Combatant Shield with the matching Elemental Damage Type grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

entries.name: Desperado
entries.text:
Finishing a reload 5.2 seconds after a Precision Kill or 3 kills within ? seconds of each reduces Firing Delay by 30% for 6 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Offhand Strike
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant the following benefits to hip-firing for 🡅8 seconds:
• 30 Stability
• 45% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• ~3° larger Precision Aim Angle
• 95%? decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 95%? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth.
Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
entries.text:
Each shot while holding down the trigger grants the following benefits:
• 🡅1.25 Stability
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 🡅12.5% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
Reaches maximum strength after 🡅8 shots, granting 10 Stability, ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size, and 100% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth.
🡅 Effect reaches maximum strength 2 shots sooner.

entries.name: Primeval's Torment
entries.text:
Fires a Taken projectile that creates a Blighted Pool in a 4.5 meter radius for 4.5 seconds upon impact with the ground.
Enemies within the pool take damage every 0.3 seconds.

entries.name: Benevolent Finisher
entries.text: Finishers consume 3 Stacks of Armor Charge and spawn an Orb of Power for your allies that grants 7.15% Super Energy.

entries.name: Gunpowder Gamble
entries.text:
Kills charge up an Improvised Explosive (three Tripmines duct-taped together).
Kills grant charges based on the method used:
• Weapons: 1 [2] charge
• Ignition and Scorch: 3 [4] charges
• Abilities: 4 charges
• Super: 6 charges
At 6 charges, replaces your Grenade Ability with a thrown explosive that travels with reduced velocity. Explosive causes an Ignition when detonated, and incurs a 6 second cooldown upon throw.
Shooting the explosive increases its damage by 50% [5%], ignition radius by ?%, and releases 9 homing submunitions from its center. Sticking the explosive directly onto an enemy and then shooting it adds an additional damage instance equal to 67% [?] of the aboved buffed detonation.
If not shot, the explosive detonates on its own after 3 seconds.
Gunpowder Gamble counts both as an Ignition and a Grenade Ability. It triggers, and is buffed by, both grenade and ignition-specific effects.

entries.name: Crackshot
entries.text:
Sets your Base Class Ability cooldown to that of Marksman's Dodge.
With full Class Abililty energy, enemies you look at within 27 meters become visually marked. Mark up to 3 enemies.
Casting your Class Ability with at least one mark active fires three ~150-180 RPM Scorching Golden Gun rounds equally divided across all marked enemies. Lower frame rates can slow the RPM, though animation duration remains the same.
Each shot deals 354 [21] damage and applies 20 Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes). Landing all 3 shots grants Cure x1.
Can be activated while in the air, and triggers the effects of your equipped dodge when activated.
Benefits from Radiant, which grants the shots 20% [0%] increased damage. Pairing Crackshot with Acrobat's Dodge always applies the damage bonus.
Crackshot can further scale up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.

entries.name: Knock 'Em Down
entries.text:
While Radiant, Powered Melee kills grant 100% Melee Ability Energy after a 0.2 second delay. Melees that grant Radiant will still trigger a refund if a kill is achieved in the same blow.
Passively grants benefits to your equipped Solar Super:
• Marksman Golden Gun duration is increased by 4 seconds
• Deadshot Golden Gun is granted 15% damage resistance
• Blade Barrage fires 3 additional knives per wave (14🠚20 Total Knives)
Casting your super grants Cure x1.

entries.name: On Your Mark
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant you and allies within a 15 meter radius of you one stack of 'On Your Mark'. Precision Kills, and Precision Hits from Hand Cannons, grant 2 stacks. Casting your Class Ability grants one stack to yourself. Stacks last for 12 seconds. Maximum of 10 stacks.
Stacks have no [1 second] cooldown on being earned.
Each stack of On Your Mark grants 5 Weapons Stat, 5? Reload Speed, and ?% decreased Reload Animation Speed.
At 10 stacks, kills grant Restoration x1 for 3 seconds (4.5 with Ember of Solace).
Kills with Red Death Reformed are reduced to Cure x1 (down from x2) while at 10 stacks.

entries.name: Solar Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Solar Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Heartshadow Catalyst
entries.text:
Increases reserves by 6 (57🠚63).
Grants 50% increased movement speed while under the effects of Void Invisibility.

entries.name: Font of Endurance
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Health stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Bait and Switch
entries.text:
Dealing damage with a weapon starts a 7 second timer. Dealing additional weapon damage resets the timer to 7 seconds.
Dealing damage with all 3 of your weapons without letting the timer run out grants you 'Bait and Switch' for 10 seconds, granting 30% increased damage.
Timer is disabled while Bait and Switch is active, requiring a full activation sequence once the buff expires.

entries.name: The Fundamentals
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to cycle this weapon's element between Arc, Solar, and Void. Selected element persists through stow and death.
Grants 30% [10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon receiving or applying an elemental buff or debuff that matches the currently selected element.
Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.name: Master of Arms
entries.text:
Scoring a Kill with any weapon grants Master of Arms x1, granting 15% increased damage for 7 seconds.
Scoring a Kill with any weapon with Master of Arms active grants Master of Arms x2, granting 25% increased damage for 4 seconds.
Master of Arms x2 expiring reverts the buff back to Master of Arms x1.

entries.name: Unflinching Harmonic Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Weapons matching your Subclass Element:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Genesis
entries.text:
Energy Weapons are refunded 1 Ammo upon hitting matching PVE Combatant Elemental Shields.
Refills magazine from reserves upon breaking a PVE Combatant, Barrier Champion, or Player Shield.

entries.name: Iron Grip
entries.text:
Passively increases Stability by 20 but decreases Reload Speed by 🡅15.
🡅 Reload Speed penalty is decreased by 5.

entries.name: MIDA Software Package
entries.text:
Kills with this or other MIDA-Synergy weapons grants progress towards the 4-stage 'Software Update' counter. Each stage requires an equal number of kills in order to advance. Dying resets progress to the start of the previous stage.
Progress to the next stage is granted by ammo type:
• Primary: 15% [100%] Stage Progress
• Special: 10% [50%] Stage Progress
Benefits at each stage of Software Update:
• Chip: 25% decreased Handling Animation Speed
• Barrel: 15 Range and 15 Stability
• Optics: 15% increased Aim Assist Falloff distance and 5% increased Auto Aim cone angle
• Ammo: Shots explode on impact, dealing 19 [7] damage in a 3 meter radius
Software Update also grants 4.8%|9.6%|14.4%|14.4% increased damage against PvE Combatants at Stages 1|2|3|4.

entries.name: Unstoppable Force
entries.text:
Blocking damage with the Glaive Shield grants 20% increased projectile damage for 🡅5 seconds.
Buff is removed if you stop blocking.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Unrelenting
entries.text:
Starts Health Regeneration and restores 65 HP upon reaching 100% Activation Progress with Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each.
Activation Progress by Enemy Rank:
• Minor Combatants: 34%
• Players: 67%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%

entries.name: Khvostov Catalyst
entries.text:
Scoring 25 Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 🡅0.8% Super Energy.
Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.name: Strand Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Strand Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: The Navigator Catalyst
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to activate Grapple Tangle mode.
Fires a floating Grapple Point to where the reticle previews at approximately 23.5 meters away. Identical to those made by the Widow's Silk aspect.
30 second cooldown, starting only once grounded.

entries.name: Stormbringer
entries.text:
On 3 Precision Hits within 6 seconds of each:
• Grants x1 Bolt Charge
• Summons a lightning strike after 1.1 seconds, dealing 973 [300] damage in a 7 meter radius
• Summons a lightning storm 0.5 seconds later, dealing 584 [180] damage in a spread-X pattern in a 5 meter radius.
Lightning storm staggers enemies and deals 25% damage at the edge of its radius. Enemies can only take damage from the storm once.
Precision Hit progress is removed on stow.

entries.name: Hip-Fire Grip
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits while hipfiring:
• 25 Stability and 15 Aim Assist
• 2.7° larger Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 20% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 20% increased Damage Falloff Distance
The Damage Falloff increase does not apply to The Last Word, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles, and Fusion Rifles.
PvP-specific note: the Precision Aim Cone Angle increase essentially just allows you to hit Crits while aimed above or slightly to the side of the head. (This is already the default behavior of Submachine Guns, Sidearms, Bows, Machine Guns, and Linear Fusion Rifles so it does not affect them)
🡅 Stronger Effect.

entries.name: Strategist
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 🡅11% Class Ability Energy.
Kills with Fusion Rifles, Glaives, Shotguns, and Sniper Rifles grant 🡅22%.
Class Ability usage grants ? Stability for ? seconds.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
🡅 Class Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%. (e.g. 10%⁠🠚⁠11%)

entries.name: Outlaw
entries.text:
Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Featherweight
entries.text:
Kills with weapons that have this origin trait grant one stack of 'Featherweight'. Maximum of 10 stacks.
Each stack grants ?% Increased Movement Speed.
Stacks are removed upon switching to a non-Featherweight weapon.

entries.name: Grenade Chaser
entries.text:
Scoring hits with Tracking Missiles grant one stack of 'Grenades Prepped'. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Hold [Reload] to switch the gun to Grenade Launcher mode, loading a grenade for each stack gained.
Grenades deal 1,308 [134] damage on impact in a 5 meter radius with up to 30% fall off at the edges. Grenades deal no self-damage.

entries.name: Unburied Treasure
entries.text:
Readying this weapon grants 'Unburied Treasure', granting it +10 range and ?% Reduced Accuracy Cone Size for 0.5 seconds. Swords recieve ?% increased lunge distance.
This benefit falls to +5 range and ?% Reduced Accuracy Cone size after 🡅 1 second, and continues to scale down to no noticable benefits for the remaining 🡅 3.5 seconds it is active.
3 second cooldown once the buff is removed before it can be reactivated.

entries.name: Dual Loader
entries.text:
Reloading loads 🡅2 additional rounds into the magazine at a time.
🡅 Loads in 1 more round at a time.

entries.name: Robber Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Grave Robber trait:
Powered Melee Hits and (Glaive) Melee Kills refill the magazine from reserves.
3 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Immovable Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Immovable Object trait:
While blocking and stationary:
Glaive Projectiles Hits grant 90% increased Weapon Energy.

entries.name: Feedback Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Replenishing Aegis trait:
Refills 1 round into the Magazine from reserves upon blocking damage.
1 second cooldown after activation. Does not work while the magazine is overfilled (assumed).

entries.name: Power Preservation
entries.text:
Super Kills spawn an Orb of Power for allies.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.75%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
1.5? second cooldown between Orb spawns.

entries.name: Wavesplitter Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 10 Range and 30 Ammo Generation.
Scoring 25 Hits within ? seconds of each triggers an explosion around the target, dealing up to 250 [?] weapon element-matching damage in an 8 meter radius.
Scoring 69 Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy. Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.name: Anti-Flinch
entries.text: Passively grants 15% Flinch Resistance.

entries.name: Utility Kickstart
entries.text:
When a Class Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Class Ability Energy.
Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Class Ability Energy refunds.
Class Ability Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

entries.name: Slideshot
entries.text:
Sliding refills 15% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants 20 Range and Stability for your next shot (of the burst) within 2.5 seconds.
0.3 second cooldown after activation but can activate multiple times during a slide. Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Ager's Call
entries.text:
Intrinsically deals 30% more PvE damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.
Weapon Kills trigger a burst of 100 [50] Stasis Slow in a 10 meter radius around the target.

entries.name: Protective Weave
entries.text:
Scoring 8 hits on an ally within 1 second of each triggers the following actions:
• Grants you 5 ammo and 10 seconds of Woven Mail
• Grants the ally 60HP and 10 seconds of Woven Mail
• Triggers regeneration for their health, or shields if health is full. Does not heal shields if health is missing
While Woven Mail is active, deal 25% [5%] increased damage and gain 40 Ammo Generation.

entries.name: Looks Can Kill
entries.text:
Fires single high-caliber rounds that deal 1078 [123] precision damage at base.
Deals 67% increased damage to Barrier Champions.
Breaking a Solar Elemental Shield or Stunning a Barrier Champion instantly triggers a Solar Ignition.
This Ignition benefits from Eriana's damage increase against Barrier Champions if it is triggered by breaking their shield.

entries.name: Stasis Scavenger
entries.text:
Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Stasis Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.name: Charged Up
entries.text: Increases the Maximum Number of Armor Charge Stacks you can hold from 3 to 4|5|6 with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Dimensional Shift
entries.text:
Collecting a Void Breach grants 'Dimensional Breach' until your next Weapon Kill.
Scoring a Weapon Kill while Dimensional Breach is active grants a 22.5 HP Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistence) and begins a 5 second timer.
Additional weapon kills extend the timer back to 5 seconds.

entries.name: Corrupted Nucleosynthesis
entries.text:
Each Direct Hit grants 25% progress to your 'Enrage'. Enrage linearly increases your rate of fire up to 126 RPM (40% increase) at maximum level.
Entering Critical Health instantly grants max Enrage.
Enrage's progress constantly decays at a rate of ?% per second over 9.5 seconds. While you are at Critical Health, Enrage does not decay.

entries.name: Absolution
entries.text:
On Orb of Power Pickups:
Grants 5%|7.5%|10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Harmonic Resonance
entries.text:
Equipping multiple 2|3 Root of Nightmares weapons grants the following benefits:
• 3.33% | 10% increased damage against The Dread, Lucent Hive, and Nezarec
• 10 | 20 Handling
• 0 | 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Stasis Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Stasis Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Turnabout
entries.text:
Grants the Turnabout trait:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Aggregate Charge
entries.text:
Damage against Elemental-Debuffed Targets is increased per unique debuff applied to the target.
Damage increased is 🡅11%|22%|33% at 1|2|3 Debuffs.
🡅 Damage buff is increased by 10% (e.g. 10%🠚11%).

entries.name: Thread of Binding
entries.text: Super Kills cause targets to explode, dealing up to ? damage and Suspending targets in a ? meter radius.

entries.name: Thread of Isolation
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each applies Sever to enemies within ? meters of the target.
Further hits are not counted for 4 seconds after an activation.
Activation Progress per Precision Hit:
• Slug Shotguns: 50%
• Bows, Sniper Rifles: 34%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 25%
• Sidearms: 20%
• Auto Rifles: 15%
• Machine Guns, Pulse Rifles: 12%
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 10%

entries.name: Thread of Continuity
entries.text:
Strand Debuffs generally last 50% longer.
Specific increases from Thread of Continuity for debuff sources can be found in their descriptions.

entries.name: Thread of Generation
entries.text:
Dealing damage grants Grenade Ability Energy for each damage instance. Provides no benefit to Slicewire grenades.
Grenade Ability Energy Gains vary depending on the source and the amount of damage dealt. Generally, more damage means more energy.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Explosive Light
entries.text:
Orb of Power pickups (even while the weapon is stowed) grant 1 Stack of Explosive Light. Maximum of 6 Stacks.
Firing the weapon comsumes 1 Stack per Shot, granting increased damage and 100 Blast Radius.
Grenade Launchers: 60% increased Explosive damage.
Rocket Launchers: 25% increased Impact and Explosive damage. (Does not affect Wolfpack Rounds)

entries.name: Solar Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Solar Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Keep Away
entries.text:
While no enemies are within 15 meters:
Grants 10 Range, 🡅35 Reload Speed, and decreases Accuracy Cone Growth by 🡅7.5?%.
🡅 Grants an additional 5 Reload Speed and further decreases Accuracy Cone Growth by 2.5?%. (5?⁠%🠚7.5?⁠%)

entries.name: Coronal Culmination
entries.text:
Counts as a Strand Weapon for most armor mods. Solar Explosion will only be buffed by Solar Surge mods.
Hold down the trigger to charge this weapon's rocket through three stages. At base, it takes 4.85 seconds to fully charge Whirling Ovation.
Upon reaching the first stage, a high damage delayed Solar Explosive is added to the rocket, which detonates after 1? second and deals damage in a 10 meter radius.
Holding down the trigger for 0.4 seconds after reaching maximum charge automatically fires the rocket.
Benefits at 33%-66%|66%-99%|100% Charge Level:
• 55%|109%|212% increased impact damage
• [N/A] |35%|52% increased explosion damage
• 207%|315%|525% overall damage increase

entries.name: Redirection
entries.text:
Hits against Minor Combatants grant 2 Stacks of Redirection. Maximum of 30 Stacks.
Stacks remain active while stowed.
Hits against Elite or higher-ranked Combatants consume up to 3 Stacks to grant 33% increased damage per Stack consumed.

entries.name: Adept Impact
entries.text: Passively grants 5 Impact.

entries.name: Four-Headed Dog
entries.text:
Fires 3 evenly spread pellets around the center pellet in an alternating triangle pattern for each shot. The central pellet always stays within the accuracy cone around your reticle.
Pellets experience 'reverse range falloff' at close-mid range and deal less damage the closer you are to the target: Deal 16.67% decreased damage at point-blank, scaling up to base damage at 14 meters (22.4 when ADS).
Beyond ~30 meters (~53 when ADS), damage starts experiencing regular falloff.

entries.name: Paracausal Affinity
entries.text:
Scoring a Kill from any source matching the elemental alignment of the weapon grants 20% increased damage for 6 seconds.
Buff can activate while stowed.
Light Alignment: Arc, Solar, Void
Darkness Alignment: Stasis, Strand

entries.name: Rolling Storm
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Bolt Charge.
While Amplified, this is increased to 2 Stacks.

entries.name: Subatomic Distortion
entries.text:
Hits with this weapon deal three additional damage instances after 0.75 seconds, lacerating enemies for 1032 [?] bonus damage.
Activating Quantum Nova triggers a 10 meter radius detonation around you, applying a Strong Weaken (30%) for 5 seconds and dealing 1420 [?] damage.

entries.name: Void Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Void Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Targeting Adjuster
entries.text: Passively grants 5 Aim Assist.

entries.name: Temporal Manipulation II
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to refill 3 ammo and switch between firing modes:
• Arc Mode fires at 150 RPM
• Stasis Mode fires at 95 RPM and deals explosive splash damage in a 3 meter radius.
Scoring 3 Kills or Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants 'Arc|Stasis Overcharge' when in Stasis|Arc firing mode. Overcharge drains at a rate of 4.5% per second once earned.
Buff is removed if you swap off the mode matching its element.

entries.name: Temporal Manipulation III
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to refill 3 ammo and switch between firing modes:
• Arc Mode fires at 150 RPM
• Stasis Mode fires at 95 RPM and deals explosive splash damage in a 3 meter radius.
Scoring 3 Kills or Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants 'Arc|Stasis Overcharge' when in Stasis|Arc firing mode. Overcharge drains at a rate of 4.5% per second once earned.
Buff is removed if you swap off the mode matching its element.

entries.name: Temporal Manipulation IV
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to refill 3 ammo and switch between firing modes:
• Arc Mode fires at 150 RPM
• Stasis Mode fires at 95 RPM and deals explosive splash damage in a 3 meter radius.
Scoring 3 Kills or Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants 'Arc|Stasis Overcharge' when in Stasis|Arc firing mode. Overcharge drains at a rate of 4.5% per second once earned.
Buff is removed if you swap off the mode matching its element.

entries.name: Sacred Flame
entries.text:
