Drawing from the hip marks up to 3 enemies near the reticle. Releasing the trigger fires lock-on arrows that apply 'Sacred Flame' to each marked target for [10] [5] seconds.
Enemies marked by Sacred Flame explode on death, dealing 295 [137] damage in a 5.5 meter radius. If a Sacred Flame explosion hits other marked enemies, they too explode.
Sacred Flame explosions are reduced by 50% damage at the edge of their radius.

entries.name: Jump Jets
entries.text:
Enables hipfiring and aim down sights while in Lift and passively grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness.
Increases Lift Duration to 4 seconds:
• High Lift: 2.6🠚4 (54% increase)
• Strafe Lift: 2.2🠚4 (82% increase)
• Catapult Lift: 1🠚4 (300% increase)
Grants the following benefits while a Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance
DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.

entries.name: Mecha Holster
entries.text:
Passively grants 40 Airborne Effectiveness, 50 Handling, and a 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier to Submachine Guns (SMGs).
Grants the following while holding an SMG:
• 30 Mobility
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance
• 33% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty (25%⁠🠚⁠16.75%)
Refills the Magazine of SMGs 1 second after they are stowed, even if the SMG is re-equipped within this window.
Scoring SMG Hits on PVE Combatants grants a Stack of 'Damage Buff' for 1 second. Maximum of 20 stacks. Damage Buff grants 5% increased SMG damage per stack, capping out at 100%.
Boss-Tier Enemies take 33% decreased damage from Peacekeeper-buffed shots.

entries.name: Linear Actuators
entries.text:
Passively increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%.
Sprinting for 1.5 seconds grants 'Linear Actuators' for 7 seconds. Melee or Glaive Hits with Linear Actuators active apply the 'Shocked' debuff to the target.
Shocked enemies chain 220 [50] Arc Damage to targets within 12 meters and spread the 'Shocked' debuff. Each chain grants two stacks of  Bolt Charge per instance.
Shocked lasts 2 seconds and its duration is refreshed when it chains to other targets. Shocked Players are immune to further chains for 2 seconds.

entries.name: Parasitism
entries.text:
Deal increased damage to targets with SIVA Nanites attached to them.
Damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Nanites:
• PvE: 30%|60%|90%|120%|150%
• PvP: 15%|30%|45%|60%|75%
For each additional Nanite beyond five, the target takes 2.1% additional damage, up to a maximum of 300% increased damage at 100 Nanites.

entries.name: Tear
entries.text:
Precision Kills Sever enemies within ? meters of the target for ? seconds.
? second cooldown between activations.
🡅 Activation cooldown is decreased.

entries.name: Bolstering Detonation
entries.text:
Grants Class Ability Energy upon dealing Grenade Ability Damage. 7 second cooldown after activation.
Class Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: All-Star
entries.text:
Picking up a Special ammo brick refills the magazine and grants 100 Reload and 35% [15%] increased damage for 🡅7 seconds. Heavy ammo bricks grants the buff for 🡅10 seconds.
Timer only decreases while the weapon is readied, and remains paused while stowed.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Adhesive Ordnance
entries.text:
Picking up an Ammo Brick causes the next shot fired to attach a Sticky Bomb on impact.
Sticky Bomb detonates after 0.8 seconds, dealing up to ? [?] Kinetic Damage and Exhausting targets in 6 meter radius. Damage falls off to 50% at the edge of the radius.
Sticky Bombs inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

entries.name: Towering Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation.
Creates a tall, slightly curved, see-through Barricade in front of you that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Grants 60% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while standing behind the Barricade.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Standing extremely close to the barricade consistently prevents enemy melee attacks from hitting you through it.

entries.name: Rally Barricade
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation and keeps you crouched after.
Creates a short, curved, see-through Barricade that blocks all projectiles fired at it.
Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.
Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.
Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies while standing behind it:
• 10% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 50% Flinch Resistance
• 30 Stability
• 100 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 80% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants

entries.name: Sect of Force
entries.text:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each grants the following for 10 seconds:
• 40? Handling
• 30 Reload Speed
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier
Activating the buff on an Elite or Miniboss or stunning a Champion marks them for 30 seconds. Mark duration cannot be refreshed.
Marked enemies are highlighted for allies and take 20% increased damage from them. Damage increase stacks with everything.
Upon marking a target for the first time, Aeon Allies not using Sect of Force receive 33.33% Grenade and Melee Ability Energy per second for 3 seconds.

entries.name: The Last Word Catalyst
entries.text:
Upon readying the weapon after scoring kills with your other Weapons:
Refills and/or overfills the Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills scored.
Loads 1 Ammo per kill achieved with other weapons.
Maximum total overfill amount is 200% of the Magazine Capacity. Each activation can only load up to 100% of the Magazine Capacity into the magazine.
On Weapon Kill, for 5 seconds:
• 50 Mobility
• 40 Handling and 20 Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
Additional Kills extend the duration by 5 seconds, up to 8 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Shield Disorient
entries.text:
On Matching Elemental Shield Break:
Explosion disorients enemies within 7 meters for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Kinetic Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Kinetic Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Spark of Volts
entries.text: Finishers make you Amplified and grant 1 Stack of Bolt Charge.

entries.name: Spark of Brilliance
entries.text: Precision Kills against Blinded enemies release a Blinding explosion, Blinding enemies within 7.5 meters.

entries.name: Spark of Amplitude
entries.text:
Scoring 2 kills within 4 seconds of each while Amplified creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
The kill that makes you amplified counts towards this requirement.
Kills within 10 seconds of an activation do not count.

entries.name: Spark of Feedback
entries.text:
Being struck by a Melee Attack grants an additional 100% [50%] of your base Melee damage for your next Melee Attack within 5 seconds.
Buff duration is not refreshable.

entries.name: Strand Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with with a Strand Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Air Trigger
entries.text:
Passively grants 🡅30 Ammo Generation Stat. (Equivalent of 1 Ammo Generation Armor Mod + 1 Non-Enhanced Abundant Ammo Weapon Mod)
Being Airborne grants the following benefits:
• 🡅35 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 15?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 20?% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size
🡅 Ammo Generation bonus is increased by 10 and Reload Speed bonus is increased by 5?.

entries.name: Stasis Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: Defensive Grip
entries.text:
Blocking ? attacks within ? seconds of each other grants 1 ammo.
1 second cooldown between activations.
Passively grants:
• 80 Guard Resistance
• 80 Guard Endurance

entries.name: Move to Survive
entries.text:
Passive grants the following benefits:
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness
• 25% increased Blink distance
• 20% decreased Blink cooldown (3.55s⁠🠚⁠2.85s)
• 30% decreased Blink activation delay (1.65s⁠🠚⁠1.15s)
• Removes Super Energy cost of Nova Warp's Dark Blink
While Blink is equipped, gain a horizontal 'Dark Blink' bound to your [Air Move]. Movement is identical to Nova Warp's Dark Blink, which spawns 4 [2] Weakening Seekers that scale with the Super stat. Incurs a 6 [8] second cooldown on use.
Blinking or casting Dark Blink grants 100 Handling for 2 seconds, Volatile Rounds for 9 [5] seconds, and the Radar remains active during the animation.
Enemies within 10? meters become Volatile when initiating Blink.

entries.name: Causality Arrows
entries.text:
Aiming Down Sights causes your arrows to instantly detonate Sacred Flame marks on enemies.
Precision Hits that are fired within the Perfect Draw window increase this explosion's damage by 100%.

entries.name: Paracausal Affinity
entries.text:
Scoring a Kill from any source matching the elemental alignment of the weapon grants 20% increased damage for 🡅7 seconds.
Buff can activate while stowed.
Light Alignment: Arc, Solar, Void
Darkness Alignment: Stasis, Strand
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Auto-Loading Holster
entries.text: Refills stowed weapon from reserves after 3.5 seconds of it being stowed.

entries.name: Spike Grenades
entries.text:
Increases Grenade Impact damage:
• 12.12% increase on Special Grenade Launchers
• 12.5% increase on Power Grenade Launchers
Due to the ratio of Detonation and Impact damage being tied to the Blast Radius stat on Grenade Launchers, a lower stat will provide a slightly higher overall damage increase.

entries.name: CQC Optics: Low
entries.text:
Passively decreases Zoom by 1.
Decreasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Decreased Magnification
• Decreased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Increased Absolute Recoil
• Widened Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

entries.name: Iron Reach
entries.text:
Passively increases Range by 20 but decreases Stability by 🡅15.
🡅 Stability penalty is decreased by 5.

entries.name: Strand Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Strand Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Collective Action
entries.text:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 30% [10%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. Firesprites and Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.
Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.
Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, or Void Breaches
Does not trigger with Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.

entries.name: Insulation
entries.text: Grants 4%|5%|6% Class Ability Energy on Orb of Power Pickups with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Insectoid Robot Grenades
entries.text: Kills spawn a seeking Insectoid Robot that hunts enemies. Detonates for 284 [?] damage on impact in a 3 meter radius.

entries.name: Aggressive Burst
entries.text: Hard-hitting two-burst fire.

entries.name: Dark Descent
entries.text:
Void Orbs linearly increase in damage as they fall, dealing up to 182.5% [47.7%] bonus damage after 3 seconds of being airborne.
Maximum damage is indicated by critical numbers.

entries.name: Recombination
entries.text:
Elemental Kills grant 1 Stack of Recombination even while the weapon is stowed. Maximum of 🡅8 stacks.
Each Stack additively increases the damage of the next shot by 🡅12.5% [🡅6.25%], up to 100% [50%] at 8 stacks.
🡅 Damage Buff ramps up 25% faster, reaching maximum strength 2 stacks sooner.

entries.name: Backup Mag
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Magazine stat (identical to Extended Mag).
On Swords, it grants 30 Ammo Capacity Stat (identical to 2 Reserves Mods and 5 less than having Enduring Blade).

entries.name: Mulligan
entries.text:
Missing has a chance to refund 1 ammo into the magazine based on the ammo type:
• Primary Weapons: 35%
• Special and Power Weapons: 20%

entries.name: Alchemical Etchings
entries.text:
Rifts and Wells of Radiance you cast grant 100 Reload Speed and a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier to all weapons for you and allies inside them. Effect is tied to the rift, even if the exotic is removed.
Empowering Rifts and Wells of Radiance you cast also grant 50% increased Damage Falloff Distance to Weapons.
Primary Weapons receive the following bonuses while hipfiring:
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance
DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.

entries.name: Strange Protractor
entries.text:
Refills held weapon from reserves after sprinting for 1.5 seconds.
Increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%.
Prevents Crouch Speed from being decreased below 4 meters per second.

entries.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
entries.text:
Passively grants 20 Reload Speed.
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a Weapon Kill refills stowed weapons from reserves.

entries.name: Bottomless Appetite
entries.text:
Dealing damage extends Ravenous Beast's duration by 0.05 [0.06] seconds per hit (grants 1.75 seconds from a full magazine of damage).
Hits against Minor and Elite Combatants increase buff duration by 0.3 seconds when it's below 3 seconds.

entries.name: Outbreak Perfected Catalyst
entries.text:
Nanite Damage is increased by 25%.
Enemies that die with Nanites attached to them release four Nanites around them, each dealing 13 [4] damage.

entries.name: Souldrinker
entries.text:
Finishing a Reload restores health based on the number of hits scored with the weapon before reloading.
Scoring 100% of the Magazine as hits restores 50 HP. No known upper limit to the total amount.
Glaive Melee Hits don't count. Grenade Launcher hits each count as 50% of the Magazine.

entries.name: VEIST Rapid-Fire
entries.text: Full Auto. Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.

entries.name: Explosive Head
entries.text:
Splits off 50% of the Bow's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates in a 3 meter radius on impact.
The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.
Payload detonation time after hitting a target or surface depends on the distance.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. On crits, the overall increase is 10.33% for Precision Bows and 9.69% for Lightweight Bows.
[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

entries.name: Sticky Grenades
entries.text:
Grenades stick to impacted surfaces for up to ? seconds and detonate once an enemy gets within ? meters.
Increases Detonation damage by 30% and decreases Impact damage by 85%.
Due to the ratio of Detonation and Impact damage being tied to the Blast Radius stat on Grenade Launchers, a higher stat will be more beneficial:
• 20 Blast Radius: 6% decreased total damage
• 48 Blast Radius: unchanged total damage
• 100 Blast Radius: 11% increased total damage

entries.name: Tenacious Handle
entries.text: Grants 25% Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring 4 Light Attacks within 3 seconds of each. Buff can be refreshed.

entries.name: Triple Tap
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 1 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.name: Splicer Surge
entries.text:
Finishing a reload after having dealt damage with the weapon grants a Stack of Splicer Surge. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Splicer Surge grants the following at 1|2|3 Stacks:
• 10? | 20? | 45? Handling
• 10 | 20 | 45 Reload Speed
• 0.967x | 0.934x | 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.name: En Garde
entries.text:
Readying the Sword grants 30% increased damage for 🡅2 seconds.
2? second cooldown after the buff expires.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5? seconds.

entries.name: Void Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Void Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Archer's Gambit
entries.text:
Hip-fire Precision Hits grant the following benefits for 4 seconds:
• 60% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ? Reload Duration Multiplier
Hip-fire Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 4 seconds up to the maximum of 8 seconds.

entries.name: To the Pain
entries.text:
Every 30 points of damage taken with the weapon readied grants a Stack of 'To the Pain'. Maximum of 10 Stacks. Stowing the weapon removes all Stacks.
Each Stack grants ? Handling and 2 Aim Assist, maxing out at ? Handling and 20 Aim Assist.
Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.
🡅 Stat bonuses are increased.

entries.name: Ballistics
entries.text: Passively grants 6 Range and 6 Stability.

entries.name: Vorpal Weapon
entries.text:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.
Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• Primary Weapons: 20% [60%]
• Special Weapons: 15% [20%]
• Power Weapons: 10% [20%]
🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability or Guard Resistance (Swords).

entries.name: Rewind Rounds
entries.text:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 60% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.
Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.
Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).
Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 14% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)

entries.name: Precision Frame
entries.text: This weapon fires a small auto-tracking missile. Missiles lock onto targets when aimed.

entries.name: Built to Blast
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits while Void Overshield, Frost Armor, or Woven Mail is active:
• 30 Stability
• ? Aim Assist
• ?% Flinch Resistance
🡅 Effect lingers for 2 seconds once conditions are no longer met.

entries.name: Slice
entries.text:
Using your Class Ability (even while the weapon is stowed) grants you 'Slice' for 🡅9 seconds.
While 'Slice' is active, damaging non-Severed targets Severs them, grants a stack of Slice, and refreshes the buff duration. (Hitting immune targets also triggers this.)
Reaching 5 stacks immediately removes the buff.
If the Severing hit kills the target, the perk will not trigger and you will not gain a stack.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Rampage
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Rampage. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Stacks expire one at a time every 4.5 seconds.
Grants a 10%|21%|33.1% damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.name: Adaptive Munitions
entries.text:
Hits against Barrier Champion or non-matching Elemental Shields deal increasingly higher damage.
Buff is removed upon hitting a matching shield or an unshielded enemy.
Damage increase by Weapon Archetype:
• Fusion Rifles: untested
• Machine Guns, Auto/Pulse/Trace Rifles: 🡅14% per hit, up to 🡅70%
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 🡅30.8% per hit, up to 🡅61.6%
• Bows, Glaives, Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 🡅35% per hit, up to 🡅70%
🡅 The damage buff is increased by ~40%.

entries.name: Surplus
entries.text:
Grants Stat Bonuses depending on the number of Charged Abilities.
Stat Bonuses with 1|2|3+ Charged Abilities:
• 5|15|25 Stability
• 5|25|60 Handling
• 10|25|60 Reload Speed

entries.name: Unflinching Void Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Void Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Void Leech
entries.text:
Dealing damage charges 'Void Leech Mode'.
Scoring 27 Weapon Hits:
• Charges one currently uncharged Void Debuff
• Uncharged debuffs are granted in the following order: Volatile 🠚 Weaken 🠚 Suppression
Scoring 6 Weapon Hits on a Void debuffed target, or having a Void debuff applied to you by an enemy, instantly leeches that debuff into your gun.
Both hit counters can progress simultaneously (E.g.: Leeching Weaken off a target also counts as 6 hits toward charging Volatile).
Leeching any Void Debuff off a target, or having all three Void Debuffs charged, enables you to hold [Reload] and activate 'Void Leech' for 15 [10] seconds.
Void Leech mode grants 20% increased damage and appplies all stored Void Debuffs on hit.

entries.name: Lead from Gold
entries.text:
Heavy Ammo Pickups grants 🡅35% of your maximum Special Ammo Reserves even while the weapon is stowed.
Equipping two Special Weapons halves the amount of ammo granted.
🡅 Increases the amount of Ammo gained by 40% (25%⁠🠚⁠35%).

entries.name: Spheromatik Trigger
entries.text:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers trigger a Kinetic Explosion at the target's location, knocking nearby enemies into the air and Disorienting them. 1 second cooldown between activations.
Explosion Damage and radius based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 439 Damage, 15m Radius
• Elites: 598 Damage, 15m Radius
• Minibosses and higher: 717 Damage, 20m Radius
• Players: ?
Explosions have up to 20% decreased damage at the edge of the radius. Finishers upgrade the explosion to the one triggered by a Powered Melee on a one rank higher target.
Explosions triggered can chain on Kills and will trigger weaker explosions that deal up to 242 [?] damage in a 8? meter radius. Chain Explosions don't have a cooldown.

entries.name: Problem Solver
entries.text:
Upon scoring multiple Direct Hits within 5 seconds of each against a Champion, Miniboss, or Boss Combatant:
• Exhausts the combatant for 5 seconds
• Grants 50? Reload Speed and 50? Handling for 10 seconds
Hit requirements by weapon type:
• Fusion Rifles: 12
• Rocket Pulses: 11
• Bows and Grenade Launchers: 3

entries.name: Stasis Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Stasis Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Trinity Ghoul Catalyst
entries.text:
Decreases Draw Time by 15% (756ms🠚633ms).
Lightning Rod is now granted after scoring any Arc kill. Trinity Ghoul must be held in order to receive Lightning Rod.

entries.name: Wish-Ender Catalyst
entries.text:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Forge Master
entries.text:
Collecting a Firesprite or scoring 3 Solar Kills within 3? seconds of each grants 'Forge Master' for 12 seconds. Buff timer starts once Throwing Hammer is used.
Upon initially gaining Forge Master, generate ~11.7% Melee Ability Energy per second for 8 seconds.
While Forge Master is active, Throwing Hammer is granted improved tracking and can be recalled by pressing your melee input. Recalling your Throwing Hammer guarantees a full refund of the ability, regardless of your Melee Stat.
Recalling after ~2? seconds of scoring a Throwing Hammer hit performs a Perfect Recall. Perfect Recall triggers an explosion at the Hammer's location that deals up to 290 [?] Damage in a ~5 meter radius.
Performing Perfect Recalls and picking up additional Firesprites extends the buff duration by 3 seconds, up to 12 seconds.

entries.name: Huckleberry Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants the Kinetic Tremors trait:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits against a target within 3 seconds of each emits 3 damaging shockwaves from its location at the time of activation. Shockwaves appear 0.25 seconds after scoring enough Hits and have a 1 second delay between each pulse. Shockwaves inherit Weapon Damage Buffs.
The perk cannot be retriggered by anyone on a target until 2? seconds after the last shockwave.
For The Huckleberry, these shockwaves activate after 14 hits. Each shockwave deals 215 [20] damage in a 6 meter radius and scales with its improved version of Rampage.

entries.name: Font of Wisdom
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Super stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Stasis Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: MIDA Multi-Tool Catalyst
entries.text:
While within 15 meters of an enemy, grants an Enhanced Radar, 20 Reload Speed, and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration.
Buff lingers for 4 seconds once the condition is no longer met.

entries.name: New Malpais Catalyst
entries.text: Embedded projectiles Unravel targets for 8 seconds upon detonation.

entries.name: Void Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Void Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Whisper of Refraction
entries.text:
Killing Frozen or Slowed enemies grants Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 9%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 13%
• Enemy Players: 15%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 30%
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 40%
• Bosses: 50%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Whisper of Durance
entries.text:
Slow you apply to targets and certain lingering abilities last longer.
Specific increases provided by Whisper of Durance can be found in the descriptions of the affected abilities and/or perks.

entries.name: Whisper of Hedrons
entries.text:
Freezing targets grants the following benefits for 11 seconds:
• ? Handling
• 30 Health stat

entries.name: Whisper of Fissures
entries.text:
Shattering enemies or Crystals creates an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] meter radius.
Damage falls off to 17 [4] damage at the edge of the radius.

entries.name: Whisper of Bonds
entries.text:
Killing Frozen enemies spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Whisper of Shards
entries.text: Shattering a Stasis Crystal grants 500% [150%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate for 6 seconds, up to a maximum of 11 seconds.

entries.name: Flame Refraction
entries.text: Kills refill 75 rounds into the magazine from reserves.

entries.name: Spark of Instinct
entries.text:
While at Critical Health:
Being damaged releases a burst of Arc Energy, dealing 46 [20] damage and applying Jolt to enemies within ? meters.
15? second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Spark of Haste
entries.text: Grants 50 Health stat after 1.25 seconds of sprinting and while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5 meters per second.

entries.name: Double Down
entries.text:
Decreases Class Ability Regeneration Speed by 50% for 19 seconds upon Class Ability usage.
Grants the following to Threaded Specters:
• 50% [25%] Damage Resistance (bypassed by damage from you)
• 34% increased duration
• 2 Perched Threadlings
Perched Threadlings are released when the Specter takes 40 damage. Destroying the Specter releases both Threadlings.
Being within 15 meters of your own Specter grants the 'Hidden' buff which removes you from enemy radar.

entries.name: Empowering Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

entries.name: Healing Rift
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.

entries.name: Restorative Turret
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a sentient Healing Turret.
Restorative Turret Properties:
• Lasts 15 seconds
• Targets you and allies within a 30 meters radius once every 3 seconds with healing orbs
• Healing orbs grant x1 Cure and x1 Restoration for 4 seconds (7 seconds with Ember of Solace) in a 7.5 meter radius
If Touch of Flame is equipped, the turret grants Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 6 seconds (9 with Ember of Solace) to the caster.

entries.name: Danger Close
entries.text:
Scoring a Precision Kill, 4 Weapon Kills, or scoring multiple Precision Hits grants a Stack of 'Exodus Rockets'. Maximum of 6 Stacks.
Class Ability usage consumes all Stacks to launch a homing rocket per Stack consumed. Rockets deal up to 540 [28] Kinetic Damage in a ? meter radius.
Hits with each rocket grant a Stack of 'Enhanced Rockets' for 10 seconds, increasing "rocket-type" damage (Empowering Buff).
Damage increase at 1|2|…|6 Stacks:
10% | 17% | 24% | 30% | 33% | 35%
Rocket-type damage includes: Rocket Launchers, Wolfpack Rounds (both Sword and Rocket versions), Rocket-Assisted Sidearms, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Grand Overture's Missile Volley, Quicksilver Storm's Tracer Rocket
'Exodus Rockets' Stack acquisition progress on Precision Hits by weapon type:
• Trace Rifles and Vex Mythoclast: 10%
• Auto Rifles and Machine Guns: 15%
• Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, and Crimson: 20%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles, and Shotguns: 40%
• Bows, Linear Fusion Rifles, Rocket Sidearms, and Sniper Rifles: 67%
Stack acquisition progress doesn't reset upon gaining a Stack, all progress is kept until reaching 600% (max Stacks).

entries.name: Anticipation
entries.text:
Anticipation passively charges over 160 seconds. Dealing damage with other weapons drastically reduces the charge rate based on damage dealt, which at its fastest reaches 100% charge in 3 seconds.
Firing (not holding down the trigger, despite what the UI shows) consumes the meter.
The time required to fully charge Whirling Ovation's rocket is reduced to 4.25|3.75|3.15|2.5|2 seconds at 20%|40%|60%|80|100% Anticipation.

entries.name: Unforeseen Repercussions
entries.text:
My beam fires for 0.6 seconds, marking 9 spots that detonate in a 7 meter radius after my 0.7 second delay.
Each of my detonations applies 10 Scorch (15 with the Ember of Ashes) to all enemies struck.
▛ These insights grant us such a feast, O Researcher Mine. You stand [rich] with Desire to [grow] your knowledge. Do you not Wish to [understand] me more...? ▟

entries.name: Starlight Beam
entries.text: While firing from the hip, this gun become an Adaptive Trace Rifle that deals approximately 85% the damage of Legendary Trace Rifles.

entries.name: Elemental Capacitor
entries.text:
Grants Passive Bonuses based on the element of your selected Super's element:
• Solar: 50 Reload Speed
• Arc: 50 Handling
• Void: 20 Stability
• Strand: 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• Stasis: 20 Recoil Direction & 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

entries.name: Mulligan
entries.text:
Missing has a chance to refund 1 ammo into the magazine based on the ammo type:
• Primary Weapons: 35%
• Special and Power Weapons: 20%

entries.name: Together Forever
entries.text: This weapon has a well-rounded adaptive grip, reliable and sturdy. Kills with this weapon reload Sturm and overflow a bonus damage round into it.

entries.name: Balanced Tang
entries.text:
Deal 10% increased damage against Minor combatants.
Scoring 3 Melee Kills within 5 seconds of each restores 65 HP and begins Health Regeneration.

entries.name: In-Flight Compensator
entries.text: Passively grants all weapons 15|25|30 Airborne Effectiveness with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Demolitionist
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 10% Grenade Ability Energy.
Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant 20%.
Using your Grenade Ability refills the Magazine with a 3 second cooldown.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Archer's Tempo
entries.text:
Precision Hits decrease Draw Time by 25% for 🡅4 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Tilting at Windmills
entries.text:
Blocking damage with this weapon increases movement speed while Blocking by 25?% for 4 seconds.
Buff is removed when you stop blocking or if Glaive/Sword Energy runs out.

entries.name: Auto-Loading Holster
entries.text:
Refills stowed weapon from reserves after 🡅3.3 seconds of it being stowed.
🡅 Activation time is reduced by 0.2 seconds.

entries.name: Arc Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Arc Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Gathering Light
entries.text:
Sword Kills grants 1 stack of 'Gathering Light'. Maximum of 10 stacks.
Gathering Light benefits at 1|2|3|...|10 Stacks:
• ? Guard Resistance
• ? Guard Endurance
• 10%|20%|30%|...|100% increased lunge distance
Stowing the sword consumes all stacks, granting 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy per stack.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Rampage
entries.text:
This gun has a unique version of Rampage that deals more damage in PvE.
Kills grant one stack each. Maximum of 3 Stacks. Stacks expire one at a time every 4.5 seconds.
Bonus damage granted at 1|2|3 stacks:
PvE: 20%|41%|66%
PvP: 10%|21%|33.1%

entries.name: Edge of Concurrence
entries.text:
Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a seeking Arc Wave.
Scoring 4 Glaive Projectile Hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next Projectile to apply Jolt.
Being Amplified decreases the number of Hits required by 1.

entries.name: Rampager's Handle
entries.text: Grants 20% Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring 3 Light Attacks within 3 seconds of each. Buff can be refreshed.

entries.name: Recycled Energy
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds after scoring 1|2|3|4|5 Weapon Kills grants 5.7%|8%|9.7%|13.3%|20% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability.
🡅 Grants ?% more Ability Energy.

entries.name: Voltaic Mirror
entries.text:
While in Arc Staff Super:
• Blocking doesn't consume Super Energy
• Reflected projectiles deal 400% increased damage
• Reflecting projectiles refunds Super Energy
Arc Staff can be deactivated at any time to preserve a portion of unspent Super Energy: 75% refund at 100% Super Energy and linearly scaling down to a 50% refund at 0% Super Energy.
On Arc Staff deactivation:
• Triggers a Blinding explosion in a 10 meter radius around you that deals 675 to 2700 [? to ?] damage with no falloff based the the number of projectiles reflected
• Grants 4 Stacks of Arc Weapon Surge for 21 [16] seconds

entries.name: Time-Slip
entries.text:
Each Precision Hit or Hit against a Stasis-Debuffed target grants 1 stack of 'Rewind Again'. Maximum of 10 stacks.
At 10 stacks, summon a 'Time-Slip Portal' that hovers next to you and fires a three-round burst every 1.25 seconds, each bullet dealing 49.1 [10.2] damage.
Time-Slip Portal has a range of 50 meters, experiences no damage falloff, and inherits the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.
Stowing the weapon removes your Time-Slip Portal.

entries.name: Clown Cartridge
entries.text:
Reloading randomly overfills the Magazine from reserves by 🡅13% to 50% of the base Magazine Capacity (rounded up).
Works out to a 🡅31.5% overfill on average.
🡅 Increases the minimum overfill amount by 30%. (10%⁠🠚⁠13%)

entries.name: Full Auto Retrofit
entries.text: Weapon Fires Full Auto. Identical to the Gameplay Setting.

entries.name: Kinetic Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Kinetic Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Strand Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Strand Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Burning Ambition
entries.text:
Direct Hits against Scorched Enemies apply additional Scorch on a 0.5 second cooldown:
• Primary Weapons apply 10 [4] additional Scorch per Direct Hit (15 [9?] with Ember of Ashes)
• Special and Power Weapons apply 20 additional Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes)
Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.
Number of Direct Hits required by weapon type:
• Bows: 🡅1
• Swords: 🡅2
• Other Weapons: 55% of the base magazine size 🡅 -1
Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.
Ember of Ashes increases the amount of Scorch applied by 50%.
🡅 Decreases the number of Direct Hits required by one.

entries.name: Thermal Atomization
entries.text:
While above 50% Heat:
• Grants 8.25% [3.5] to 14% [?] increased weapon damage as Heat increases from 50% to 100%
• Enemies explode on direct damage kills, dealing up ? damage matching the weapon's element in a 7.5 meter radius.
Detonation damage by weapon type:
• Hand Cannons: 74 (lol) [77?]
• Submachine Guns: 289 [?]
• Sniper Rifles: 552 [?]
Detonation damage falls off to 0% damage at the edge of the radius.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
🡅 Unknown Benefit

entries.name: Duality Catalyst
entries.text: Grants 20 Range and increases Magazine Size by 2 (6🠚8)

entries.name: Wellspring
entries.text:
On Weapon Kill:
Grants 8% Ability Energy split equally amongst all uncharged abilities.
Abilities with multiple charges only receive one third of the ability energy normally split to them once they have a full ability charge ready.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Unflinching Strand Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Strand Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Momentum Transfer
entries.text:
Grants Melee Ability Energy upon dealing Grenade Ability damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.
Melee Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Attaching to targets with a Grapple triggers the mod but Grapple Melees do not.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Missile Tracers
entries.text:
Scoring 13 Hits loads a Tracking Missile which fires on the next shot. Missiles are removed on reload.
Tracking Missiles aggressively seek targets to a maximum range of 50 meters and deal 160 [22.7] damage on impact.

entries.name: Iron Gaze
entries.text:
Passively increases Aim Assist by 20 but decreases Range by 🡅15.
🡅 Range penalty is decreased by 5.

entries.name: Timeless Mythoclast
entries.text:
This Fusion Rifle fires its bolts one at a time, behaving like a High-Impact Auto Rifle.
Emptying the magazine refills 80% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the magazine from reserves. Requires at least 9 hits to activate.
Unlike traditional Rewind Rounds, this refill has no cooldown.

entries.name: Volatile Light
entries.text:
Damage Falloff for this weapon ends at a 30% penalty (instead of the usual 50% for Auto Rifles).
Bullets ricochet up to two times, dealing 100% [35%] increased damage after at least one ricochet.

entries.name: Aggressive Frame
entries.text: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after kill.

entries.name: Conditional Finality Catalyst
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants Cure x2 to you and Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.
Killing Frozen Enemies or Shattering a Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants a Stack of Frost Armor.

entries.name: Keep Away
entries.text:
While no enemies are within 15 meters:
Grants 10 Range, 30 Reload Speed, and decreases Accuracy Cone Growth by 5?%.

entries.name: Redemption
entries.text:
Uses Auto Rifle recoil patterns.
Kills grant 120 HP (Cure x2), 100 Reload Speed, and 20% decreased Reload Animation Duration for ? seconds. Healing is reduced to Cure x1 if the Hunter Aspect 'On Your Mark' is at x10 stacks.
Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a kill grants 60 HP (Cure x1) to allies within a 15? meter radius of you.

entries.name: Acrobat's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a front flip in your movement input's direction and slams down the ground with a Solar Knife.
Upon landing after using Acrobat's Dodge:
• Grants you and allies within ? meters Radiant for 10 seconds (15 with Ember of Solace)
• Deals up to 40 [20] damage to targets in a ? meter radius

entries.name: Marksman's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs an evasive maneuver in your movement input's direction that instantly reloads all equipped weapons and collects ammo bricks that are on the ground within a 15 meter radius of you.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

entries.name: Gambler's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Grants 1% [0.35%] Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] at 100 Melee Stat.
Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of 200% [70%] energy.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Deterministic Chaos Catalyst
entries.text:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.
Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.
% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%
Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [10.46%] to 40% [25%] upon reaching maximum strength.
Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.

entries.name: The Corruption Spreads II
entries.text:
Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal 77 [13] damage each.
Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.

entries.name: The Corruption Spreads III
entries.text:
Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal 77 [13] damage each.
Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.

entries.name: The Corruption Spreads IV
entries.text:
Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal 77 [13] damage each.
Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.

entries.name: Chaos Reshaped
entries.text:
Being in Combat for 12 seconds grants a Stack of 'Chaos Reshaped' for 7 seconds. Maintaining the first Stack for 12 seconds grants a second Stack. Buff can be activated while stowed.
For Chaos Reshaped, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds.
Benefits at Chaos Reshaped x1 and x2:
• x1: grants 20% increased damage
• x2: grants 35% increased damage and grants a periodic burst of healing
Healing effect is bugged!
While Chaos Reshaped x2 is active:
Stowing the weapon or keeping it readied for 7 seconds grants a continous healing effect of 5 HP per second.
Stowing this weapon grants the effect for 1 to 7 seconds (cycling, it's complicated), while keeping it readied after activation makes the healing effectively constant.
While this healing effect is active, NO OTHER SOURCE OF HEALING CAN RESTORE THE FINAL [~35 to 5] HP OF YOUR HEALTH BAR!
This unrecoverable HP segment can only be healed by Chaos Reshaped's 5/HPs effect.
For more details, visit the perk description in the Destiny Data Compendium.

entries.name: Tesseract
entries.text:
While at full Sword Energy, sprinting for 1 second grants 'Temporal Sprint' until you are no longer sprinting.
Performing a Grounded Heavy Attack with Temporal Sprint launches a teleporting Blink Attack, draining 50% Sword Energy and teleporting you 10 meters forward.
The Blink Attack consumes 3 ammo and deals up to 530 [353] damage 7 times to all enemies within 2 meters of the teleportation path.
Scoring a kill with this attack grants Temporal Sprint again for 2 seconds, and allows you to perform an additional Blink Attack that only costs 1 ammo and 10% sword energy.

entries.name: Overflow
entries.text:
Upon picking up Special or Heavy Ammo:
Refills and Overfills the Magazine from reserves.
Overfill amount maxes out at 100% of the Magazine Capacity. Activates even while stowed.

entries.name: Twintails
entries.text:
Fires two rockets in a burst pattern.
Each rocket only benefits from armor mods matching its element. The benefits of Loader Mods are based on the last element fired.

entries.name: Cold Steel
entries.text:
Powered Sword Hits apply Slow stacks for 4.25 [1.5] seconds.
Light Attacks apply 40 Slow stacks, Heavy Attacks apply 60.
Flash Counter's disorienting blast also applies 60 Slow stacks.

entries.name: Sect of Insight
entries.text:
Scoring 2 Precision Multikills generates an Orb of Power at the target's location for allies that grants 3.57% Super Energy.
Finishers spawn Ammo Bricks for allies based on Enemy Rank:
• Elites: Special Ammo Brick
• Miniboss or Boss: Heavy Ammo Brick
Spawned Ammo Bricks grant 60% of a Regular Ammo Brick's pickup amount but retain full variability.
Finishing an Elite, Miniboss, or Boss grants ?% Super Energy to Aeon Allies not using Sect of Insight.

entries.name: Focusing Strike
entries.text:
Grants Class Ability Energy upon dealing Elemental Melee Damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.
Class Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: Dreaded Visage
entries.text:
Taking damage from enemies grants 5% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy. 1 second cooldown between activations.
If a Void Super Ability is equipped:
Scoring a Kill at Critical Health or 3 Kills within 5 seconds of each grants you Devour for 5 seconds (7.5 seconds with Echo of Persistance).
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Transfusion Matrix
entries.text:
Powered Arc Melee kills refund a Melee Ability Charge and start Health Regeneration.
Melee Hits grant Melee ability energy:
• 50%: Powered Melee Hits
• 15%: Melee Hits with Knockout active
• 5%: Unpowered Melee and Glaive Melee Hits

entries.name: Skittering Stinger
entries.text:
Requires Weighted Throwing Knife to be equipped in order to function.
Grants Weighted Throwing Knifes a second bounce with greatly increased tracking and velocity.
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each grants the 'Strengthened Throwing Knife' buff for 10 seconds. Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 5 seconds up to the maximum of 30 seconds.
Strengthened Throwing Knife:
• Grants 50 Strength while the buff is active
• Deals 300% [100%] Increased Damage
• Stuns Unstoppable Champions
• Buff is consumed on Knife Hit

entries.name: Scissor Fingers
entries.text:
Grants an extra Solar Melee Ability charge.
All Melee charges are recharged simultaneously.
(e.g.: both are recharged on Gambler's Dodge)
Throwing Knife Kills increase Throwing Knife damage by 30%|60%|200% after 1|2|3 Kills for 5 seconds. Casting Gambler's Dodge refreshes the buff's duration.
Interaction with the Knock 'Em Down Aspect while Radiant:
• Knife Kills restore 1 charge
• Knife Trick Precision Kills and Direct Ignition Kills in which Knife Trick applied the initial Scorch restore both charges

entries.name: The Fate of All Fools
entries.text:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 Precision Hits  within 2 seconds of each refills the magazine and grants 1 stack of 'Fate of All Fools'. Maximum of 15 stacks.
Fate of All Fools grants 100% increased damage to Firefly explosions while active.
Non-precision Direct Hits consume one stack of Fate of All Fools and make the shot deal precision damage.

entries.name: Adagio
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant the following for 7 seconds:
• 10 Range
• 30% increased damage
• 20% longer Firing Delay/Charge Time/Draw Time
Hand Cannons only recieve a 27% damage increase. Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Immovable Object
entries.text:
While blocking and stationary:
Glaive Projectiles Hits grant 🡅100% increased Weapon Energy.
🡅 Energy Bonus is increased by 11.11% (90%⁠🠚⁠100%).

entries.name: Solar Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Solar Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Assassin's Blade
entries.text:
Grants the following on Weapon Kills for 🡅5.5 seconds:
• 15% increased damage
• Maximized Movement Speed
Remains active even if stowed.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Sect of Vigor
entries.text:
Ally Deaths grant 40% Damage Resistance in PVE for 15 seconds and 25% Class Ability Energy.
Reviving Allies grants 40% Damage Resistance in PVE for 10 seconds and 100% Class Ability Energy.
Allies at Critical Health within 10 meters receive 25% Damage Resistance in PVE. Aeon Allies who are not using Sect of Vigor additionally receive 15% Class Ability Energy per second. Buff lingers for 1 second once no longer at Critical Health.

entries.name: Collective Pugilism
entries.text:
Collecting an Elemental Pickup enables Weapon Damage to generate Melee Ability energy per hit for 8 seconds.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Shot Tangles extend the timer by 4 seconds. Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Thrown Tangles extend the timer by 8 seconds.
Timer can be extended to a maximum of 16 seconds.
Melee energy granted by weapon type:
Spreadshot HC: 🡅0.55%
Burst Sidearm: 🡅0.86%
Fusion Rifle: 🡅1.27%
Rocket Pulse: 🡅2.15%
Sidearm: 🡅2.57%
Scout: 🡅3.67%
Rocket Launcher: 🡅14.19%
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.
🡅 Melee Energy generated is increased by 10%.

entries.name: Focusing Strike
entries.text:
Grants Class Ability Energy upon dealing Elemental Melee Damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.
Class Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.name: Blast Distributor
entries.text:
Dealing Explosive Weapon damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
'Blast Distributor' grants 🡅13 Grenade Stat per stack.
🡅 Grants 3 more Grenade Stat per stack.

entries.name: Shoot to Loot
entries.text:
Weapon Hits against Orbs of Power collect them.
If collecting ammo is possible:
Weapon Hits against Ammo Bricks pick them up, trigger Ammo Pickup Effects, and refill all Weapons from reserves.
Does not require direct hits.

entries.name: Euphony Catalyst
entries.text:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.
Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed
Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack

entries.name: Duelist's Trance
entries.text:
Sword Kills grant 60 Guard Resistance, Guard Endurance, and (Guard) Charge Rate.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Surrounded
entries.text:
Being within 15 meters of 3 Enemies grants 40% increased damage. Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once the condition is no longer met.
Exceptions:
• Swords only receive a 35% damage increase.
• Grenade and Rocket Launchers receive a 35% Explosive Damage increase and a 40% Impact Damage increase.
• Wolfpack Rounds receive a 35% Explosive Damage increase.

entries.name: Ace of Spades Catalyst
entries.text: Firefly's explosion damage is increased by 50% while Memento Mori is active.

entries.name: Elemental Charge
entries.text:
Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying Tangles grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Activation Progress.
Activation Progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• Firesprites, Void Breaches, Tangles: 50%|50%|100%
• Ionic Traces: 34%|50%|50%
• Stasis Shards: 25%|34%|50%

entries.name: Recycled Energy
entries.text: Finishing a reload within ? seconds after scoring 1|2|3|4|5 Weapon Kills grants 5.7%|8%|9.7%|13.3%|20% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability.

entries.name: Accelerated Assault
entries.text:
For single-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 1.2 seconds or at most 4 seconds between each other grants ? Reload Speed and 5% [?] increased damage for 8 seconds.
Additional hits while the buff duration is below 4 seconds refresh the timer to 4 seconds.
For multi-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 0.8 seconds or at most 1.2 seconds between each other refills 10% of the magazine and grants 5% [?] increased damage for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: Eye of the Storm
entries.text:
Grants a scaling buff to Handling and Accuracy as your Shield Health drops below 40 and reaches maximum strength at 0 Shield HP.
Buff at maximum strength grants:
• 🡅33 Handling
• 🡅44% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 🡅18.7% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
The buff linearly scales from 0% at 80 Shield HP to 100% at 0 Shield HP (Critical Health).
It initially triggers as you drop to 40 Shield HP — giving you 50% of the maximum buff. However, as you regenerate your Shield Health, the buff will still remain until you reach 80 Shield HP where the benefits scale down to zero.
🡅 Perk benefits are increased by 10%.

entries.name: Concussive Dampener
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming AoE Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Swap Mag
entries.text: Decreases Ready/Stow Animation Duration by 10%.

entries.name: Air Assault
entries.text:
Passively grants 10 Airborne Effectiveness.
Grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness per stack for 5 seconds. Maximum of 2 Stacks.
Grounded Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack while airborne kills grant 2 Stacks. Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Burning Souls
entries.text:
Casting your Class Ability grants Cure x2.
Upon scoring multiple Solar kills within 3 seconds of each, grants one stack of 'Burning Souls' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Progress is granted based on Enemy Rank:
Minor Enemies: 34%
Elites, Players, and higher: 50%
Burning Souls grants the following benefits while active:
• 15% Increased Solar Ability Damage
• Class Ability Healing is enhanced and granted to allies within 15 meters of cast.
Healing granted at 1|2|3 stacks of Burning Souls:
• Cure x3
• Cure x1 + Restoration x1 for 3 seconds
• Cure x2 + Restoration x1 for 5 seconds
Restoration duration is increased by 50% with Ember of Solace.

entries.name: Bolstering Detonation
entries.text:
Grants Class Ability Energy upon dealing Grenade Ability Damage. 7 second cooldown after activation.
Class Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Transcendent Moment
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant stat benefits based on the weapon's elemental alignment for ? seconds.
Light Alignment grants ? Stability and ? Handling.
Dark Alignment grants ? Range and ? Aim Assist.
Kills while Transcendent activate both bonuses.
Light Alignment: Arc, Solar, Void
Darkness Alignment: Stasis, Strand

entries.name: Whispered Breathing
entries.text:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.
Aiming Down Sights for 1.2 seconds without firing grants 'Whispered Breathing' until you leave ADS.
Whispered Breathing grants 35% increased precision damage, and an additional 10.77% increased damage against PvE Combatants.

entries.name: Bait and Switch
entries.text:
Dealing damage with a weapon starts a 7 second timer. Dealing additional weapon damage resets the timer to 7 seconds.
Dealing damage with all 3 of your weapons without letting the timer run out grants you 'Bait and Switch' for 🡅11 seconds, granting 30% increased damage.
Timer is disabled while Bait and Switch is active, requiring a full activation sequence once the buff expires.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Cascade Point
entries.text:
After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:
Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for 2.5 seconds.
Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.
Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits

entries.name: Psychohack
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.name: Payday
entries.text:
Collecting an Ammo Brick refills the magazine.
At maximum rate of fire, Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size is reduced by 15%.

entries.name: Under Pressure
entries.text:
Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty:
• 🡅15% to 🡅30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 0 to 30? Stability
🡅 Accuracy benefit is increased by 20%. (25%⁠🠚⁠30%)

entries.name: Tarrabah Catalyst
entries.text:
Reloading after scoring kills with Tarrabah overfills the magazine from reserves based on the number of Kills scored.
Tarrabah overfills the next magazine by 20% per kill scored, up to a maximum of 150% Base Magazine Capacity. Always rounds up.
Kill counter persists through stow.

entries.name: Aggregate Charge
entries.text:
Damage against Elemental-Debuffed Targets is increased per unique debuff applied to the target.
Damage increased is 10%|20%|30% at 1|2|3 Debuffs.

entries.name: Heat Sink
entries.text: HP Drain is reduced by 50% (15 HP🠚7.5 HP) while not Aiming Down Sights.

entries.name: Melee Momentum
entries.text:
Glaive Melee Kills grant Weapon Energy and ?% increased movement speed while Blocking for 10 seconds.
Weapon Energy granted by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 16.7%
• Elites, Players: ?%
• Minibosses: 50%

entries.name: Special Ammo Finder
entries.text:
Grants a 1.25x|1.4x|1.5x multiplier to all Special Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
This works in the Crucible as well.

entries.name: Solar Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Solar Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Tithing Harvest
entries.text:
Collecting a Stasis Shard refills the magazine.
While Creeping Attrition is active, Precision Kills or Shattering a Stasis Crystal spawns a Small Stasis Shard which tracks back to you.
2 second cooldown between generating additional Stasis Shards.

entries.name: Radar Booster
entries.text: Passively increases maximum Radar Range by 8 meters (48⁠🠚⁠56 meters).

entries.name: Split Decision
entries.text:
Counts for and benefits from the 'Harmonic Resonance' origin trait.
While the Stasis shot is loaded:
• Benefits from Stasis Armor Mods
• Fires pellets in a triangular spread
While the Solar shot is loaded, or the magazine is empty.
• Benefits from Solar Armor Mods
• Fires pellets in a circular spread

entries.name: Adept Icarus Grip
entries.text: Passively grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and 5 Handling.

entries.name: Orbs of Restoration
entries.text:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability on Orb of Power pickups.
Abilities with multiple charges do not receive any energy if they already have a full charge.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Fencing Tang
entries.text: Deal 15% increased damage to Bosses and Vehicles.

entries.name: Impact Casing
entries.text:
Increases Impact damage by 10%, resulting in a 2.2% total damage increase (not accounting for other damage perks).
High-Impact Rocket Launchers only receive a 1.03% total damage increase.

entries.name: Ambitious Assassin
entries.text:
Reloading after scoring Kills with the weapon overfills the magazine from reserves based on the number of Kills scored.
Overfill amount maxes out at 150% of the Magazine Capacity. Always rounds up. Kill counter persists through stow.
Overfill amount per Kill scored:
• Primary Weapons: 20%
• Special and Power Weapons: 10%
🡅 Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Arc Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Arc Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Immovable Object
entries.text:
While blocking and stationary:
Glaive Projectiles Hits grant 90% increased Weapon Energy.

entries.name: See Me, Feel Me
entries.text:
Grants Volatile Rounds for 9 [3] seconds upon exiting Void Invisibility, making hits with Void Weapons apply Volatile.
On Finishers while affected by Void Invisibility:
• Grants a 35% Weapon Damage Empowering Buff for 6 seconds
• Grants you and allies within 24 meters the Reserve Overshield buff
Reserve Overshield:
• Grants 500% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Consumed on Class Ability usage, granting the user a 40 HP Void Overshield for 10 seconds
(Letting the timer run out with Echo of Persistence equipped will not grant you Volatile Rounds. Volatile explosions do not count as damage originating from your weapon.)

entries.name: Black Talon Catalyst
entries.text:
Due to an unresolved bug, this catalyst does not function.
The intended behavior was that damage against Void-Debuffed enemies is increased per unique Void-Debuff applied to the target, at a rate of 10% per debuff.

entries.name: Synergy
entries.text:
Scoring 12 [6] Weapon Kills spawns an Elemental Pickup matching the weapon's element. Kill counter persists through stow.
Kinetic Weapons spawn an Orb of Power that grants ?% Super Energy instead.
Synergy ignores the global spawning cooldowns of the Elemental Pickups but each spawn will still start the global cooldown. A Kill can trigger Synergy's Pickup spawn and that of a different Pickup Spawner simultaneously.
Synergy has its own Pickup spawning cooldowns separately from the global ones:
• Ionic Traces: 0 seconds
• Firesprites, Void Breaches, Stasis Shards: 5 seconds
• Tangles: 12 seconds
Kills during Synergy's Pickup spawning cooldown do not contribute any activation progress.

entries.name: Firefly
entries.text:
On Precision Kills:
• Target explodes, dealing 104 [80] Solar damage in a 4 meter radius
• Grants 50 Reload Speed for 6 seconds

entries.name: Grasp of the Devourer
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Weapons of Sorrow: Thorn, Osteo Striga, Touch of Malice, Cull's Shadow, and Necrochasm.
Melee Hits apply Potent Corruption, which deals Kinetic damage. Defeated enemies spread Potent Corruption on death in a 5 meter radius.
Kills with the following also spread the Potent Corruption:
• Thorn's Bullets
• Osteo Striga's Corruption Effect
• Touch of Malice's Blight's Corruption Effect
• Necrochasm's Corruption and Cursed Thrall Explosions
• Cull's Shadow Corruption Effect
Potent Corruption ticks every 0.52 [0.7] seconds for a total of 19 [?] ticks over 10 [?] seconds. Deals a total of 1366 [?] damage over the entire duration.
Corruption's first tick deals 32.35 [5?] damage.
Exclusive to 'Potent Corruption': DoT ramps up every tick, with the damage increases compounding together. For the first 14 ticks, each tick deals 11% more damage than the last. For the last 5 ticks, the damage increases by an average of 41% per tick.

entries.name: Enlightened Action
entries.text:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.
Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed
Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack

entries.name: Harmonic Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Weapon matching your Super Element.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Hunter's Trace
entries.text:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.
Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.
Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [474] precision damage.
Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.

entries.name: Rewind Again
entries.text: Precision Hits and Hits against Stasis-Debuffed targets refill 1 ammo into the magazine.

entries.name: Vanguard Determination
entries.text:
Scoring a Weapon Kill within 20 seconds of using you Class Ability grants a stack of 'Vanguard's Determination' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
'Vanguard's Determination' grants 2%|4%|6% Damage Resist at 1|2|3 stacks.
Stacks are shared across different weapons with the Vanguard's Determination origin trait.

entries.name: Solar Resistance
entries.text:
Reduces Incoming Solar Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.name: Arc Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with an Arc Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Echo of Cessation
entries.text:
Finishers make enemies within ? meters Volatile.
Killing Volatile enemies spawns a Void Breach.

entries.name: Echo of Vigilance
entries.text:
Killing an enemy while at Critical Health grants a 45 HP Void Overshield for 5 seconds (7.5 with Echo of Persistence).
8 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Relentless Strikes Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Relentless Strikes trait:
Scoring 3 Powered Hits within 2? seconds of each refunds 1 ammo.
Wolfpack Round Hits do not count.

entries.name: Attrition Orbs Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Attrition Orbs trait:
Scoring multiple Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy.
Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.
Hit requirements for activation:
• Rocket Launchers: 2 hits
• Heavy Grenade Launchers: 3 Hits
• Wave-Frame Grenade Launchers: 4 hits
• Bows: 4 Hits
• Swords: 5 Hits
• Area-Denial Grenade Launchers: 26 Hits
• Others: 55% of Magazine Size rounded down + 1
Support Frame Auto Rifle healing round Hits on damaged allies count as 2 Hits.

entries.name: SUBROUTINE: ~RECURSION
entries.text:
Nanites restore an additional ? HP based on Nano-Assault meter progress.
Taking damage while Nano-Assault is active spawns ? additional nanites around you, with a 2 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Burning Ambition Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Burning Ambition trait:
Direct Hits against Scorched Enemies apply additional Scorch on a 0.5 second cooldown:
• Primary Weapons apply 10 [4] additional Scorch per Direct Hit (15 [9?] with Ember of Ashes)
• Special and Power Weapons apply 20 additional Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes)
Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.
Number of Direct Hits required by weapon type:
• Bows: 2
• Swords: 3
• Other Weapons: 55% of the base magazine size
Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.
Ember of Ashes increases the amount of Scorch applied by 50%.

entries.name: Diamond Lance
entries.text:
Scoring 1 [3] kills with Stasis Weapons, Abilities, or Shatter spawns a 'Diamond Lance' at the enemy's death location. Enters a 7 [17] second cooldown upon creation.
Diamond Lance stays on the ground for 25 seconds, and lasts for 10 seconds upon pickup.
Throwing the Lance with [Fire] launches it forward, Freezing enemies and Shattering Stasis Crystals within a 5 meters radius of its impact.
Pressing [Melee] will instead slam the lance onto the ground below you, Freezing enemies within an 8 [5?] meter radius and Shattering any Stasis Crystals it damages. Slamming the Diamond Lance grants you and allies within a ? meter radius x2 Frost Armor.

entries.name: Pack Hunter
entries.text:
While within 15 meters of an ally, grants the following benefits:
• 50 Handling
• 50 Reload Speed
• 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration
Firing within 15 meters of an ally grants them 'Pack Hunter' for 15 seconds.
Pack Hunter buffs all non-exotic Rocket Launchers and causes them to spawn Wolfpack Rounds on detonation. Wolfpack Rounds deal damage matching the element of the rocket that fired them, and in most cases benefit from weapon perks and Empowering buffs.
On average, Wolfpack Rounds are a 26% buff to base Rocket Launcher damage.

entries.name: Impulse Amplifier
entries.text:
Passively grants 🡅25 Reload Speed and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration (20% for Rocket Launchers).
Passively increases Projectile Velocity based on Weapon Archetype:
• Rocket Launchers: 10%
• Support-Frame Auto Rifles: 15%
• Micro-Missile Frame Weapons: 25%
🡅 Reload Speed Bonus is increased by 5.

entries.name: Eyes Up
entries.text:
After being within combat for ? seconds, kills within ? seconds of having entered combat grant one stack of 'Eyes Up' for 8 seconds. Maximum of 15 stacks.
Being within combat is defined as having dealt or received damage within the specified window.
Additional kills increment the buff and add 4 seconds to the timer's duration.
'Eyes Up' grants ? Range, ? Reload Speed, and 1.5% to 5% increased damage, scaling with the amount of stacks.

entries.name: Dornröschen
entries.text:
Intrinsically lower Crit Multipler (more forgiving due to reduced difference between bodyshot and precision damage).
Fires a massive overpenetrating laser that ricochets into five sub-lasers on impact with the environment, each dealing 369 [145] damage.
Bosses take 95% decreased damage from sub-lasers.

entries.name: Unflinching Void Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Void Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Kinetic Tremors
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits against a target within 3 seconds of each emits 3 damaging shockwaves from its location at the time of activation. Hit counter persists through stow.
Shockwaves appear 0.25 seconds after scoring enough Hits and have a 1 second delay between each pulse. With Bows, the initial delay is decreased to 0.167 seconds.
Each shockwave deals up to 90 [20] damage in a 6 meter radius. Shockwaves deal 33.33% more damage when activated on Miniboss or higher tier PvE Combatants.
Shockwaves inherit Weapon Damage Buffs, the weapon's passive Kinetic Damage Bonus in PVE (10% on Primary, 15% on Special), and its Combatant Damage Scaling. They also count as non-direct Hits with the weapon for other interactions.
The perk cannot be retriggered by anyone on a target until 2? seconds after the last shockwave.
Hits required for Activation:
• Submachine Guns: 14
• Auto Rifles: 12
• Pulse Rifles: 11
• Sidearms: 8
• Hand Cannons or Scout Rifles (Rapid-Fire and Precision-Frame): 6
• All other Hand Cannons and Scout Rifles: 5
• Rocket Sidearms: 4
• Bows, Sniper Rifles: 3

entries.name: Ignoble Deeds
entries.text:
Applying an elemental debuff to a target grants 2 stacks of 'Ignoble Deeds'. Stacks can be earned while stowed. Maximum of 10 stacks.
Kills remove 1 [2] stacks.
Ignoble Deeds grants 30 (🡅 35) Handling, 30 (🡅 35) Reload Speed, and 20 (🡅?) Sword Charge Rate.

entries.name: Unwound
entries.text:
Precision Kills spawn one Threadling.
Landing 6 hits within 3? seconds of each other spawns three Threadlings at the target's location. Hit progress persists through stow.

entries.name: Full Auto Trigger System
entries.text:
Weapon fires Full Auto. (Identical to the setting)
Decreases Firing Delay by 10% on Shotguns.
🡅 Grants 5 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Black Hole
entries.text:
Damage is split between the two shots of the burst:
• First shot deals 15% reduced damage with no recoil
• Second shot deals 35.25% increased damage with increased recoil, and has no damage falloff
Total damage stays equal to the Heavy Burst archetype.

entries.name: New Tricks
entries.text:
Grants an extra Skip Grenade Charge. Skip Grenade drones chase enemies much more aggressively.
