Drone Hits grant 4.2% [1.4%] Grenade Ability Energy and x1 Bolt Charge. Each drone can hit enemies 2-3 times.
Gaining Bolt Charge gives ?% grenade energy per stack.
Upon reaching x10 Bolt Charge:
• Gain 40?% Grenade Ability Energy
• Heal allies within ? meters for ?HP
• Grants 'New Tricks', which enhances the next thrown Skip Grenade by adding 2 additional seekers on the first bounce.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Right Hook
entries.text:
Dealing Melee damage grants 10 Aim Assist and 10 Range for 10 seconds.
Dealing additional Melee damage while the Buff is active extends the duration by 10 seconds, up to the maximum of 20 seconds.

entries.name: Tenacity
entries.text:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of an enemy grant a stack of 'Tenacity'. Maximum of 20 stacks.
Stacks persist until death.
'Tenacity' grants 0.5% increased damage (additively), 2? Handling and 2? Reload Speed per stack.

entries.name: Insectoid Robot Grenades
entries.text:
Fires seeking robotic droids that can crawl over surfaces and detonate near enemies or after 2.5 seconds.
Kills spawn more droids based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 2
• Elites: 3
• Minibosses and Bosses: 6
• Players: 1

entries.name: Whirlwind Blade
entries.text:
Powered Sword Hits grant 3% increased damage for 3.5 seconds. Stacks 10 times for a 30% Buff.
Stowing the weapon or Blocking removes all stacks. Wolfpack Round Hits also count as Powered Sword Hits.

entries.name: Bewildering Burst
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a kill grants 'Bewildering Burst' for 🡅7 seconds.
While Bewildering Burst is active, your next Direct Hit spawns a Kinetic explosive above the target that detonates after a 0.85 second delay. The detonation deals 10 [4] damage and Disorients enemies within a 10 meter radius for 3.5 🡅[1.25] seconds.
🡅 Buff lasts for one additional second. Disorient lasts longer.

entries.name: Void Weapon Surge
entries.text:
Increases Void Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Firmly Planted
entries.text:
While Crouched:
• 🡅35 Handling and 🡅25 Stability
• -40% Accuracy Cone Size
• -17% Accuracy Cone Growth
• -80% horizontal Recoil
Effects are halved on Fusion Rifles (decimals are rounded up).
🡅 Grants 5 more Handling and Stability.

entries.name: Strand Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with with a Strand Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Lasting Impression
entries.text:
Passively grants 50 Blast Radius.
Rockets attach on impact and detonate after 3 seconds, dealing 35% increased Explosive Damage.
Due to the split of impact and explosive damage on Rocket Launchers, this perk only provides an overall increase of 26-27% damage for the sake of boss DPS.
Does not buff the damage of Wolfpack Rounds.

entries.name: Cerebral Uplink
entries.text:
Passively grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and 45% Additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
Highlights enemies below 50% HP in a red outline, and Enemy Players with fully-charged Supers in a yellow outline. Highlighting bypasses invisibility.

entries.name: Abyssal Extractors
entries.text:
Void Kills grant 'Abyssal Extractors' for 2.5 seconds. While active, kills with Soul Siphon and Void Kills on Suppressed enemies grant 4 seconds. Duration can be extended up to 20 seconds.
Soul Siphon hits inflict Suppression for 10 [?] seconds.
Abyssal Extractor grants the following benefits:
• 300% additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Recharge Rate
• 200% additional Base Super and Class Ability Recharge Rate

entries.name: Actual Grandeur
entries.text:
Scoring weapon Kills while Devour is active grants additional Super Energy, ranging between 1% to 4.5% depending on Enemy Rank. Works with any Super.
Massively increases Damage Resist during Nova Bomb cast: starts at 99.5% and drops down to 75% near the end.
Casting Nova Bomb grants the ability to cast 'Nova Bomb: Lance' for 5 seconds. Destroying a Nova Bomb: Cataclysm with the Lance triggers a Nova Vortex alongside the original Nova Bomb, effectively granting the effects of both Nova Bombs. Requires a minimum distance of 20 meters to trigger.
Nova Bomb returns ~5% Super Energy per kill, up to 50% Super Energy.

entries.name: Conduction Tines
entries.text:
While you have at least 1 Arc Ability equipped:
Arc Ability and Jolt Kills grant a Stack of Conduction Tines for 10 [4] seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
There is a very short cooldown for acquiring Stacks.
Conduction Tines 1|2|3 grant the following:
• 167.5%|335%|502.5% additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Super Regeneration Rate
• 22%|44%|66% decreased Passive Stormtrance Super Drain
• Casting Ionic Sentry spawns a Storm Grenade on its point of impact

entries.name: Cooling Baubles
entries.text:
Collecting an Orb of Power or Elemental Pickup dissipates 33% Weapon Heat.
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

entries.name: Marksman's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs an evasive maneuver in your movement input's direction that instantly reloads all equipped weapons and collects ammo bricks that are on the ground within a 15 meter radius of you.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

entries.name: Gambler's Dodge
entries.text:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Grants 1% [0.35%] Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] at 100 Melee Stat.
Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of 200% [70%] energy.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: On Black Wings
entries.text:
Scoring a pellet kill or landing 10 pellets grants one stack of 'On Black Wings' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
On Black Wings grants the following at 1|2|3| stacks:
• 15.6%|39%|54.7% increased Slug Precision damage
• 3.5%|8.8%|12.4% increased Pellet Precision Damage
• ? Reload Speed
• ? Reload Speed Animation Duration
Precision Hits with slug rounds refresh buff duration.

entries.name: Hands-On
entries.text:
Melee Kills grant additional Super energy based on Enemy Rank with 1|2|3 mods:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: ?% | ?% | ?%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 1.33?% | ?% | ?%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?% | ?% | ?%
• T4 Minors, T3-T4 Elites, and higher: 5?% | ?% | ?%
• Players: ?% | ?% | ?%
Kill can only trigger either Hands On or Ashes to Assets but not both.

entries.name: To the Pain
entries.text:
Every 30 points of damage taken with the weapon readied grants a Stack of 'To the Pain'. Maximum of 10 Stacks. Stowing the weapon removes all Stacks.
Each Stack grants ? Handling and 2 Aim Assist, maxing out at ? Handling and 20 Aim Assist.
Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.

entries.name: Alethonym Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants the One For All trait:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Arc Conductor
entries.text:
Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Arc Conductor' for 6 seconds.
While Arc Conductor is active, gain 50% [15%] Damage Resistance to Arc Damage and emit chain lightning around you in a 12 meter radius every 0.25 seconds, dealing 171 [26] damage per tick. On single targets, a bonus second tick triggers every 1.5 seconds.
Lightning is treated as sword damage.
Buff is removed on stow.

entries.name: Closing Time
entries.text:
Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% capacity to empty:
• 10 to 20 Range
• 30? to 50? Handling
• 10-20% decreased Handling Animation Duration
• 5?% to 10?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.
🡅 Stronger effect.

entries.name: Jolting Feedback
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits with the weapon within 3 seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to apply Jolt.
Being Amplified decreases the number of Hits required.
Hits needed to activate normally | while Amplified:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 18 | 13
• Machine Guns: 16 | 11
• Auto Rifles: 15 | 11
• Pulse Rifles: 14 | 9
• Sidearms: 10 | 7
• Rocket Pulse Rifle: 8 | 5
• Scout Rifles, Hand Cannons: 7 | 6
• Swords: 6 | 4
• Glaives, Linear Fusion Rifles: 4 | 3
• Rocket Sidearm, Sniper Rifle?: 4 | 2
• Bows, Grenade Launchers: 3 | 2
• Shotguns, Aggressive Frame Fusion Rifle: 3|1

entries.name: Traveler's Chosen Catalyst
entries.text:
Increases Magazine Size by 2 (15🠚17)
Grants the Surplus trait:
Grants Stat Bonuses depending on the number of Charged Abilities.
Stat Bonuses with 1|2|3+ Charged Abilities:
• 5|15|25 Stability
• 5|25|60 Handling
• 10|25|60 Reload Speed
Also grants the Osmosis trait:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.
Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.
Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on Primary, 15% on Special).
Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.

entries.name: Harmonic Holster
entries.text:
After stowing a Weapon matching your Super Element:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.name: Harbinger's Pulse
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Void Kills from any source within 4.5 seconds of each refills the magazine.
Kills with Telesto count as 2.

entries.name: No Distractions
entries.text:
Grants 35% Flinch Resistance after 🡅0.9 seconds of Aiming Down Sights (ADS) without firing. Remains active until you're no longer ADS.
Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.
🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.

entries.name: Tracking Module
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights and targeting an Enemy:
Fired Rockets track the targeted enemy. Diminshed effectiveness in PVP.
Tracking persists for 1 second once no longer aiming at the enemy.

entries.name: Dragon's Vengeance
entries.text:
Grants the following benefits for 11 seconds upon reaching Critical Health, or on Ally Death:
• Refills magazine from reserves
• 5 Range and 10 Handling
• Decreases Charge/Draw Time by 2.5%

entries.name: Discord
entries.text:
Grants the following for 7 seconds upon readying the weapon within 5? seconds of scoring a Kill with a different weapon:
• 25% decreased ADS Animation Duration
• 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness
Weapon Kills while Discord is active fully refill the Magazine of Primary Weapons, and refund 1 Ammo for Special and Power Weapons. (Scoring multiple kills with a single shot/burst still only refunds 1 ammo.)

entries.name: Ticuu's Divination Catalyst
entries.text:
Triggering Sacred Flame explosions grants one stack of 'Causality Quiver' for 5.5 seconds. Marking enemies with Sacred Flame refreshes the buff. Maximum of 6 stacks.
Causality Quiver increases the impact damage of your arrows (not the explosion) at 1|2|3|4|5|6 stacks:
• PvE: 16%|31%|49%|67.5%|87%|87%
• PvP: 3.6%|11%|12%|16%|23%|23%

entries.name: Strand Dexterity
entries.text:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Strand Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.name: Unflinching Strand Aim
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights with Strand Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.name: Void Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Void Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Aggressive Frame
entries.text: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after kill.

entries.name: Envious Arsenal
entries.text: Dealing any damage with both of your other weapons refills the magazine from reserves upon readying the weapon.

entries.name: Veist Stinger
entries.text:
Hits have a chance to trigger 'Veist Stinger' for 7 seconds, granting the following bonuses:
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
• 15% decreased Draw Time to Bows
• ? Charge Rate to Swords
• Refills 25% of Magazine from reserves on activation. Rounds up. Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
4 second cooldown between activations.
Activation Chance on hits:
• Auto Rifle, Submachine Gun: 2%
• Sidearm: 4%
• Bow, Linear Fusion Rifle, Sniper Rifle: 10%

entries.name: Skulking Wolf
entries.text:
Weapon Kills while at or below 90 HP grant the following benefits for 10 seconds:
• Enhanced Radar (6⁠🠚⁠12 sectors)
• Removes you from passively pinging enemy radars
• PvE Combatants become less accurate when targeting you
Firing weapons will still ping enemy radars for 2 seconds. (Radar Blip indicates that it's only visible for 0.75 seconds; this is inaccurate)

entries.name: Deconstruct
entries.text:
Upon scoring multiple hits within 6 seconds of each:
• Refills 10% of the Magazine (rounded up) from reserves. Can be reactivated without a cooldown. Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
• Grants 40% increased damage against Constructs and Vehicles for 5 seconds. Additional hits refresh the buff duration.
Number of Hits Required:
• If Magazine Size is 1: 3 Hits
• Otherwise: 2 + 50% (25% on Primary Weapons) of Base Magazine Capacity rounded down
Hits against Constructs and Vehicles provide 1.5x activation progress for Primary weapons and 2x progress for Special weapons.
Wave Frame Grenade Launchers:
• Direct Impacts count as 2 Hits
• Doesn't receive bonus activation progress against Constructs and Vehicles

entries.name: Stacks on Stacks
entries.text: All Armor Charge sources grant an additional Stack.

entries.name: Tommy's Matchbook Catalyst
entries.text: While Ignition Trigger is active, kills grant 60 HP (Cure x1) and every 5th shot applies 15 [10] Scorch. Ember of Ashes increases this to 20 for both PvE and PvP.

entries.name: Adept Stability
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Stability.

entries.name: Special Finisher
entries.text: Finishers consume 3 Stacks of Armor Charge and generate a Special Ammo Brick for you and allies.

entries.name: One-Two Finisher
entries.text:
Finishers consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant Melee Ability Energy.
Energy Gains with 3|4|5|6 Stacks Consumed:
70% | 80% | 90% | 100%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Bulwark Finisher
entries.text:
Finishers consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant a 45 HP Void Overshield.
Overshield lasts 8|10|12|14 seconds with 3|4|5|6 Stacks of Armor Charge consumed.

entries.name: Healthy Finisher
entries.text: Finishers consume 1 Stack of Armor Charge to fully restore Health and Shields.

entries.name: Snapload Finisher
entries.text: Finishers consume 1 Stack of Armor Charge and refill all your weapons from reserves.

entries.name: Explosive Finisher
entries.text:
Finisher consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant Grenade Ability Energy.
Energy Gains with 3|4|5|6 Stacks Consumed:
70% | 80% | 90% | 100%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: String of Curses
entries.text:
Weapon Kills instantly refill the magazine and grant one stack of 'String of Curses' for 5.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
String of Curses Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• Increased Super Energy per kill: 0.8%|1.1%|1.4%|1.7%|2%
• Increased damage (PvE): 20%|40%|60%|80%|100%
• Increased damage (PvP): 10%|20%|30%|40%|50%
Scoring three kills within 7.5 seconds of each other triggers a Cursed Explosion at the enemy's location, dealing 305 [?] damage in a ? meter radius. Kills must be achived without performing a manual reload or stowing the gun.
Cursed Explosion kills count towards triggering the next explosion and benefit from String of Curses.

entries.name: Suros Synergy
entries.text:
Finishing a reload grants 40 Handling and 20% Flinch Resistance for 6 seconds.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Dual Speed Receiver
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to switch to this mode.
While Aiming Down Sights, RPM and Damage Profile are set to the High Impact Auto Rifle Archetype.
Grants 30 Range, increases Zoom by 3, and kills generate ?% increased Heavy Ammo Progress.

entries.name: Toxic Overload
entries.text:
Landing 14 Hits or 7 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each other, or scoring a kill, triggers a burst of Potent Corruption (Poison) at the target's location in a 5 meter radius.
Potent Corruption deals 32.35 [5?] damage on the first tick, then increases in damage every 0.52 [0.7] seconds for a total of 19 [?] ticks over 10 [?] seconds.
Potent Corruption damage increases by 11% per tick for the first 14 ticks, then by an average of 41% per tick for the last 5 ticks, dealing 1366 [?] damage over the entire duration.
Targets that die to the corruption trigger another burst of poison around them. Cooldown of 2 seconds.
Osteo Striga's poison counts as weapon damage and benefits from all related buffs. Reapplying the poison resets it back to the first stack.

entries.name: Collective Demolition
entries.text:
Collecting an Elemental Pickup enables Weapon Damage to generate Grenade Ability energy per hit for 8 seconds.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Shot Tangles extend the timer by 4 seconds. Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Thrown Tangles extend the timer by 8 seconds.
Timer can be extended to a maximum of 16 seconds.
Grenade energy granted by weapon type:
Spreadshot HC: 0.5%
Burst Sidearm: 0.78%
Fusion Rifle: 1.15%
Rocket Pulse: 1.95%
Sidearm: 2.34%
Scout: 3.34%
Rocket Launcher: 12.9%
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

entries.name: Misdirection
entries.text:
Class Ability usage applies Misdirection to enemies within 10 [22] meters.
Misdirection:
• Deals ~0 damage but counts as a Hit
• PVE: Disorients Minors and Elites for 5 seconds
• PVP: briefly distorts audio, Disorients, and disables Radar for 5 seconds

entries.name: Deflection Tang
entries.text: Blocking damage within 1 second of starting your guard grants 20% increased damage for 2 seconds.

entries.name: Distribution
entries.text:
Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Grenade, Melee, Class Ability, and Super Energy.
Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods Equipped:
• Ability Energy: 4% [2%] | 6% [3%] | 7% [3.5%]
• Super Energy: 2% [1%] | 3% [1.5%] | 4% [2%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website. (Super Energy gains are unaffected)

entries.name: Bolt Scavenger
entries.text:
Picking up a Crossbow Bolt grants ? Handling and ? Reload Speed for 4 seconds.
Picking up additional Bolts adds 3? seconds to the buff duration up to the maximum of 15 seconds.

entries.name: Headseeker
entries.text:
Dealing non-Precision Direct damage grants the following benefits for 0.55 seconds:
• 20% increased Precision Bonus (complicated, see specific damage increases below)
• 3% increased Aim Assist Cone size
Precision damage increases by weapon type/frame:
• Pulse Rifles: Adaptive: 7.1%, Aggressive Burst: 10%, Heavy Burst: 9.5%, High-Impact: 8.74%, Lightweight: 6.3%, Rapid-Fire: 10.3%
• Sidearms: Adaptive Burst: 8.46%, Heavy Burst: 7.36%
• Scout Rifles: Precision: 8.66%
[Bug] Heavy Burst Hand Cannons: 7% increased Weakspot damage.
The distinction between Weakspots and Critspots is complicated and we might write an explainer blog post about it eventually. For the purposes of PvP, the two are equivalent.
🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability.

entries.name: Sunburn
entries.text:
Fires explosive payloads that highlight targets for 1 second on direct impact.
In PvE, the explosive portion deals 14% more damage than the impact damage. In PvP, the split is equalized.

entries.name: Weapons Font
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Weapons stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.name: Feast of Light
entries.text:
Orbs of Power grant an additional 2% Super Energy.
This is decreased to 0.5% if Golden Gun: Marksman is the selected Super Ability.
Picking up an Orb of Power with a charged Super Ability grants a Stack of 'Feast of Light'. Maximum of 6 Stacks.
Casting your Super while at 1|2|3|4|5|6 Stacks consumes all Stacks and grants the following benefits:
• 18.2%|36.4%|54.6%|59.7%|64.8%|70% increased Super damage for 14 seconds
• Restores ?|?|?|?|?|200 HP
• 100 HP Overshield for 16 seconds if cast at 6 Stacks

entries.name: One for All
entries.text:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Physic
entries.text:
Triggering 'Support Frame Boost' by healing allies with the weapon grants its element-matching effect to the user as well as the targeted ally.
Effect granted based on Weapon Element:
Solar: Restoration x1 for 🡅5 seconds (🡅7.5 with Ember of Solace)
Arc: Amplified for 5 seconds
Stasis: x2 Frost Armor for 5 seconds
Strand: Releases 4 Unraveling Threads
Void: Grants a ?HP Void Overshield for ? Seconds
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 25%.

entries.name: Gear Shift
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill, or becoming Amplified, grants 1 stack of 'Gear Shift' for 🡅15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Grants 15%|20%|25%|30%|35% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks.
Buff can be triggered while stowed and refreshed with each new application of Amplified.
🡅 Buff duration is increased.

entries.name: Polaris Lance Catalyst
entries.text: Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing up to 123.89 [95.3] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4.5-meter radius.

entries.name: Reciprocity
entries.text:
Hitting allies with healing projectiles from the weapon restores 🡅3.5 HP to you for each projectile.
🡅 Restores an additional 0.5 HP per healing shot.

entries.name: Threat Detector
entries.text:
Grants 1|2 Stacks while within 15 meters of 1|2+ enemies.
Bonuses at 1|2 Stacks:
• 15|40 Stability
• 18|60 Reload Speed
• 25|100 Handling
• 0.9x|0.81x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Crow's Wings
entries.text:
Intrinsically deals 30% increased damage to Minor combatants.
Charged Heavy Attacks consume 50% Sword Energy to launch a Suppressing Void projectile.
Projectile hits on Suppressed targets Suppresses nearby enemies in an 8 meter radius.

entries.name: Aggressive Frame
entries.text: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after kill.

entries.name: Proximity Ward
entries.text: Grants a 200 HP Overshield for the duration of your Finisher Animation.

entries.name: Swashbuckler
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Swashbuckler' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
(Glaive) Melee Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly.
Damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
6.7% | 13.3% | 20% | 26.6% | 33.3%
Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.name: Relentless Strikes
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Powered Hits within 2? seconds of each refunds 1 ammo.
Wolfpack Round Hits do not count.
🡅 Allowed time between Hits is increased.

entries.name: Recuperation
entries.text: Orb of Power Pickups immediately restore 15|21|21 HP with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Thorn Catalyst
entries.text:
Passively grants 15 Range, 5 Stability, and 5 Airborne Effectiveness.
Kills or collecting Remnants grants 'Refined Soul' for 7 seconds. Additional kills or Remnants can extend this timer up to 11 seconds.
Refined Soul grants 10 Range, 15 Handling, and 50 Mobility.

entries.name: One Quiet Moment
entries.text:
After not having exchanged damage for 1 second:
Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier. Swords receive up to a 12.5% increase to Movement Speed instead.
After not having exchanged damage for 2 seconds:
Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 5% decresed Reload Duration. Swords receive up to a 25% increase to Movement Speed instead.
Can activate while stowed.
Exchanging damage refers to either dealing or receiving damage. Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.

entries.name: Winged Eclipse
entries.text:
Kills charge up 'Winged Eclipse', with progress granted based on Enemy Rank.
• Minor Enemies: 1
• Elite Enemies: 2
• Miniboss+ and Guardians: 3
At six charges, replaces your grenade abilty with two charges of Loyal Moths. Incurs a six second cooldown upon spending both charges before progress can be gained.
Moth Grenades explode on impact, releasing 2 Loyal Moths that fly to their nearest target. Moths that spawn closer to allies turn into Void Moths, while Moths that spawn closer to enemies turn into Arc Moths.
Loyal Moth variants:
• Arc Moths: slower-flying, offensive role. They seek out targets at 10m/s and detonate on contact, dealing up to 526 [31 to Players, 201 to Objects] damage in a 4 meter radius and Blinding targets. Counts as Arc Grenade Damage.
• Void Moths: faster-flying, support role. They seek out allies at 25m/s and grant them a 22.5 HP Void Overshield on contact.

entries.name: Impromptu Ammunition
entries.text:
Weapon Kills grant 15% improved Special ammo generation and 10% improved Heavy ammo generation from all sources for 🡅5.5 seconds. Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration up to 7 seconds.
Buff is additive to Ammo Finder Helmet mods.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Invisible Hand
entries.text:
Consecutively missing multiple times within 2.5 seconds of each grants 25? Stability for 2.5 seconds.
Buff is removed 1? second after scoring a Hit. Missing again refreshes the buff duration.
Misses in a row required:
• Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns: 10
• Pulse Rifles: 9
• Hand Cannons: 4
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 2
🡅 Deactivation time after scoring a hit is increased.

entries.name: Touch of Venom
entries.text:
Requires a Void Melee to be equipped in order to function.
Killing Weakened enemies grants 30% Void Melee Energy and releases a Weakening puff of Void Smoke at their location.
Void Smoke is functionally identical to Smoke Bomb and triggers melee-associated effects.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.text:
After being in Combat for 12 seconds:
Grants 15% increased damage, 100 Handling, and 100 Reload Speed for 7.2 seconds.
Works and can activate while stowed. Dealing and receiving damage refreshes the buff duration.
For Frenzy, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds.
Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.

entries.name: Sun Blast
entries.text:
Kills cause targets to explode, dealing 432 [160] damage and applying 10 Scorch (15 with Ember of Ashes) in a 6 meter radius.
Explosion damage falls to 40% at the edge of its radius.
Explosion kills can chain into additional explosions.

entries.name: Snapshot Sights
entries.text:
Passively decreases the ADS Animation Duration:
• 50% decrease on Primary Weapons
• 20% decrease on Special Weapons
🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability.

entries.name: Acrobat's Focus
entries.text:
Using a Grapple grants Woven Mail for 10 seconds and restores 7 HP.
Woven Mail grants %? Flinch Resistance and kills with it active restore 17 HP.

entries.name: Panic Response
entries.text:
Magazine is refilled every 0.2 seconds based on currently remaining ammo while not firing the weapon.
Refill amount by currently remaining ammo:
• 1-2 Ammo: 4 shots
• 3-8 Ammo: 3 shots
• 9-16 Ammo: 2 shots
• 17 Ammo: 1 shot
Generates 2% Blight per hit. Not firing for 1.3 seconds drains 3.33% Blight every 1.2 seconds.
Performing a manual reload creates Blighted Seekers for 7 seconds, granting 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight converted. Maximum of 6 Seekers. Blight always rounds up to the next full Seeker.
Grants ? Reload Speed based on the amount of Blighted Seekers prepared.
Blighted Seekers are fired at 720 RPM while aiming down sights or 450 RPM if fired from the hip.

entries.name: Crossing Over
entries.text:
As the Magazine drops from full to 50% capacity:
Linearly scales down from granting 10 Range and ? Handling to 50% strength.
As the Magazine drops from 50% capacity to empty:
Linearly grants 1.5% to 3% increased damage, reaching maximum strength with the second to last bullet.

entries.name: Sharp Harvest
entries.text:
Scoring 3 Powered Sword Hits within 1.5? seconds of each grants 5% of Special Ammo reserves.
Equipping two Special Weapons halves the amount of ammo granted to 2.5% for each one.

entries.name: Trinary Vision
entries.text:
Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that can [cannot] deal overlapping damage.
Each projectile deals 581 [?] damage and travels 12 meters across the ground.

entries.name: Trinary Vision
entries.text:
Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that can [cannot] deal overlapping damage.
Each projectile deals 581 [?] damage and travels 12 meters across the ground.

entries.name: Trinary Vision
entries.text:
Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that can [cannot] deal overlapping damage.
Each projectile deals 581 [?] damage and travels 12 meters across the ground.

entries.name: Drop Mag
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier.
Decreases Magazine Size Stat by 30. (Equivalent to the "inverse" of Extended Mag)

entries.name: Disease Vector
entries.text:
Nanite Damage is increased by 25%.
Enemies that die with Nanites attached to them release four Nanites around them, each dealing 13 [4] damage.

entries.name: Bray Legacy
entries.text:
Hits with the weapon grant ability energy to the most charged ability. Does not require Direct Hits.
Does not grant any energy to abilities that you already have a full charge of.
Ability energy gains by weapon:
• VS Pyroelectric Propellant: 0.2%
• VS Velocity Baton: 0.365%
• VS Gravitic Arrest: 0.425%
• VS Chill Inhibitor: 3.5%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries.text: While Solo, or Last Guardian Standing, gain 100 Health Stat, ? Handling, and 30 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Reign Havoc
entries.text: Kills spawn a Lightning Strike, dealing 232 [65] damage in a 5 meter radius and grant x1 Bolt Charge.

entries.name: Reaper
entries.text:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds of using your Class Ability spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)
10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Häkke Light Burst Fire
entries.text: Becomes an Aggressive-Burst Frame Pulse Rifle.

entries.name: Iron Gaze
entries.text: Passively increases Aim Assist by 20 but decreases Range by 20.

entries.name: Bitterspite
entries.text:
Taking 20 damage grants a Stack of Bitterspite. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 10 | 20 | 30 | 40 | 50 Reload Speed
• 0.97x | 0.96x | 0.95x | 0.92x | 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
Reloading the weapon consumes all Stacks.

entries.name: Outreach
entries.text:
Class Ability usage grants Melee Energy.
Melee Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Turncoat Catalyst
entries.text:
Upon exiting Void Empowerment, gain a Void Overshield for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence).
The amount of Void Overshield granted is determined by how long you were empowered. 3 HP is granted for for each second that Empowerment lasted, capping at 40 HP for 13 seconds of Empowerment.

entries.name: Lucky Shot
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Precision Kill grants 'Lucky Shot Ready'.
Scoring a Precision Hit while you have Lucky Shot Ready refills the magazine by 1 from reserves and begins a 🡅7 second timer. Additional precision hits during this timer continue to refill the magazine from reserves.
🡅 Buff duration is increased.

entries.name: Insatiable
entries.text:
Super Ability activation fully restores Health, Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy for you and allies within ? meters.
Grants 66% Grenade and Melee Ability Energy per second for 8 seconds after your Super ends.

entries.name: Barrel Constrictor
entries.text:
Kills with the weapon reduce Pellet/Projectile Spread by 20% for 🡅8.5 seconds.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.
🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.name: Ember of Resolve
entries.text: Grenade Kills grant Cure x1.

entries.name: Ember of Mercy
entries.text:
Firesprite pickups grant Restoration x1 for 2 seconds (3 with Ember of Solace). Extends Restoration's duration by the same amount if it's already active.
Collecting a Firesprite while Restoration's timer is above 15 seconds will lower it back down to 15 seconds.
Reviving allies grants you and allies within ? meters Restoration x1 for 5 seconds (7.5 with Ember of Solace).

entries.name: Grenade Kickstart
entries.text:
When a Grenade Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Grenade Ability Energy.
Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Grenade Energy refunds.
Grenade Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Tireless Blade
entries.text:
Your first Powered Sword Kill after (re)spawning refunds 1 Ammo. Afterward, every other Powered Sword Kill also refunds 1 Ammo.
🡅 ?% chance to be granted 1 more Ammo.

entries.name: Cursebringer
entries.text:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.
Precision Kills, Cursed Thrall Explosion Kills, or killing a Poisoned enemy grants 70 Reload Speed, 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration, and trigger a Cursed Thrall Explosion at the target's location.
Cursed Thrall Explosions deal up to 630 [130] Arc damage and inflict Corruption (Poison) over an 8 meter radius. Corruption lasts for 3.5 seconds and deals 18 [0.4] damage every 0.5 seconds.
Kills with Cursed Thrall Explosions refill the magazine.
Cursed Thrall Explosion and Corruption inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

entries.name: Touch of Winter
entries.text:
Enhances your Stasis Grenade abilities:
•  Coldsnap Grenades duplicate upon freezing an enemy, turning into two and then four additional seekers on hit. For each enemy hit, spawn a Small, Medium, and then Large Stasis Crystal on the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd stage of Seeker duplication
• Duskfield Grenades gain 50% increased radius and spawn a Small Stasis Crystal on impact
• Glacial Grenades now form in a heptagon pattern (7-sided circle) with two additional Large Stasis Crystals added to the formation
• Shatter Grenades create ? additional shrapnel upon detonating. Hitting Frozen targets with the Shatter Grenade refunds 20?% Grenade Ability Energy.

entries.name: Revolution
entries.text:
Hold [Reload] to activate Arc Seeker mode.
Arc Seeker Mode reduces Fire Rate to 100 RPM and shoots tracking bolts that deal 76 [50] damage in a 3 meter radius.
Special Note:
Bolt Charge that is discharged through Arc Seeker hits counts as 'Scout Rifle Weapon Damage' and benefits from all increases that apply to this damage type. This allows the Bolt Charge detonations to scale both with traditional weapon damage buffs (like Radiant and Surges) and with Combatant Scalars.
Furthermore, hits that would discharge Bolt Charge anyway (such as hits behind a Storm's Keep barricade or hits as the caster of a Well of Radiance) cause Bolt Charge to discharge twice, with one buffed as weapon damage and the other being a regular discharge.
This damage increase to Bolt Charge can be further compounded by the Flashover Artifact Mod from the Tablet of Ruin, which adds a multiplicative 50%.

entries.name: Bomber
entries.text:
Class Ability usage grants Grenade Energy.
Grenade Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [6%] | 17% [8.5%] | 20% [10%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Ursine Guard
entries.text:
Increases movement speed by 15% while guarding with Unbreakable or Sentinel Shield.
Blocking damage with Sentinel Shield refunds Super Energy after it ends. Maximum of a 50% refund.
Damage Blocked with an active Overshield does not count towards the Super Energy Refund.
Blocking damage Unbreakable refunds 15% [?%] Grenade energy after recieving ? [?] damage. Blocking additional damage can refund up to 60% [?%] Grenade energy.

entries.name: Breakthrough
entries.text:
Fires a three-burst volley with 7 pellets in each burst.
Shots intrinsically stun Unstoppable champions.

entries.name: Proximity Power
entries.text:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of an enemy grant a stack of Proximity Power 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Each stack grants 15 Melee stat.

entries.name: Flow State
entries.text:
Killing a Jolted enemy grants Amplified.
Grants the following benefits while Amplified:
• 200% Increased Base Class Ability Rengeneration Rate
• 66% [32%] Damage Resistance during your Dodge animation
• 50 Reload Speed
• 20% Decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.name: Tempest Strike
entries.text:
Killing Jolted enemies grants x1 Bolt Charge.
Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding launches an Arc Uppercut that travels 22 meters and Jolts all enemies hit. Grants 75% damage resistance against Combatants for 4 seconds after cast.
Tempest Strike can consume and receive the benefits of Combination Blow and Lethal Current's aftershock.
Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.

entries.name: Lethal Current
entries.text:
Direct Melee Hits on Jolted targets Blinds them for ? seconds.
Casting your Class Ability grants 'Lethal Current' for 10 seconds, which is consumed on your next melee hit.
Lethal Current increases Melee Lunge Distance to 7 meters, causes your next Direct Melee Hit to apply Jolt, and triggers a damaging 6 meter radius Arc Explosion.
Lethal Current can consume and receive the benefits of Combination Blow.

entries.name: Ascension
entries.text:
Casting [Air Move] with full Class Ability Energy consumes the charge and vertically thrusts you ? meters into the air.
Ascension deals damage and Jolts enemies within a 10 meter radius of the cast, while granting Amplified to you and all allies within that same radius.
Casting Ascension triggers the effects of your equipped dodge. Scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.

entries.name: Meganeura
entries.text:
Precision Hits grant one stack of Meganeura for 🡅4 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing 123.89 [95.3] | 173.6 [?] | 207.57 [?] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 7.5-meter radius at 1|2|3| stacks.
Explosion has up to 50% damage falloff at the furthest point.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased.

entries.name: Detonator Beam
entries.text: Scoring 25 Hits within ? seconds of each triggers an explosion around the target, dealing up to 250 [?] weapon element-matching damage in an 8 meter radius.

entries.name: Whirling Ovation Catalyst
entries.text:
Fully charged rockets overpenetrate through Minor and Elite combatants, leaving a Solar Grenade behind at each combatant's death location for 2? seconds.
Solar Grenade can benefit from the Touch of Flame Aspect, but not from Sunbracers.

entries.name: Gutshot Straight
entries.text:
While Aiming Down Sights:
• Increased Body Shot damage
• 🡅10% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size (No effect on Magnetism AKA reticle stickiness)
Body Shot damage increases:
• Auto/Scout/Sniper Rifles, Bows, Hand Cannons: 20%
• Pulse/Trace Rifles, Sidearms, SMGs, LMGs: 10%
🡅 Reduces Auto Aim penalty by 33?% (15%⁠🠚⁠10%).

entries.name: Target Lock Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Target Lock trait:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.
Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.
% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%
Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [10.46%] to 40% [25%] upon reaching maximum strength.
Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.

entries.name: One for All Refit
entries.text:
Grants the One For All trait:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.name: Hatchling Refit
entries.text:
Grants the Hatchling trait:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

entries.name: High-Impact Reserves Refit
entries.text:
Grants the High-Impact Reserves trait:
Increases damage by 12.1% [3%] to 25.6% [6%] as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty.
The buff in PVE ranges between 10.3% and 22.9% instead on Fusion Rifles and Aggressive Frame Linear Fusion Rifles.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.name: Killing Wind
entries.text:
On Weapon Kill, for 🡅5.5 seconds:
• 50 Mobility
• 40 Handling and 20 Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
Additional Kills extend the duration by 5 seconds, up to 8 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.
🡅 Initial Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: The Corruption Spreads
entries.text:
Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal 77 [13] damage each.
Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.

entries.name: Thread of Propagation
entries.text: Powered Melee Kills Grant Unraveling Rounds to your Strand Weapons for 8 [5] seconds.

entries.name: Thread of Evolution
entries.text: Threadlings deal 33% [12.5%] increased damage, move 30?% faster, and travel farther.

entries.name: Thread of Ascent
entries.text:
Using your Grenade Ability refills your readied weapon from reserves and grants the following stat bonuses for 15 seconds:
• 40? Handling
• 40 Reload Speed
• 0.925x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness
4 second cooldown between Magazine Refills.

entries.name: Thread of Finality
entries.text: Finishers spawn a Threadling.

entries.name: Thread of Mind
entries.text:
Killing Suspensded enemies grants Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 12%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Players: 15%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 30%
1? second cooldown between activations.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Thread of Fury
entries.text:
Dealing damage with Tangles grants Melee Energy per damage instance based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 18%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20%
• Players: 25%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 30%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Thread of Rebirth
entries.text:
Scoring Strand Weapon Kills spawns Threadlings upon reaching 100% Activation Progress.
Activation Progress gained and Threadling Count vary based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 34% Activation Progress | 1 Threadling
• Elites: 67% | 2
• Minibosses and Bosses: 100% | 3

entries.name: Thread of Transmutation
entries.text:
Weapon Kills while you have Woven Mail spawn a Tangle at the target's location.
Shares the 12 second global Tangle creation cooldown.

entries.name: Thread of Warding
entries.text: Orb of Power Pickups grant Woven Mail for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Thread of Wisdom
entries.text:
Killing Suspended enemies spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Symmetry Catalyst
entries.text:
Grants 10 Reload Speed and 10 Handling.
Dynamic Charge's maximum stack count is is increased by 5 (15🠚20), allowing for up to 600% increased damage and 100% increased radius.
Grants the Eddy Current trait:
Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier
Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.
Being Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.

entries.name: Soaring Fusilier
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles.
Fusion Rifle and Linear Fusion Rifle Kills grant Radiant for 7.5 seconds (11.25 with Ember of Solace).
Air Dodges refill all equipped weapons from reserves. Air Dodges include both Icarus Dash and Weavewalk.

entries.name: Heal Clip
entries.text:
Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants Cure x2 to you and Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.
🡅 Allowed time before reloading is increased.

entries.name: The Gift of Certainty
entries.text:
Casting Ascension or Tempest Strike releases 3 tracking Arc Projectiles that each deal up to 200 [40] Arc damage and apply Jolt on Hit.
Applying Jolt to enemies within 15? meters grants you a Damage Resist buff for 10 seconds that can stack 3 times.
Damage Resist granted with 1|2|3 Jolt applications (Resist x2|x3|x4):
25% [5%] | 40% [7.5%] | 50% [10%]
Applying Jolt to multiple targets with a single activation of a Jolt source still only counts as a single application.

entries.name: Glorious Charge
entries.text:
Melee Kills while Amplified grant additional Super Energy:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 2.5?%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2.5%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 3%
• Players: ?%
Thundercrash deals 55% increased damage.
Thundercrash deactivation grants 50% [10%] Damage Resistance for ? seconds.

entries.name: Strand Loader
entries.text:
Grants the following to Strand Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.name: Subsistence
entries.text:
Weapon Kills refill 🡅20% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.
🡅 Refill amount is increased by an additive 10%. (3% on Submachine Guns and Auto Rifles)

entries.name: Whirling Maelstrom
entries.text:
Detonating a Tangle morphs it into a spinning, seeking, damaging construct that roams the environment.
Whirling Tangles last for 12 seconds and continually seek targets, dealing damage to enemies in a 2 meter radius every 0.1 seconds.
Defeating enemies with a Whirling Maelstrom releases Unraveling projectiles.
Whirling Maelstrom counts as Tangle Hits and (inconsistently) counts as Ability Damage.

entries.name: Threaded Specter
entries.text:
Base Class Ability Regeneration Speed is decreased by 40% while equipped.
Casting your Class Ability spawns a 'Threaded Specter' decoy in your place for 12 seconds.
Decoy has 175 HP, 70% Damage Resistance against Combatants, and lures enemy attacks for its duration. Players deal 150% bonus damage to the decoy.
Once destroyed, or if an enemy gets within ? meters of the decoy after it has been active for 3 seconds, the decoy explodes for damage and releases two Threadlings.
Damage scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.

entries.name: Ensnaring Slam
entries.text:
Casting [Air Move] with full Class Ability Energy consumes the charge and causes you to dive to the ground, Suspending all enemies in an 8 [6.5] meter radius on impact.
Gain 4 seconds of Woven Mail per enemy Suspended, up to a maximum of 20 seconds.
Ensnaring Slam triggers the effects of your equipped dodge upon consumption.

entries.name: Widow's Silk
entries.text:
Grants an additional Grenade Ability Charge.
Your Grapple leaves behind a 'Grapple Tangle' on its point of impact, allowing for repeated use of Grapple. The Grapple Tangle will not be created if it attaches to an enemy or ally.
Dealing damage with a Grapple Melee Hit (inconsistently) creates a Grapple Tangle, which rises into the air for future use. The Grapple Tangle will only be created if the Grapple used was not previously refunded by attaching to a Tangle or Grapple Tangle.

entries.name: Mobius Conduit
entries.text:
Upon casting Gathering Storm:
• Releases lightning at enemies within ? meters of you, dealing 650 [?] damage and Jolting them
• You and allies within ? meters become Amplified
Lightning strikes (inconsistently) refund up to 50% Super Energy on Arc-Debuffed enemy Hits or Kills based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: ?% on Hits | ? on Kills
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: ?% | ?%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?% | ?%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25?% | ?%
Arc-Debuffed enemy Kills (inconsistently) grant additional Gathering Storm Super Energy:
• Minors: 1%
• Elites: 2.5%
• Players, Minibosses and higher: 4%
Inconsistencies are only(?) observed with Jolted enemies. Possibly due to killing enemies too fast after triggering Jolt's damage.

entries.name: Bottomless Grief
entries.text:
Passively grants 30 Magazine stat. (Identical to Extended Mag)
Kills refill the magazine while Last Guardian Standing. Does not activate when playing solo.

entries.name: Solar Siphon
entries.text:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Solar Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.name: Dead Messenger Catalyst
entries.text:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Parasite Catalyst
entries.text: Dealing any damage with both of your other weapons refills the magazine from reserves upon readying the weapon.

entries.name: Dawning Surprise
entries.text:
Scoring multiple Kills with the weapon spawns a Dawning Gift for you and allies. Dawning Gifts remain on the ground for 10 seconds.
Picking up Dawning Gifts grants 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy, restores 22 HP, and starts Health Regeneration.
Activation progress on Kills by Enemy Rank:
• Minors and Guardians: 16.66%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 50%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.name: Distribution
entries.text:
Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Grenade, Melee, Class Ability, and Super Energy.
Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods Equipped:
• Ability Energy: 4% [2%] | 6% [3%] | 7% [3.5%]
• Super Energy: 2% [1%] | 3% [1.5%] | 4% [2%]
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website. (Super Energy gains are unaffected)

entries.name: Full Auto Trigger System
entries.text:
Weapon fires Full Auto. (Identical to the setting)
Decreases Firing Delay by 10% on Shotguns.

entries.name: Bastion Catalyst
entries.text: Dealing Melee Damage refills 20% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants ? Handling for ? seconds.

entries.name: Valiant Charge
entries.text:
Taking any damage while Guarding increases Lunge Distance by 80% for the next swing within 🡅1.5 seconds.
Guarding while receiving Healing Effects (including healing over time from Restoration) from allies also activates the perk.
🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Valiant Charge
entries.text:
Taking any damage while Guarding increases Lunge Distance by 80% for the next swing within 1 second.
Guarding while receiving Healing Effects (including healing over time from Restoration) from allies also activates the perk.

entries.name: Adept Handling
entries.text: Passively grants 10 Handling.

entries.name: Arc Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Arc Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.name: White Nail IV
entries.text: Landing 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each refills the magazine. Pulls 2 shots from reserves and generates 1 ammo from thin air.

entries.name: White Nail III
entries.text: Landing 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each refills the magazine. Pulls 2 shots from reserves and generates 1 ammo from thin air.

entries.name: White Nail II
entries.text: Landing 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each refills the magazine. Pulls 2 shots from reserves and generates 1 ammo from thin air.

entries.name: Strand Reserves
entries.text:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Strand Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).
Currently bugged and does not work with Swords.

entries.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
entries.text:
While the perk's buff isn't active, Weapon Kills grant 'Golden Tricorn x1' for 7 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 15%. Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to 🡅8 seconds.
While Golden Tricorn x1 or x2 is active:
Grenade or Elemental Melee Kills matching the element of the Weapon grant Golden Tricorn x2 for 10 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 50%.
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.
🡅 Golden Tricorn x1's duration is refreshed to 8 seconds.

entries.name: Incandescent
entries.text:
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

entries.name: Arc Holster
entries.text:
After stowing Arc Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.
